programme.title: Killers Bodyguard 2
programme.desc: Bodyguard Michael Bryce no longer has a license and is under surveillance. But Sonia Kincaid, the wife of contract killer Darius Kincaid, forces him to act. She needs Bryce's help to free Darius from gangsters. The three are then involved in another dangerous mission. They must thwart the plans of the crazy Aristotle Papadopoulos, otherwise Europe will be plunged into chaos. / Der Bodyguard Michael Bryce hat keine Lizenz mehr und steht unter Beobachtung. Doch Sonia Kincaid, die Frau des Auftragmorders Darius Kincaid, zwingt ihn zum Handeln. Sie braucht Bryces Hilfe, um Darius von Gangstern zu befreien. Daraufhin werden die drei in eine andere gefahrliche Mission verwickelt. Sie mussen Plane vom verruckten Aristotle Papadopoulos vereiteln, ansonsten wird Europa ins Chaos gesturzt.

programme.title: 9-1-1 Emergency Call L.A. / 9-1-1 Notruf L.A.
programme.desc: Die Serie begleitet Polizisten, Rettungssanitater und Feuerwehrleute im Arbeitsalltag. Es werden unter anderem Erfahrungen der Ersthelfer geschildert, die regelmaSSig unvorhersehbare und herzzerreiSSende Situationen erleben.

programme.title: ZIB Zack Mini
programme.desc: Die Sendung vermittelt taglich Zusammenhange und Hintergrunde fur Sechs- bis Zehnjahrige.

programme.title: Pippi Langstrumpf
programme.desc: Pippi Longstocking is a cheeky nine-year-old girl with freckles, two sticky red braids and different colored stockings. She lives without parents, but with a horse and a monkey in a large, colorful villa. She doesn't let anyone dictate anything to her, she is brave, generous and so strong that she can even lift her horse. Together with her friends Tommy and Annika she experiences the craziest adventures. / Pippi Langstrumpf ist ein freches neunjahriges Madchen mit Sommersprossen, zwei abstehenden roten Zopfen und unterschiedlich gefarbten Strumpfen. Sie lebt ohne Eltern, aber mit einem Pferd und einem Affen in einer groSSen bunten Villa. Sie lasst sich von niemandem etwas vorschreiben, ist mutig, groSSzugig und so stark, dass sie sogar ihr Pferd hochstemmen kann. Zusammen mit ihren Freunden Tommy und Annika erlebt sie die verrucktesten Abenteuer.

programme.title: The hunt for the Kju Wang / Die Jagd nach dem Kju Wang
programme.desc: The city of Venice, inhabited by birds, is ruled by a powerful duke. This duke owns a valuable gemstone, the Kju-Wang, which symbolizes his power. The ambassador of a foreign country wants to steal the Kju-Wang. / Die Stadt Venedig, die von Vogeln bewohnt wird, wird von einem machtigen Herzog regiert. Dieser Herzog besitzt einen wertvollen Edelstein den Kju-Wang, der seine Macht symbolisiert. Der Botschafter eines fremden Landes will den Kju-Wang stehlen.

programme.title: Servus Kasperl
programme.sub-title: Kasperl and Co: Mitternachts im Marchenmoor
programme.desc: Die Sendung prasentiert Malwettbewerbe, GeburtstagsgruSSe und Geschichten mit dem Kasperl.

programme.title: The miracle YOU / Das Wunder DU
programme.desc: Die Kindersendung befasst sich mit wissenschaftlichen Themen rund um den menschlichen Korper.

programme.title: Tolle Tiere
programme.desc: Kurt the cat goes on a journey through the Schonbrunn Zoo. It introduces native and exotic wild animals as well as popular and unusual pets. As zoo helpers, two children also experience working with the zoo animals up close. / Kater Kurt begibt sich auf eine Reise durch den Tiergarten Schonbrunn. Er stellt heimische und exotische Wildtiere sowie beliebte und ungewohnliche Haustiere vor. Als Zoohelfer erleben zwei Kinder zudem hautnah die Arbeit mit den Zootieren.

programme.title: Kiwi
programme.desc: Twini and Twiki are two animals made of plasticine who want to teach us English words through funny stories. Because every occasion is good for discovering some vocabulary and their spelling and learning them in a playful way. / Twini und Twiki sind zwei Tiere aus Knetmasse, die uns in lustigen Geschichten englische Worter naherbringen wollen. Denn jeder Anlass ist gut geeignet, um einige Vokabeln sowie deren Schreibweise zu entdecken und spielerisch zu lernen.

programme.title: Garfield
programme.sub-title: Lousy machines: combat in space / Miese Maschinen: Kampf im Weltall
programme.desc: Garfield, the world's laziest cat, is back and has more fun adventures. Garfield's quirky misadventures here are generally rougher and more bizarre than in the past. / Garfield, der faulste Kater der Welt ist zuruck und erlebt noch mehr witzige Abenteuer. Dabei fallen Garfields schrullige Missgeschicke hier in der Regel derber und bizarrer aus als in der Vergangenheit.

programme.title: Malcolm mittendrin
programme.desc: Ein hochbegabtes Kind muss mit seiner exzentrischen Familie umgehen. Die Cleavers sind eine mittelstandische US-Familie mit chaotischem Alltagsleben. Der kleine Malcom nutzt seine Intelligenz, um mit seinen Brudern Streiche auszuhecken.

programme.title: Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn Kiesewetter left the police service to run a farm. But when a fire destroys the farm, the burned-out ex-investigator returns to Lubeck and the police force. From now on he investigates here with Inspector Lars Englen. / Finn Kiesewetter hat den Polizeidienst verlassen, um einen Bauernhof zu fuhren. Doch als ein Brand den Hof zerstort, kehrt der abgebrannte Ex-Ermittler nach Lubeck und in den Polizeidienst zuruck. Fortan ermittelt er hier mit Kommissar Lars Englen.

programme.title: Smart10 - The quiz with the ten possibilities / Smart10 - Das Quiz mit den zehn Moglichkeiten
programme.desc: Zwei Zweierteams treten im Wissensduell bei Caroline Athanasiadis gegeneinander an. Dabei mussen die Teilnehmer Allgemeinwissen, gutes Teamwork, Taktik und Risikoeinschatzung unter Beweis stellen, um erfolgreich abzuschneiden.

programme.title: Q1 One note is incorrect / Q1 Ein Hinweis ist falsch
programme.desc: This quiz is all about clues. First, the topic of the searched term is announced. The candidates are supposed to get on the right track with the help of four clues - but only three of them are correct. / Bei diesem Quiz dreht sich alles um Hinweise. Zuerst wird das Thema des gesuchten Begriffes bekannt gegeben. Mithilfe von vier Hinweisen sollen die Kandidaten auf die richtige Spur kommen - doch nur drei davon sind richtig.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the “Jager”. This is not an easy task, because the “Jagers” are proven quiz professionals from the German national quiz team, including the German quiz master. In the first round, the candidates individually build up a game total, which they have to defend together against the “Jager” in the second round in order to advance to the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the “Jager” and defend the money they have earned so far. You must answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions correctly than the “Jager”, they win. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A gruesome violent crime occurs on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. To clear it up, London investigator Richard Poole is assigned to the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but he can't get used to the Caribbean mentality at all. This always creates entertaining situations. The meticulous suit wearer manages to solve the case together with his colleagues on site. They really want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like seafood. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk on the hunt for the missing jewel / Mr. Monk auf der Jagd nach dem verschwundenen Juwel
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.desc: Die engagierte Sonderkommission der Wiener Wasserschutzpolizei klart im GroSSraum der osterreichischen Hauptstadt Verbrechen auf. Der Fokus des Kriminalistenteams liegt dabei auf Straftaten, die an und auf der Donau sowie ihren Nebenflussen geschehen.

programme.desc: Das Tiroler Unterland mit seinen herausragenden sportlichen und touristischen Angeboten ist der Schauplatz des Polizeiteams um Kriminalbeamtin Karin Kofler und ihrem auf Kriminalpsychologie spezialisierten Kollegen Lukas Roither, die mit viel Sachverstand und Einfuhlungsvermogen den ortlichen Verbrechern das Handwerk legen. Dabei werden die Ermittler von Karins Vater Hannes unterstutzt, der das legendare Gasthaus "Pochlarner Stuben" betreibt, und mit ahnlichem kriminalistischen Spursinn gesegnet ist wie seine Tochter. Und schlieSSlich ist da noch Grafin Schonberg, die sich mit ihren Kontakten zum Kitzbuheler Jetset immer wieder als wertvolle Hilfe fur die Beamten erweist.

Sie entdeckt, dass er mit einer anderen Frau ein Doppelleben fuhrte. Sie beschlieSSt, sich der Frau unter einer anderen Identitat zu nahern.

programme.title: The Sinner
programme.desc: Detective Harry Ambrose returns to his hometown on the outskirts of New York to solve a disturbing and heartbreaking crime: an 11-year-old boy is said to have murdered his parents with no apparent motive. Ambrose quickly realizes that this is no ordinary child. His investigation took him deep into the hidden darkness of his hometown. There are people there who will stop at nothing to protect their secrets. This also includes the mysterious Vera. / Detective Harry Ambrose kehrt in seine Heimatstadt am Rande von New York zuruck, um ein beunruhigendes und zugleich herzzerreiSSendes Verbrechen aufzuklaren: Ein 11-jahriger Junge soll ohne ersichtliches Motiv seine Eltern ermordet haben. Ambrose erkennt schnell, dass es sich nicht um ein gewohnliches Kind handelt. Seine Ermittlungen fuhren ihn tief in die verborgene Dunkelheit seiner Heimatstadt. Dort gibt es Menschen, die vor nichts zuruckschrecken, um ihre Geheimnisse zu schutzen. Dazu gehort auch die mysteriose Vera.

programme.title: Shameless
programme.desc: Frank Gallagher lives as a single father with his six children. However, he spends most of his time in the bar and prefers to spend the little money the family has on alcohol instead of food. His eldest daughter Fiona is forced to take on the role of mother to her siblings: the intelligent but petty criminal Lip, Ian, who hides his homosexuality, the responsible but fragile Debbie, the violent 10-year-old Carl and little Liam. Together, the children try to master their lives in a creative, scandalless, but also warm-hearted way, despite their impossible father. / Frank Gallagher lebt als alleinerziehender Vater mit seinen sechs Kindern zusammen. Allerdings verbringt er die meiste Zeit in der Bar und gibt das wenige Geld, das der Familie zur Verfugung steht, statt fur Essen lieber fur Alkohol aus. Seine alteste Tochter Fiona ubernimmt notgedrungen die Mutterrolle fur ihre Geschwister: den intelligenten aber kleinkriminellen Lip, Ian, der seine Homosexualitat verbirgt, die verantwortungsbewusste aber fragile Debbie, den 10-jahrigen gewalttatigen Carl und den kleinen Liam. Gemeinsam versuchen die Kinder, trotz ihres unmoglichen Vaters ihr Leben auf kreative, skandalose, aber auch warmherzige Weise zu meistern.

A. ist bei Fallen der nationalen Sicherheit der Vereinigten Staaten Amerikas im Einsatz. Die hervorragend ausgebildeten Profis geben bei den gefahrlichen Undercover-Einsatzen ihr Bestes.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy Plunkett had her daughter Violet when she was 16 and has a son named Roscoe with her ex-husband. Christy has been sober for a year now and is still struggling with her addiction. She works as a waitress in a restaurant and has an affair with her married boss. One day she decides to turn her life around and even attends Alcoholics Anonymous meetings. She gets help from her mother Bonnie, of all people. She was an alcoholic and drug addict herself and was therefore unable to take much care of her daughter Christy when she was a child. Now she wants to make amends and is trying to regain her daughter's trust. Bonnie finally wants to start being a good mother to Christy, chaos included. / Christy Plunkett bekam ihre Tochter Violet mit 16 Jahren und hat einen Sohn namens Roscoe gemeinsam mit ihrem Ex-Mann. Seit einem Jahr ist Christy nun trocken und hat immer noch schwer mit ihrer Sucht zu kampfen. Sie arbeitet als Kellnerin in einem Restaurant und hat eine Affare mit ihrem verheirateten Chef. Eines Tages fasst sie den Entschluss, ihr Leben umzukrempeln und besucht sogar Treffen der Anonymen Alkoholiker. Hilfe bekommt sie ausgerechnet von ihrer Mutter Bonnie. Sie war selbst alkoholsuchtig und drogenabhangig und konnte sich daher nur wenig um Tochter Christy kummern, als die ein Kind war. Nun will sie das wiedergutmachen und versucht, das Vertrauen ihrer Tochter wiederzugewinnen. Bonnie will endlich damit anfangen, eine gute Mutter fur Christy zu sein, Chaos inklusive.

She doesn't let anyone dictate anything to her, she is brave, generous and so strong that she can even lift her horse. Together with her friends Tommy and Annika she experiences the craziest adventures. / Pippi Langstrumpf ist ein freches neunjahriges Madchen mit Sommersprossen, zwei abstehenden roten Zopfen und unterschiedlich gefarbten Strumpfen. Sie lebt ohne Eltern, aber mit einem Pferd und einem Affen in einer groSSen bunten Villa. Sie lasst sich von niemandem etwas vorschreiben, ist mutig, groSSzugig und so stark, dass sie sogar ihr Pferd hochstemmen kann. programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the “Jager”. This is not an easy task, because the “Jagers” are proven quiz professionals from the German national quiz team, including the German quiz master. In the first round, the candidates individually build up a game total, which they have to defend together against the “Jager” in the second round in order to advance to the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the “Jager” and defend the money they have earned so far. You must answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions correctly than the “Jager”, they win. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A gruesome violent crime occurs on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. To clear it up, London investigator Richard Poole is assigned to the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but he can't get used to the Caribbean mentality at all. This always creates entertaining situations. The meticulous suit wearer manages to solve the case together with his colleagues on site. They really want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like seafood. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk and the alien alibi / Mr. Monk und das auSSerirdische Alibi
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.desc: After their big hit "Live is Life", the pensioner band "Rocco and the Pacemakers" enjoyed their fame with countless performances. But that takes a toll on their strength and so, after one band member becomes weak, the group decides with a heavy heart to end the tour. The pensioners return to the retirement home, but there they are treated like little children. The rustic pensioners don't like this at all and they hatch a plan to buy the home. / Die Rentnerband "Rocco and die Herzschrittmacher" hat nach ihrem groSSen Hit "Live is Life" ihren Ruhm mit zahllosen Auftritten ausgekostet. Doch das zehrt an den Kraften und so beschlieSSt die Gruppe nach dem Schwacheanfall eines Bandmitglieds schweren Herzens, die Tournee zu beenden. Die Pensionare kehren in die Seniorenresidenz zuruck, aber dort werden sie wie kleine Kinder behandelt. Das gefallt den rustigen Rentnern ganz und gar nicht und sie hecken einen Plan aus, um das Heim zu kaufen.

programme.title: Family is a celebration - baptism alarm / Familie ist ein Fest - Taufalarm
programme.desc: Religion, tradition or family don't actually play a special role in the relationship between Amelie Kiefer and Reza Brojerdi. However, that changes when their first child is born. Both sets of grandparents insist on enforcing the traditions of their respective families and the young set of parents tries to please everyone. Of course this doesn't work because the conservative grandparents are all quite stubborn. / Religion, Tradition oder Familie spielen eigentlich keine besondere Rolle in der Beziehung von Amelie Kiefer und Reza Brojerdi. Beide GroSSelternpaare beharren darauf, die Tradition der jeweiligen Familie durchzusetzen und das junge Elternpaar versucht es allen Recht zu machen. programme.title: Inside Man
programme.desc: Dalton Russell robs a bank in New York City. His plan to crack the safe deposit box of the bank's CEO, Arthur Case, goes awry when a hostage situation occurs. Detective Keith Frazier is assigned to the case and it quickly becomes clear that Russel is playing for time. The negotiations are going slowly and are being delayed even further by lawyer Madeleine White. Case's past contains a cruel secret that he wants to cover up with the help of the lawyer. / Dalton Russell uberfallt eine Bank in New York City. Sein Plan, das SchlieSSfach des Vorstandsvorsitzenden der Bank, Arthur Case, zu knacken, geht schief, als es zu einer Geiselnahme kommt. Detective Keith Frazier wird mit dem Fall betraut und schnell wird klar, dass Russel auf Zeit spielt. Die Verhandlungen laufen schleppend und werden durch Anwaltin Madeleine White noch weiter hinausgezogert. Cases Vergangenheit birgt ein grausames Geheimnis, das er mithilfe der Anwaltin vertuschen will.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Simon and Robyn are a young couple whose life has so far gone exactly according to plan. But then they accidentally meet an old acquaintance of Simon's and their whole world falls apart. Simon doesn't recognize Gordo at first, but after a few encounters and mysterious gifts, a terrible secret from the past comes to light. Robyn has to ask herself how well she really knows her husband and what happened between him and Gordo back then. / Simon und Robyn sind ein junges Paar, deren Leben bislang genau nach Plan verlief. Doch dann treffen sie zufallig einen alten Bekannten von Simon, und ihre ganze Welt gerat aus den Fugen. Simon erkennt Gordo zuerst gar nicht, doch nach einigen Begegnungen und mysteriosen Geschenken kommt ein schreckliches Geheimnis aus der Vergangenheit ans Tageslicht. Robyn muss sich die Frage stellen, wie gut sie ihren Mann wirklich kennt und was damals zwischen ihm und Gordo geschehen ist.

programme.desc: Red-haired bomb expert and former NYPD agent Horatio Caine is the head of the CSI division in Miami. There he and his team are responsible for the security of the city. programme.title: Die Simpsons
programme.desc: There is always something going on in the lives of the Simpson family. The lovable but unlucky, scatterbrained and rather lazy father Homer Simpson works in a nuclear power plant and tries to keep his family afloat as best he can. As a mother and housewife, his wife Marge is the good soul in the Simpson house and always tries to improve basic moral values ​​both in the family and in society. The parents have their hands full with their three children. With ten-year-old Bart, you never know what prank he'll come up with next. The eight-year-old, highly intelligent and ambitious Lisa is a do-gooder who is often teased as a nerd at school. The Simpsons is completed by Baby Maggie. The lives of the family and the other residents of the small US town of Springfield are characterized by the everyday chaos and normal madness of society. / Im Leben der Familie Simpson ist immer etwas los. Der liebenswerte, aber vom Pech verfolgte, schusselige und ziemlich faule Vater Homer Simpson arbeitet in einem Atomkraftwerk und versucht, seine Familie bestmoglich uber Wasser zu halten. Seine Frau Marge ist als Mutter und Hausfrau die gute Seele im Hause Simpson und versucht stets, sowohl in der Familie als auch in der Gesellschaft die moralischen Grundwerte zu verbessern. Die Eltern haben alle Hande voll zu tun mit ihren drei Kindern. Bei dem zehnjahrigen Bart weiSS man nie, welchen Streich er als nachstes ausheckt. Die achtjahrige hochintelligente und ehrgeizige Lisa ist eine Weltverbesserin, die in der Schule oft als Streber gehanselt wird. Vervollstandigt werden die Simpsons von Baby Maggie. Das Leben der Familie und der anderen Bewohner der US-Kleinstadt Springfield ist gepragt vom alltaglichen Chaos und ganz normalen Wahnsinn der Gesellschaft.

programme.title: Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all this in the living room at home - the “Yoga Magazine” makes it possible. Competent and friendly yoga trainers show the best exercises for switching off. By the way, the program doesn't just report from the television studio. The programs are often recorded in a very special location - for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. Kompetente und sympathische Yogatrainer zeigen die besten Übungen zum Abschalten. Die Sendung meldet sich ubrigens nicht nur aus dem Fernsehstudio. Oftmals werden die Sendungen in einer ganz besonderen Location aufgenommen _ zum Beispiel auf Ibiza.

programme.title: “We move Austria” school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Basketball: Superliga
programme.desc: The Graz team certainly hopes to be able to continue the good series. The UBSC team won the last seven direct duels. In the last direct meeting, the Graz team won 95:83 against the Furstenfeld Panthers. 5th round: UBSC Graz - Panthers Furstenfeld / Das Grazer Team hofft sicherlich, die gute Serie fortsetzen zu konnen. Die jungsten sieben Direktduelle konnte die UBSC-Truppe fur sich entscheiden. Im letzten direkten Aufeinandertreffen gewannen die Grazer mit 95:83 gegen die Furstenfeld Panthers. 5. Runde: UBSC Graz - Panthers Furstenfeld

programme.title: Funsport
programme.desc: The term “fun sports” encompasses trendy and extreme sports that are mostly primarily about the fun factor. The high pressure to perform that is common in normal sports is often eliminated here. There are winners, but no losers. The athletes want to live out a passion together and encourage each other to achieve new, extraordinary achievements. / Unter dem Begriff "Funsport" werden Trend- und Extrem­sportarten zusammengefasst, bei denen es zumeist primar um den SpaSSfaktor geht. Der hohe Leistungsdruck, der in normalen Sportarten ublich ist, entfallt hier haufig. Es gibt Gewinner, aber keine Verlierer. Die Sportler wollen gemeinsam eine Leidenschaft ausleben und sich gegenseitig zu neuen, auSSergewohnlichen Leistungen anspornen.

programme.title: Boxen
programme.desc: Kushtrim Veseli will be there in Korneuburg. Before the gala, the Viennese fighter had a record of six wins from six encounters. His opponent is Bosko Misic. programme.title: Handball: Handball Liga Austria
programme.desc: Will Hard's team be able to continue their good run? The team is unbeaten in the last eight meetings with Bregenz and has won six of them. The HC's last defeat came in May 2022. Die Truppe ist in den letzten acht Aufeinandertreffen mit Bregenz ungeschlagen und konnte sechs davon gewinnen. Die letzte Niederlage des HC gab es im Mai 2022. Damals musste das Team sich mit 29:33 im OHB-Cup geschlagen geben. 6. Runde: Alpla Hard - Bregenz

programme.title: Formula 1: Grand Prix of the USA / Formel 1: GroSSer Preis der USA
programme.desc: Will George Russell manage to achieve his third win of the season? The Brit took first place in Canada and Singapore. Last year Russell finished sixth at the United States Grand Prix. programme.title: Sisi
programme.desc: The Extraordinary Life of Elizabeth of Bavaria, better known as Sisi, tells the story of an extraordinary woman who became Europe's first superstar. The series follows her teenage days, her love story with Emperor Franz Joseph I, and life's ups and downs, revealing her greatest joys, but also the pain and suffering she went through. / Izuzetni život Elizabete od Bavarske, poznatije kao Sisi, prikazuje priču izvanredne žene koja je postala prva evropska superzvijezda. Serija prati njene tinejdžerske dane, ljubavnu priču s carem Franjom Josipom I, te životne uspone i padove, otkrivajući i njene najveće radosti, ali i bol i patnju kroz koje je prolazila.

programme.title: ATV vijesti
programme.desc: Overview of the most important news in one place, every working day in the most watched show of Alternative Television _ Central News exactly at 19:00 live from the studio. Journalists of the ATV newsroom research, discover and report on current events and phenomena in the sphere of politics, economy, society, social problems, city current affairs, sports and weather. / Pregled najvažnijih vijesti na jednom mjestu, svakog radnog dana u najgledanijoj emisiji Alternativne televizije _ Centralne vijesti tačno u 19:00 uživo iz studija. Vijesti donose pregled dešavanja u Republici Srpskoj, BiH, regionu i svijetu. Gosti u studiju komentarišu aktuelne teme dana. Novinari Informativne redakcije ATV _ a istražuju, otkrivaju i izvještavaju o aktuelnim događajima i pojavama u sferi politike, privrede, društva, o socijalnim problemima, gradske aktuelnosti, sport i vrijeme.

programme.desc: The show is dedicated to farmers, but also to those who live in urban areas, have gardens, orchards, greenhouses. programme.title: Practice with Lidia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world, we often don't have time to exercise. There are many benefits of regular exercise. In addition to shaping your body, you are also assured of good health. In addition to good physical shape, exercise also contributes to good mental health. Exercise releases endorphins, which are the main trigger of good emotions and bring only positivity. / U današnjem svijetu često nemamo vremena za vježbanje. Mnoge su prednosti redovnog vježbanja. Osim oblikovanja tijela, osigurano vam je i dobro zdravlje. Osim dobre fizičke forme, vježbanje doprinosi i dobrom mentalnom zdravlju. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

programme.title: Autoshop magazin
programme.desc: Specijalizovana i sponzorisana emisija posvećena svijetu automobilske industrije. Najvažinije informacije, noviteti, recenzije u polusatnom izdanju idealne su za ljubitelje četvorotočkaša.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Bistra voda
programme.desc: The story of two once close friends, Aleksandar and Arsen, who unexpectedly meet in Skopje after 45 years. Years of betrayal and separation have left deep traces, and the meeting awakens memories, emotions and hope for reconciliation. / Priča o dva nekada bliska prijatelja, Aleksandru i Arsenu, koji se nakon 45 godina neočekivano sreću u Skoplju. Godine izdaje i razdvojenosti ostavile su duboke tragove, a susret budi sjećanja, emocije i nadu za pomirenje.

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: The series Persona is a Turkish crime drama from 2018 directed by Onur Sajlak, which magnificently combines true tragedy and the absurdity of life, and puts moral values ​​to the test of existence. The story follows Aga, a retired judge and widower, who has been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Aware that he will soon forget everything, that nothing will remain of his personality and values, he makes a fatal decision - he will kill all the criminals who skilfully escaped from under the law. He embarks on a revenge campaign, and the task of finding out who in turn twists Istanbul's dirtiest souls and minds will fall to Inspector Nevra, who has been the jailer of her own life's storms for years. Will Aga and Nerva be opponents or will they join forces? How terrible will the network of secrets be, with the death of witnesses and oblivion? / Serija Persona je turska kriminalistička drama iz 2018. godine u režiji Onura Sajlaka, koja na veličanstven način spaja istinsku tragediju i apsurd života, a na test postojanja stavlja moralne vrijednosti. Priča prati penzionisanog sudiju i udovca Agu, kojem je dijagnostifikovana Alchajmerova bolest. Svjestan da će uskoro zaboraviti sve, da od njegove ličnosti i vrijednosti neće ostati ništa, donosi kobnu odluku – ubiće sve zločince koji su se vješto izvukli ispod ruke zakona. On polazi u osvetnički pohod, a zadatak da otkrije ko redom uvija najprljavije duše i umove Istambula pripašće inspektorki Nevri, koja je već godinama tamničar sopstvenih životnih bura. Da li će Aga i Nerva biti protivnici ili će udružiti svoje snage? Koliko će strašna biti mreža tajni, smrtim svjedoka i zaborava?

programme.title: Homecoming / Povratak kući

Dolazi u rodnu kuću sa ćerkom sa kojom nije u dobrim odnosima i novim mužem, i počinje da je renovira. Međutim, ni renoviranje i suočavanje sa prošlošću neće biti lako.

programme.title: The nation is a witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-reportage show by journalist Biljana Stokić, will reveal to you what the heart of the people says about Srpska, about the tradition and history of our towns and villages, about their everyday life and the struggle to preserve true values, hard work, faith, and love for their and our homeland. In a mix of honest stories of those who live from their work, through the discovery of landmarks and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with words of hope and inspiration, and with images that melt the heart, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokić, with many years of journalistic experience, will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are its problems and challenges? Where does he find the strength to work and nurture traditions and good interpersonal relationships? How does our birth lump breathe and does it have equal beauty? What do they remember? What are they amazed by? What do they return to? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell their story, those for whom we do not know how much love, perseverance, courage they carry, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt both suffering and the beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: Energo klub
programme.desc: Our new Energo Club format will provide you with relevant current events in the field of electricity production, as well as the possibility of creating renewable sources and their sustainability. We bring the words of experts and the experiences of investors, we talk about system development, trends and successful projects, we inform about the most important events dedicated to energy. / Naš novi format Energo klub pružiće vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti proizvodnje električne energije, te mogućnosti stvaranja obnovljivih izvora i njihove održivosti. Donosimo riječi stručnjaka i iskustva investitora, pričamo o razvoju sistema, trendovima i uspješnim projektima, informišemo o najvažnijim događajima posvećenim energetici.

programme.title: Krvavo cvijeće
programme.desc: The story of Dilan and Baran, two young people who are forced to enter the port of marriage. Despite numerous conflicts, their unwanted marriage gives birth to a strong love. / Priča o Dilan i Baranu, dvoje mladih ljudi koji su prisiljeni uploviti u bračnu luku. Unatoč brojnim sukobima, njihov neželjeni brak iznjedriće snažnu ljubav.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies of the 80s, set in World War II France occupied by German troops. In the small town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Artois cafe, a place for the French and Germans to hang out. Colonel Von Strohm asks Rene to hide a stolen painting in his cafe, which Hitler himself wanted at the same time. Rene tries to balance his work in order to please the French Resistance and Nazi troops in order to survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: Wild bees / Divlje pčele
programme.desc: Three sisters were left alone after the death of their father. programme.title: Na ivici terena
programme.desc: The show "On the edge of the field" will reveal how our famous athletes live, far from their homeland, and how they defend the colors of the biggest clubs. What does their life look like in training and on the field where they leave heart, tears and sweat and how do they spend their free time when they are not winning points and titles. Our sports enthusiasts will prepare short postcards of the cities for you, and tell you something about the history of the clubs where our athletes win not only points in important competitions and derbies, but also the hearts of the fans. You will meet some of the famous Serbian athletes who have already made their mark in the history of major European clubs. / Emisija "Na ivici terena" otkriće vam kako žive naši poznati sportisti, daleko od domovine, i kako brane boje najvećih klubova. Kako to izgleda njihov život na treninzima i na terenu na kojem se ostavlja srce, suze i znoj i kako provode slobodno vrijeme kada ne osvajaju poene i titule. Naši zaljubljenici u sport prirediće vam i kratke razglednice gradova, te vam otkriti ponešto o istoriji klubova u kojima naši sportisti vrtoglavo osvajaju ne samo bodove na važnim takmičenjima i derbijima, nego i srca navijača. Upoznaćete neke od slavnih srpskih sportista koji su se već upisali u istoriju velikih evropskih klubova.

programme.title: Ćirilica
programme.desc: Popular television show by author and host Milomir Marić every Monday on ATV _ u! You will have the opportunity to watch everything that is not published even by scandalous tabloids. "Cirilica" brings the hidden background of events that are talked about the most and least known about! Milomir Marić brings together the incompatible, at the border where political propaganda and false promises stop, and reality begins. Politicians speak like ordinary people, without censorship and political platitudes. / Popularna televizijska emisija autora i voditelja Milomira Marića svakog ponedjeljka na ATV _ u! Imaćete priliku gledati sve ono što ne objavljuju čak ni skandalozni tabloidi. "Ćirilica" donosi skrivenu pozadinu događaja o kojima se najviše priča, a najmanje zna! Milomir Marić spaja nespojivo, na granici gdje prestaju politička propaganda i lažna obećanja, a počinje stvarnost. Političari govore kao obični ljudi, bez cenzure i političkih floskula.

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: The series Persona is a Turkish crime drama from 2018 directed by Onur Sajlak, which magnificently combines true tragedy and the absurdity of life, and puts moral values ​​to the test of existence. The story follows Aga, a retired judge and widower, who has been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Aware that he will soon forget everything, that nothing will remain of his personality and values, he makes a fatal decision - he will kill all the criminals who skilfully escaped from under the law. He embarks on a revenge campaign, and the task of finding out who in turn twists Istanbul's dirtiest souls and minds will fall to Inspector Nevra, who has been the jailer of her own life's storms for years. Will Aga and Nerva be opponents or will they join forces? How terrible will the network of secrets be, with the death of witnesses and oblivion? / Serija Persona je turska kriminalistička drama iz 2018. godine u režiji Onura Sajlaka, koja na veličanstven način spaja istinsku tragediju i apsurd života, a na test postojanja stavlja moralne vrijednosti. Priča prati penzionisanog sudiju i udovca Agu, kojem je dijagnostifikovana Alchajmerova bolest. Svjestan da će uskoro zaboraviti sve, da od njegove ličnosti i vrijednosti neće ostati ništa, donosi kobnu odluku – ubiće sve zločince koji su se vješto izvukli ispod ruke zakona. On polazi u osvetnički pohod, a zadatak da otkrije ko redom uvija najprljavije duše i umove Istambula pripašće inspektorki Nevri, koja je već godinama tamničar sopstvenih životnih bura. Da li će Aga i Nerva biti protivnici ili će udružiti svoje snage? Koliko će strašna biti mreža tajni, smrtim svjedoka i zaborava?

When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Energo klub
programme.desc: Our new Energo Club format will provide you with relevant current events in the field of electricity production, as well as the possibility of creating renewable sources and their sustainability. We bring the words of experts and the experiences of investors, we talk about system development, trends and successful projects, we inform about the most important events dedicated to energy. / Naš novi format Energo klub pružiće vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti proizvodnje električne energije, te mogućnosti stvaranja obnovljivih izvora i njihove održivosti. Donosimo riječi stručnjaka i iskustva investitora, pričamo o razvoju sistema, trendovima i uspješnim projektima, informišemo o najvažnijim događajima posvećenim energetici.

programme.title: ATV vijesti
programme.desc: Overview of the most important news in one place, every working day in the most watched show of Alternative Television _ Central News exactly at 19:00 live from the studio. The news provides an overview of events in the Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the region and the world. Guests in the studio comment on current topics of the day. Vijesti donose pregled dešavanja u Republici Srpskoj, BiH, regionu i svijetu. Gosti u studiju komentarišu aktuelne teme dana. Novinari Informativne redakcije ATV _ a istražuju, otkrivaju i izvještavaju o aktuelnim događajima i pojavama u sferi politike, privrede, društva, o socijalnim problemima, gradske aktuelnosti, sport i vrijeme.

programme.title: Practice with Lidia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world, we often don't have time to exercise. There are many benefits of regular exercise. In addition to shaping your body, you are also assured of good health. In addition to good physical shape, exercise also contributes to good mental health. Exercise releases endorphins, which are the main trigger of good emotions and bring only positivity. / U današnjem svijetu često nemamo vremena za vježbanje. Mnoge su prednosti redovnog vježbanja. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

programme.title: Na ivici terena
programme.desc: The show "On the edge of the field" will reveal how our famous athletes live, far from their homeland, and how they defend the colors of the biggest clubs. What does their life look like in training and on the field where they leave heart, tears and sweat and how do they spend their free time when they are not winning points and titles. Our sports enthusiasts will prepare short postcards of the cities for you, and tell you something about the history of the clubs where our athletes win not only points in important competitions and derbies, but also the hearts of the fans. You will meet some of the famous Serbian athletes who have already made their mark in the history of major European clubs. / Emisija "Na ivici terena" otkriće vam kako žive naši poznati sportisti, daleko od domovine, i kako brane boje najvećih klubova. Kako to izgleda njihov život na treninzima i na terenu na kojem se ostavlja srce, suze i znoj i kako provode slobodno vrijeme kada ne osvajaju poene i titule. Naši zaljubljenici u sport prirediće vam i kratke razglednice gradova, te vam otkriti ponešto o istoriji klubova u kojima naši sportisti vrtoglavo osvajaju ne samo bodove na važnim takmičenjima i derbijima, nego i srca navijača. Upoznaćete neke od slavnih srpskih sportista koji su se već upisali u istoriju velikih evropskih klubova.

programme.title: Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies of the 80s, set in World War II France occupied by German troops. In the small town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Artois cafe, a place for the French and Germans to hang out. Colonel Von Strohm asks Rene to hide a stolen painting in his cafe, which Hitler himself wanted at the same time. Rene tries to balance his work in order to please the French Resistance and Nazi troops in order to survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.desc: Three sisters were left alone after the death of their father. Bez podrške nekog muškarca one će morati da se suprotstave suprotnom i dominantnom spolu i pokazati da su sposobne same voditi svoje imanje.

Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Pogledaj u sutra
programme.desc: Chloe Delcourt went in search of her son after the terrible explosion on the coast of Sète. Her life turns upside down when the body of her sister, whom she hasn't seen for years, is found on the shore... / Chloe Delcourt otišla je u potragu za svojim sinom nakon strašne eksplozije na obali Sète. Njezin život okrene se naglavačke kada na obali pronađu tijelo njezine sestre koju godinama nije vidjela...

programme.title: ATV vijesti
programme.desc: Overview of the most important news in one place, every working day in the most watched show of Alternative Television _ Central News exactly at 19:00 live from the studio. The news provides an overview of events in the Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the region and the world. Guests in the studio comment on current topics of the day. Journalists of the ATV newsroom research, discover and report on current events and phenomena in the sphere of politics, economy, society, social problems, city current affairs, sports and weather. / Pregled najvažnijih vijesti na jednom mjestu, svakog radnog dana u najgledanijoj emisiji Alternativne televizije _ Centralne vijesti tačno u 19:00 uživo iz studija. Vijesti donose pregled dešavanja u Republici Srpskoj, BiH, regionu i svijetu. Gosti u studiju komentarišu aktuelne teme dana. Novinari Informativne redakcije ATV _ a istražuju, otkrivaju i izvještavaju o aktuelnim događajima i pojavama u sferi politike, privrede, društva, o socijalnim problemima, gradske aktuelnosti, sport i vrijeme.

programme.title: Practice with Lidia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world, we often don't have time to exercise. There are many benefits of regular exercise. In addition to shaping your body, you are also assured of good health. In addition to good physical shape, exercise also contributes to good mental health. Exercise releases endorphins, which are the main trigger of good emotions and bring only positivity. / U današnjem svijetu često nemamo vremena za vježbanje. Mnoge su prednosti redovnog vježbanja. Osim oblikovanja tijela, osigurano vam je i dobro zdravlje. Osim dobre fizičke forme, vježbanje doprinosi i dobrom mentalnom zdravlju. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

programme.title: ATV Jutro
programme.desc: The morning program of Alternative Television "ATV jutro" is a specific combination of information and entertainment. The first daily information, the first morning reports from the field throughout Republika Srpska, interesting contributions from the world of politics, culture and sports, dedicated to people and interesting events. / Jutarnji program Alternativne televizije "ATV jutro" specifičan je spoj informative i zabave. Prve dnevne informacije, prvi jutarnji raporti sa terena širom Republike Srpske, zanimljivi prilozi iz svijeta politike, kulture i sporta, posvećeni ljudima i zanimljivim dešavanjima.

programme.title: Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies of the 80s, set in World War II France occupied by German troops. In the small town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Artois cafe, a place for the French and Germans to hang out. Colonel Von Strohm asks Rene to hide a stolen painting in his cafe, which Hitler himself wanted at the same time. Rene tries to balance his work in order to please the French Resistance and Nazi troops in order to survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: Wild bees / Divlje pčele
programme.desc: Three sisters were left alone after the death of their father. Without the support of a man, they will have to stand up to the opposite and dominant sex and show that they are capable of running their own estate. / Tri sestre ostale su same nakon smrti oca. Bez podrške nekog muškarca one će morati da se suprotstave suprotnom i dominantnom spolu i pokazati da su sposobne same voditi svoje imanje.

programme.title: The nation is a witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-reportage show by journalist Biljana Stokić, will reveal to you what the heart of the people says about Srpska, about the tradition and history of our towns and villages, about their everyday life and the struggle to preserve true values, hard work, faith, and love for their and our homeland. In a mix of honest stories of those who live from their work, through the discovery of landmarks and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with words of hope and inspiration, and with images that melt the heart, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokić, with many years of journalistic experience, will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are its problems and challenges? Where does he find the strength to work and nurture traditions and good interpersonal relationships? How does our birth lump breathe and does it have equal beauty? What do they remember? What are they amazed by? What do they return to? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell their story, those for whom we do not know how much love, perseverance, courage they carry, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt both suffering and the beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Pogledaj u sutra
programme.desc: Chloe Delcourt went in search of her son after the terrible explosion on the coast of Sète. Journalists of the ATV newsroom research, discover and report on current events and phenomena in the sphere of politics, economy, society, social problems, city current affairs, sports and weather. / Pregled najvažnijih vijesti na jednom mjestu, svakog radnog dana u najgledanijoj emisiji Alternativne televizije _ Centralne vijesti tačno u 19:00 uživo iz studija. Vijesti donose pregled dešavanja u Republici Srpskoj, BiH, regionu i svijetu. Gosti u studiju komentarišu aktuelne teme dana. Novinari Informativne redakcije ATV _ a istražuju, otkrivaju i izvještavaju o aktuelnim događajima i pojavama u sferi politike, privrede, društva, o socijalnim problemima, gradske aktuelnosti, sport i vrijeme.

programme.title: Practice with Lidia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world, we often don't have time to exercise. There are many benefits of regular exercise. In addition to shaping your body, you are also assured of good health. programme.title: Boks
programme.desc: Rocky Marciano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Louis. Do you need any more reason to follow this noble martial art? We find the first traces of boxing already in the third century BC on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxing were established in the 18th century in London and define the fighting area, equipment and illegal and allowed types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Martial arts - MMA / Borilački sport - MMA
programme.desc: The term "mixed martial arts" was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a reference to the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" martial arts tournament. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Martial arts - MMA / Borilački sport - MMA
programme.desc: The term "mixed martial arts" was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a reference to the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" martial arts tournament. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: KIK-BOKS Trofej Beograda
programme.desc: Kickboxing is practiced as a form of self-defense, regular maintenance of body shape or as a martial sport. Kickboxing as a modern martial sport that includes several sports disciplines, These are Semi contact (Semi contact), "Light contact", "Full contact", Low kick, Thai kickboxing, musical forms and Aero kickboxing. The beginnings of this martial art date back to the 60s of the 20th century in Japan, while kickboxing became popular in Europe and North America ten years later. Maximum protective equipment is used, which consists of a helmet, mouth guard, chest guard (women), genital guard, gloves, shin guards and slippers. / Kikboks se praktikuje kao vrsta samoobrane, redovno održavanje telesne forme ili kao borilački sport. Kikboks kao moderan borilački sport koji obuhvata više sportskih disciplina, To su Semi kontakt (Polu kontakt), "Light contact" (Lagani kontakt), "Full contact" (Puni kontakt), Lou kik, Taj kikboks, muzičke forme i Aero kikboks. Početci ove borilačke veštine datiraju još iz 60ih godina 20. veka u Japanu, dok se u Evropi i Severnoj Americi kikboks popularizovao deset godina kasnije. Koristi se maksimalna zaštitna oprema koja se sastoji od kacige, štitnika za zube, štitnika za prsa (žene), štitnika za genitalije, rukavica, štitnika za potkolenice te papuča.

programme.title: MMA UFC 14
programme.desc: The term "mixed martial arts" was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a reference to the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" martial arts tournament. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: MMA UFC Fight Night
programme.desc: Follow exciting duels in martial arts organized by the UFC. This association was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Las Vegas. / Pratite uzbudljive duele u borilačkim veštinama u organizaciji UFC-a. Ovo udruženje je osnovano 1993. godine, a sedište im je u Las Vegasu.

programme.title: Martial arts - MMA / Borilački sport - MMA
programme.desc: The term "mixed martial arts" was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a reference to the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" martial arts tournament. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Football - WWin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league gets a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the League for Champions and the League for Relegation. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Željezničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football Qualifications for WC 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred members of the world football organization FIFA compete in the qualifications for the main tournament of the world football championship. These long and especially tense qualifications differ depending on the continental confederation. But what they all have in common is that they are a real prelude to the final tournament, given the very high stakes they are playing for. The significance of the qualifications is added by the fact that no one except the hosts has the right to participate in the final tournament, and the world champions must also confirm their visas in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

Pobjednik ovog takmičenja se plasira u Premijer ligu BiH.

programme.title: Football - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The Italian Serie A is a professional football competition with 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since it was founded in 1929, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the decline of the financial power of the Italian first league teams and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly dropped in quality, but it is returning to its rightful place with sure steps. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Romanian League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: The first football league of Romania has a long history, the first season was played back in 1909, when the now defunct Olympia Bucharest won the first title. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steaua and Dinamo Bucharest, who took most of the championship titles. Currently, the league has 14 clubs and after the "regular" part, where each team plays one game at home and one away, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is the play off for the champion, where the six best-placed clubs participate, while the rest fight in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.
