programme.title: Basketball - NBA league / Košarka - NBA liga
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA league, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers. / Šesti dan juna mjeseca davne 1946. godine zauvijek će promjeniti košarkašku igru. Tog dana u Njujorku osnovano je najelitnije svjetsko košarkaško takmičenje, NBA liga. 29 ekipa iz SAD-a i jedna iz Kanade svaku jesen počinje lov na legendarni prsten namijenjen prvaku NBA lige. Ekipe su podijeljene na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju te kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gdje u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. NBA finale je jedno od najpraćenijih sportskih događaja godine koje oduševljava sve košarkaške zaljubljenike.

programme.title: Basketball - NBA league / Košarka - NBA liga
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA league, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers. / Šesti dan juna mjeseca davne 1946. godine zauvijek će promjeniti košarkašku igru. Tog dana u Njujorku osnovano je najelitnije svjetsko košarkaško takmičenje, NBA liga. 29 ekipa iz SAD-a i jedna iz Kanade svaku jesen počinje lov na legendarni prsten namijenjen prvaku NBA lige. Ekipe su podijeljene na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju te kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gdje u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. NBA finale je jedno od najpraćenijih sportskih događaja godine koje oduševljava sve košarkaške zaljubljenike.

programme.title: Football - WWin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league gets a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the League for Champions and the League for Relegation. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Željezničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football Qualifications for WC 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred members of the world football organization FIFA compete in the qualifications for the main tournament of the world football championship. These long and especially tense qualifications differ depending on the continental confederation. But what they all have in common is that they are a real prelude to the final tournament, given the very high stakes they are playing for. The significance of the qualifications is added by the fact that no one except the hosts has the right to participate in the final tournament, and the world champions must also confirm their visas in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The Italian Serie A is a professional football competition with 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since it was founded in 1929, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the decline of the financial power of the Italian first league teams and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly dropped in quality, but it is returning to its rightful place with sure steps. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Romanian League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: The first football league of Romania has a long history, the first season was played back in 1909, when the now defunct Olympia Bucharest won the first title. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steaua and Dinamo Bucharest, who took most of the championship titles. Currently, the league has 14 clubs and after the "regular" part, where each team plays one game at home and one away, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is the play off for the champion, where the six best-placed clubs participate, while the rest fight in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - NBA league / Košarka - NBA liga
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA league, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers. / Šesti dan juna mjeseca davne 1946. godine zauvijek će promjeniti košarkašku igru. programme.title: Football - WWin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league gets a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the League for Champions and the League for Relegation. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Željezničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The Italian Serie A is a professional football competition with 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since it was founded in 1929, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the decline of the financial power of the Italian first league teams and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly dropped in quality, but it is returning to its rightful place with sure steps. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the decline of the financial power of the Italian first league teams and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly dropped in quality, but it is returning to its rightful place with sure steps. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Handball - EHF European League / Rukomet - EHF Europska liga
programme.desc: The EHF Cup, the second most important competition for men's handball clubs in Europe, began its journey in 1993. Until then, this competition was called the IHF Cup, which played its first season in the 1981-1982 season. Since 2012, the former EHF Cup Winners' Cup has been added to the EHF Cup. The competition, like the Champions League, consists of a part where clubs play in groups and the best ones go to the "knock out" phase. After the quarter-finals with two games between opponents, the "final four" follows. The semifinals and finals, as well as the match for third place, are played to one game won. / EHF kup kako drugo po važnosti takmičenje za muške rukometne klubove u Evropi svoj put započinje 1993. godine. Do tada se ovo takmičenje nazivalo IHF kup koje je svoju prvu sezonu odradilo u sezoni 1981.-1982. Od 2012. godine EHF kupu je priključen nekadašnji EHF Kup pobjednika kupova. Takmičenje se kao i Liga šampiona sastoji od dela gdje klubovi igraju po grupama i najbolji prolazi u "knock out" fazu. Nakon četvrtfinala na dvije utakmice između protivnika sijledi "final four". Polufinale i finale, kao i utakmica za treće mjesto, igraju se na jednu dobijenu utakmicu.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: The Handball League of Champions has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name of the Champions Cup. We got our first winner in the 1956-1957 season. year, and that was the team from Prague, because in that season only the city's selections performed. Today that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993, the competition was held under that name and was played according to the knockout cup system. Since 1993, in addition to changing the name to the Champions League, a group stage of the competition followed by eliminations has been introduced. The group stage has changed over the years, and the Final Four was introduced for the four best handball teams in Europe, after which the champion is awarded. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Handball - EHF European League / Rukomet - EHF Europska liga
programme.desc: The EHF Cup, the second most important competition for men's handball clubs in Europe, began its journey in 1993. Until then, this competition was called the IHF Cup, which played its first season in the 1981-1982 season. Since 2012, the former EHF Cup Winners' Cup has been added to the EHF Cup. The competition, like the Champions League, consists of a part where clubs play in groups and the best ones go to the "knock out" phase. After the quarter-finals with two games between opponents, the "final four" follows. The semifinals and finals, as well as the match for third place, are played to one game won. / EHF kup kako drugo po važnosti takmičenje za muške rukometne klubove u Evropi svoj put započinje 1993. godine. Do tada se ovo takmičenje nazivalo IHF kup koje je svoju prvu sezonu odradilo u sezoni 1981.-1982. Od 2012. godine EHF kupu je priključen nekadašnji EHF Kup pobjednika kupova. Takmičenje se kao i Liga šampiona sastoji od dela gdje klubovi igraju po grupama i najbolji prolazi u "knock out" fazu. Nakon četvrtfinala na dvije utakmice između protivnika sijledi "final four". Polufinale i finale, kao i utakmica za treće mjesto, igraju se na jednu dobijenu utakmicu.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: The Handball League of Champions has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name of the Champions Cup. We got our first winner in the 1956-1957 season. year, and that was the team from Prague, because in that season only the city's selections performed. Today that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993, the competition was held under that name and was played according to the knockout cup system. Since 1993, in addition to changing the name to the Champions League, a group stage of the competition followed by eliminations has been introduced. The group stage has changed over the years, and the Final Four was introduced for the four best handball teams in Europe, after which the champion is awarded. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - Argentinian League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom to establish its own football league is Argentina. It was back in 1891, and only teams from Buenos Aires and Rosario had the right to perform. In 1931, when 18 clubs moved from the amateur to the professional ranks, the Argentinian league got the forerunner of its current version. Since 2014, the league has 30 teams that fight for the title of champion of Argentina in a single-round system. The legendary River Plate from Buenos Aires has the most titles, but it is closely followed by its biggest rival, Boca Juniors. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

programme.title: Football - Scottish Premiership / Fudbal - Škotski Premiership
programme.desc: The Scottish Football Championship started its first season in 1890, and even then a rarity was established. The two teams then shared the championship title due to the same number of points at the end of the season. These were today's world-famous Glasgow Rangers, a team with more than 50 championship titles, and today's relatively unknown Dumbarton club. The league itself has changed names and format on a couple of occasions over the years, but since 2013 it is officially called the "Scottish Professional Football League" and is the highest level of Scottish football. The league is also marked by one of the biggest derbies in football history between two Glasgow teams, Celtic and Rangers. / Škotsko fudbalsko prvenstvo u svoju prvu sezonu su krenuli 1890. godine i već tada je postavljen jedan raritet. Dve ekipe su tada podijelile šampionsku titulu zbog istog broja bodova na kraju sezone. To su bili danas svjetski poznati Glazgov Rendžersi, ekipa sa više od 50 šampionskih titula i danas relativno nepoznati klub Dumbarton. Sama liga je kroz godine u par navrata mijenjala nazive i format, no od 2013. se službeno zove "Scottish Professional Football League" i najviši je rang škotskog fudbala. Ligu isto obilježava jedan od najvećih derbija u istoriji fudbala između dve glazgovske ekipe Seltika i Rendžersa.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - French League / Fudbal - Francuska liga
programme.desc: Ligue 1 is the first French professional football league with 20 teams fighting for the French championship title. It was founded in 1932 and is considered one of the most respected European leagues. The club with the most trophies with ten titles won is AS Saint Etienne, but the "Greens" have been waiting for a new title since long ago in 1981 and the time of the great Michel Platini. The matches of the French league are an unmissable event for every fan of this magnificent game. / Ligue 1 prva je francuska profesionalna fudbalska liga koja broji 20 ekipa u borbi za titulom prvaka Francuske. Osnovana je 1932. godine i smatra se jednom od najcjenjenijih evropskih liga. Najtrofejniji klub s deset osvojenih titula je AS Sent Etjen ali "Zeleni" na novu titulu čekaju još od davne 1981. godine i vremena velikog Mišela Platinija. Susreti francuske lige nezaobilazan su događaj za svakog ljubitelja ove veličanstvene igre.

They will talk about their wins and losses, the thorny road to the podium and the less visible side of the sport. / Sportski serijal bivšeg fudbalera Slavena Bilića donosi priče uspješnih sportista iz regiona. Oni će govoriti o svojim pobjedama i porazima, trnovitom putu do pobjedničkog postolja i manje vidljivoj strani sporta.

programme.title: American football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world, the NFL, was founded in 1920, but only by merging with the competing AFL in the middle of the last century, was the present version of the competition created. The league features 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams of the conference each enter the playoffs until the grand finale, popularly called the Super Bowl. The Super Bowl takes place at the beginning of February and is the most covered sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - 2nd ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. Krka Novo Mesto is the historic first winner of the ABA 2nd League, a competition that was founded in the 2017/2018 season. Along with the victory in the final four and the trophy for the winner, the Krka team also achieved placement in the 1st ABA league from next season. 12 teams participate in the league, and after the two-round system of matches, they are looking for a way to the four best teams and a place in the final four. The purpose of the ABA 2nd League is to enable smaller basketball communities to compete with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Uvodni studio Lige Prvaka
programme.desc: The studio show brings analysis and comments from sports experts ahead of the matches held as part of the Champions League. / Studijska emisija donosi analizu i komentare sportskih stručnjaka uoči utakmica koje se održavaju u sklopu Lige prvaka.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: The final studio of the Champions League / Završni studio Lige Prvaka
programme.desc: Studijska emisija donosi osvrte i analizu fudbalskih stručnjaka nakon odigrane utakmice Lige prvaka.

programme.title: NHL
programme.desc: The "Natonal Hockey League" is the most prestigious club hockey competition in the world, which dates back to 1917, when the competition was formed and operated with two other North American hockey associations. Since 1926, the NHL has become the main and most important hockey association and thus the competition in North America. The competition itself is divided into two divisions, Western and Eastern, and after the regular part, the playoffs for the Stanley Cup trophy are played. / "Natonal Hockey League" je najprestižnije klupsko hokejaško takmičenje na svijetu koje datira još iz 1917. godine kada je takmičenje formirano i funkcionisalo je sa još dvije sjevernoameričke hokejšake asocijacije. Od 1926. NHL postaje glavna i najznačajnija hokejaška asocijacija i samim time takmičenje u Severnoj Americi. Samo takmičenje je podijeljeno u dve divizije, zapadnu i istočnu te se nakon regularnog dijela igra plejof za trofej Stenli kupa.

With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - 2nd ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. Krka Novo Mesto is the historic first winner of the ABA 2nd League, a competition that was founded in the 2017/2018 season. Along with the victory in the final four and the trophy for the winner, the Krka team also achieved placement in the 1st ABA league from next season. 12 teams participate in the league, and after the two-round system of matches, they are looking for a way to the four best teams and a place in the final four. The purpose of the ABA 2nd League is to enable smaller basketball communities to compete with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Fudbal - Copa Libertadores
programme.desc: "Copa Libertadores" is an annual competition founded in 1960, in which 38 of the best teams from South America compete. Throughout history, the format of the competition has changed, from the fact that only the champions in their respective leagues have the right to perform until today, when each country provides a minimum of three representatives. The most successful club with the most titles won is the Argentinian giant Independiente. Argentina also produced the most Kopa winners. The competition has an iconic status and is considered one of the most exciting football events on the planet. / "Copa Libertadores" je godišnje takmičenje osnovano 1960. godine te u njemu nastupa 38 najboljih ekipa Južne Amerike. Kroz istoriju format takmičenja se mijenjao, od toga da samo prvaci u svojim liga imaju pravo nastupa pa do danas kada svaka država daje po minimalno tri predstavnika. Najuspešniji klub sa najviše osvojenih titula je argentinski velikan Indipendijente. Argentina je dala i najviše osvajača Kope. Takmičenje ima ikonski status te se smatra jednim od nauzbudljivih fudbalskih događaja na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The goal of this league is to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, the regular part, the playoffs and the final tournament of the best four, or popularly called the final four. The final is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Basketball - 2nd ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. Krka Novo Mesto is the historic first winner of the ABA 2nd League, a competition that was founded in the 2017/2018 season. Along with the victory in the final four and the trophy for the winner, the Krka team also achieved placement in the 1st ABA league from next season. 12 teams participate in the league, and after the two-round system of matches, they are looking for a way to the four best teams and a place in the final four. The purpose of the ABA 2nd League is to enable smaller basketball communities to compete with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: The Handball League of Champions has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name of the Champions Cup. We got our first winner in the 1956-1957 season. year, and that was the team from Prague, because in that season only the city's selections performed. Today that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993, the competition was held under that name and was played according to the knockout cup system. Since 1993, in addition to changing the name to the Champions League, a group stage of the competition followed by eliminations has been introduced. The group stage has changed over the years, and the Final Four was introduced for the four best handball teams in Europe, after which the champion is awarded. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka

The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, the regular part, the playoffs and the final tournament of the best four, or popularly called the final four. programme.title: Basketball - 2nd ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. Krka Novo Mesto is the historic first winner of the ABA 2nd League, a competition that was founded in the 2017/2018 season. Along with the victory in the final four and the trophy for the winner, the Krka team also achieved placement in the 1st ABA league from next season. 12 teams participate in the league, and after the two-round system of matches, they are looking for a way to the four best teams and a place in the final four. The purpose of the ABA 2nd League is to enable smaller basketball communities to compete with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: The Handball League of Champions has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name of the Champions Cup. We got our first winner in the 1956-1957 season. year, and that was the team from Prague, because in that season only the city's selections performed. Today that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993, the competition was held under that name and was played according to the knockout cup system. Since 1993, in addition to changing the name to the Champions League, a group stage of the competition followed by eliminations has been introduced. The group stage has changed over the years, and the Final Four was introduced for the four best handball teams in Europe, after which the champion is awarded. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historical title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Zagreb's Dinamo won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Romanian League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: The first football league of Romania has a long history, the first season was played back in 1909, when the now defunct Olympia Bucharest won the first title. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steaua and Dinamo Bucharest, who took most of the championship titles. Currently, the league has 14 clubs and after the "regular" part, where each team plays one game at home and one away, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is the play off for the champion, where the six best-placed clubs participate, while the rest fight in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Basketball - 2nd ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. Krka Novo Mesto is the historic first winner of the ABA 2nd League, a competition that was founded in the 2017/2018 season. Along with the victory in the final four and the trophy for the winner, the Krka team also achieved placement in the 1st ABA league from next season. 12 teams participate in the league, and after the two-round system of matches, they are looking for a way to the four best teams and a place in the final four. The purpose of the ABA 2nd League is to enable smaller basketball communities to compete with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine also participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Zagreb's Dinamo won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Serbian Superliga / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga premiered in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and functions according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - Polish League / Fudbal - Poljska liga
programme.desc: Ekstraklasa is the highest professional football league in Poland. The first Polish football league was founded in 1927, and the league is organized by the Polish Football Association (PZPN). Currently, 16 teams participate in the league, and the winner directly wins the title of Polish champion. / Ekstraklasa je najviša profesionalna fudbalska liga Poljske. Prva liga Poljske u fudbalu osnovana je 1927. godine, a tu ligu organizuje Fudbalski savez Poljske (PZPN). Trenutno u ligi sudjeluje 16 ekipa, a pobjednik direktno osvaja titulu poljskog šampiona.

programme.title: Football - Romanian League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: The first football league of Romania has a long history, the first season was played back in 1909, when the now defunct Olympia Bucharest won the first title. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steaua and Dinamo Bucharest, who took most of the championship titles. Currently, the league has 14 clubs and after the "regular" part, where each team plays one game at home and one away, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is the play off for the champion, where the six best-placed clubs participate, while the rest fight in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Basketball - 2nd ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. Krka Novo Mesto is the historic first winner of the ABA 2nd League, a competition that was founded in the 2017/2018 season. Along with the victory in the final four and the trophy for the winner, the Krka team also achieved placement in the 1st ABA league from next season. 12 teams participate in the league, and after the two-round system of matches, they are looking for a way to the four best teams and a place in the final four. The purpose of the ABA 2nd League is to enable smaller basketball communities to compete with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine also participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Football - French League / Fudbal - Francuska liga
programme.desc: Ligue 1 is the first French professional football league with 20 teams fighting for the French championship title. It was founded in 1932 and is considered one of the most respected European leagues. The club with the most trophies with ten titles won is AS Saint Etienne, but the "Greens" have been waiting for a new title since long ago in 1981 and the time of the great Michel Platini. The matches of the French league are an unmissable event for every fan of this magnificent game. / Ligue 1 prva je francuska profesionalna fudbalska liga koja broji 20 ekipa u borbi za titulom prvaka Francuske. Osnovana je 1932. godine i smatra se jednom od najcenjenijih evropskih liga. Najtrofejniji klub s deset osvojenih titula je AS Sent Etjen ali "Zeleni" na novu titulu čekaju još od davne 1981. godine i vremena velikog Mišela Platinija. Susreti francuske lige nezaobilazan su događaj za svakog ljubitelja ove veličanstvene igre.

programme.title: Basketball - Italian league / Košarka - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The long history of the Italian "Lega Basket Serie A" dates back to 1920 and its collapse. The first winner was the team from Kostana in the same year, 1920. This league is of great importance for European club basketball as a league that has given over 35 titles to its clubs in European competitions, starting with the Euroleague, FIBA ​​Saporta Cup and the Radivoje Korac Cup. The competition itself consists of 30 games that each team plays against 15 opponents in a round robin, followed by an eight-team playoff. The elimination matches are played on four won matches out of seven or in English terminology "Best of seven". / Dugogodišnja istorija italijanske "Lega Basket Serie A" datira još do davne 1920. i njenog osivanja. Prvi pobednik je bila ekipa Kostance iste te 1920. godine. Ova liga ima veliki značaj za evropsku klupsku košarku kao liga koja je dala preko 35 naslova njenih klubova u evropskim takmičenjima počevši od Evrolige, FIBA Saporta Kupa i Kupa Radivoja Koraća. Samo takmičenje se sastoji od 30 utakmica koju svaka ekipa igra protiv 15 protivnika dvokružno, nakon čega sledi plejof od osam ekipa. Eliminacione utakmice se igraju na četiri dobijene utakmice od sedam ili engleska terminologija "Best of seven".

programme.title: Football - Champions League / Fudbal - Liga šampiona
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format, the UEFA Champions League was founded in 1992, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. Real Madrid has won the most European championship titles. / Na predlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga šampiona, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Evrope. Plasman u Ligu šampiona klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige šampiona postalo je televizijski najgledaniji fudbalski događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih titula prvaka Evrope ima madridski velikan Real.

With the media popularization of this format, the UEFA Champions League was founded in 1992, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. Real Madrid has won the most European championship titles. / Na predlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga šampiona, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Evrope. Plasman u Ligu šampiona klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige šampiona postalo je televizijski najgledaniji fudbalski događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih titula prvaka Evrope ima madridski velikan Real.

programme.title: Cycling - Tour de France (M) / Biciklizam - Tur Francuske (M)
programme.desc: The Tour de France is an annual bicycle race through France with occasional visits to neighboring countries. It was held for the first time in 1903 and since then it has been held every year with a break of several years during the two world wars. The race is traditionally run in July for three weeks, it is about 3500 km long and consists of 21 stages and two days off. / Tour de France je godišnja biciklistička trka kroz Francusku uz povremene posete susednim zemljama. Prvi put je održana 1903. i od tada se održava svake godine uz nekoliko godina pauze tokom dva svetska rata. Trka se tradicionalno vozi u julu tokom tri nedelje, dugačka je oko 3500 km i sastoji se od 21 etape i dva slobodna dana.

programme.title: Cycling - Tour de France (M) / Biciklizam - Tur Francuske (M)
programme.desc: The Tour de France is an annual bicycle race through France with occasional visits to neighboring countries. It was held for the first time in 1903 and since then it has been held every year with a break of several years during the two world wars. The race is traditionally run in July for three weeks, it is about 3500 km long and consists of 21 stages and two days off. / Tour de France je godišnja biciklistička trka kroz Francusku uz povremene posete susednim zemljama. Prvi put je održana 1903. i od tada se održava svake godine uz nekoliko godina pauze tokom dva svetska rata. Trka se tradicionalno vozi u julu tokom tri nedelje, dugačka je oko 3500 km i sastoji se od 21 etape i dva slobodna dana.

This competition disappears from the calendar program in 2009 to return again in 2022. / Pratite Tur de Frans za žene, etapnu trku drumskog biciklizma u okviru UCI svetske turneje. U ženskoj konkurenciji nastupiće najbolje takmičarke sveta u borbi za titulu i prestižnu šampionsku dresu.
