programme.title: And she was / I bila je
programme.desc: Byrdie is a prolific screenwriter in her fifties. The problem is that none of the producers want to work with her. Even though she's just completed what is probably the best screenplay of her life, her agent isn't returning her calls, and none of the filmmakers want to read it. So he comes up with a plan to get revenge on them. Looking to revive her career, Byrdie enlists the help of her charming and attractive twentysomething nephew, a former used car salesman, Neil. Just like Cyrano de Bergerac, Byrdie writes screenplays and Neil pitches them to studios as his own. Thanks to Byrdie's giftedness and Neil's youthful charm, the duo achieve great success. Neil soon becomes one of the most sought after Hollywood screenwriters. While visiting the studios, he meets Andrea, the head of acquisitions and the only devotee of Byrdie's work, and falls in love with her. Byrdie and Neil feel guilty about lying to Andrea, but they're in too deep to back out now. Things get even more complicated when Byrdie's family, unaware of their prank, deduces that Byrdie has a drinking problem and organizes an intervention. Despite her fierce opposition, Byrdie is sent to rehab and unable to deliver the script to Neil. Neil tries to write on his own, but soon realizes that writing a screenplay is much more difficult than going to meetings. Does the 50-year-old have a chance to succeed in the ruthless world of Hollywood? And will the truth destroy her nephew's relationship? / Byrdie je plodna scenaristica na pragu pedesete. Problem je što nitko od producenata ne želi raditi s njom. Iako je upravo dovršila vjerojatno najbolji scenarij u svom životu, njezin joj agent ne uzvraća pozive, a nitko ga od filmaša ne želi pročitati. Stoga smisli plan kako da im se osveti. U želji da oživi svoju karijeru, Byrdie potraži pomoć svog šarmantnog i privlačnog dvadeset-i-nešto-godišnjeg nećaka, bivšeg prodavača rabljenih automobila, Neila. Baš poput Cyrana de Bergeraca, Byrdie piše scenarije, a Neil ih studijima nudi kao svoje. Zahvaljujući Byrdienoj darovitosti i Neilovom mladenačkom šarmu, dvojac postiže velik uspjeh. Neil ubrzo postaje jedan od najtraženijih holivudskih scenarista. Obilazeći studije upoznaje Andreu, voditeljicu akvizicija i jedinu poklonicu Byrdienog rada, te se zaljubljuje u nju. Byrdie i Neil imaju grižnju savjesti što lažu Andrei, no preduboko su se uvalili da bi se sad povukli. Stvari se dodatno zakompliciraju kad Byrdiena obitelj, koja ne zna za njihovu podvalu, zaključi da Byrdie ima problema s alkoholom i organizira intervenciju. Unatoč njezinu žestokom protivljenju, Byrdie pošalju na odvikavanje pa ne može Neilu dostaviti scenarij. Neil pokuša sam pisati, no ubrzo shvaća da je pisanje scenarija daleko teže od hodanja po sastancima. Ima li 50-godišnjakinja šanse uspjeti u nemilosrdnom svijetu Hollywooda? I hoće li istina uništiti vezu njezina nećaka?

programme.title: Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: The forgotten battle of Nuštar 91. / Zaboravljena bitka Nuštar 91.
programme.desc: In the fall of 1991, Croatia was fighting a battle for survival. At the very beginning of November, the Slavonian village of Nuštar found itself in an almost hopeless situation as the only unconquered stronghold between the city on the Danube and the city on Bosut. And while the ring around Vukovar tightens more and more, and the enemy, occupying village after village, is getting closer to Vinkovci and the column of exiles is getting longer, it is uncertain how long the few and poorly armed defenders will be able to resist the aggressor. In those days, Nuštar lived through his most dramatic moments in history, and this is the story of a three-day forgotten battle, of despair and hope, of miraculous heroism and the victory of the heart over the armor. Nuštar had no choice, defeat would have written a different history. Animation: Mato Granić / U jesen 1991. godine Hrvatska bije bitku za opstanak. Na samom početku mjeseca studenoga slavonsko selo Nuštar našlo se u gotovo bezizlaznoj situaciji kao jedino neosvojeno uporište između grada na Dunavu i grada na Bosutu. I dok se sve više steže obruč oko Vukovara, a neprijatelj, zauzimajući selo za selom, sve se više približava Vinkovcima te je kolona prognanika sve duža, neizvjesno je koliko dugo će malobrojni i slabo naoružani branitelji moći odolijevati agresoru. Nuštar tih dana proživljava svoje najdramatičnije trenutke u povijesti, a ovo je priča o trodnevnoj zaboravljenoj bici, o očaju i nadi, o čudesnom junaštvu i pobjedi srca nad oklopom. Nuštar nije imao izbora, poraz bi pisao drugačiju povijest. Animacija: Mato Granić

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Zovite babicu
programme.desc: This time, Jenny is not facing the beginning, but the end of her life. Frank, the brother of the cleaner Peggy from Nonnatus House, has cancer, and the sisters take care of him. Jenny thus gets to know better their difficult past and the relationship that was shaped by the childhood spent in the poorhouse. At the same time, the other residents of the house help Fred in his (somewhat unusual) business idea _ raising Evie the piglet. But the bacon-earning plan changes when Evie is left unborn. With that, the police find Sister Monica Joan wandering around the docks and bring her back to Nonnatus House. After recovering from pneumonia, she returns to her duties _ until she's accused of stealing... According to the memoir: Jennifer Worth / Jenny se ovoga puta ne susreće s početkom, već s krajem života. Frank, brat čistačice Peggy iz Nonnatus Housea, obolio je od raka, a sestre se brinu o njemu. Jenny tako bolje upoznaje njihovu tešku prošlost i odnos koji je oblikovalo djetinjstvo provedeno u ubožnici. Paralelno, ostale stanovnice kuće pomažu Fredu u njegovoj (pomalo nesvakidašnjoj) poslovnoj ideji _ uzgoju prasice Evie. No plan o zaradi od slanine mijenja se kad Evie ostane skotna. Uz to policija pronalazi sestru Monicu Joan kako luta po dokovima i vraća je u Nonnatus House. Nakon oporavka od upale pluća, vraća se svojim obavezama _ sve dok je ne optuže za krađu... Prema memoarima: Jennifer Worth

programme.title: Ljubav poslijepodne
programme.desc: Ariane Chavasse (A. Hepburn) is the daughter of a private investigator working on the case of Mr. X (J. McGiven) whose wife is in a secret love affair with a handsome rich man, American Frank Flannagan (G. Cooper). Ariane eavesdrops on her father's conversation and hears Mr. X threatening to kill Flannagan, so she rushes to the hotel and saves him from the wrath of her jealous husband. After that, she arouses the interest of a charming rich man who tries to win a mysterious girl by all means... / Ariane Chavasse (A. Hepburn) kći je privatnog istražitelja koji radi na slučaju gospodina X-a (J. McGiven) čija je žena u tajnoj ljubavnoj vezi sa zgodnim bogatašem, Amerikancem Frankom Flannaganom (G. Cooper). Ariane prisluškuje očev razgovor i načuje gospodina X-a kako prijeti da će ubiti Flannagana, te hita u hotel i spašava ga od bijesa ljubomornog muža. Nakon toga i sama pobuđuje zanimanje šarmantnog bogataša koji na sve načine nastoji osvojiti tajanstvenu djevojku...

programme.title: Pozitivno
programme.desc: Do you know why the Church of St. Maria of Mercy in Vrboska, people call the church Tvrđava? Our guest is the director of the Catholic general high school in Popovača, Rev. Josip Bulat. Among other things, he tells us why he was first a religious teacher, and then a priest, and who confesses best. Be the salt of the earth! _ said Jesus to his disciples and followers. Find out what the symbolism of salt is in the Bible, as well as some other interesting facts. / Znate li zašto Crkvu sv. Marije od Milosti u Vrboskoj u narodu zovu crkva Tvrđava? Gost nam je ravnatelj Katoličke opće gimnazije u Popovači vlč. Josip Bulat. Uz ostalo, govori nam zašto je najprije bio vjeroučitelj, a potom svećenik te tko se najbolje ispovijeda. Budite sol zemlje! _ rekao je Isus svojim učenicima i sljedbenicima. Doznajte koja je simbolika soli u Bibliji, ali i još neke zanimljivosti.

programme.title: Biblija
programme.desc: Every Sunday, the show introduces us to the content, messages and historical context of the Holy Scriptures. Croatian biblical scholars and theologians explain how the Bible was created, what it consists of, who wrote it and when, the differences between the Old and New Testaments, the most famous biblical terms, and who the biblical characters are and what their messages mean for us today. / Svake nedjelje emisija nas upoznaje sa sadržajem, porukama i povijesnim kontekstom Svetoga Pisma. Hrvatski bibličari i teolozi objašnjavaju kako je nastala Biblija, od čega se sastoji, tko ju je pisao i kada, razlike između Starog i Novog Zavjeta, najpoznatije biblijske pojmove te tko su biblijski likovi i što njihove poruke znače za nas danas.

programme.title: Misa
programme.desc: Parish of the Exaltation of St. The cross in Lukarišće was established on Josipovo in 2004. The parish church was blessed by Cardinal Josip Bozanić on December 19, 2010, and consecrated on August 16, 2020. World Mission Day, established by Pope Pius XI. 1926, is celebrated on the penultimate Sunday in October. The mass in Lukarišće will be led by Rev. Tomislav Kralj, parish priest in Dugi Selo. Production organizer: Ante Vito Valić Director: Neven Mihael Dianežević Editor: Dragutin Siladi / Župa Uzvišenja Sv. Križa u Lukarišću ustanovljena je na Josipovo 2004. godine. Župnu crkvu blagoslovio je kardinal Josip Bozanić 19. prosinca 2010., a posvetio ju je 16. kolovoza 2020. Svjetski dan misija, koji je ustanovio papa Pio XI. 1926., obilježava se predzadnje nedjelje u listopadu. Misu u Lukarišću predvodit će vlč. Tomislav Kralj, župnik u Dugom Selu. Organizator produkcije: Ante Vito Valić Redatelj: Neven Mihael Dianežević Urednik: Dragutin Siladi

programme.title: Stories with conch from borscha by Stanko Ferić / Priče s končom iz borše Stanka Ferića
programme.desc: Few people today still remember the intoxicating and sweet wine nectar _ dessert marastina, which was produced in the Šibenik region for several centuries until the middle of the 20th century. But once upon a time, almost every house there had that wine, not only noble and middle-class, but also heavy ones. It was drunk in small quantities, on holidays, as a delicacy, but also put in individual, also delicate dishes, such as Skradin cake, or fragrant Christmas sausages, luganig. The Tambača and Škarica families from Šibenik got rich from its production during the 19th century. and the first half of the 20th century, receiving numerous wine awards for him at international exhibitions. However, after II. after the Second World War, the delicate and relatively complex production of the dessert maraština stagnated, and in the end it stopped altogether _ until 2019, when, in cooperation with HRT and Vinarija Sladić from Plastovo, a village above Skradin, and at the instigation of our storyteller with a conch, Stanko Ferić, it was restarted... Researcher and narrator: Stanko Ferić Performer of original music: Alan Bjelinski / Opojnog i slatkog vinskog nektara _ desertne maraštine koja se tijekom nekoliko stoljeća, sve do sredine XX. proizvodila u šibenskom kraju, danas se još malo tko sjeća. Ali nekoć je to vino ondje imala gotovo svaka kuća, ne samo plemićka i građanska već i težačka. Pilo ga se u malim količinama, za blagdane, kao delikatesu, ali i stavljalo u pojedina, također delikatesna jela, poput skradinske torte, ili mirisnih božićnih kobasica, luganiga. Šibenske obitelji Tambača i Škarica obogatile su se na njegovoj proizvodnji tijekom XIX. i prve polovine XX. st., primajući za njega na međunarodnim izložbama i brojna vinska odličja. Međutim, nakon II. svjetskog rata delikatna i relativno složena proizvodnja desertne maraštine stagnirala je, a na kraju i sasvim prestala _ sve do 2019., kad je, u suradnji HRT-a i Vinarije Sladić iz Plastova, sela iznad Skradina, a na poticaj našeg pripovjedača s končom, Stanka Ferića, ponovno pokrenuta... Istraživač i narator: Stanko Ferić Izvođač originalne glazbe: Alan Bjelinski

It is broadcast from HRT's studios in Split, Rijeka, Zadar and Pula. / Mozaična informativna emisija posvećena bogatstvu našeg Jadranskog mora, obale i priobalja. Donosi zanimljive reportaže o temama vezanim za život na moru i uz njega. Emitira se iz HRT-ovih studija Split, Rijeka, Zadar i Pula.

programme.title: Nedjeljom u dva
programme.desc: Why do we kill animals and could we survive as a species without meat? Is a diet without meat healthy and does it contribute to the preservation of the environment _ are just some of the questions that will be discussed in the show "Sunday at 2", whose guest is the president of the Animal Friends Association, Luka Oman. / Zašto ubijamo životinje i bismo li kao vrsta mogli opstati bez mesa? Je li prehrana bez mesa zdrava i doprinosi li očuvanju okoliša _ samo su neka od pitanja o kojima će biti riječi u emisiji "Nedjeljom u 2", čiji je gost predsjednik udruge Prijatelji životinja, Luka Oman.

programme.title: Gentler among women / Blaž među ženama
programme.desc: The new employee of the Harbor Master's Office is Elvis, the senior manager of Bokobran and a fierce fighter. Blaž's presentation in Kapetania was "hacked" by Špira's dating app. For the first day of school, Ivona receives a shocker-pen from Daria, a diary of his childhood from Blaž, a tablet from Ankica, and a bengal from Špira! Kindred souls, Ješko and Sphinx in a blind date, Blago from grief and their offer you can't refuse, NATO ships in the port of Split, golduni in Filipino and other antics in the new episode of Blaž's torture. / Novi zaposlenik Lučke kapetanije je Elvis, viši upravnik Bokobrana i žestoki torcidaš. Blaževa prezentacija u Kapetaniji "hakirana" je Špirinom aplikacijom za dejtanje. Ivona za prvi dan škole od Darije dobiva šoker-penkalu, od Blaža dnevnik njegovog djetinjstva, od Ankice tablet, a od Špire _ bengalku! Srodne duše, Ješka i Sfinga u spoju naslijepo, Blago sa žala i njihova ponuda koju ne možete odbiti, NATO brodovi u splitskoj luci, golduni na filipinskom i druge ludorije u novoj epizodi muka po Blažu.

programme.title: The cloud in the service of the law / Oblak u službi zakona
programme.desc: Nikola is lying sick, and an urn with the ashes of his late wife is placed on his table in the station. Ružić. The lady's granddaughter brought it because her grave was stolen. Požgaj must solve a case of theft in which the high-ranking police officer Pohajda from Narcotics is also involved. / Nikola leži bolestan, a na njegov je stol u postaji odložena urna s pepelom pokojne gđe. Ružić. Donijela ju je gospođina unuka jer joj je ukraden grob. Požgaj mora riješiti slučaj krađe u koji je umiješan i visokopozicionirani policijski službenik Pohajda iz Narkotika.

programme.title: Volim Hrvatsku
programme.desc: Sunday afternoons are again cheered up by the team of the show Volim Hrvatska. The captains are Dušan Bućan and Goran Navojec. In the fifth show, Dušan's team will feature: Antonela Đinđić, Romina Tonković and Goran Grgić, while Laura Sučec, Dino Antonić and Jelena Perčin will be in Goran's team. Contestants will try their hand at well-known games such as Guess the Song, Happy Birthday, TV and Film, Sport, Famous Compatriots, Shufflers, Average Citizen and Word Croatian. The show is hosted by Mirko Fodor. The hits of local music are performed live by the band Ante Gele. / Nedjeljna popodneva ponovno uveseljava ekipa šoua Volim Hrvatsku. Kapetani su Dušan Bućan i Goran Navojec. U petoj emisiji u Dušanovom timu nastupaju: Antonela Đinđić, Romina Tonković i Goran Grgić, dok će u Goranovom timu biti Laura Sučec, Dino Antonić i Jelena Perčin. Natjecatelji će se okušati u dobro poznatim igrama poput Pogodi pjesmu, Sretan rođendan, TV i film, Sport, Poznati sunarodnjaci, Premetaljke, Prosječni građanin i Riječ hrvatska. Emisiju vodi Mirko Fodor. Hitove domaće glazbe uživo izvodi bend Ante Gele.

programme.title: Superpotjera
programme.desc: In the Superchase, hunters join a super team _ five top experts who act as one. Having created one of the most powerful quiz teams in the world, they are ready to face any challenger. Who among the contestants has enough knowledge, skill and concentration to defeat this unbeatable team? / U Superpotjeri lovci se udružuju u super tim _ petero vrhunskih znalaca koji djeluju kao jedan. Stvorivši jednu od najmoćnijih kvizaških ekipa na svijetu, spremni su suočiti se sa svakim izazivačem. Tko među natjecateljima ima dovoljno znanja, vještine i koncentracije da pobijedi ovaj nepobjedivi tim?

programme.title: Appaloosa na kraju puta
programme.desc: Viggo Mortensen and Ed Harris play hired law enforcement officers on the hunt for an escaped killer, and Oscar winner Renee Zellweger plays a beautiful and dangerous widow with ulterior motives. Their paths will cross in the lawless town of Appaloosa in the Wild West. Virgil Cole (Harris) and Everett Hitch (Mortensen) arrive in Appaloosa, a small, dusty town abused by an outlaw rancher with no respect for the law. He regularly steals goods from shops, horses and women, and he also killed the town sheriff and his deputies. Cole and Hitch, traveling peacekeepers, know how to get rid of opportunistic thieves, but this time they encounter an unusually stubborn opponent who not only skilfully plays with the law, but also with their feelings. / Viggo Mortensen i Ed Harris glume unajmljene čuvare zakona u lovu na odbjeglog ubojicu, a oskarovka Renee Zellweger glumi lijepu i opasnu udovicu s prikrivenim namjerama. Njihovi će se putovi ukrižiti u bezakonjem rastrganom gradiću Appaloosi na Divljem zapadu. Virgil Cole (Harris) i Everett Hitch (Mortensen) stižu u Appaloosu, malen, prašnjav grad koji zlostavlja rančer odmetnik bez imalo poštovanja prema zakonu. Redovito otima robu iz dućana, konje i žene, a ubio je i gradskog šerifa i njegove zamjenike. Cole i Hitch, putujući čuvari reda i mira, znaju kako se riješiti oportunističkih kradljivaca, no ovaj put nailaze na neuobičajeno tvrdokornog protivnika koji ne samo da se vješto poigrava sa zakonom, već i s njihovim osjećajima.

programme.title: Diary 3 / Dnevnik 3
programme.desc: The latest news from the country and the world and a summary weather forecast for the next day. / Najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta te sažeta vremenska prognoza za sljedeći dan.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Slava ubija
programme.desc: Tupac transformed rap from a simple street trend into an elite art form. He laid the foundations for today's version of hip-hop and continued its development as a poet whose stories of alienation captivated young people, regardless of race or background. From the beginning, he suspected that he would not live long, and he had a strong desire to leave a mark with his creativity. He wrote, composed and recorded continuously. Even while he was serving a prison sentence, he was writing a screenplay. Knowing that he did not have much time in this world, he came with a clear purpose _ and left a legacy that deeply influenced an entire generation. The circumstances of his death have never been clarified. With most of the key players dead or serving long prison terms, we'll probably never know exactly what happened. Still, that won't stop people from trying to find out. / Tupac je preobrazio rap iz jednostavnog uličnog trenda u elitnu umjetničku formu. Postavio je temelje za današnju verziju hip-hopa i nastavio njegov razvoj kao pjesnik čije su priče o otuđenosti osvojile mlade, bez obzira na rasnu pripadnost i podrijetlo. Od početka je slutio da neće dugo živjeti, a imao je snažnu želju da svojim stvaralaštvom ostavi trag. Neprekidno je pisao, skladao i snimao. Čak i dok je služio zatvorsku kaznu, pisao je scenarij. Znajući da nema mnogo vremena na ovom svijetu, došao je s jasnom svrhom _ i ostavio naslijeđe koje je duboko utjecalo na cijeli naraštaj. Okolnosti njegove smrti nikada nisu razjašnjene. S obzirom na to da je većina ključnih sudionika mrtva ili služi dugogodišnju zatvorsku kaznu, vjerojatno nikad nećemo saznati što se točno dogodilo. Ipak, to neće spriječiti ljude da pokušaju otkriti.

programme.title: Yves Saint Laurent
programme.desc: Biographical drama. Paris, 1957. At only 21 years old, Yves Saint Laurent became the director of a large fashion house founded by Christian Dior. All eyes were on this young assistant as he presented his first haute couture collection for Dior. At that highly successful and innovative fashion show, Yves Saint Laurent met Pierre Berge, the love of his life and longtime business partner. Three years later, they founded the company Yves Saint Laurent together, which became one of the most famous luxury fashion brands. / Biografska drama. Pariz, 1957. Sa samo 21 godinom Yves Saint Laurent postao je direktor velike modne kuće koju je osnovao Christian Dior. Sve oči bile su uprte u tog mladog asistenta dok je predstavljao svoju prvu kolekciju visoke mode za Dior. Na toj vrlo uspješnoj i inovativnoj reviji Yves Saint Laurent upoznao je Pierrea Bergea, ljubav svog života i dugogodišnjeg poslovnog partnera. Tri godine kasnije zajedno su osnovali kompaniju Yves Saint Laurent koja je postala jedna od najpoznatijih luksuznih modnih marki.

programme.title: Plodovi zemlje
programme.desc: The Sunday show about agriculture and fisheries deals with current topics, critically discusses agrarian policy, advises and teaches viewers, and provides agricultural forecasting. The oldest specialized show of Croatian Television, broadcast since 1958. / Nedjeljna emisija o poljoprivredi i ribarstvu bavi se aktualnim temama, kritički progovara o agrarnoj politici, savjetuje i poučava gledatelje te donosi agroprognozu. Najstarija specijalizirana emisija Hrvatske televizije, emitira se od 1958. godine.

programme.title: Nedjeljom u dva
programme.desc: Why do we kill animals and could we survive as a species without meat? Is a diet without meat healthy and does it contribute to the preservation of the environment _ are just some of the questions that will be discussed in the show "Sunday at 2", whose guest is the president of the Animal Friends Association, Luka Oman. / Zašto ubijamo životinje i bismo li kao vrsta mogli opstati bez mesa? Je li prehrana bez mesa zdrava i doprinosi li očuvanju okoliša _ samo su neka od pitanja o kojima će biti riječi u emisiji "Nedjeljom u 2", čiji je gost predsjednik udruge Prijatelji životinja, Luka Oman.

programme.title: Stories with conch from borscha by Stanko Ferić / Priče s končom iz borše Stanka Ferića
programme.desc: Few people today still remember the intoxicating and sweet wine nectar _ dessert marastina, which was produced in the Šibenik region for several centuries until the middle of the 20th century. But once upon a time, almost every house there had that wine, not only noble and middle-class, but also heavy ones. It was drunk in small quantities, on holidays, as a delicacy, but also put in individual, also delicate dishes, such as Skradin cake, or fragrant Christmas sausages, luganig. The Tambača and Škarica families from Šibenik got rich from its production during the 19th century. and the first half of the 20th century, receiving numerous wine awards for him at international exhibitions. However, after II. after the Second World War, the delicate and relatively complex production of the dessert maraština stagnated, and in the end it stopped altogether _ until 2019, when, in cooperation with HRT and Vinarija Sladić from Plastovo, a village above Skradin, and at the instigation of our storyteller with a conch, Stanko Ferić, it was restarted... Researcher and narrator: Stanko Ferić Performer of original music: Alan Bjelinski / Opojnog i slatkog vinskog nektara _ desertne maraštine koja se tijekom nekoliko stoljeća, sve do sredine XX. proizvodila u šibenskom kraju, danas se još malo tko sjeća. Ali nekoć je to vino ondje imala gotovo svaka kuća, ne samo plemićka i građanska već i težačka. Pilo ga se u malim količinama, za blagdane, kao delikatesu, ali i stavljalo u pojedina, također delikatesna jela, poput skradinske torte, ili mirisnih božićnih kobasica, luganiga. Šibenske obitelji Tambača i Škarica obogatile su se na njegovoj proizvodnji tijekom XIX. i prve polovine XX. st., primajući za njega na međunarodnim izložbama i brojna vinska odličja. Međutim, nakon II. svjetskog rata delikatna i relativno složena proizvodnja desertne maraštine stagnirala je, a na kraju i sasvim prestala _ sve do 2019., kad je, u suradnji HRT-a i Vinarije Sladić iz Plastova, sela iznad Skradina, a na poticaj našeg pripovjedača s končom, Stanka Ferića, ponovno pokrenuta... Istraživač i narator: Stanko Ferić Izvođač originalne glazbe: Alan Bjelinski

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Pozitivno
programme.desc: Do you know why the Church of St. Maria of Mercy in Vrboska, people call the church Tvrđava? Our guest is the director of the Catholic general high school in Popovača, Rev. Josip Bulat. Among other things, he tells us why he was first a religious teacher, and then a priest, and who confesses best. Be the salt of the earth! _ said Jesus to his disciples and followers. Find out what the symbolism of salt is in the Bible, as well as some other interesting facts. / Znate li zašto Crkvu sv. Marije od Milosti u Vrboskoj u narodu zovu crkva Tvrđava? Gost nam je ravnatelj Katoličke opće gimnazije u Popovači vlč. Josip Bulat. Uz ostalo, govori nam zašto je najprije bio vjeroučitelj, a potom svećenik te tko se najbolje ispovijeda. Budite sol zemlje! _ rekao je Isus svojim učenicima i sljedbenicima. Doznajte koja je simbolika soli u Bibliji, ali i još neke zanimljivosti.

programme.title: Zadar: Sea / Zadar: More
programme.desc: A mosaic informative show dedicated to the wealth of our Adriatic Sea, coast and coastline. It brings interesting reports on topics related to life at sea and by it. It is broadcast from HRT's studios in Split, Rijeka, Zadar and Pula. / Mozaična informativna emisija posvećena bogatstvu našeg Jadranskog mora, obale i priobalja. Donosi zanimljive reportaže o temama vezanim za život na moru i uz njega. Emitira se iz HRT-ovih studija Split, Rijeka, Zadar i Pula.

programme.title: The third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: Joy, excitement, fear, uncertainty... all that, and a lot more confusion in the head, causes retirement. This is often witnessed by those who leave the world of work and face a new period of life. Can and how can we prepare for this new life chapter? Of course, those who have already experienced it can teach us this best. One of them is the retired doctor Mira Lončar Dušek, who wrote a book about the "pension project", the story of which was written by Branimira Volf Milunović. And what are the conditions for a less stressful retirement, do we know what memory optimism is and what we can do to make retirement as pleasant as possible, we will talk with psychologist Lovorka Brajković. / Radost, uzbuđenje, strah, neizvjesnost... sve to, pa i puno više zbrke u glavi, izaziva odlazak u mirovinu. Svjedoče nam to često oni koji napuštaju svijet rada i suočavaju se s novim razdobljem života. Možemo li se i kako pripremiti na to novo životno poglavlje? Tomu nas, naravno, mogu najbolje poučiti oni koji su to već iskusili. Jedna od njih je i umirovljena liječnica Mira Lončar Dušek, koja je o "projektu mirovina" napisala knjigu, o kojoj je priču napravila Branimira Volf Milunović. A koji su uvjeti za manje stresan odlazak u mirovinu, znamo li što je optimizam pamćenja i što sami možemo napraviti da mirovina bude što ugodnija, razgovarat ćemo s psihologinjom Lovorkom Brajković.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Some Italian dishes are too good for Lidia not to share with others. For example, a version of bruschetta with mussels, inspired by Lidia's favorite restaurant on the beach in Fiumicino. Afterwards, Lorenzo will stop by for an olive oil tasting. At the end, Lidia will prepare a dish from the coast in Amalfi _ spaghetti in cream sauce and lemon juice. Lidia fell in love with these dishes at the first bite, so she hopes that we will too. / Neka talijanska jela predobra su da ih Lidia ne bi podijelila s drugima. Primjerice, inačica brusketa s dagnjama, nadahnuta Lidijinim najdražim restoranom na plaži u Fiumicinu. Potom će Lorenzo svratiti na degustaciju maslinova ulja. Lidia će na kraju pripremiti jelo s obale u Amalfiju _ špagete u umaku od vrhnja i limunova soka. Lidia se u ova jela zaljubila na prvi zalogaj pa se nada da ćemo se i mi.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: Botox is best known for its aesthetic application, but it is also much more than that. From migraines to muscle spasms, from sweating to urology _ Botox helps people as a medicine as well. How it works and when it is used, we will find out in today's show from urologist Dr. Anđel Mojsović, neurologist Assoc. Ph.D. Hrvoje Budinčević and otorhinolaryngologist Assoc. Ph.D. Krešimir Gršić. / Botoks je najpoznatiji po svojoj estetskoj primjeni, ali je i puno više od toga. Od migrena do spazma mišića, od znojenja do urologije _ botoks pomaže ljudima i kao lijek. Kako funkcionira i kada se koristi doznat ćemo u današnjoj emisiji od urologa dr. Anđela Mojsovića, neurologa doc. dr. sc. Hrvoja Budinčevića i otorinolaringologa doc. dr. sc. Krešimira Gršića.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Sport
programme.desc: Daily sports reports and reports. / Dnevni sportski izvještaji i reportaže.

programme.title: Vrijeme
programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Marco denies that Marquinho is Tiago's son. This infuriates Tiago and he attacks Marco, and the security guards intervene. Lalá persuades Valdemar to meet, claiming to be coming on Simone's behalf. He warns Valdemar that Simone wants to press charges against him for impersonating a baron and stealing her jewelry. / Marco poriče da je Marquinho Tiagov sin. To razbjesni Tiaga i on napadne Marca, a zaštitari interveniraju. Lalá nagovori Valdemara da se susretnu, tvrdeći da dolazi u Simoneino ime. Upozori Valdemara da Simone želi podići optužnicu protiv njega jer se lažno predstavljao kao barun i što joj je ukrao nakit.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Pía confesses to Romulus that she killed the baron. Martina drags Jacob into organizing the wedding. Leocadia warns Cruz that she got married on false grounds. Catalina catches Samuel stealing the vase. Jana finally discovers the secret passage opening and tells Curro that Cruz killed Tomás. / Pía prizna Romulu da je ubila baruna. Martina zavlači Jacoba s organizacijom vjenčanja. Leocadia upozori Cruz da se udala na lažnim temeljima. Catalina zatekne Samuela u krađi vaze. Jana napokon otkrije kako se otvara tajni prolaz i kaže Curru kako je Cruz ubila Tomása.

programme.title: Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: A herb hunter visits Psunj, a mountain in the southwestern region of Slavonia in eastern Croatia. It is the highest mountain in Slavonia, with the highest peak Brezovo polje at 985 meters above sea level, located in the Požega-Slavonia County. Psunj has a Paleozoic core surrounded by Neogene sediments. The higher parts of the mountain are covered with forest, and the foothills are planted with vineyards and orchards. Some of the plants in this episode are Japanese gardenia, field horsetail, judder's ear, white comfrey, male fern, buttercup, and primrose. The guests of the episode are ecological producer Tatjana Ordanić and the owner of an adventure agency in Slavonia, Josip "Lux" Lukačević. / Lovac na bilje posjećuje Psunj, planinu u jugozapadnom području Slavonije u istočnoj Hrvatskoj. To je najviša planina Slavonije, s najvišim vrhom Brezovo polje na 985 metara nadmorske visine, koji se nalazi u Požeško-slavonskoj županiji. Psunj ima paleozojsku jezgru koju okružuju neogenski sedimenti. Viši dijelovi planine prekriveni su šumom, a na prigorjima su zasađeni vinogradi i voćnjaci. Neke od biljaka u ovoj epizodi su japanski dvornik, poljska preslica, judino uho, bijeli gavez, muška paprat, zdravičica i šumska krasuljica. Gosti epizode su ekološka proizvođačica Tatjana Ordanić i vlasnik pustolovne agencije u Slavoniji Josip "Lux" Lukačević.

programme.title: Our little parties / Naše male fešte
programme.desc: The episode follows the Brodet Cup in Ližnjan, a traditional event that brings together locals and visitors around a sailing regatta, a culinary competition and various fun activities while emphasizing the togetherness and love for the sea that this small festival brings. / Epizoda prati Brodet kup u Ližnjanu, tradicionalnu manifestaciju koja mještane i posjetitelje okuplja oko jedriličarske regate, kulinarskog natjecanja i raznih zabavnih aktivnosti uz isticanje zajedništva i ljubavi prema moru koje ova mala fešta donosi.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: This week Ben will spend practically at home. In rural Oxfordshire, he will be the guest of an extended family who have given up their conventional lifestyle and moved to a 16-acre property. Ben will find out what obstacles they faced, how they spent twenty years perfecting the skills of cultivating the land on which eleven family members live today. They will also discover how the Muslim faith affects their approach to agriculture. As their guest, Ben will take care of sheep, take care of hooves, drive a tractor, feed thousands of chickens... He will realize that it is possible to live in the homeland as well as in the isolated wilderness, and learn that the future of this rural idyll is in doubt. / Ovaj tjedan Ben će provesti praktički kod kuće. U ruralnom Oxfordshireu bit će gost proširene obitelji koja se odrekla konvencionalnog načina života i preselila na posjed površine 16 hektara. Ben će saznati s kakvim su se preprekama susretali, kako su dvadeset godina usavršavali vještine obrade zemlje na kojoj danas živi jedanaest članova obitelji. Otkrit će i kako muslimanska vjera utječe na njihov pristup poljoprivredi. Kao njihov gost, Ben će čuvati ovce, njegovati papke, voziti traktor, hraniti tisuće kokoši... Shvatit će da se i u zavičaju može živjeti kao i u izoliranoj divljini te saznati da je budućnost ove seoske idile pod upitnikom.

programme.desc: HTV teams from all Croatian counties bring the most interesting current events and stories from all over the country, and there is also a detailed regional weather forecast. / Ekipe HTV-a iz svih hrvatskih županija donose najzanimljivije aktualne događaje i priče iz cijele zemlje, a tu je i detaljna regionalna vremenska prognoza.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: The daily show Kod nas doma talks about current topics and events in our country and in the world every weekday afternoon. It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

programme.title: Potjera
programme.desc: In The Chase, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. But the Hunter stands in their way. In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz _ it is also a race in which the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is? / U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?

programme.title: Vrijeme
programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2
programme.desc: The most important news from the country and the world, numerous reports, guest appearances by prominent experts and commentators in Dnevnik 2, the most watched news show on HTV. In addition to sports news, see the detailed weather forecast for the following days. / Najvažnije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta, brojne reportaže, gostovanja istaknutih stručnjaka i komentatora u Dnevniku 2, u najgledanijoj informativnoj emisiji HTV-a. Uz sportske aktualnosti pogledajte i detaljnu vremensku prognozu za sljedeće dane.

programme.title: Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: The Knežević family from Šiškovci has been cultivating beekeeping for four generations. Their story was not without challenges, the head of the family survived a heart attack twice and returned to his work each time. Today, the whole family works side by side, producing top quality honey and at the same time contributing to the preservation of nature and biodiversity. The episode tells a story about perseverance, togetherness and love for work that overcomes obstacles. / Obitelj Knežević iz Šiškovaca već četiri generacije njeguje pčelarstvo. Njihova priča nije bila bez izazova, glava obitelji dvaput je preživio infarkt i svaki put se vraćao svom poslu. Danas cijela obitelj radi rame uz rame, proizvodeći vrhunski med i istodobno pridonoseći očuvanju prirode i biodiverziteta. Epizoda donosi priču o ustrajnosti, zajedništvu i ljubavi prema poslu koji nadilazi prepreke.

programme.title: Gentler among women / Blaž među ženama
programme.desc: Through Ho, Spiro finds out who Anki's crush really is and decides to do something. In order to reduce the number of angry people from the cramped house, Daria plans to move in with grandmother Bjanka, but not only Bjanka but also her cat Bajdo is wondering about it. Some of our eastern neighbors are looking for Maja in Split _ who would it be but her abandoned and grieving husband? Blaž oscillates between all these situations like a ball in a pinball machine, on the way looking for the Holy Grail _ tickets for an exclusive concert by Nene Belan... Creators of the series: Branko Ružić and Goran Kulenović / Špiro preko Ho doznaje tko je zapravo Ankičina simpatija i odlučuje nešto poduzeti. Kako bi smanjila broj čeljadi bijesne iz kuće tijesne, Daria se planira smjestiti kod bake Bjanke, ali tu se ne pita samo Bjanka nego i njezin mačak Bajdo. Maju po Splitu traži neki naš istočni susjed _ tko bi to bio nego njezin ostavljeni i ucviljeni suprug? Blaž između svih tih situacija titra kao kuglica u fliperu, usput tražeći Sveti Gral _ karte za ekskluzivni koncert Nene Belana... Tvorci serije: Branko Ružić i Goran Kulenović

programme.title: Otvoreno
programme.desc: HTV's central political talk show in which the political topic of the day is analyzed every evening from Monday to Thursday with relevant guests from opposing viewpoints. / Središnji politički talk show HTV-a u kojem se svake večeri od ponedjeljka do četvrtka uz relevantne goste suprotstavljenih stajališta analizira politička tema dana.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Labirint
programme.desc: Sleep disorders are present all over the world. A third of Europeans suffer from insomnia. Even more than eighty percent of Croats are not satisfied with the quality of their sleep. And while some people struggle with insomnia, others with respiratory arrest during sleep _ what are the consequences of sleepless nights? When and where to seek help? / Poremećaji spavanja prisutni su u cijelome svijetu. Trećina Europljana boluje od nesanice. Čak više od osamdeset posto Hrvata nije zadovoljno kvalitetom svojeg sna. I dok se jedni bore s nesanicom, drugi sa zastojem disanja tijekom spavanja _ koje su posljedice neprospavanih noći? Kada i gdje potražiti pomoć?

programme.title: Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: All life needs water to survive. But water is not always available and animal parents have to adapt to this issue without question. Dedication, perseverance and sheer courage are key to success in the freshwater world. In the Brazilian Amazon, thousands of turtles must predict the timing of the seasonal rains before laying their eggs. If they get it wrong, their young will drown underground, but if they get it right, it will be the start of one of the greatest spectacles on Earth as thousands of baby turtles follow their mothers' call to the water. In Namibia, watering holes provide a reliable source for the desert life of male South African saja. He must choose wisely the moment of decision in which to take water for his birds. If he makes a mistake in one second, he will end up in the claws of a predator. Some animal parents try to turn the power of water to their advantage. In the Caribbean, a flounder called a tri-tri diverts an underwater current to supply oxygen to its eggs. But before the eggs are laid, a once-in-a-lifetime storm sweeps him and everything he's made downstream. You have to make it over three hundred meters of waterfalls to get another chance for parenthood. In the wetlands of Florida, the clever swamp canary uses the power of its bite to pull its young out of danger in a matter of seconds. For some, it seems that the search for water never ends. In drought-stricken Kenya, an elephant and her family must share the remaining water with humans until the rains begin. And when it rains, the water is so violent that it can become deadly. With climate change, the movement of fresh water is increasingly difficult to predict. Humans and wildlife are adapting to changing freshwater flows, but we may choose to give the next generation a future where freshwater is a more reliable factor. / Sav život treba vodu da bi opstao. No voda nije stalno dostupna i roditelji životinja moraju se bespogovorno prilagođavati tom pitanju. Predanost, ustrajnost i puka hrabrost ključni su za uspjeh u slatkovodnom svijetu. U brazilskoj Amazoniji tisuće kornjača moraju predvidjeti vrijeme sezonskih kiša prije nego što polože jaja. Ako pogriješe, njihov će se pomladak utopiti pod zemljom, ali ako dobro pogode, bit će to početak jednog od najvećih spektakala na Zemlji jer tisuće mladunaca kornjača slijede poziv svojih majki u vodu. U Namibiji pojilišta pružaju pouzdan izvor za pustinjski život mužjaka južnoafričke sadže. Mora mudro odabrati trenutak odluke u kojem će uzeti vodu za svoje ptiće. Pogriješi li za jednu sekundu, završit će u pandžama grabljivice. Neki životinjski roditelji pokušavaju okrenuti snagu vode u svoju korist. Na Karibima, glavoč zvan tri-tri skreće podvodnu struju za dovod kisika svojim jajašcima. No prije nego što su jajašca i položena, oluja koja se događa jednom u životu odnese nizvodno i njega i sve što je izradio. Mora se uspeti preko tristo metara slapova da bi dobio još jednu priliku za roditeljstvo. U močvarnim staništima Floride pametni močvarni kanarinac koristi se snagom zalogaja da izvuče svoju mladunce iz ralja opasnosti u trenutku kad je sve pitanje sekundi. Nekima se čini da potraga za vodom nikad ne prestaje. U sušom pogođenoj Keniji slonica i njezina obitelj moraju dijeliti preostalu vodu s ljudima dok ne počnu kiše. A kad kiša padne, voda je toliko silovita da može postati smrtonosna. Promjenom klime kretanja slatke vode sve je teže predvidjeti. Ljudi i divlje životinje prilagođavaju se promjenjivim slatkovodnim tokovima, ali možda odlučimo pružiti sljedećem naraštaju budućnost u kojoj će slatka voda biti pouzdaniji čimbenik.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Pía confesses to Romulus that she killed the baron. Martina drags Jacob into organizing the wedding. Leocadia warns Cruz that she got married on false grounds. Catalina catches Samuel stealing the vase. Jana finally discovers the secret passage opening and tells Curro that Cruz killed Tomás. / Pía prizna Romulu da je ubila baruna. Martina zavlači Jacoba s organizacijom vjenčanja. Leocadia upozori Cruz da se udala na lažnim temeljima. Catalina zatekne Samuela u krađi vaze. Jana napokon otkrije kako se otvara tajni prolaz i kaže Curru kako je Cruz ubila Tomása.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Joaquim realizes his plan to destroy the fashion show. He begs Onofre for help to slow down the production of fabric in the factory. Mariana is a high-ranking member of the Brazilian Aid Legion, and steals the donated items for herself. However, Arminda finds out and hatches a plan with Julinha to expose her. With the arrival of the first lady in town, Mariana falls for Julina's trick and exposes her in front of Mrs. Darci Vargas. During the fashion show, Yedda, a friend of Eugenio's ex-fiancée, reveals to him that he has never been cheated on. Matias goes crazy with jealousy when he hears that Violeta and Eugenio got married. Joaquim turns off the lights in the theater to ruin the fashion show, but Rafael manages the situation. Isadora finally surrenders to the love she feels and kisses Rafael. Eugenio kisses Violeta. Matias reveals Heloís's secret. / Joaquim ostvari svoj plan kojim želi uništiti modnu reviju. Moli Onofrea za pomoć kako bi usporio proizvodnju tkanine u tvornici. Mariana je visokopozicionirana u Brazilskoj legiji za pomoć, i ukrade donirane stvari za sebe. Međutim, Arminda to sazna i kuje plan sa Julinhom kako bi je razotkrile. Dolaskom prve dame u grad, Mariana nasjedne na Julinhinu smicalicu i razotkriju je pred gđom Darci Vargas. Tijekom modne revije, Yedda, prijateljica Eugeniove bivše zaručnice otkrije mu da on nikad nije bio prevaren. Matias poludi od ljubomore kad čuje da su se Violeta i Eugenio vjenčali. Joaquim gasi svjetla u kazalištu kako bi uništio modnu reviju, ali Rafael se snađe u toj situaciji. Isadora se konačno prepusti ljubavi koju osjeća i poljubi Rafaela. Eugenio poljubi Violetu. Matias oda Heloísinu tajnu.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Marco denies that Marquinho is Tiago's son. This infuriates Tiago and he attacks Marco, and the security guards intervene. Lalá persuades Valdemar to meet, claiming to be coming on Simone's behalf. He warns Valdemar that Simone wants to press charges against him for impersonating a baron and stealing her jewelry. / Marco poriče da je Marquinho Tiagov sin. To razbjesni Tiaga i on napadne Marca, a zaštitari interveniraju. Lalá nagovori Valdemara da se susretnu, tvrdeći da dolazi u Simoneino ime. Upozori Valdemara da Simone želi podići optužnicu protiv njega jer se lažno predstavljao kao barun i što joj je ukrao nakit.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: The daily show Kod nas doma talks about current topics and events in our country and in the world every weekday afternoon. It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: The third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: Joy, excitement, fear, uncertainty... all that, and a lot more confusion in the head, causes retirement. This is often witnessed by those who leave the world of work and face a new period of life. Can and how can we prepare for this new life chapter? Of course, those who have already experienced it can teach us this best. One of them is the retired doctor Mira Lončar Dušek, who wrote a book about the "pension project", the story of which was written by Branimira Volf Milunović. And what are the conditions for a less stressful retirement, do we know what memory optimism is and what we can do to make retirement as pleasant as possible, we will talk with psychologist Lovorka Brajković. / Radost, uzbuđenje, strah, neizvjesnost... sve to, pa i puno više zbrke u glavi, izaziva odlazak u mirovinu. Svjedoče nam to često oni koji napuštaju svijet rada i suočavaju se s novim razdobljem života. Možemo li se i kako pripremiti na to novo životno poglavlje? Tomu nas, naravno, mogu najbolje poučiti oni koji su to već iskusili. Jedna od njih je i umirovljena liječnica Mira Lončar Dušek, koja je o "projektu mirovina" napisala knjigu, o kojoj je priču napravila Branimira Volf Milunović. A koji su uvjeti za manje stresan odlazak u mirovinu, znamo li što je optimizam pamćenja i što sami možemo napraviti da mirovina bude što ugodnija, razgovarat ćemo s psihologinjom Lovorkom Brajković.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: Botox is best known for its aesthetic application, but it is also much more than that. From migraines to muscle spasms, from sweating to urology _ Botox helps people as a medicine as well. How it works and when it is used, we will find out in today's show from urologist Dr. Anđel Mojsović, neurologist Assoc. Ph.D. Hrvoje Budinčević and otorhinolaryngologist Assoc. Ph.D. Krešimir Gršić. / Botoks je najpoznatiji po svojoj estetskoj primjeni, ali je i puno više od toga. Od migrena do spazma mišića, od znojenja do urologije _ botoks pomaže ljudima i kao lijek. Kako funkcionira i kada se koristi doznat ćemo u današnjoj emisiji od urologa dr. Anđela Mojsovića, neurologa doc. dr. sc. Hrvoja Budinčevića i otorinolaringologa doc. dr. sc. Krešimira Gršića.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Some Italian dishes are too good for Lidia not to share with others. For example, a version of bruschetta with mussels, inspired by Lidia's favorite restaurant on the beach in Fiumicino. Afterwards, Lorenzo will stop by for an olive oil tasting. At the end, Lidia will prepare a dish from the coast in Amalfi _ spaghetti in cream sauce and lemon juice. Lidia fell in love with these dishes at the first bite, so she hopes that we will too. / Neka talijanska jela predobra su da ih Lidia ne bi podijelila s drugima. Primjerice, inačica brusketa s dagnjama, nadahnuta Lidijinim najdražim restoranom na plaži u Fiumicinu. Potom će Lorenzo svratiti na degustaciju maslinova ulja. Lidia će na kraju pripremiti jelo s obale u Amalfiju _ špagete u umaku od vrhnja i limunova soka. Lidia se u ova jela zaljubila na prvi zalogaj pa se nada da ćemo se i mi.

programme.title: Zlatna liga
programme.desc: Two giants are coming to visit us. Both are academics and bards of Croatian architecture. We are honored to host Andrija Mutnjaković and Nikola Bašić in the Golden League! Half an hour is absolutely not enough for their huge oeuvre and incredible contribution to Croatian architecture, that's why in the conversation we will only touch on some of their works, such as the Trešnja Theatre, the library in Priština or... the Zadar sea organ and Salutation to the Sun, as well as Kornati crosses. Of course, along with these two architectural giants, we will touch on urbanism as a burning problem in Croatia. / U goste nam dolaze dvojica velikana. Obojica su akademici i bardovi hrvatske arhitekture. Čast nam je u Zlatnoj ligi ugostiti Andriju Mutnjakovića i Nikolu Bašića! Pola sata je apsolutno nedostatno za njihov golemi opus i nevjerojatan doprinos hrvatskoj arhitekturi, zato ćemo se u razgovoru dotaknuti samo nekih od njihovih djela, poput Kazališta Trešnja, biblioteke u Prištini ili... zadarskih morskih orgulja i Pozdrava Suncu, ali i kornatskih križeva. Naravno, uz ovakva dva arhitektonska velikana, dotaknut ćemo se urbanizma kao gorućeg problema u Hrvatskoj.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Dining is not the only way to bond with family and friends. This can also be achieved by cooking together. So let's prepare dinner together. Lidija's quick penne with cauliflower and green olive pesto are perfect for that. And with a little advance planning, Lidia's salad of poached chicken and pickled vegetables will be a complete meal full of proteins, vegetables, colors and flavors. / Objedovanje nije jedini način zbližavanja s obitelji i prijateljima. To se može postići i zajedničkim kuhanjem. Zato zajedno pripremimo večeru. Za to su savršene Lidijine brzinske penne s cvjetačom i pestom od zelenih maslina. A uz malo prethodnog planiranja, Lidijina salata od poširane piletine i kiselog povrća bit će cjelovit obrok pun bjelančevina, povrća, boja i okusa.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: Staying healthy _ is it a matter of choice or circumstance? Are we destined for some diseases? Can we change outcomes? How much they depend on our decisions and lifestyle, we discover in the show. The geneticist Assoc. will help us in this. Ph.D. Ljubica Odak, Dr. Laura Vidović and nutritionist Dr. sc. Eva Pavić. / Ostati zdrav _ je li to stvar izbora ili okolnosti? Jesmo li predodređeni za neke bolesti? Možemo li promijeniti ishode? Koliko oni ovise o našim odlukama i načinu života, otkrivamo u emisiji. U tome će nam pomoći genetičarka doc. dr. sc. Ljubica Odak, dr. Laura Vidović i nutricionistica dr. sc. Eva Pavić.

Júlia kaže Vitoriji da Marco još inzistira da je Marquinho njegov sin.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Jana barely avoids the marquise finding her in the secret room. Catalina stops Samuel from stealing the vase, but decides to give it to him herself for a noble cause. Curro tells Cruz that he knows she's arranging a marriage for him behind his back... and brings up more than he should have in an argument. / Jana jedva izbjegne da je markiza zatekne u tajnoj sobi. Catalina spriječi Samuela da ukrade vazu, no odluči mu je sama predati za plemenitu svrhu. Curro kaže Cruz da zna kako ona dogovara brak za njega iza njegovih leđa... i u svađi iznese više nego što je trebalo.

programme.title: In Suzy's kitchen / U kuhinji kod Suzy
programme.desc: Suzy Josipović let us into her home where she prepares a simple dish in the kitchen in front of the cameras and shares her culinary knowledge and experience with us. / Suzy Josipović pustila nas je u svoj dom gdje u kuhinji ispred kamera sprema jednostavno jelo te dijeli s nama svoje kulinarsko znanje i iskustvo.

programme.title: Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: The Knežević family from Šiškovci has been cultivating beekeeping for four generations. Their story was not without challenges, the head of the family survived a heart attack twice and returned to his work each time. Today, the whole family works side by side, producing top quality honey and at the same time contributing to the preservation of nature and biodiversity. The episode tells a story about perseverance, togetherness and love for work that overcomes obstacles. / Obitelj Knežević iz Šiškovaca već četiri generacije njeguje pčelarstvo. Njihova priča nije bila bez izazova, glava obitelji dvaput je preživio infarkt i svaki put se vraćao svom poslu. Danas cijela obitelj radi rame uz rame, proizvodeći vrhunski med i istodobno pridonoseći očuvanju prirode i biodiverziteta. Epizoda donosi priču o ustrajnosti, zajedništvu i ljubavi prema poslu koji nadilazi prepreke.

programme.title: Our little parties / Naše male fešte
programme.desc: The episode takes us to Vinkovci, where the rich history of this town, famous for the Roman emperors Valens and Valentinian, is celebrated. Through a dynamic presentation of the Roman festival, we follow the preparations and activities of visitors and organizers, from pottery workshops to the spectacular parade of legionnaires and gladiator fights. The culmination of the day is the Roman feast, where local restaurateurs recreate Roman delicacies, and it ends under the stars, with special screenings of chivalric films and a sense of community. / Epizoda nas vodi u Vinkovce, gdje se slavi bogata povijest ovog grada, poznatog po rimskim carevima Valensu i Valentinijanu. Kroz dinamičan prikaz Rimske fešte, pratimo pripreme i aktivnosti posjetitelja i organizatora, od radionica lončarstva do spektakularnog mimohoda legionara i borbi gladijatora. Kulminacija dana je Rimska gozba, gdje lokalni ugostitelji rekonstruiraju rimske delicije, a završava pod zvijezdama, s posebnim prikazima viteških filmova i osjećajem zajedništva.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben travels to the Arizona desert where he meets Dee _ a retiree who lives a nomadic life. She converted a military truck into a cozy house for living, and she documents her adventures on You Tube under the name "Box Van Dee". As he follows Dee in his car, Ben will experience firsthand what it's like to live in a small vehicle in the middle of the desert. Together they will solve the problems of food preparation, water collection, waste disposal and solar panel repair. Ben will find out about Dee's creative activities and how she finds friends. / Ben putuje u pustinju u Arizoni gdje će upoznati Dee _ umirovljenicu koja živi nomadskim životom. Vojni kamion preuredila je u ugodnu kućicu za stanovanje, a svoje pustolovine dokumentira na You Tubeu pod imenom "Box Van Dee". Dok bude automobilom slijedio Dee, Ben će iz prve ruke iskusiti kako je to živjeti u malom vozilu usred pustinje. Zajedno će rješavati probleme pripreme jela, skupljanja vode, bacanja otpada i popravka solarnih panela. Ben će saznati s kojim se kreativnim aktivnostima Dee bavi i kako nalazi prijatelje.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma

It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

programme.title: Potjera
programme.desc: In The Chase, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. But the Hunter stands in their way. In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz _ it is also a race in which the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is? / U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?

programme.title: Vrijeme
programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2
programme.desc: The most important news from the country and the world, numerous reports, guest appearances by prominent experts and commentators in Dnevnik 2, the most watched news show on HTV. In addition to sports news, see the detailed weather forecast for the following days. / Najvažnije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta, brojne reportaže, gostovanja istaknutih stručnjaka i komentatora u Dnevniku 2, u najgledanijoj informativnoj emisiji HTV-a. Uz sportske aktualnosti pogledajte i detaljnu vremensku prognozu za sljedeće dane.

programme.title: Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: What happens in the virtual world rarely stays there. For a once hidden heavenly place like Blue Cave, the echo in reality means that after a series of reviews and likes, it will be at the top of the list of top five undiscovered destinations of Croatian islands in a flash. But when the hidden paradise becomes only a backdrop for selfies, and the sea _ soup of tourists _ there is a fine line between discovery and destruction. Can our fantastic natural beauty survive its own popularity if every star has consequences? / Ono što se dogodi u virtualnom svijetu, rijetko ondje i ostane. Za nekada skriveno rajsko mjesto poput Modre špilje, odjek u stvarnosti znači da će nakon niza recenzija i lajkova, munjevito biti na vrhu liste top pet neotkrivenih destinacija hrvatskih otoka. No kada skriveni raj postane tek kulisa za selfije, a more _ juha od turista _ tanka je granica između otkrivanja i uništavanja. Mogu li naše fantastične prirodne ljepote preživjeti vlastitu popularnost ako svaka zvjezdica ima posljedice?

programme.title: Policijske priče
programme.desc: This episode brings us the untold story of the mine in the port of Rijeka, which filled the newspaper columns. Find out firsthand how pyrotechnicians feel when they have to dive into the mud and come face to face with an explosive device. / Neispričanu priču o mini u luci Rijeka koja je punila novinske stupce donosi nam ova epizoda. Iz prve ruke doznajte kako se osjećaju pirotehničari u trenutku kada moraju zaroniti u mulj i naći se licem u lice s eksplozivnom napravom.

programme.title: Kotlina
programme.desc: After the corpse disappears from the morgue, Edib and Mido try to discover the victim's identity by following various clues. Ajla still fails to interview Selma, but comes across intriguing information about secret plans related to the museum. Senchi, using old criminal connections, tries to get hold of Smiley. Creators: Danis Tanović, Amra Bakšić Čamo / Nakon što leš nestane iz mrtvačnice, Edib i Mido pokušavaju otkriti identitet žrtve slijedeći razne tragove. Ajla i dalje ne uspijeva obaviti intervju sa Selmom, no dolazi do intrigantnih informacija o tajnim planovima vezanim za muzej. Senči, koristeći stare kriminalne veze, pokušava doći do Smajlija. Kreatori: Danis Tanović, Amra Bakšić Čamo

programme.title: Otvoreno
programme.desc: HTV's central political talk show in which the political topic of the day is analyzed every evening from Monday to Thursday with relevant guests from opposing viewpoints. / Središnji politički talk show HTV-a u kojem se svake večeri od ponedjeljka do četvrtka uz relevantne goste suprotstavljenih stajališta analizira politička tema dana.

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: The guest of Razgovor with a reason is the director of the Zagreb Youth Theater Snježana Abramović Milković. We talk about the role played by boards that mean life in society. Should provocation and criticism be avoided or encouraged in the theater? Why is it important for the theater to be brave, to be a space of freedom and truth? Why does it have to question social movements and political power? Why should you feel for a person? Can we purify traumas and unresolved relationships through theater? Why is international cooperation important to ZKM? From drama to dance, from provocation to artistic freedom, there are many reasons to talk to Snježana Abramović Milković. / Gošća Razgovora s razlogom je ravnateljica Zagrebačkog kazališta mladih Snježana Abramović Milković. Razgovaramo o ulozi koju u društvu igraju daske koje život znače. Treba li u kazalištu izbjegavati provokaciju i kritiku ili ih poticati? Zašto je važno da kazalište bude hrabro, da bude prostor slobode i istine? Zašto mora preispitivati društvena kretanja i političku moć? Zašto treba imati osjećaj za čovjeka? Možemo li kroz kazalište pročistiti traume i neriješene odnose? Zašto je ZKM-u važna međunarodna suradnja? Od drame do plesa od provokacije do umjetničke slobode, mnogo je razloga za razgovor sa Snježanom Abramović Milković.

programme.title: Legende o Zemlji
programme.desc: According to ancient philosophy, four basic elements interact to create our planet. One of them is air. This invisible and untouchable element has created amazing phenomena such as powerful tornadoes in the USA or wild storms that hit the Irish coast, but also the wonderful aurora borealis in the Finnish sky. In this sequel, legends and science help explain the origin and beauty of these unusual landscapes. / Prema antičkoj filozofiji, četiri osnovna elementa međudjelovanjem stvaraju naš planet. Jedan je od njih zrak. Taj nevidljivi i nedodirljivi element stvorio je začuđujuće pojave poput snažnih tornada u SAD-u ili divljih oluja koje pogađaju irsku obalu, ali i divnu polarnu svjetlost na finskom nebu. U ovom nastavku legende i znanost pomažu objasniti postanak i ljepotu tih neobičnih krajolika.

Curro kaže Cruz da zna kako ona dogovara brak za njega iza njegovih leđa... i u svađi iznese više nego što je trebalo.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Matias remembers the day Heloísa gave herself to him as a very young girl. He reveals that he remembers that Heloís' lost daughter is also his. Mrs. Felicidade finds a new relationship with Onofre and worries about firing him after it is revealed that he deliberately sabotaged the factory for money. Isadora breaks off her engagement with Joaquim, which makes him angry. Isadora tells Violeta that she has finally given in to the love she feels for Rafael. Mariana blackmails Ms. Julinha into rehiring her at the Brazilian Aid Legion. Eugenio and Violeta kiss again and he confesses that he is in love with her. Julinha cannot resist the temptation and takes the money that Darca gave to the Brazilian Legion. He gambled with him and lost. Julinha's mother suddenly appears and settles in Constantin's house. Olívia tells Father Tenori that she is in love with him. Joaquim finds a hit man who should kill Rafael. / Matias se prisjeća dana kada mu se Heloísa podala kao vrlo mlada djevojka. Otkrije da se sjeća kako je Heloísina izgubljena kći također i njegova. Gđa Felicidade nađe novi čunak s Onofreom i zabrine se hoće li ga otpustiti nakon što se otkrije da je on namjerno sabotirao tvornicu zbog novca. Isadora raskine zaruke sa Joaquimom, a njega to razljuti. Isadora kaže Violeti da je napokon popustila ljubavi koju osjeća prema Rafaelu. Mariana ucjenjuje gđu Julinhu kako bi je ponovno zaposlila u Brazilskoj legiji za pomoć. Eugenio i Violeta ponovno se poljube i on prizna da je zaljubljen u nju. Julinha ne može odoljeti kušnji i uzima novac koji je Darci dala Brazilskoj legiji. Kocka s njim i izgubi. Julinhina majka se iznenada pojavi i smjesti se u Constantinovoj kući. Olívia kaže ocu Tenoriju da je zaljubljena u njega. Joaquim nađe plaćenog ubojicu koji bi trebao ubiti Rafaela.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Marlene questions Susana about Simone and Rui. He offers her money for information. programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Ivančica or Ivanščica, also known as Očura in older literature, is the highest mountain in Croatian Zagorje. On its slopes, especially the southern ones, after the invasion of the Tatars in the middle of the 13th century, but also later during the war with the Ottomans _ forts, noble cities were built that functioned mainly until the 17th century, when they were abandoned and fell into oblivion. Researchers of the past of noble towns have been warning for more than a century about their importance and the need for the places where generations of noble families who created Croatian history were born, married and died to be better known, restored or at least preserved in their current state. So far, only a few have been so lucky. / Ivančica ili Ivanščica, u starijoj literaturi poznata i kao Očura, najviša je planina u Hrvatskom zagorju. Po njezinim se padinama, osobito južnima, grade nakon provale Tatara sredinom 13. stojeća ali i poslije u doba rata s Osmanlijama _ utvrde, plemićki gradovi koji funkcioniraju uglavnom do u 17. stoljeće kad se napuštaju i padaju u zaborav. Istraživači prošlosti plemićkih gradova već više od stoljeća upozoravaju na njihovu važnost i potrebu da se mjesta gdje su se rađale, ženile i umirale generacije plemićkih rodova koji su stvarali hrvatsku povijest bolje upoznaju, obnove ili barem konzerviraju u svom sadašnjem stanju. Dosad su samo rijetki bili te sreće.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: Staying healthy _ is it a matter of choice or circumstance? Are we destined for some diseases? Can we change outcomes? How much they depend on our decisions and lifestyle, we discover in the show. The geneticist Assoc. will help us in this. Ph.D. Ljubica Odak, Dr. Laura Vidović and nutritionist Dr. sc. Eva Pavić. / Ostati zdrav _ je li to stvar izbora ili okolnosti? Jesmo li predodređeni za neke bolesti? Možemo li promijeniti ishode? Koliko oni ovise o našim odlukama i načinu života, otkrivamo u emisiji. U tome će nam pomoći genetičarka doc. dr. sc. Ljubica Odak, dr. Laura Vidović i nutricionistica dr. sc. Eva Pavić.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Dining is not the only way to bond with family and friends. This can also be achieved by cooking together. So let's prepare dinner together. Lidija's quick penne with cauliflower and green olive pesto are perfect for that. And with a little advance planning, Lidia's salad of poached chicken and pickled vegetables will be a complete meal full of proteins, vegetables, colors and flavors. / Objedovanje nije jedini način zbližavanja s obitelji i prijateljima. To se može postići i zajedničkim kuhanjem. Zato zajedno pripremimo večeru. Za to su savršene Lidijine brzinske penne s cvjetačom i pestom od zelenih maslina. A uz malo prethodnog planiranja, Lidijina salata od poširane piletine i kiselog povrća bit će cjelovit obrok pun bjelančevina, povrća, boja i okusa.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Zlatna liga
programme.desc: Veterans of the Rijeka club Primorje are with us today. One of them achieved top results as a player in order to later pass on knowledge and experience to younger players. The other continued his sports career as a water polo referee, but also a respected businessman, one of the pioneers of containerization in our country. Today, Zoran Roje and Zvonko Brkljačić are in the pool of the Golden League. / S nama su danas veterani riječkog kluba Primorje. Jedan je kao igrač postigao vrhunske rezultate da bi kasnije znanje i iskustvo prenosio mlađima . Drugi je sportsku karijeru nastavio kao vaterpolo sudac, ali i ugledni gospodarstvenik, jedan od pionira kontejnerizacije u nas. Danas su u bazenu Zlatne lige mnogostruko nagrađivani i već odavno zlatni _ Zoran Roje i Zvonko Brkljačić.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Time spent cooking helps you develop a refined palate, improve your cooking skills and boost your confidence. Today, Lidia will reveal the secrets of preparing a salad of thinly sliced ​​artichokes, spinach and mortadella. He will pair that special salad with one of his favorite dishes _ mussels with sausage meat and potatoes in white wine, which is a great weekday one-pot meal. / Vrijeme provedeno u kuhanju pomaže vam da steknete istančano nepce, poboljšate kuharske vještine i povećate samopouzdanje. Lidia će danas otkriti tajne pripreme salate od tanko narezanih artičoka, špinata i mortadele. Tu posebnu salatu spojit će s jednim od svojih najdražih jela _ dagnjama s mesom kobasica i krumpirom u bijelom vinu, što je izvrsno jelo iz jednog lonca na radni dan.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: The brain is the center of the nervous system and the most important organ for the human ability to think and most functions in the body. It has no pain receptors and therefore cannot feel pain, but any disease affecting that organ can be fatal. One of them is certainly meningitis, the secrets of which we reveal with infectious disease specialist Viktor Kotarski and virologist Vladimir Stevanović. / Mozak je središte živčanog sustava i najvažniji organ za čovjekovu sposobnost razmišljanja i većinu funkcija u tijelu. Nema receptore za bol i zbog toga ne može osjetiti bol, no svaka bolest koja zahvati taj organ može biti fatalna. Jedna od njih svakako je meningitis čije tajne razotkrivamo s infektologom Viktorom Kotarskim i virologom Vladimirom Stevanovićem.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.
