programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Júlia confides in Vitoria that Marco still claims to be Marquinho's father and says that a DNA test should be done. He also tells her that David has agreed to move in with her. But she is now afraid that Tiago will want to bring Cacau and Marquinho to the house. / Júlia se povjeri Vitoriji da Marco i dalje tvrdi da je Marquinhov otac i kaže da bi valjalo napraviti DNK test. Također joj kaže da se David pristao doseliti k njoj. Ali ona se sada boji da će Tiago htjeti dovesti u kuću Cacau i Marquinha.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Curro does not dare to accuse Cruz of Tomás and Dolores' murder. Leocadia is suspicious because Jana keeps asking her about Dolores. Catalina works out permission for María Fernández and Samuel to travel to sell the vase. / Curro se ne usudi optužiti Cruz za Tomásovo i Doloresino ubojstvo. Leocadia je sumnjičava jer je Jana uporno ispituje o Dolores. Catalina isposluje dopuštenje za Maríju Fernández i Samuela da otputuju prodati vazu.

programme.title: In Suzy's kitchen / U kuhinji kod Suzy
programme.desc: Suzy Josipović let us into her home where she prepares a simple dish in the kitchen in front of the cameras and shares her culinary knowledge and experience with us. / Suzy Josipović pustila nas je u svoj dom gdje u kuhinji ispred kamera sprema jednostavno jelo te dijeli s nama svoje kulinarsko znanje i iskustvo.

programme.title: Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: What happens in the virtual world rarely stays there. For a once hidden heavenly place like Blue Cave, the echo in reality means that after a series of reviews and likes, it will be at the top of the list of top five undiscovered destinations of Croatian islands in a flash. But when the hidden paradise becomes only a backdrop for selfies, and the sea _ soup of tourists _ there is a fine line between discovery and destruction. Can our fantastic natural beauty survive its own popularity if every star has consequences? / Ono što se dogodi u virtualnom svijetu, rijetko ondje i ostane. Za nekada skriveno rajsko mjesto poput Modre špilje, odjek u stvarnosti znači da će nakon niza recenzija i lajkova, munjevito biti na vrhu liste top pet neotkrivenih destinacija hrvatskih otoka. No kada skriveni raj postane tek kulisa za selfije, a more _ juha od turista _ tanka je granica između otkrivanja i uništavanja. Mogu li naše fantastične prirodne ljepote preživjeti vlastitu popularnost ako svaka zvjezdica ima posljedice?

programme.title: Policijske priče
programme.desc: This episode brings us the untold story of the mine in the port of Rijeka, which filled the newspaper columns. Find out firsthand how pyrotechnicians feel when they have to dive into the mud and come face to face with an explosive device. / Neispričanu priču o mini u luci Rijeka koja je punila novinske stupce donosi nam ova epizoda. Iz prve ruke doznajte kako se osjećaju pirotehničari u trenutku kada moraju zaroniti u mulj i naći se licem u lice s eksplozivnom napravom.

programme.title: Our little parties / Naše male fešte
programme.desc: The episode takes us to Zlarin, where every year the "World Championship in mullet hunting" is held, one of the most unusual competitions in Croatia. We follow the locals who prepare their dishes with humor and tradition, and competitors from all over the world compete in catching fish using special techniques and secrets they inherited from their grandfathers. With joy, jokes and friendly competition, the inhabitants of Zlarin celebrate this unique event, which gathers more than 500 competitors and becomes a symbol of community, tradition and the summer spirit of the island. / Epizoda nas vodi na Zlarin, gdje se svake godine održava "Svjetsko prvenstvo u lovu ciplov na teću", jedno od najneobičnijih natjecanja u Hrvatskoj. Pratimo mještane koji s humorom i tradicijom pripremaju svoje teće, a natjecatelji iz cijelog svijeta natječu se u lovu riba pomoću posebnih tehnika i tajni koje su naslijedili od svojih djedova. S veseljem, šalama i prijateljskim nadmetanjem Zlarinjani slave ovu jedinstvenu manifestaciju, koja okuplja više od 500 natjecatelja i postaje simbol zajedništva, tradicije i ljetnog duha otoka.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben Fogle will visit legendary snowboarder Mike Basich _ a man who gave up fame and fortune to connect with nature and lead a quiet life in the Sierra Nevada mountains. He will be his guest in the log cabin, find out what Mike thinks about extreme sports, why he decided to leave that life and what his next big project is. Ben will join Mike in a snowy idyll and explore the mountain on skis. He will make sure that Mike is a gifted mechanic, metal worker and carpenter who knows how to cut down a tree, install solar panels, a jacuzzi and his own ski lift. / Ben Fogle će posjetiti legendarnog daskaša na snijegu Mikea Basicha _ čovjeka koji se odrekao slave i bogatstva kako bi se povezao s prirodom i vodio miran život u gorju Sierra Nevada. Bit će njegov gost u brvnari, saznati što Mike misli o ekstremnim sportovima, zašto je odlučio ostaviti taj život i što je njegov sljedeći veliki projekt. Ben će se pridružiti Mikeu u snježnoj idili i istraživati planinu na skijama. Uvjerit će se da je Mike nadaren mehaničar, metalac i stolar koji zna posjeći stablo, ugraditi solarne panele, jacuzzi i vlastiti skijaški lift.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: The daily show Kod nas doma talks about current topics and events in our country and in the world every weekday afternoon. It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

The chase is not just a quiz _ it is also a race in which the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is? / U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Uz sportske aktualnosti pogledajte i detaljnu vremensku prognozu za sljedeće dane.

programme.title: Heart 7 / Loto 7
programme.desc: Follow the Lot 7 draw live. / Pratite izravno izvlačenje Lota 7.

programme.title: Dnevnik Nomada
programme.desc: In the valley of the Omo river, in the extreme south of Ethiopia, Kristijan Iličić witnesses the living customs of the tribes that were ruled by the Seljan brothers on behalf of the Ethiopian emperor. In the Hamar tribe, he attends a shocking ceremony of whipping women. In the Karo tribe, he discovers the terrible practice of killing the so-called cursed "mingi" children, so he talks to a mother who killed her three children because of superstition. From the women of the Mursi tribe, he learns everything about the tradition of wearing a plate in the mouth, and in the Dasanech tribe, he discovers the horrors of genital mutilation of girls. But although the reality of tribal life is often shocking, it also contains many positive sides, the humanity that Christian manages to bring to the surface. In the Omo River Valley, he is also trying to find the girls from his tattoos, which he photographed in 2009, when he first visited the tribes in southern Ethiopia. / U dolini rijeke Omo, na krajnjem jugu Etiopije, Kristijan Iličić svjedoči i danas živim običajima plemena kojima su u ime etiopskog cara vladala braća Seljan. U plemenu Hamar nazoči šokantnoj ceremoniji bičevanja žena. U plemenu Karo otkriva strašnu praksu ubojstva tzv. uklete "mingi" djece pa razgovara s majkom koja je zbog praznovjerja ubila svoje troje djece. Od žena iz plemena Mursi saznaje sve o tradiciji nošenja tanjura u usnama, a u plemenu Dasanech otkriva užase genitalne mutilacije djevojčica. Ali iako je stvarnost plemenskog života često šokantna, ona sadrži i mnoge pozitivne strane, ljudskost koju Kristijan uspijeva izvući na površinu. U dolini rijeke Omo također pokušava pronaći djevojčice sa svojih tetovaža, koje je fotografirao 2009., kada je prvi put posjetio plemena na jugu Etiopije.

programme.title: Krah
programme.desc: Social services increasingly threaten to tear the Carrisford family apart, and the consequences of Jess and Ed's behavior slowly begin to affect all their friends. New alliances are formed and new betrayals are born. After seeing Jess and Ed's relationship begin to crumble, Mel begins to question what she really believes. After Frankie's medical examination, suspicion falls on both parents. During this time, Jess becomes convinced that the hospital is not taking enough care of Betsey and tries to find new ways to get involved. Charlotte is adamant about helping Ed legally. Because of this, he is not only risking his own marriage. The tension spreads to the playground, so Mela and Jessa's trip to Richmond Park ends in disaster. The whole group immediately returned to the hospital. Liz is reaching for alcohol more and more and thus endangering her career. A professional mistake calls her judgment into question. As her worst suspicions seem to be coming true, Jess takes shocking steps to protect Betsey. / Socijalna služba sve snažnije prijeti da će razdvojiti obitelj Carrisford, a posljedice Jessina i Edova ponašanja polako počinju utjecati na sve njihove prijatelje. Formiraju se nova savezništva i rađaju nove izdaje. Nakon što je vidjela kako se Jessina i Edova veza počinje raspadati, Mel počinje propitkivati u što zapravo vjeruje. Nakon Frankiejeva liječničkog pregleda, sumnja pada na oba roditelja. Za to vrijeme Jess postane uvjerena da se bolnica ne brine dovoljno o Betsey te pokušava pronaći nove načine kako da se umiješa. Charlotte je nepokolebljiva u namjeri da pravno pomogne Edu. Zbog toga ne riskira samo vlastiti brak. Napetost se širi i na igralište pa Melin i Jessin izlet u park Richmond završava pravom katastrofom. Cijela se skupina odmah vrati u bolnicu. Liz sve više poseže za alkoholom i time ugrožava svoju karijeru. Profesionalna pogreška dovede u pitanje njezinu moć rasuđivanja. Budući da se čini kako se ostvaruju njezine najgore slutnje, Jess poduzima šokantne korake kako bi zaštitila Betsey.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Remek-djelo ili zlodjelo
programme.desc: In this episode, Fiona Bruce and Philip Mold investigate a mysterious canvas that could be the work of one of the pioneers of abstract expressionism, Arshile Gorky. The works of this Armenian-American artist reach millions at auctions, but owner Liza Dunluca is separated from a possible profit by a big obstacle _ the canvas is covered with a layer of white paint. The painting was given as a gift by Liz's late husband, Alexander, in 1965, when he was working as a curator in the conservation department of London's Tate Gallery. Alexander was an extremely respected restorer, and Gorkog's widow, Agnes Mougouch Magruder, asked him to remove the white layer so that the work could be exhibited in a major retrospective exhibition. When Alexander failed to do so in time, Mougouch gave him the painting. Almost six decades later, the painting is still in the family _ partially obscured and without official recognition as the work of Gorko. Dissatisfied that solving the case is not progressing, Liza turned to the Masterpiece or Crime team for help. / U ovoj epizodi Fiona Bruce i Philip Mould istražuju zagonetno platno koje bi moglo biti djelo jednog od pionira apstraktnog ekspresionizma, Arshilea Gorkog. Djela ovog armensko-američkog umjetnika na aukcijama postižu milijunske iznose, no vlasnicu Lizu Dunluce od moguće zarade dijeli velika prepreka _ platno je prekriveno slojem bijele boje. Sliku je na dar dobio Lizin pokojni suprug Alexander 1965., kada je radio kao kustos na odjelu za konzervaciju londonske galerije Tate. Alexander je bio iznimno cijenjen restaurator, a udovica Gorkoga, Agnes Mougouch Magruder, zamolila ga je da ukloni bijeli sloj kako bi djelo moglo biti izloženo na velikoj retrospektivnoj izložbi. Kad Alexander to nije uspio učiniti na vrijeme, Mougouch mu je sliku darovala. Gotovo šest desetljeća poslije slika je i dalje u obitelji _ djelomično zaklonjena i bez službenog priznanja kao djelo Gorkoga. Nezadovoljna što rješavanje slučaja ne napreduje, Liza se za pomoć obratila ekipi Remek-djela ili zlodjela.

programme.title: Krajnja desnica i neonacisti
programme.desc: Across Europe, a new generation of white supremacists is being radicalized. They dream of an ethnically pure Europe and take action. A far-right coup was prevented in Germany. In France, they arrested six people who were planning to attack politicians. In Bratislava, a student associated with the extreme right killed two people in front of a club for LGBT people. We will meet with people who are considered race war ideologues and investigate these new white supremacists and the threat they pose. Wunsiedel, Northern Bavaria. The neo-Nazi political party Dritte Weg gathered to pay tribute to Adolf Hitler's deputy Rudolf HeSS. Locals silently watch as they march through the streets carrying torches and placards and beating drums. What is happening in Germany is happening all over Europe. The threat of far-right violence has never been stronger. Their targets are Muslims, Jews, migrants, left-wing leaders who, in their opinion, threaten the continent with a "great racial exchange". We spent two years investigating these semi-hidden networks in France, Germany and Romania. We opened a fake profile on a French neo-Nazi forum. He is one of many who spread hatred on the Internet, and has more than 3,600 members. There are also white-only dating platforms that celebrate "white life, white love." Members exchange Nazi souvenirs. We will meet with a man who fought in the ranks of the SS in the Second World War. Shockingly, he still nostalgically misses Nazi ideals. A role model for many fighters for the white race is Daniel Conversano who left France and went to the "land of the whites" Romania where he gathered a community of "braves". Among his followers is the convicted terrorist Login Nisin, who admitted that he planned to kill Christophe Castaner and Jean-Luc Melenchon. In Bucharest, we visited Conversan and his supporters and questioned him about his views. Many believe that a "racial civil war" is inevitable. Terrorism expert Frank Dittrich explains: "There is always a risk that a group of people will, in the worst case, carry out attacks against government institutions, migrants or political enemies." Far-right extremists are now seen as the biggest threat to democracy in Europe. / Diljem Europe radikalizira se novi naraštaj bjelačkih suprematista. Maštaju o etnički čistoj Europi i kreću u akciju. U Njemačkoj je spriječen puč krajnje desnice. U Francuskoj su uhitili šestero ljudi koji su planirali napasti političare. U Bratislavi je student povezan s krajnjom desnicom ubio dvoje ljudi ispred kluba za LGBT osobe. Sastat ćemo se s ljudima koji se smatraju ideolozima rasnoga rata i istražiti te nove bjelačke suprematiste i prijetnju koju predstavljaju. Wunsiedel, sjeverna Bavarska. Neonacistička politička stranka Dritte Weg okupila se kako bi odala počast zamjeniku Adolfa Hitlera Rudolfu HeSSu. Mještani nijemo promatraju kako stupaju ulicama noseći baklje i plakate te bubnjajući. Ono što se događa u Njemačkoj događa se u cijeloj Europi. Prijetnja nasiljem krajnje desnice nikada nije bila tako jaka. Njihove su mete muslimani, židovi, migranti, ljevičarski vođe koji, prema njihovu mišljenju, prijete kontinentu "velikom rasnom zamjenom". Dvije smo godine istraživali te poluskrivene mreže u Francuskoj, Njemačkoj i Rumunjskoj. Otvorili smo lažni profil na francuskom neonacističkom forumu. Jedan je od mnogih koji na internetu šire mržnju, a ima više od 3600 članova. Postoje i platforme za upoznavanje partnera namijenjene samo bijelcima koje slave "bijeli život, bijelu ljubav". Članovi razmjenjuju nacističke suvenire. Sastat ćemo se s čovjekom koji se u Drugom svjetskom ratu borio u redovima SS-a. Šokantno, no još mu nostalgično nedostaju nacistički ideali. Uzor mnogim borcima za bijelu rasu je Daniel Conversano koji je napustio Francusku i otišao u "zemlju bijelaca" Rumunjsku gdje je okupio zajednicu "hrabrih". Među njegovim je sljedbenicima osuđeni terorist Login Nisin koji je priznao da je planirao ubiti Christophea Castanera i Jean-Luca Melenchona. U Bukureštu smo posjetili Conversana i njegove pristaše te smo ga ispitali o njegovim stajalištima. Mnogi smatraju da je "rasni građanski rat" neizbježan. Stručnjak za terorizam Frank Dittrich objašnjava: "Stalno postoji rizik da će skupina ljudi, u najgorem slučaju, izvesti napade protiv vladinih institucija, migranata ili političkih neprijatelja". Krajnje desni ekstremisti sada se smatraju najvećom prijetnjom demokraciji u Europi.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: The hired killer Gaspar surprises Rafael. Gaspar gives up his job and goes after Joaquim to leave Rafael alone. Isadora donates clothes, shoes and other clothing accessories, and Emília uses the donation to go to the casino and pretend to be a rich widow. Joaquim goes to the factory's anniversary celebration to comfort Isadora over Rafael's death. But Rafael appeared alive and well. Inácio spilled food on his clothes. Arminda sees him without a shirt and is petrified. Eugenio declares his love for Violeta again. Isadora asks Rafael to meet someone from his past, and he turns to his old friend Romana to help him with the lie. Lorenzo flies in a plane with Marcos, but they are attacked and the plane crashes. / Plaćeni ubojica Gaspar iznenadi Rafaela. Gaspar odustaje od posla i kreće za Joaquimom kako bi Rafaela ostavio na miru. Isadora donira odjeću, obuću i ostale odjevne dodatke, a Emília iskoristi donaciju za odlazak u kasino i glumi bogatu udovicu. Joaquim odlazi na proslavu godišnjice tvornice kako bi utješio Isadoru zbog Rafaelove smrti. Ali Rafael se pojavi živ i zdrav. Inácio ga zalije jelom po odjeći. Arminda ga vidi bez košulje i skameni se. Eugenio ponovno izjavljuje ljubav Violeti. Isadora moli Rafaela da upozna nekoga iz njegove prošlosti, a on se obrati staroj prijateljici Romani da mu pomogne oko laži. Lorenzo leti u avionu s Marcosom, ali napadnu ih i avion padne.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Júlia confides in Vitoria that Marco still claims to be Marquinho's father and says that a DNA test should be done. He also tells her that David has agreed to move in with her. But she is now afraid that Tiago will want to bring Cacau and Marquinho to the house. / Júlia se povjeri Vitoriji da Marco i dalje tvrdi da je Marquinhov otac i kaže da bi valjalo napraviti DNK test. Također joj kaže da se David pristao doseliti k njoj. Ali ona se sada boji da će Tiago htjeti dovesti u kuću Cacau i Marquinha.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: The daily show Kod nas doma talks about current topics and events in our country and in the world every weekday afternoon. It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Kulturna baština
programme.desc: About thirty kilometers from Zagreb, in the Moslavina plain, is Ivanić-Grad. In addition to being a civilian settlement, it was also a military fortress. It was mentioned for the first time in 1246 as part of the property of the Zagreb Diocese. / Tridesetak kilometara od Zagreba, u moslavačkoj ravnici, smjestio se Ivanić-Grad. Bio je, osim civilnog naselja, i vojna utvrda. Prvi put se spominje 1246. kao dio posjeda Zagrebačke biskupije.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: The brain is the center of the nervous system and the most important organ for the human ability to think and most functions in the body. It has no pain receptors and therefore cannot feel pain, but any disease affecting that organ can be fatal. One of them is certainly meningitis, the secrets of which we reveal with infectious disease specialist Viktor Kotarski and virologist Vladimir Stevanović. / Mozak je središte živčanog sustava i najvažniji organ za čovjekovu sposobnost razmišljanja i većinu funkcija u tijelu. Nema receptore za bol i zbog toga ne može osjetiti bol, no svaka bolest koja zahvati taj organ može biti fatalna. Jedna od njih svakako je meningitis čije tajne razotkrivamo s infektologom Viktorom Kotarskim i virologom Vladimirom Stevanovićem.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Time spent cooking helps you develop a refined palate, improve your cooking skills and boost your confidence. Today, Lidia will reveal the secrets of preparing a salad of thinly sliced ​​artichokes, spinach and mortadella. He will pair that special salad with one of his favorite dishes _ mussels with sausage meat and potatoes in white wine, which is a great weekday one-pot meal. / Vrijeme provedeno u kuhanju pomaže vam da steknete istančano nepce, poboljšate kuharske vještine i povećate samopouzdanje. Lidia će danas otkriti tajne pripreme salate od tanko narezanih artičoka, špinata i mortadele. Tu posebnu salatu spojit će s jednim od svojih najdražih jela _ dagnjama s mesom kobasica i krumpirom u bijelom vinu, što je izvrsno jelo iz jednog lonca na radni dan.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Dobro jutro, Hrvatska
programme.desc: A mosaic show that brings current informative and entertaining content from Monday to Saturday, with a host couple in the studio and guests, as well as reports and live broadcasts from all over Croatia and regular sections with advice from all areas of life. / Mozaična emisija koja od ponedjeljka do subote donosi aktualne informativne i zabavne sadržaje, s voditeljskim parom u studiju i gostima te uz reportaže i javljanja uživo iz cijele Hrvatske i redovite rubrike sa savjetima iz svih područja života.

programme.title: Vijesti
programme.desc: A short overview of news from Croatia and the world. / Kratki pregled vijesti iz Hrvatske i svijeta.

programme.desc: A mosaic show that brings current informative and entertaining content from Monday to Saturday, with a host couple in the studio and guests, as well as reports and live broadcasts from all over Croatia and regular sections with advice from all areas of life. / Mozaična emisija koja od ponedjeljka do subote donosi aktualne informativne i zabavne sadržaje, s voditeljskim parom u studiju i gostima te uz reportaže i javljanja uživo iz cijele Hrvatske i redovite rubrike sa savjetima iz svih područja života.

programme.title: Peti dan
programme.desc: Topics: Doctors, politicians, Society of addicts Commentators are Aleksandar Musić, Marijana Bijelić, Ena Katarina Haler and Erik Brezovec. / Teme: Liječnici političari Društvo ovisnika Komentatori su Aleksandar Musić, Marijana Bijelić, Ena Katarina Haler i Erik Brezovec.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly freaks out when she finds out that Adam called Brea despite his promise to stay away from her until they both settle in college. Joanne lands a coveted job at a fancy law firm in Philadelphia. / Beverly poludi kad sazna da je Adam zvao Breu unatoč obećanju da će se držati podalje od nje dok se oboje ne snađu na fakultetu. Joanne dobiva željeni posao u otmjenoj odvjetničkoj tvrtki u Philadelphiji.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Everyone talks only about the birth of the child, no one mentions Erica's degree anymore, so she wonders how much it really means in their lives. Adam and Barry argue over who will be "head of house" while Murray is away. / Svi govore samo o rođenju djeteta, nitko više ne spominje Ericinu diplomu pa se ona zapita koliko im zapravo znači u životu. Adam i Barry prepiru se tko će biti "glava kuće" dok nema Murraya.

programme.title: Kućni ljubimci
programme.desc: Weekly show about pets, their breeding, care, treatment, adoption. / Tjedna emisija o kućnim ljubimcima, njihovu uzgoju, njezi, liječenju, udomljivanju.

programme.title: DW: Tomorrow is today / DW: Sutrašnjica danas
programme.desc: Deutsche Welle's show about the European way of life brings interesting things from European cities. / Emisija Deutsche Wellea o europskom načinu života, donosi zanimljivosti iz europskih gradova.

programme.title: Svijet znanosti
programme.desc: Medicines are printed in China, amber is sought on the shores of the Baltic Sea. The Sami people in Sweden are fighting for the survival of the reindeer. Plans to open mines on ancient reindeer migration routes threaten the source of livelihood for many. Do high fashion and dirt go together? / U Kini se printaju lijekovi, na obalama Baltičkog mora traži se jantar. Narod Sami u Švedskoj bori se za opstanak sobova. Planovi za otvaranje rudnika na drevnim migracijskim rutama sobova mnogima ugrožavaju izvor egzistencije. Idu li zajedno visoka moda i prljavština?

programme.title: Up to the wine / Fino i vino
programme.desc: We are traveling to the Spanish San Sebastian! We also visited Gastronomika, an international gastronomic congress and haute cuisine fair together with Metro and the best chefs in Croatia. The top wines of Slavonia and Podunavlja came together with great food and great entertainment at the second Danube Wine Festival. See what it looks like when art and top cuisine come together at a dinner that took place at the Museum of Contemporary Art and was prepared by JRE chefs. We report from this year's Via vino festival and discover what is behind the InterWine project. Find out what will happen at Bregfest, which will be held for the fourth time in Zagreb's Lauba. / Putujemo u španjolski San Sebastian! Posjetili smo i Gastronomiku, međunarodni gastronomski kongres i sajam visoke kuhinje zajedno s Metroom i najboljim chefovima Hrvatske. Vrhunska vina Slavonije i Podunavlja spojila su se uz odličnu hranu i sjajnu zabavu na drugom po redu Dunav Wine Festivalu. Pogledajte kako izgleda kad se spoje umjetnost i vrhunska kuhinja na večeri koja se odvila u Muzeju suvremene umjetnosti, a koju su pripremili JRE chefovi. Donosimo izvještaj s ovogodišnjeg Via vino festivala i otkrivamo što stoji iza projekta InterWine. Doznajte što će se sve događati na Bregfestu koji će se po četvrti put održati u zagrebačkoj Laubi.

programme.title: Rekreacija
programme.desc: We are taking you to Petrinja to the Chestnut Festival and Mountaineering Chestnut Festival _ an event that successfully combines tradition, sport and hiking, gastronomy and music in one unforgettable experience in two days. We were also at the Zagreb Marathon, which gathered as many as 5,019 runners from almost 80 countries around the world. We investigated who the pacers are and what their role is in the success of the race. We also bring a story about outdoor training _ at training grounds that are springing up in more and more Croatian cities. And in our permanent section From the gym, we present a series of new, useful exercises to strengthen muscles and improve body stability. / Vodimo vas u Petrinju na Festival kestena i planinarsku kestenijadu _ manifestaciju koja u dva dana uspješno spaja tradiciju, sport i planinarenje, gastronomiju i glazbu u jedno nezaboravno iskustvo. Bili smo i na Zagrebačkom maratonu, koji je okupio čak 5019 trkača iz gotovo 80 zemalja svijeta. Istražili smo tko su pejseri i kakva je njihova uloga u uspjehu na utrci. Donosimo i priču o treningu na otvorenom _ na vježbalištima koja niču u sve više hrvatskih gradova. A u našoj stalnoj rubrici Iz teretane predstavljamo niz novih, korisnih vježbi za jačanje mišića i poboljšanje stabilnosti tijela.

programme.title: Psi na zadatku
programme.desc: In the first episode, we will dive deeper into the world of Istrian truffles, but literally! Following Bubica, a curly-haired lagotti from Paladin, and her owner Ivana, we will find out the role of sniffing friends in finding this valuable food and what is hidden in the depths of the Istrian forests. Get ready for an exciting journey through the world of gourmet delights and incredible adventures with our four-legged truffle. / U prvoj epizodi zaronit ćemo dublje u svijet istarskih tartufa, ali doslovno! Prateći Bubicu, kovrčavu lagotticu iz Paladina, i njezinu vlasnicu Ivanu, doznat ćemo koja je uloga njuškajućih prijatelja u pronalasku ove vrijedne namirnice i što se to krije u dubinama istarskih šuma. Pripremite se za uzbudljivo putovanje kroz svijet gurmanskih užitaka i nevjerojatnih pustolovina s našom četveronožnom tartufarkom.

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: After Marco's proposal, Bella goes on an adventure with Claudine to decide what to do with her future. Constance goes out with Vito and tells him about Tommy, but he's understanding. Alice is enraged when Count Albani rejects her courtship. With Claudine's help, Bella confesses her feelings to Marc and finally tells her family about the breakup. Meanwhile, Betty's engagement celebration is interrupted by the shocking return of Lucian, Billy and a new guest. / Nakon Marcove prosidbe Bella odlazi u pustolovinu s Claudine kako bi odlučila što će sa svojom budućnošću. Constance izlazi s Vitom i kaže mu za Tommyja, ali on ima razumijevanja. Alice se razbjesni kad grof Albani odbije njezino udvaranje. Uz Claudineinu pomoć Bella priznaje Marcu svoje osjećaje i konačno kaže obitelji za rastavu. Za to vrijeme proslavu Bettynih zaruka prekida šokantni povratak Luciana, Billyja i novog gosta.

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: Bella is delighted to have Luciano back, but notices that he is not his old self. Constance is disappointed by Luciano's coldness, so she gets closer to Vita. After her father threatens to withdraw his money from the hotel if she separates, Bella decides to start a business with Claudine. Cecil learns the last dark truth about Danioni, but when Cecil and Bella settle their quarrel, the family is shocked by the news of the Wall Street crash in which all of Cecil and George's money is gone. / Bella je oduševljena Lucianovim povratkom, ali primjećuje da on nije onaj stari. Constance je razočarana Lucianovom hladnoćom pa se zbližava s Vitom. Nakon što joj otac zaprijeti da će povući svoj novac iz hotela ako se rastane, Bella odluči pokrenuti posao s Claudine. Cecil dozna posljednju mračnu istinu o Danioniju, ali kad Cecil i Bella razriješe svoje svađe, obitelj šokira vijest o krahu Wall Streeta u kojem je nestao sav Cecilov i Georgeov novac.

programme.title: Krimi matineja: Grantchester
programme.desc: Sidney feels as lost as ever and struggles to remember the last words of a murdered woman, while Geordie investigates a dilapidated building linked to a murderous web of vice. / Sidney se osjeća izgubljen kao nikad i s mukom se pokušava sjetiti posljednjih riječi ubijene žene, a Geordie istražuje oronulu zgradu povezanu s ubojitom mrežom poroka.

programme.title: Krimi matineja: Foyleov rat
programme.desc: Due to Foyle's investigation of a murder on a deserted beach, the donation of American aid becomes questionable. / Zbog Foyleove istrage ubojstva na napuštenoj plaži donacija američke pomoći postaje upitna.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain - Upoznavanje nepoznatog
programme.desc: Bourdain dives into the gastronomic scene at a crossroads: on the one hand, a recognizable steel town defined by working-class food _ steaks and potatoes, sausages and sauerkraut _ and on the other, a city on the rise attracting a foodie crowd thanks to a new high-tech industry. Bourdain crosses the divide between old and new, hanging out with, among others, professional wrestlers, civil rights activists, and author and native Pittsburgher Stewart ONan. The pioneering chefs of the new restaurant scene, Sonja Finn and Justin Severino, are roasting suckling pig out of town, and chef Kevin Sousa is serving up pasture-fed ribs at his new Superior Motors restaurant. / Bourdain zaranja u gastronomsku scenu na raskrižju: s jedne strane, prepoznatljivi grad čelika definiran radničkom hranom _ odresci i krumpir, kobasice i kiseli kupus _ a s druge, grad u usponu koji privlači gurmansku publiku zahvaljujući novoj visokotehnološkoj industriji. Bourdain prelazi razdjelnice starog i novog družeći se, među ostalima, s profesionalnim hrvačima, aktivistima za građanska prava te piscem i rođenim Pitsburžaninom Stewartom ONanom. Pionirski kuhari nove restoranske scene, Sonja Finn i Justin Severino, peku odojka izvan grada, a chef Kevin Sousa poslužuje rebarca od krava hranjenih na pašnjaku u svom novom restoranu Superior Motors.

programme.title: Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: On Dugi otok, the Žampera family shows how it is possible to make a living from agriculture even in island conditions. Their goats, chickens and pigs are a source of food and pride, because being a shepherd on the island means preserving tradition and identity. In addition to the production of cheese, vegetables and eggs, the family runs Robinson tourism on the island of Krknata. The episode also tells the story of Goran Morović, the owner of a luxury hotel on Dugi otok, who brings a new dimension of tourism to island life. / Na Dugom otoku obitelj Žampera pokazuje kako je moguće živjeti od poljoprivrede i u otočnim uvjetima. Njihove koze, kokoši i svinje su izvor hrane i ponosa, jer biti pastir na otoku znači čuvati tradiciju i identitet. Osim proizvodnje sira, povrća i jaja, obitelj vodi robinzonski turizam na otočiću Krknata. Epizoda donosi i priču Gorana Morovića, vlasnika luksuznog hotela na Dugom otoku koji unosi novu dimenziju turizma u otočki život.

programme.title: Magazin LP
programme.desc: It provides an overview and summaries of all Champions League matches, as well as stories about the best football players and reports about the actors of the competition. / Donosi pregled i sažetke svih utakmica Lige prvaka te priče o najboljim nogometašima i reportaže o akterima natjecanja.

programme.title: SuperSport HNL
programme.desc: Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the highest ranking football competition in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Association. Until 2022, the league was called the First Croatian Football League. The ten best football clubs from Croatia participate in SuperSport HNL. The club that is crowned national champion has the opportunity to try out for the 2nd preliminary round of the UEFA Champions League, while the second and third placed teams enter the 2nd preliminary round of the UEFA European Conference League. / Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu.

programme.title: Europsko prvenstvo u stolnom tenisu
programme.desc: From October 12 to 19, 2025, Zadar will host the 44th European Team Table Tennis Championship, where 24 men's national teams and 24 women's national teams will compete in the group and knockout stages. The competition in the Višnjik hall brings top-class sport, tension and spectacular encounters in the quest for the title. / Od 12. do 19. listopada 2025. Zadar će biti domaćin 44. Europskog ekipnog prvenstva u stolnom tenisu, gdje će 24 muške reprezentacije i 24 ženske reprezentacije odmjeriti snage u grupama i nokaut fazama. Natjecanje u dvorani Višnjik donosi vrhunski sport, napetost i spektakularne susrete u pohodu na naslov.

programme.title: Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: On Dugi otok, the Žampera family shows how it is possible to make a living from agriculture even in island conditions. Their goats, chickens and pigs are a source of food and pride, because being a shepherd on the island means preserving tradition and identity. In addition to the production of cheese, vegetables and eggs, the family runs Robinson tourism on the island of Krknata. The episode also tells the story of Goran Morović, the owner of a luxury hotel on Dugi otok, who brings a new dimension of tourism to island life. / Na Dugom otoku obitelj Žampera pokazuje kako je moguće živjeti od poljoprivrede i u otočnim uvjetima. Njihove koze, kokoši i svinje su izvor hrane i ponosa, jer biti pastir na otoku znači čuvati tradiciju i identitet. Epizoda donosi i priču Gorana Morovića, vlasnika luksuznog hotela na Dugom otoku koji unosi novu dimenziju turizma u otočki život.

programme.title: Slava ubija
programme.desc: Tupac transformed rap from a simple street trend into an elite art form. He laid the foundations for today's version of hip-hop and continued its development as a poet whose stories of alienation captivated young people, regardless of race or background. From the beginning, he suspected that he would not live long, and he had a strong desire to leave a mark with his creativity. He wrote, composed and recorded continuously. Even while he was serving a prison sentence, he was writing a screenplay. Knowing that he did not have much time in this world, he came with a clear purpose _ and left a legacy that deeply influenced an entire generation. The circumstances of his death have never been clarified. With most of the key players dead or serving long prison terms, we'll probably never know exactly what happened. Still, that won't stop people from trying to find out. / Tupac je preobrazio rap iz jednostavnog uličnog trenda u elitnu umjetničku formu. Postavio je temelje za današnju verziju hip-hopa i nastavio njegov razvoj kao pjesnik čije su priče o otuđenosti osvojile mlade, bez obzira na rasnu pripadnost i podrijetlo. Od početka je slutio da neće dugo živjeti, a imao je snažnu želju da svojim stvaralaštvom ostavi trag. Neprekidno je pisao, skladao i snimao. Čak i dok je služio zatvorsku kaznu, pisao je scenarij. Znajući da nema mnogo vremena na ovom svijetu, došao je s jasnom svrhom _ i ostavio naslijeđe koje je duboko utjecalo na cijeli naraštaj. Okolnosti njegove smrti nikada nisu razjašnjene. S obzirom na to da je većina ključnih sudionika mrtva ili služi dugogodišnju zatvorsku kaznu, vjerojatno nikad nećemo saznati što se točno dogodilo. Ipak, to neće spriječiti ljude da pokušaju otkriti.

programme.title: Stadion
programme.desc: Weekly overview of the strongest European football leagues, as well as smaller national championships, and other current sports topics. / Tjedni pregled najjačih europskih nogometnih liga, kao i manjih nacionalnih prvenstava, te druge aktualne sportske teme.

programme.title: In the arena: Serena Williams / U areni: Serena Williams
programme.desc: After years of struggling to overcome obstacles and step out of the shadow of her older sister Venus Williams, 17-year-old Serena, who began her tennis career on public courts in Compton, California, won her first Grand Slam title in 1999 at the US Open. / Nakon što se godinama borila da svlada prepreke i izađe iz sjene svoje starije sestre Venus Williams, 17-godišnja Serena, koja je tenisku karijeru započela na javnim terenima u Comptonu, u Kaliforniji, prvi je Grand Slam naslov osvojila 1999. godine na US Openu.

programme.title: Foyleov rat
programme.desc: Due to Foyle's investigation of a murder on a deserted beach, the donation of American aid becomes questionable. / Zbog Foyleove istrage ubojstva na napuštenoj plaži donacija američke pomoći postaje upitna.

programme.title: Grantchester
programme.desc: Sidney feels as lost as ever and struggles to remember the last words of a murdered woman, while Geordie investigates a dilapidated building linked to a murderous web of vice. / Sidney se osjeća izgubljen kao nikad i s mukom se pokušava sjetiti posljednjih riječi ubijene žene, a Geordie istražuje oronulu zgradu povezanu s ubojitom mrežom poroka.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly freaks out when she finds out that Adam called Brea despite his promise to stay away from her until they both settle in college. Joanne lands a coveted job at a fancy law firm in Philadelphia. / Beverly poludi kad sazna da je Adam zvao Breu unatoč obećanju da će se držati podalje od nje dok se oboje ne snađu na fakultetu. Joanne dobiva željeni posao u otmjenoj odvjetničkoj tvrtki u Philadelphiji.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Everyone talks only about the birth of the child, no one mentions Erica's degree anymore, so she wonders how much it really means in their lives. Adam and Barry argue over who will be "head of house" while Murray is away. / Svi govore samo o rođenju djeteta, nitko više ne spominje Ericinu diplomu pa se ona zapita koliko im zapravo znači u životu. Adam i Barry prepiru se tko će biti "glava kuće" dok nema Murraya.

programme.title: Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: In the Reader's Club, we are discussing Frederic Lenoir's book _ The Philosophy of Desire. What desire means for a person, whether it can be controlled and whether it is a driver or an obstacle to happiness, are discussed by: dr. sc. Zvonimir Galić, full professor at the Department of Psychology of the Faculty of Philosophy in Zagreb Sanja Srdić Jungić, communication specialist Srđan Sandić, journalist and writer dr. sc. Tomislav Pletenac, ethnologist and cultural anthropologist / U Klubu čitatelja razgovaramo o knjizi Frederica Lenoira _ Filozofija želje. O tome što želja znači za čovjeka, može li se njome upravljati i je li ona pokretač ili prepreka sreći, raspravljaju: dr. sc. Zvonimir Galić, redoviti profesor na Odsjeku za psihologiju Filozofskog fakulteta u Zagrebu Sanja Srdić Jungić, komunikologinja Srđan Sandić, novinar i književnik dr. sc. Tomislav Pletenac, etnolog i kulturni antropolog

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Erica's due date is approaching, but she has had enough of pregnancy and wants to go on one last trip together before the baby is born. Adam and Barry don't know what is expected of them as uncles, so they decide to follow the advice from the movie Uncle Buck. / Erici se bliži termin poroda, no već joj je dosta trudnoće i želi otići na posljednje putovanje udvoje prije rođenja djeteta. Adam i Barry ne znaju što se očekuje od njih kao ujaka pa odluče poslušati savjete iz filma "Striko Buck".

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam decides to visit Dave Kim at New York University to celebrate Halloween together, but discovers that his best friend has changed drastically. Geoff resents Beverly taking care of the baby, resulting in many comical and terrifying situations! / Adam odlučuje posjetiti Davea Kima na Sveučilištu u New Yorku kako bi skupa proslavili Noć vještica, no otkriva da se njegov najbolji prijatelj stubokom promijenio. Geoff negoduje što je Beverly preuzela brigu o bebi, iz čega proizlaze mnoge komične, ali i zastrašujuće situacije!

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Steve Brown will take in the spectacular scenery of Scotland's Perth, Kinross and beyond as he helps an Essex couple with three children find their dream home in the hinterland. They need a large garden, good transport links and want to be only half an hour away from the rugby club. / Steve Brown divit će se spektakularnom krajoliku škotskog Pertha, Kinrossa i šire dok pomaže paru s troje djece iz Essexa naći dom iz snova u unutrašnjosti. Trebaju veliki vrt, dobre prometne veze i žele biti udaljeni samo pola sata od ragbijaškog kluba.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: George will tour an architectural folly in the shape of a wedding cake, an impressive beach house inspired by pill boxes, an old RNLI station, a maritime aid organization and a fascinating round house in Denmark inspired by the owner's car collection. / George će razgledati arhitektonsku ludost u obliku svadbene torte, dojmljivu kuću na plaži inspiriranu kutijicama za pohranu tableta, staru stanicu RNLI, organizacije za pomoć na moru, kao i fascinantnu kružnu kuću u Danskoj, inspiriranu vlasnikovom kolekcijom automobila.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: Gordon prepares modern versions of the dishes he adored as a child. For breakfast they will prepare light potato fritters, and for lunch sandwiches of fish sticks and fried potatoes. He will then be joined in the kitchen by his mother Helen, who will help him prepare the Ramsay family's favorite dinner, which consists of a delicious shepherd's pie and sponge cake with dates and caramel sauce. / Gordon priprema suvremene inačice jela koja je obožavao u djetinjstvu. Za doručak će pripremiti lagane popečke od krumpira, a za ručak sendviče od ribljih štapića i prženih krumpirića. U kuhinji će mu se potom pridružiti majka Helen, koja će mu pomoći s pripremom omiljene večere u obitelji Ramsay, koja se sastoji od slasne pastirske pite i biskvitnoga kolača s datuljama i umakom od karamela.

programme.title: UK: Garden of the Year / UK: Vrt godine
programme.desc: Our panel of judges consisting of Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde and Lachlan Rae visit the competitors in the north of England this time. In Cheshire they discover a garden that has been transformed into a series of beautiful garden rooms. Near Huddersfield they find a garden growing luxuriantly in an unexpected place, and in the heart of Manchester there is an urban garden that the owners have turned into a tropical paradise. In North Humberside, they step into a garden that has been lovingly landscaped. It was developed over 30 years and today there is an abundance of trees and mixed flower beds that enchant at any time of the year. / Naš žiri u sastavu Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde i Lachlan Rae ovaj put obilaze natjecatelje na engleskom sjeveru. U Cheshireu otkrivaju vrt koji je pretvoren u niz predivnih vrtnih soba. U blizini Huddersfielda pronalaze vrt koji bujno raste na neočekivanom mjestu, a u srcu Manchestera smjestio se urbani vrt koji su vlasnici pretvorili u tropski raj. U North Humbersideu kroče u vrt koji je uređen s mnogo ljubavi. Razvijao se tijekom 30 godina i danas je obilje stabala i mješovitih gredica koje očaravaju u svako doba godine.

programme.title: Michel Roux: Okusi francuskog juga
programme.desc: Michel will prepare a decadent early lunch today. A cheese souffle will serve as a starter. A visit to a historic restaurant in Avignon will inspire the preparation of a classic pithivier of smoked chicken and mushrooms. And at the end, an elegant sweet wine jelly with autumn fruits will be served. / Michel će danas pripremiti dekadentni rani ručak. Za početak će poslužiti souffle od sira. Posjet povijesnom restoranu u Avignonu nadahnut će pripremu klasičnog pithiviera od dimljene piletine i gljiva. A za kraj poslužit će elegantni žele od slatkog vina s jesenskim voćem.

programme.title: Countries - people - adventures / Zemlje - ljudi - pustolovine
programme.desc: The land between the mighty Gissar Mountains and the almost dried up Aral Sea stretches far away. Uzbekistan is characterized by sandy deserts, which seem endless, and oases that were once among the most important in the entire East. For thousands of years here, on the Silk Road, there was actually only one means of transport: the camel. After Russia annexed the territory of today's Uzbekistan, a railway network was built. Even today, the Silk Road express route is the main transport link between the green east of Uzbekistan and the arid deserts in the west. / Daleko se proteže zemlja između moćnog gorja Gissar i gotovo isušenog Aralskog jezera. Uzbekistan je obilježen pješčanim pustinjama, koje se doimaju beskrajnim, i oazama koje su nekoć bile među najvažnijima na cijelom Istoku. Tisućljećima je ovdje, na Putu svile, postojalo zapravo samo jedno prijevozno sredstvo: deva. Nakon što je Rusija pripojila područje današnjeg Uzbekistana, izgrađena je željeznička mreža. Još i danas ruta ekspresa Puta svile glavna je prometna poveznica između zelenog istoka Uzbekistana i sušnih pustinja na zapadu.

programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: A smart young student is found dead in a hotel room, and detectives Hathaway and Lewis are drawn into a world of intrigue and ambition that stops short of anything. It is about Jo Gilchirst, one of the three students at Oxford who decided to succeed in life. The case, which contains elements of dangerous sexual politics, will force Lewis to face his own past and to convince himself that in today's world, personal advancement is very often much more important than friendship. / Pametna mlada studentica nađena je mrtva u hotelskoj sobi, a detektivi Hathaway i Lewis uvučeni su u svijet spletki i ambicije koja ne preže ni pred čime. Riječ je o Jo Gilchirst, jednoj od tri studentice na Oxfordu koje su pošto-poto odlučile uspjeti u životu. Slučaj koji u sebi nosi elemente opasne seksualne politike natjerat će Lewisa da se suoči s vlastitom prošlosti i da se uvjeri da je osobni probitak u današnjem svijetu vrlo često mnogo važniji od prijateljstva.

programme.title: Samo lagano
programme.desc: Every great dream begins with a dreamer. And we should remember that we have the strength, patience and passion to reach for the stars and change the world..." _ Harriet Tubman's words. But even if you don't change the world by following your dreams, you will most certainly change your own life! And in today's show we hang out with people who have made it happen! So never forget that all our dreams can only come true if we have the courage to follow them... But _ JUST EASY! / Svaki veliki san počinje sanjarem. I treba zapamtiti kako u sebi imamo snagu, strpljenje i strast da dosegnemo zvijezde i promijenimo svijet..." _ riječi su Harriet Tubman. Ali čak i ako ne promijenite svijet, slijedeći snove, posve ćete sigurno promijeniti vlastiti život! A u današnjoj se emisiji družimo s ljudima koji su to i ostvarili! Zato nikada ne zaboravite kako se svi naši snovi mogu ostvariti samo ako ih imamo hrabrosti slijediti... Ali _ SAMO LAGANO!

programme.title: Stadion
programme.desc: Weekly overview of the strongest European football leagues, as well as smaller national championships, and other current sports topics. / Tjedni pregled najjačih europskih nogometnih liga, kao i manjih nacionalnih prvenstava, te druge aktualne sportske teme.

programme.title: Auto Market Magazin
programme.desc: Every week, the show for car enthusiasts presents new car models, technological innovations, tests new vehicles, and provides advice on maintenance. / U emisiji za ljubitelje automobila svaki tjedan predstavljaju se novi modeli automobila, tehnološke inovacije, testiraju nova vozila, donose savjeti o održavanju.

programme.title: Moj put
programme.desc: It is incredible how much strength, positive energy and perseverance is hidden in Gordana Glass, a fragile and ethereal woman from Zagreb, resident of the Slovak capital Bratislava since 1998. Her path to international success was long and often not easy. From her workshop, fascinating works of art, often weighing hundreds of kilograms, leave the world. Gordana is a proud mother of two adult sons, a woman ready to share a good word with the needy and beautify their living space with her works. She built her family and business nest in Lamač, a suburb of Bratislava, which was settled by her compatriots about five hundred years ago. It was one of about a hundred majority Croatian villages at the time. Today, only four remain: Hrvatski Grob, Jandorf, Čunovo and Devinska Nova Vas. The latter has been the host of the Festival of Croatian Culture for 36 years in memory of the centuries-old tradition and history of Croats in that area. Exposed to assimilation more strongly than ever before, they try to say that they still preserve their customs and language. The natives of Devinska Nova Vasa still remember how the fanfare announced the first festival. It symbolically stimulated the awakening of the Croatian community there, which had been somewhat forgotten until then. It was in June 1989, on the eve of the "velvet revolution" that marked the end of the era of political unanimity. Thanks to the courage and sacrifice of many generations, the festival evokes memories of ancient Croatian ancestors. Mostly tough, hard-working and hard-working people, they inherited their peculiarities from the past, the specific Chakavian-Ikavian version of the Croatian Gradišća dialect, songs, costumes, and traditional dishes. / Nevjerojatno je koliko se snage, pozitivne energije i upornosti krije u Gordani Glass, krhkoj i eteričnoj Zagrepčanki, od 1998. stanovnici glavnoga slovačkog grada Bratislave. Dug je i nerijetko ne baš lagodan bio njezin put do međunarodnog uspjeha. Iz njezine radionice u svijet odlaze fascinantna umjetnička djela mahom teška i stotine kilograma. Gordana je majka dvojici odraslih sinova, žena spremna podijeliti s potrebitima lijepu riječ i svojim radovima uljepšati im životni prostor. Svoje obiteljsko-poslovno gnijezdo savila je u Lamaču, predgrađu Bratislave, koje su prije petstotinjak godina naselili njezini sunarodnjaci. Bilo je to jedno od stotinjak tada većinskih hrvatskih sela. Danas su ostala tek četiri: Hrvatski Grob, Jandorf, Čunovo i Devinska Nova Vas. Upravo ovo potonje već 36 godina u spomen na stoljetnu tradiciju i povijest Hrvata na tom prostoru domaćin je Festivala hrvatske kulture. Izloženi asimilaciji snažnije nego ikada prije, nastoje poručiti da još čuvaju svoje običaje i jezik. Starosjedioci Devinske Nove Vasi još pamte kako su fanfare najavile prvi festival. Njime je simbolično potaknuto buđenje tamošnje, dotad pomalo zaboravljene, hrvatske zajednice. Bilo je to u lipnju 1989., uoči "baršunaste revolucije" koja je označila kraj epohe političkog jednoumlja. Zahvaljujući hrabrosti i požrtvovnosti mnogih naraštaja, festival priziva sjećanja na davne hrvatske pretke. Mahom težaci, radišni i vrijedni ljudi baštinili su od prošlosti svoje posebnosti, specifičnu čakavsko-ikavsku inačicu hrvatskog gradišćanskog narječja, napjeve, nošnje, tradicionalna jela.

programme.title: Zadar: Sea / Zadar: More
programme.desc: A mosaic informative show dedicated to the wealth of our Adriatic Sea, coast and coastline. It brings interesting reports on topics related to life at sea and by it. It is broadcast from HRT's studios in Split, Rijeka, Zadar and Pula. / Mozaična informativna emisija posvećena bogatstvu našeg Jadranskog mora, obale i priobalja. Donosi zanimljive reportaže o temama vezanim za život na moru i uz njega. Emitira se iz HRT-ovih studija Split, Rijeka, Zadar i Pula.

programme.title: Hit dana
programme.desc: Every weekday, Hit presents the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: This week Ben will spend practically at home. In rural Oxfordshire, he will be the guest of an extended family who have given up their conventional lifestyle and moved to a 16-acre property. Ben will find out what obstacles they faced, how they spent twenty years perfecting the skills of cultivating the land on which eleven family members live today. They will also discover how the Muslim faith affects their approach to agriculture. As their guest, Ben will take care of sheep, take care of hooves, drive a tractor, feed thousands of chickens... He will realize that it is possible to live in the homeland as well as in the isolated wilderness, and learn that the future of this rural idyll is in doubt. / Ovaj tjedan Ben će provesti praktički kod kuće. U ruralnom Oxfordshireu bit će gost proširene obitelji koja se odrekla konvencionalnog načina života i preselila na posjed površine 16 hektara. Ben će saznati s kakvim su se preprekama susretali, kako su dvadeset godina usavršavali vještine obrade zemlje na kojoj danas živi jedanaest članova obitelji. Otkrit će i kako muslimanska vjera utječe na njihov pristup poljoprivredi. Kao njihov gost, Ben će čuvati ovce, njegovati papke, voziti traktor, hraniti tisuće kokoši... Shvatit će da se i u zavičaju može živjeti kao i u izoliranoj divljini te saznati da je budućnost ove seoske idile pod upitnikom.

programme.title: Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: All life needs water to survive. But water is not always available and animal parents have to adapt to this issue without question. Dedication, perseverance and sheer courage are key to success in the freshwater world. In the Brazilian Amazon, thousands of turtles must predict the timing of the seasonal rains before laying their eggs. If they get it wrong, their young will drown underground, but if they get it right, it will be the start of one of the greatest spectacles on Earth as thousands of baby turtles follow their mothers' call to the water. In Namibia, watering holes provide a reliable source for the desert life of male South African saja. He must choose wisely the moment of decision in which to take water for his birds. If he makes a mistake in one second, he will end up in the claws of a predator. Some animal parents try to turn the power of water to their advantage. In the Caribbean, a flounder called a tri-tri diverts an underwater current to supply oxygen to its eggs. But before the eggs are laid, a once-in-a-lifetime storm sweeps him and everything he's made downstream. You have to make it over three hundred meters of waterfalls to get another chance for parenthood. In the wetlands of Florida, the clever swamp canary uses the power of its bite to pull its young out of danger in a matter of seconds. For some, it seems that the search for water never ends. In drought-stricken Kenya, an elephant and her family must share the remaining water with humans until the rains begin. And when it rains, the water is so violent that it can become deadly. With climate change, the movement of fresh water is increasingly difficult to predict. Humans and wildlife are adapting to changing freshwater flows, but we may choose to give the next generation a future where freshwater is a more reliable factor. / Sav život treba vodu da bi opstao. No voda nije stalno dostupna i roditelji životinja moraju se bespogovorno prilagođavati tom pitanju. Predanost, ustrajnost i puka hrabrost ključni su za uspjeh u slatkovodnom svijetu. U brazilskoj Amazoniji tisuće kornjača moraju predvidjeti vrijeme sezonskih kiša prije nego što polože jaja. Ako pogriješe, njihov će se pomladak utopiti pod zemljom, ali ako dobro pogode, bit će to početak jednog od najvećih spektakala na Zemlji jer tisuće mladunaca kornjača slijede poziv svojih majki u vodu. U Namibiji pojilišta pružaju pouzdan izvor za pustinjski život mužjaka južnoafričke sadže. Mora mudro odabrati trenutak odluke u kojem će uzeti vodu za svoje ptiće. Pogriješi li za jednu sekundu, završit će u pandžama grabljivice. Neki životinjski roditelji pokušavaju okrenuti snagu vode u svoju korist. Na Karibima, glavoč zvan tri-tri skreće podvodnu struju za dovod kisika svojim jajašcima. No prije nego što su jajašca i položena, oluja koja se događa jednom u životu odnese nizvodno i njega i sve što je izradio. Mora se uspeti preko tristo metara slapova da bi dobio još jednu priliku za roditeljstvo. U močvarnim staništima Floride pametni močvarni kanarinac koristi se snagom zalogaja da izvuče svoju mladunce iz ralja opasnosti u trenutku kad je sve pitanje sekundi. Nekima se čini da potraga za vodom nikad ne prestaje. U sušom pogođenoj Keniji slonica i njezina obitelj moraju dijeliti preostalu vodu s ljudima dok ne počnu kiše. A kad kiša padne, voda je toliko silovita da može postati smrtonosna. Promjenom klime kretanja slatke vode sve je teže predvidjeti. Ljudi i divlje životinje prilagođavaju se promjenjivim slatkovodnim tokovima, ali možda odlučimo pružiti sljedećem naraštaju budućnost u kojoj će slatka voda biti pouzdaniji čimbenik.

programme.title: Till
programme.desc: The film follows Mamie Till-Mobley, the mother of 14-year-old Emmett Till, who was brutally murdered in Mississippi in 1955 for allegedly making inappropriate comments to a white woman. Seeking justice for her son, she confronts racism, and her determination to ensure that Emmett's death does not go unnoticed has encouraged the general public and the media to become more seriously involved in the fight against racial injustice. / Film prati Mamie Till-Mobley, majku 14-togodišnjeg Emmetta Tilla, koji je brutalno ubijen u Mississippiju 1955. zbog optužbi da je neprimjereno komentirao bijelu ženu. Tražeći pravdu za sina, suprotstavlja se rasizmu, a njezina odlučnost da Emmettova smrt ne ostane neprimijećena potaknula je širu javnost i medije da se ozbiljnije uključe u borbu protiv rasne nepravde.

programme.title: Pred sudom javnosti
programme.desc: The trial that everyone has been waiting for with impatience begins. As the prosecution tries to prove beyond doubt that Talitha and Dhillon killed Hanna Ellis together, Cleo tries to undermine the credibility of the evidence against Talitha. Lucinda Bright's testimony hurts Dhillon. Tension rises in the courtroom as Cleo and Damian clash over whether to call Talitha as a witness. / Počinje suđenje koje su svi s nestrpljenjem iščekivali. Dok tužiteljstvo nastoji nepobitno dokazati da su Talitha i Dhillon zajedno ubili Hannu Ellis, Cleo pokušava umanjiti vjerodostojnost dokaza protiv Talithe. Svjedočenje Lucinde Bright našteti Dhillonu. Napetost u sudnici raste, a Cleo i Damian sukobe se oko toga trebaju li pozvati Talithu kao svjedoka.

programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: A smart young student is found dead in a hotel room, and detectives Hathaway and Lewis are drawn into a world of intrigue and ambition that stops short of anything. It is about Jo Gilchirst, one of the three students at Oxford who decided to succeed in life. The case, which contains elements of dangerous sexual politics, will force Lewis to face his own past and to convince himself that in today's world, personal advancement is very often much more important than friendship. / Pametna mlada studentica nađena je mrtva u hotelskoj sobi, a detektivi Hathaway i Lewis uvučeni su u svijet spletki i ambicije koja ne preže ni pred čime. Riječ je o Jo Gilchirst, jednoj od tri studentice na Oxfordu koje su pošto-poto odlučile uspjeti u životu. Slučaj koji u sebi nosi elemente opasne seksualne politike natjerat će Lewisa da se suoči s vlastitom prošlosti i da se uvjeri da je osobni probitak u današnjem svijetu vrlo često mnogo važniji od prijateljstva.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Erica's due date is approaching, but she has had enough of pregnancy and wants to go on one last trip together before the baby is born. Adam and Barry don't know what is expected of them as uncles, so they decide to follow the advice from the movie Uncle Buck. / Erici se bliži termin poroda, no već joj je dosta trudnoće i želi otići na posljednje putovanje udvoje prije rođenja djeteta. Adam i Barry ne znaju što se očekuje od njih kao ujaka pa odluče poslušati savjete iz filma "Striko Buck".

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam decides to visit Dave Kim at New York University to celebrate Halloween together, but discovers that his best friend has changed drastically. Geoff resents Beverly taking care of the baby, resulting in many comical and terrifying situations! / Adam odlučuje posjetiti Davea Kima na Sveučilištu u New Yorku kako bi skupa proslavili Noć vještica, no otkriva da se njegov najbolji prijatelj stubokom promijenio. Geoff negoduje što je Beverly preuzela brigu o bebi, iz čega proizlaze mnoge komične, ali i zastrašujuće situacije!

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: We are hosting the renowned composer of theater and film music Ozren K. Glaser, the man who composed the music for the film "The Woman I Read About". The reason for the conversation was a recent concert by Vatroslav Lisinski, the first author's concert of that young, successful composer, with 200 musicians on stage. The concert called "Achilles' song" is music for a film that was not made. What that film would be like, what are the dreams of that young successful composer, whose first author's concert was attended by many people from Zagreb, as well as music film Oscar winners, find out in today's ART. / Ugošćujemo uglednog skladatelja kazališne i filmske glazbe Ozrena K. Glasera, čovjeka koji je skladao glazbu za film "Žena kojoj sam čitao". Povod razgovoru je nedavno održan koncert u KD Vatroslava Lisinskog, prvi autorski koncert tog mladog, uspješnog skladatelja, s 200 glazbenika na pozornici. Koncert pod nazivom "Ahilejeva pjesma" glazba je za film koji nije snimljen. Kakav bi bio taj film, kakvi su snovi toga mladog uspješnog skladatelja, kojem su na prvi autorski koncert uz brojne Zagrepčane došli i glazbeni filmski oskarovci, otkrijte u današnjem ART-u.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly embraces her new role as a grandmother, but tries to stay young at heart. Adam gets a job while waiting to start his studies. / Beverly prihvaća svoju novu ulogu bake, no pokušava ostati mlada u srcu. Adam dobiva posao dok čeka da krene na studij.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam and Barry do everything in their power to make Thanksgiving go smoothly because they know how much it means to Beverly, but things go wrong. / Adam i Barry čine sve u svojoj moći kako bi Dan zahvalnosti protekao bez trzavica jer znaju koliko to znači Beverly, no stvari krenu po zlu.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: After almost escaping seven years ago, this episode's couple want to try again, and Ginny Buckley will help them move from the Surrey town to the area on the Norfolk/Suffolk border. Ginny will also meet someone who has already moved there and turned the thatched cottage into a charming postcard home. / Nakon što zamalo da im je uspjelo pobjeći prije sedam godina, par iz ove epizode želi pokušati ponovno, a Ginny Buckley će im pomoći da se presele iz grada u Surreyu u područje na granici Norfolka i Suffolka. Ginny će također upoznati nekoga tko se već preselio onamo i pretvorio kućicu sa slamnatim krovom u očaravajući dom s razglednica.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: A couple converts a military truck and an old camper trailer into an off-road vehicle. One man builds a luxury cabin on his family farm. And in Denmark, George will tour a container converted into a living space. / Par pretvara vojni kamion i staru kamp prikolicu u vozilo za terensku vožnju. Jedan čovjek gradi luksuznu kolibu na svojoj obiteljskoj farmi. A u Danskoj, George će razgledati kontejner pretvoren u prostor za stanovanje.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: Gordon's guide to cooking at home continues the theme of cooking for friends. Dishes that are great to share include grilled polenta with roasted tomatoes and fresh goat's cheese for an early lunch and impressive salt-crusted halibut for lunch. Gordon's son Jack will help him prepare a roast chicken stuffed with chickpeas and a fantastic layered dessert with hazelnuts and snow for dinner. / Gordonov vodič za kuhanje kod kuće nastavlja se temom kuhanja za prijatelje. Jela koja je sjajno dijeliti s drugima uključuju palentu s grila s pečenim rajčicama i kozjim svježim sirom za rani ručak i dojmljivu ribu kantara u korici od soli za ručak. Gordonov sin Jack pomoći će mu da za večeru pripremi pečeno pile nadjeveno slanutkom i fantastični slojeviti desert s lješnjacima i snijegom.

programme.title: UK: Garden of the Year / UK: Vrt godine
programme.desc: Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde and Lachlan Rae are to choose the most beautiful gardens in Scotland and Northern Ireland this time. In the village of Inversek, they discover a garden that has been lovingly landscaped for more than 30 years. Despite its size and formality, this garden is playful and full of personality. In Magherafelt, Northern Ireland, there is another garden with a lovely story. The young amateur gardener started arranging the garden where he spent his childhood, and soon it grew into his life's work. Then, in Scotland's Tay, he will visit a terraced garden in an inhospitable location that requires great commitment. Above the famous Firth of Forth, they visit a spectacular garden, which is being arranged by the second generation. / Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde i Lachlan Rae ovaj put trebaju odabrati najljepše vrtove u Škotskoj i Sjevernoj Irskoj. U selu Inverseku otkrivaju vrt koji je s mnogo ljubavi uređivan više od 30 godina. Unatoč svojoj veličini i formalnosti, ovaj je vrt razigran i pun osobnosti. U Magherafeltu u Sjevernoj Irskoj je još jedan vrt s ljupkom pričom. Mladi je vrtlar amater počeo uređivati vrt u kojem je proveo djetinjstvo, a ubrzo je prerastao u njegovo životno djelo. Zatim će u škotskom Tayju posjetiti terasasti vrt na negostoljubivom položaju za koji je potrebna velika predanost. Iznad poznatog zaljeva Firth of Forth posjećuju spektakularan vrt koji uređuje već drugi naraštaj.

programme.title: Michel Roux: Okusi francuskog juga
programme.desc: Michel will prepare a celebratory meal in this episode. Inspired by a visit to the famous LOusta De Baumaniere, they will serve millefeuille with mussels in curry sauce, rich venison daube with zucchini puree, followed by princess donuts. / Michel će u ovoj epizodi pripremiti slavljenički obrok. Nadahnut posjetom poznatom LOustau De Baumaniereu, poslužit će millefeuille s dagnjama u umaku od curryja, bogati daube od divljači s pireom od tikvica nakon kojeg će poslužiti princes krafne.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Red wooden houses on picturesque lakes and passing moose _ the image of Sweden is often characterized by tourist spots in the south of the country. But further north, in a mountainous and hilly region in the heart of Sweden, the country shows its untouched, wild side. Here, along the border with Norway, there are probably more reindeer, bears and lynx than people. The lonely hinterland far from big cities has its own special charm. Residents here wouldn't want to live anywhere else. Because the field means freedom to them. / Crvene drvene kuće na slikovitim jezerima i losovi u prolazu _ sliku Švedske često obilježuju turistička mjesta na jugu zemlje. Ali dalje na sjeveru, u planinskom i brežuljkastom kraju u srcu Švedske, zemlja pokazuje svoju netaknutu, divlju stranu. Ovdje, duž granice s Norveškom, vjerojatno ima više sobova, medvjeda i risova nego ljudi. Samotno zaleđe daleko od velikih gradova ima svoj poseban čar. Ovdašnji stanovnici ne bi željeli živjeti nigdje drugdje. Jer fjeld njima znači slobodu.
