programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: After the body of a woman who allegedly hanged herself is found, Lewis and Hathaway must find out if it really was a case of suicide. To make matters worse, the victim was left behind by her husband and two minor girls. Although Innocentica is convinced that it was a suicide, Lewis can't shake the impression that something stinks. / Nakon što je nađeno truplo žene koja se navodno objesila, Lewis i Hathaway moraju otkriti je li doista riječ o slučaju samoubojstva. Da bi stvar bila gora, iza žrtve ostao je muž i dvije malodobne djevojčice. Iako je Innocentica uvjerena da je riječ o samoubojstvu, Lewis se nikako ne može oteti dojmu da tu nešto smrdi.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Stories from Croatia / Priče iz Hrvatske
programme.desc: The show features stories about people, their interests, exploits and inspiring life moments. Through intimate and stimulating stories, he reveals the richness of everyday life that is often lost in the noise of the day. / Emisija donosi priloge o ljudima, njihovim interesima, podvizima i inspirativnim životnim trenucima. Kroz intimne i poticajne priče otkriva bogatstvo svakodnevice koje se često izgubi u buci dana.

programme.title: Superpotjera
programme.desc: In the Superchase, hunters join a super team _ five top experts who act as one. Having created one of the most powerful quiz teams in the world, they are ready to face any challenger. Who among the contestants has enough knowledge, skill and concentration to defeat this unbeatable team? / U Superpotjeri lovci se udružuju u super tim _ petero vrhunskih znalaca koji djeluju kao jedan. Stvorivši jednu od najmoćnijih kvizaških ekipa na svijetu, spremni su suočiti se sa svakim izazivačem. Tko među natjecateljima ima dovoljno znanja, vještine i koncentracije da pobijedi ovaj nepobjedivi tim?

programme.title: Dom na kvadrat
programme.desc: We investigate how much artificial intelligence has influenced architecture and what kind of transformation playgrounds will experience — first in Zagreb, and then throughout Croatia. We also take you to an apartment for a family of four, decorated in the style of modern classics. / Istražujemo koliko je umjetna inteligencija utjecala na arhitekturu te kakvu će transformaciju doživjeti igrališta — najprije u Zagrebu, a potom i diljem Hrvatske. Vodimo vas i u stan četveročlane obitelji uređen u stilu moderne klasike.

programme.title: Glas domovine
programme.desc: How do Croats live and how are they organized in Augsburg, Germany? Antun Krešimir Buterin, president of the Meeting G2 association, talks about this in the show. The Festival of Bunjevac Letters, the most important annual musical event of the Croatian community in Serbia, was held in Subotica. The children's and youth choir of the Cultural Association from Veliki Borištof is the winner of the Minimetron award. / Kako žive i kako su organizirani Hrvati u njemačkom Augsburgu? O tome u emisiji govori Antun Krešimir Buterin, predsjednik udruge Meeting G2. U Subotici je održan Festival bunjevački pisama, najvažniji godišnji glazbeni događaj hrvatske zajednice u Srbiji. Dječji i zbor mladih Kulturne zadruge iz Velikog Borištofa dobitnik je nagrade Minimetron.

programme.title: HAK - Traffic education / HAK - Prometna edukacija
programme.desc: Edukativna tjedna emisija Hrvatskog autokluba donosi reportaže, kratke savjete i zanimljivosti o cestovnom prometu i povećanju sigurnosti.

programme.title: turizam.hrt
programme.desc: In the weekly show about tourism, we follow, question and analyze tourist current affairs on the coast, islands and inland. / U tjednoj emisiji o turizmu pratimo, propitkujemo i analiziramo turističke aktualnosti na obali, otocima i u unutrašnjosti.

programme.title: Hit dana
programme.desc: Every weekday, Hit presents the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben travels to the Arizona desert where he meets Dee _ a retiree who lives a nomadic life. She converted a military truck into a cozy house for living, and she documents her adventures on You Tube under the name "Box Van Dee". As he follows Dee in his car, Ben will experience firsthand what it's like to live in a small vehicle in the middle of the desert. Together they will solve the problems of food preparation, water collection, waste disposal and solar panel repair. Ben will find out about Dee's creative activities and how she finds friends. / Ben putuje u pustinju u Arizoni gdje će upoznati Dee _ umirovljenicu koja živi nomadskim životom. Vojni kamion preuredila je u ugodnu kućicu za stanovanje, a svoje pustolovine dokumentira na You Tubeu pod imenom "Box Van Dee". Dok bude automobilom slijedio Dee, Ben će iz prve ruke iskusiti kako je to živjeti u malom vozilu usred pustinje. Zajedno će rješavati probleme pripreme jela, skupljanja vode, bacanja otpada i popravka solarnih panela. Ben će saznati s kojim se kreativnim aktivnostima Dee bavi i kako nalazi prijatelje.

programme.title: Legende o Zemlji
programme.desc: According to ancient philosophy, four basic elements interact to create our planet. One of them is air. This invisible and untouchable element has created amazing phenomena such as powerful tornadoes in the USA or wild storms that hit the Irish coast, but also the wonderful aurora borealis in the Finnish sky. In this sequel, legends and science help explain the origin and beauty of these unusual landscapes. / Prema antičkoj filozofiji, četiri osnovna elementa međudjelovanjem stvaraju naš planet. Jedan je od njih zrak. Taj nevidljivi i nedodirljivi element stvorio je začuđujuće pojave poput snažnih tornada u SAD-u ili divljih oluja koje pogađaju irsku obalu, ali i divnu polarnu svjetlost na finskom nebu. U ovom nastavku legende i znanost pomažu objasniti postanak i ljepotu tih neobičnih krajolika.

programme.title: The Three Musketeers: DArtagnan / Tri mušketira: DArtagnan
programme.desc: The plot follows a young D'Artagnan who joins the king's musketeers to secure the future of France. / Radnja prati mladog DArtagnana koji se pridružuje kraljevim mušketirima kako bi osigurali budućnost Francuske.

programme.title: Pred sudom javnosti
programme.desc: As the trial draws to a close, Cleo and Talitha's time is running out. After the prosecution finishes presenting, Dhillon and Talitha have the opportunity to give their testimony about what happened between them and Hanna. Cleo and James must make some tough decisions to ensure a fair trial. After a series of shocking revelations in court, the jury must decide whether Talitha is guilty or not. / Suđenje se bliži završetku, Cleo i Talithi vrijeme istječe. Nakon što tužiteljstvo završi s izlaganjem, Dhillon i Talitha imaju priliku dati svoj iskaz o tome što se dogodilo između njih i Hanne. Cleo i James moraju donijeti neke teške odluke kako bi osigurali pošteno suđenje. Nakon niza šokantnih otkrića na sudu, porota mora odlučiti je li Talitha kriva ili ne.

programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: After the body of a woman who allegedly hanged herself is found, Lewis and Hathaway must find out if it really was a case of suicide. To make matters worse, the victim was left behind by her husband and two minor girls. Although Innocentica is convinced that it was a suicide, Lewis can't shake the impression that something stinks. / Nakon što je nađeno truplo žene koja se navodno objesila, Lewis i Hathaway moraju otkriti je li doista riječ o slučaju samoubojstva. Da bi stvar bila gora, iza žrtve ostao je muž i dvije malodobne djevojčice. Iako je Innocentica uvjerena da je riječ o samoubojstvu, Lewis se nikako ne može oteti dojmu da tu nešto smrdi.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly embraces her new role as a grandmother, but tries to stay young at heart. Adam gets a job while waiting to start his studies. / Beverly prihvaća svoju novu ulogu bake, no pokušava ostati mlada u srcu. Adam dobiva posao dok čeka da krene na studij.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam and Barry do everything in their power to make Thanksgiving go smoothly because they know how much it means to Beverly, but things go wrong. / Adam i Barry čine sve u svojoj moći kako bi Dan zahvalnosti protekao bez trzavica jer znaju koliko to znači Beverly, no stvari krenu po zlu.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Returning to the UK after 22 years in eastern Australia, today's couple have decided to make their new inland home in glorious Gloucestershire. Nicki Chapman has the keys to some unusual properties and meets a couple who have literally bought themselves their dream home. / Povratnici u UK nakon 22 godine provedene u istočnoj Australiji, današnji par je odlučio da njihov novi dom u unutrašnjosti bude u slavnom Gloucestershireu. Nicki Chapman ima ključeve nekih osebujnih nekretnina, a sastaje se i s parom koji si je doslovno kupio svoj dom iz snova.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: George meets a couple who are turning an abandoned gas station into a luxury holiday home and a swimmer who is building a futuristic micro-camper. Plus a glamping treehouse in a Danish forest. / George upoznaje par koji napuštenu crpnu postaju pretvara u luksuznu kuću za odmor te plivača koji gradi futuristički mikrokamper. Uz to glamping kućica na drvetu u danskoj šumi.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: We will learn from Gordon how to prepare a great breakfast, lunch and dinner inspired by the flavors and techniques of Southeast Asia. We'll see a very flavorful noodle soup with vongole, and Gordon's daughter Holly will help him prepare delicious, sticky and spicy chicken wings and banana coconut fritters. / Od Gordona ćemo naučiti kako se pripremaju sjajan doručak, ručak i večera nadahnuti okusima i tehnikama iz jugoistočne Azije. Vidjet ćemo vrlo aromatičnu juhu s vongolama i rezancima, a Gordonova kći Holly pomoći će mu da pripremi slasna, ljepljiva i pikantna pileća krilca te popečke od banane i kokosa.

programme.title: UK: Garden of the Year / UK: Vrt godine
programme.desc: Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde and Lachlan Rae traveled across the UK to find gardens to compete for Garden of the Year. Now the owners and representatives of the best of the best have gathered to participate in the announcement of the winner. Only one will win the title of Garden of the Year. / Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde i Lachlan Rae putovali su cijelim Ujedinjenim Kraljevstvom kako bi pronašli vrtove koji će se natjecati za Vrt godine. Sada su se okupili vlasnici i predstavnici najboljih od najboljih kako bi sudjelovali u proglašenju pobjednika. Samo će jedan ponijeti titulu Vrta godine.

programme.title: Prue Leith - in the kitchen with friends / Prue Leith - u kuhinji s prijateljima
programme.desc: Prue is joined by Lulu _ who sings as she makes a chocolate puddle cake _ and, with the help of her husband John, cooks a decorated haggis with turnips and mash. / Prue dobiva društvo u Lulu _ koja pjeva dok izrađuje čokoladnu lokvastu tortu _ i uz pomoć svojeg supruga Johna kuha ukrašeni haggis s repom i pireom.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: In the middle of the Atlantic lies a green paradise - the Azores. Nine islands of volcanic origin between Europe and America. Fascinating plant and animal life above and in the sea. A green garden of paradise with an abundance of exotic flowers, a secret destination for travelers, which has so far managed to remain spared from mass tourism. Within that Portuguese archipelago rises the highest mountain in Portugal, the extinct volcano Pico. Some of the 1,700 volcanoes in the Azores are still active. The Azores' national dish, cozido, is cooked by local residents in the heat of the volcano, as in the past. The most beautiful cows on the Atlantic graze on the evergreen slopes of the cooled volcanoes, and there is also the only European tea plantation. The film crew went on an expedition to the Azores. / Usred Atlantika pritajio se zeleni raj _ Azori. Devet otoka vulkanskog podrijetla između Europe i Amerike. Fascinantan biljni i životinjski svijet iznad mora i u njemu. Zeleni rajski vrt s obiljem egzotičnog cvijeća, tajno odredište putnikâ, koje je zasad uspjelo ostati pošteđeno masovnog turizma. U sklopu tog portugalskog arhipelaga uzdiže se najviša planina Portugala, ugasli vulkan Pico. Neki od 1700 vulkana na Azorima još su aktivni. Azorsko nacionalno jelo cozido ovdašnji stanovnici kuhaju u vrelini vulkana, kao u prošlosti. Na zimzelenim obroncima ohlađenih vulkana pasu najljepše krave na Atlantiku, a tu je i jedina europska plantaža čaja. Filmska ekipa krenula je na Azore u ekspediciju.

programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: The police are called to the house of Dr. Stringer, an expert on the poetry of the Romantic poets. dr. Stringer thinks that someone has broken into his garden, although there are no valuables in the house except for rare books. Lewis notices Neil's picture on the wall. Later, in the Bodleian library, Chapman is found shot to the head by an employee of the library. Chapman was a heavy gambler, which his aggressive brother-in-law resented. Hathaway finds books from the 19th century in Chapman's house, and borrowing from the Bodleian library is forbidden. Lewis soon finds himself in the middle of a case that hides much more far-reaching consequences... / Policija je pozvana u kuću dr. Stringera, stručnjaka za poeziju pjesnika romantizma. Dr. Stringer misli da mu je netko provalio u vrt, premda u kući nema nikakvih dragocjenosti osim rijetkih knjiga. Lewis zamjećuje Neilovu sliku na zidu. Kasnije u knjižnici Bodleian zaposlenika knjižnice Chapmana pronađu ubijenog hicem u glavu. Chapman je bio teški kockar, što mu je njegov agresivni šurjak zamjerao. Hathaway u Chapmanovoj kući pronalazi knjige iz 19. stoljeća, a zabranjeno je posuđivanje iz knjižnice Bodleian. Lewis se ubrzo nađe usred slučaja koji krije mnogo dalekosežnije posljedice...

programme.title: Svijet znanosti
programme.desc: The show brings current events, new scientific discoveries, interesting facts from the animal and plant world, and social phenomena. We will look into all the corners of the Earth, and we will not forget the rest of the universe either. We bring the serious, but also the more casual, fun side of science. / Emisija donosi aktualnosti, nova znanstvena otkrića, zanimljivosti iz životinjskog i biljnog svijeta te društvene fenomene. Zavirit ćemo u sve kutke Zemlje, a nećemo zaboraviti ni ostatak svemira. Donosimo ozbiljnu, ali i onu ležerniju, zabavnu stranu znanosti.

programme.title: Prometej
programme.desc: The weekly show about science, new knowledge and innovations that practically change our world, improving our everyday life, presents the professional and scientific achievements of our scientists in all scientific fields. / Tjedna emisija o znanosti, novim spoznajama i inovacijama koje praktično mijenjaju naš svijet poboljšavajući nam svakodnevicu, predstavlja stručna i znanstvena postignuća naših znanstvenika u svim znanstvenim područjima.

programme.title: Poslovni plan
programme.desc: The show brings the latest news from the economy, talks about perspectives, economic forecasts, GDP trends, problems and growth generators. / Emisija donosi najnovije vijesti iz ekonomije, govori o perspektivama, ekonomskim prognozama, kretanju BDP-a, problemima i generatorima rasta.

programme.title: Koordinacija
programme.desc: Coordination is a specialized weekly show about construction that brings current topics and conversations with leading Croatian experts, scientists and engineers in an entertaining way. / Koordinacija je specijalizirana tjedna emisija o građevinarstvu koja na zabavan način donosi aktualne teme i razgovore s vodećim hrvatskim stručnjacima, znanstvenicima i inženjerima.

programme.title: View across the border - Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina / Pogled preko granice - Hrvati u BiH
programme.desc: The weekly show brings short reports about the everyday life of Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina, follows the political scene there, events in the Croatian community, reminds us of the greats of Croatian culture, science and history. / Tjedna emisija, donosi kratke reportaže o svakodnevici Hrvata u BiH, prati tamošnju političku scenu, događaje u hrvatskoj zajednici, podsjeća na velikane hrvatske kulture, znanosti i povijesti.

programme.title: Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: A herb hunter visits Psunj, a mountain in the southwestern region of Slavonia in eastern Croatia. It is the highest mountain in Slavonia, with the highest peak Brezovo polje at 985 meters above sea level, located in the Požega-Slavonia County. Psunj has a Paleozoic core surrounded by Neogene sediments. The higher parts of the mountain are covered with forest, and the foothills are planted with vineyards and orchards. Some of the plants in this episode are Japanese gardenia, field horsetail, judder's ear, white comfrey, male fern, buttercup, and primrose. The guests of the episode are ecological producer Tatjana Ordanić and the owner of an adventure agency in Slavonia, Josip "Lux" Lukačević. / Lovac na bilje posjećuje Psunj, planinu u jugozapadnom području Slavonije u istočnoj Hrvatskoj. To je najviša planina Slavonije, s najvišim vrhom Brezovo polje na 985 metara nadmorske visine, koji se nalazi u Požeško-slavonskoj županiji. Psunj ima paleozojsku jezgru koju okružuju neogenski sedimenti. Viši dijelovi planine prekriveni su šumom, a na prigorjima su zasađeni vinogradi i voćnjaci. Neke od biljaka u ovoj epizodi su japanski dvornik, poljska preslica, judino uho, bijeli gavez, muška paprat, zdravičica i šumska krasuljica. Gosti epizode su ekološka proizvođačica Tatjana Ordanić i vlasnik pustolovne agencije u Slavoniji Josip "Lux" Lukačević.

programme.title: Hit dana
programme.desc: Every weekday, Hit presents the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben Fogle will visit legendary snowboarder Mike Basich _ a man who gave up fame and fortune to connect with nature and lead a quiet life in the Sierra Nevada mountains. He will be his guest in the log cabin, find out what Mike thinks about extreme sports, why he decided to leave that life and what his next big project is. Ben will join Mike in a snowy idyll and explore the mountain on skis. He will make sure that Mike is a gifted mechanic, metal worker and carpenter who knows how to cut down a tree, install solar panels, a jacuzzi and his own ski lift. / Ben Fogle će posjetiti legendarnog daskaša na snijegu Mikea Basicha _ čovjeka koji se odrekao slave i bogatstva kako bi se povezao s prirodom i vodio miran život u gorju Sierra Nevada. Bit će njegov gost u brvnari, saznati što Mike misli o ekstremnim sportovima, zašto je odlučio ostaviti taj život i što je njegov sljedeći veliki projekt. Ben će se pridružiti Mikeu u snježnoj idili i istraživati planinu na skijama. Uvjerit će se da je Mike nadaren mehaničar, metalac i stolar koji zna posjeći stablo, ugraditi solarne panele, jacuzzi i vlastiti skijaški lift.

programme.title: Football: Champions League - show / Nogomet: Liga prvaka - emisija
programme.desc: The Football Champions League has reached the third round. A new episode of the great European rivalry awaits us on the magnificent stage of the Santiago Bernabeu. Real Madrid welcomes Juventus and is looking for a continuation of the winning streak in front of its fans. Will Kylian Mbappe and the expensive company from the Spanish capital register their third victory or will the Old Lady led by our Igor Tudor mess up their accounts? / Nogometna liga prvaka stigla je do trećeg kola. Na veličanstvenoj pozornici Santiago Bernabeua očekuje nas nova epizoda velikog europskog rivalstva. Madridski Real dočekuje Juventus i pred svojim navijačima traži nastavak pobjedničke serije. Hoće li Kylian Mbappe i skupocjeno društvo iz španjolske prijestolnice upisati i treću pobjedu ili će im Stara dama vođena našim Igorom Tudorom pomrsiti račune?

programme.title: Football - Champions League / Nogomet - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: The 71st season of the Champions League begins with the qualifiers in July 2025 and ends with a spectacular final that will take place on May 30, 2026 in Budapest. The biggest European club competition brings together 36 top clubs who compete in eight rounds, and only the best move on. Follow the tense matches and enjoy the top football! / 71. sezona Lige prvaka počinje kvalifikacijama u srpnju 2025. godine i završava spektakularnim finalom koje će se održati 30. svibnja 2026. u Budimpešti. Najveće europsko klupsko natjecanje okuplja 36 vrhunskih klubova koji se natječu kroz osam kola, a samo oni najbolji idu dalje. Pratite napete utakmice i uživajte u vrhunskom nogometu!

programme.title: Zaljev
programme.desc: Sergeant Jenn Townsend, family co-ordinator for Morecambe Police, returned to the Serious Crime Unit after her father's death. Already on the first working day, he learns that the body of the murdered Hanna Dawson has been found. Jenn suppresses her own grief in order to break the sad news to the victim's loved ones with a cool head. Hanna's divorced parents Julie and Steve are forced to face each other again after their daughter's death, and Hanna's grandfather Tommy and brother Bradley, as well as Julie's current husband Craig, find themselves between the two fires. At the same time, Jenna's family life becomes even more chaotic after the arrival of an unexpected guest. Jenn soon gets a new lead in the case. / Narednica Jenn Townsend, obiteljska koordinatorica PU u Morecambeu, nakon očeve smrti vratila se u Odjel teških zločina. Već prvoga radnog dana doznaje da je nađeno tijelo ubijene Hanne Dawson. Jenn zatomi vlastitu tugu kako bi tužnu vijest hladne glave priopćila žrtvinim bližnjima. Hannini rastavljeni roditelji Julie i Steve primorani su ponovno se suočiti nakon kćerine smrti, a između dvije vatre nađu se Hannin djed Tommy i brat Bradley, ali i Julien sadašnji muž Craig. Istodobno, Jennin obiteljski život postaje još kaotičniji nakon dolaska neočekivane gošće. Jenn uskoro dobiva novi trag u vezi sa slučajem.

programme.desc: Beverly is asked out on a date, and Adam questions his friendship with Dave Kim. / Beverly pozivaju na spoj, a Adam preispituje svoje prijateljstvo s Daveom Kimom.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: A newly engaged couple from Cheshire are looking to buy their first home together in rural Northumberland, where Jules Hudson comes to the rescue and shows them a selection of properties to suit their wishes. The two most important requirements are a secluded location and enough land to start a rental business. / Upravo zaručen par iz Cheshirea želi kupiti svoj prvi zajednički dom u ruralnom Northumberlandu, gdje im Jules Hudson priskače u pomoć i pokazuje im izbor nekretnina koje odgovaraju njihovim željama. Dva najvažnija zahtjeva su mjesto na osami i dovoljno zemlje za pokretanje posla iznajmljivanja.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: George follows two eccentric construction ventures. A couple builds a camper on the back of a tiny Italian tuk-tuk, and a father of two creates an unusual vacation space in an abandoned nuclear bunker. / George prati dva ekscentrična građevinska poduhvata. Jedan par gradi kamper na stražnjem dijelu malenog talijanskog tuk-tuka, a otac dvoje djece stvara neobičan prostor za odmor u napuštenom nuklearnom bunkeru.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: Gordon's guide to cooking at home continues the theme of great dishes with intense flavors. For breakfast, he will prepare irresistible croissants stuffed with merguez sausages and fontina cheese, then spicy Mexican soup, and his eldest daughter Megan will help him prepare roasted duck with a crispy crust in black bean sauce and an impressive tarte tatin with spicy bananas. / Gordonov vodič za kuhanje kod kuće nastavlja se temom sjajnih jela intenzivnih okusa. Za doručak će pripremiti neodoljive kroasane nadjevene kobasicama merguez i sirom fontinom, potom pikantnu meksičku juhu, a njegova najstarija kći Megan pomoći će mu da pripremi pečenu patku s hrskavom koricom u umaku od crnoga graha te dojmljivi tarte tatin sa začinjenim bananama.

programme.title: Spašavatelji vrtova
programme.desc: Emma and Nathan would love to turn their run-down backyard into a Balinese paradise. Nathan recently retired from military service and works from home, and Emma is a nurse. After the pandemic spent at home, they would love to stay outside in a tropical environment with lush vegetation and a water feature. Such a garden would be unique among all the traditional English gardens surrounding them. These are all small plots that were arranged by the Lever family for the workers of the soap factory in Port Sunlight even before the First World War. The challenge is accepted by Charlie and Chris with a budget of £6,000. However, the Institute for the Protection of Cultural Monuments imposes some inconvenient restrictions. How will designers solve them? / Emma i Nathan rado bi pretvorili svoj zapušteni kućni vrt u balijski raj. Nathan se nedavno povukao iz vojne službe i radi od kuće, a Emma je medicinska sestra. Nakon pandemije provedene u kući voljeli bi boraviti vani u tropskom okruženju s bujnim raslinjem i vodenim elementom. Takav bi vrt bio jedinstven među svim tradicionalnim engleskim vrtovima koji ih okružuju. Sve su to sitne parcele koje je još prije Prvog svjetskog rata uredila obitelj Lever za radnike tvornice sapuna u Port Sunlightu. Izazova se prihvaćaju Charlie i Chris uz budžet od 6000 funta. Međutim, Zavod za zaštitu spomenika kulture nameće neka nezgodna ograničenja. Kako će ih dizajneri riješiti?

programme.title: Prue Leith - in the kitchen with friends / Prue Leith - u kuhinji s prijateljima
programme.desc: Prue welcomes the glamorous Kelly Brook into her kitchen and together with her husband John prepares two quiches _ Leith's favorite dish. / Prue dočekuje glamuroznu Kelly Brook u svojoj kuhinji i zajedno sa svojim suprugom Johnom priprema dva quichea _ Leithino omiljeno jelo.

programme.title: Transilvanija
programme.desc: Zingarina (A. Argento), two months pregnant, travels with her friend Marie (A. Casar) to Transylvania in search of her lover Milan Augustin... / Zingarina (A. Argento), trudna dva mjeseca, putuje s prijateljicom Marie (A. Casar) u Transilvaniju u potrazi za svojim ljubavnikom Milanom Augustinom...

programme.title: Cavalier with a gun / Kavalir s pištoljem
programme.desc: At the age of 70, Forrest Tucker escapes from San Quentin and commits a series of daring robberies that baffle the police and amaze the public. Detective John Hunt, amazed by Forrest's dedication to work, and a woman who loves him despite his "occupation" set out in search of him... / U dobi od 70 godina Forrest Tucker pobjegne iz San Quentina i počini niz smjelih pljački koje zbune policiju i oduševe javnost. U potragu za njim kreću detektiv John Hunt, zadivljen Forrestovom predanošću poslu, i žena koja ga voli unatoč njegovu "zanimanju"...

programme.title: Skitancije
programme.desc: The second episode of the travel series is dedicated to the wild beauty of the secret corners of Velebit, which are not found on tourist maps or on mountaineer routes. Meteorologist Zoran Vakula guides us through this adventure. He will reveal to us wonderful places of rugged beauty such as the Štirovača rainforest and the abyss of Klepina duliba, descend into the glacier, spend the night in a secret cabin in the forest that only a few people know about. In this adventure, he will be accompanied by Prpa, a lover of Velebit who was born there and decided to die in its forests, a young nature conservationist, Josip Tomaić, who knows and protects every blade of grass in his beloved surroundings, and wildlife photographer Krunoslav Rac, who will take Vakula to photograph wild animals with questionable success. In the end, they all find themselves together on Zavižan, from which there is such a view that even the gentle Vakula _ was speechless. / Druga epizoda putopisne serije posvećena je divljoj ljepoti tajnih kutova Velebita, koji se ne nalaze na turističkim kartama niti u rutama planinara. Kroz tu nas pustolovinu vodi meteorolog Zoran Vakula. On će nam otkrivati čudesna mjesta grube ljepote kao što je prašuma Štirovača i ponor Klepina duliba, spustiti se u ledenicu, noćiti u tajnoj kolibi u šumi za koju znaju samo rijetki. U toj pustolovini društvo će mu biti zaljubljenik u Velebit Prpa koji je tu rođen i koji je odlučio umrijeti u njegovim šumama, mladi čuvar prirode Josip Tomaić koji poznaje i čuva svaku travčicu voljenog okružja, te fotograf divljine Krunoslav Rac koji će Vakulu povesti na fotografiranje divljih životinja s upitnim uspjehom. Na kraju se svi zajedno nalaze na Zavižanu s kojeg se pruža takav pogled da je čak i blagoglagoljivi Vakula _ zanijemio.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: Immediately after listening to the story of Gromousno, the dogs set out on a mission to save the elephants who were frightened by the terrible sound. // The mayoress is in charge of the class pet, but the hamster escaped! Dogs on patrol must rescue the pet. / Odmah nakon što su poslušali priču o Gromousnom, psići kreću u misiju spašavanja slonova koji su se prepali strašnog zvuka. // Gradonačelnica je zadužena za razrednog ljubimca, ali hrčak je pobjegao! Psići u ophodnji moraju spasiti ljubimca.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just turned three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the flock, he is used to having everything his way. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. Each episode shows one day in kindergarten. The daily routine is disturbed only by the antics of the little ones. Through various accidents and mishaps, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game also await you! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu gets upset when Max doesn't want to join in her imitation game. / Lu se uzruja kad se Maks ne želi uključiti u njenu igru oponašanja.

programme.title: Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of curious little ones left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy crosses the rickety bridge to bring the runaway whistling button to Mucu. With all the balance and tension due to danger, the last thing he needs is Muco's hopping, which makes the bridge shake even more! / Tvidi prelazi preko klimavog mosta da bi Mucu donio odbjegli fijukavi gumb. Uza sve održavanje ravnoteže i napetost zbog opasnosti posljednje što mu treba je Mucovo skakutanje, zbog kojega se most još jače klima!

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Numbers are called to help after a wish at a magical fountain goes wrong. The team must search for coins in the Number Park and collect the exact value needed for a new wish that will restore everything to the way it was. / Brojčići su pozvani u pomoć nakon što želja kod čarobne fontane pođe po zlu. Ekipa mora tražiti kovanice po Brojevnom parku i skupiti točnu vrijednost potrebnu za novu želju koja će sve vratiti na staro.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: The Love Monster promises to prepare the biggest moon pie of all time, but he can't take the job... / Ljubavno Čudovište obeća pripremiti najveću mjesečevu pitu svih vremena, ali nikako da se prihvati posla...

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: In the pizza baking competition, Bob will fight Zip and Pop for the prize. / U natjecanju pečenja pizza, Bob će se za nagradu boriti protiv Zipa i Popa.

programme.title: It's at the hotel / Ho ho ho hotel
programme.desc: HO HO HO HOTEL This fall, we invite you to a hotel like you've never seen before! What kind of guests will be welcomed by the best and funniest hosts of Hotel Ruža i Franc and what funny, silly and impossible wishes and problems will be faced by their guests - you will see in 20 episodes of the new humorous and educational series for children! Ruža and Franc can solve any problem, but in their own special and funny way. Dramatic-educational series of 20 ten-minute episodes produced by the Program for Children and Young People takes place in a hotel with the most unusual, best and sweetest hosts Ruža and Franco and their guests with even more unusual crazy wishes and problems! Through the funny and silly incidents of a clumsy magician, a silly scientist, an opera diva who lost her voice and many others, we will learn what is warm and what is cold, what is quiet and what is loud, fast or slow, big or small, high or low, near or far, heavy or light, visible or invisible! In the main series / HO HO HO HOTEL Ove vas jeseni pozivamo u hotel kakav još nikada niste vidjeli! Kakve će sve goste dočekati najbolji i i najzabavniji domaćini Hotela Ruža i Franc i koje će smiješne, šašave i nemoguće želje i probleme imati njihovi gosti- vidjet ćete u 20 epizoda nove humoristično- edukativne serije za djecu ! Ruža i Franc mogu riješiti svaki problem, ali , na a svoj posebni i smiješni način. Igrano- edukativna serija od 20 desetominutnih epizoda u produkciji Programa za djecu i mlade događa se u hotelu s najneobičnijim, najboljim i najsješnijim domaćinima Ružom i Francom te njihovim gostima s još neobičnijim luckastim željama i problemima! Kroz smiješne i šašave zgode nespretnog mađioničara, šašavog znanstvenika, operne dive koja je ostala bez glasa i mnogih drugih, naučit ćemo što je toplo, a što hladno, što tiho, a što glasno, brzo ili sporo, veliko il malo, visoko i nisko, blizu ili daleko, teško ili lagano, vidljivo ili nevidljivo! U seriji glavne

programme.title: Odred jelena
programme.desc: Jade's first sleepover gets even more interesting after it starts raining teddy bears around town and the Central Forest! // Sir Steel is beside himself after discovering that he wasn't invited to Lady Fluffpot's party, and the Stag Squad was. / Jadein prvi prespavanac postane još zanimljiviji nakon što po gradu i Centralnoj šumi počnu kišiti medvjedići! // Sir Steel je izvan sebe nakon što otkrije da nije pozvan na zabavu Lady Fluffpot, a Odred jelena je.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: Min and Clover teach the little ones how to play nice with each other when they hear Klara Tikvić and her raptor Drapka arguing. They are invited to join the lessons about friendship, to which Klara reluctantly agrees, but she and Drapka do not stop arguing even during the lessons. In the end, Klara gives up, but Drapka wants to stay, so Klara leaves offended. Wanting to apologize to Drapka, Klara picks some delicious flowers, but runs into Gazigrom and his child Gazigromica, who also want those flowers! Drapka and the Dinoranchers rush to Klara's aid, and she uses Mina's lessons to show that she can be a better friend to Drapka. / Min i Clover uče diniće kako se lijepo igrati jedni s drugima, kad začuju kako se Klara Tikvić i njezina raptorica Drapka svađaju. Pozivaju ih da se pridruže podukama o prijateljstvu, na što se Klara nevoljko pristaje, ali ona i Drapka ne prestaju se prepirati ni za vrijeme poduka. Na kraju Klara odustaje, no Drapka želi ostati, pa Klara uvrijeđeno odlazi. Želeći se ispričati Drapki, Klara ubere nekoliko ukusnih cvjetova, ali naiđe na Gazigroma i njegovo dijete Gazigromicu, koji također žele te cvjetove! Drapka i Dinorančeri jure u pomoć Klari, a ona koristi Minine poduke kako bi pokazala da može biti bolja prijateljica Drapki.

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song "I'll do it all by myself" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and know how to do by themselves _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy crosses the rickety bridge to bring the runaway whistling button to Mucu. With all the balance and tension due to danger, the last thing he needs is Muco's hopping, which makes the bridge shake even more! / Tvidi prelazi preko klimavog mosta da bi Mucu donio odbjegli fijukavi gumb. Uza sve održavanje ravnoteže i napetost zbog opasnosti posljednje što mu treba je Mucovo skakutanje, zbog kojega se most još jače klima!

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: I love zoo animals / Volim životinje ZOO
programme.desc: In the series, we meet the animals in the zoo. Volunteer Marko learns about the animal world by helping in the zoo. Every day is a new challenge for him, because he gets a special task that he can't do if he doesn't learn something about the daily activities in the zoo _ feeding, cleaning and arranging the enclosures, playing, training or treating the animals. Together with Mark, we will learn more about the role of zoos in the protection of animal species, scientific research of rare and endangered species, education of children, but also about the importance of groomers, zoologists, nutritionists, and educators in everyday life in the zoo. In the first episode, Marko was given the task of making ice cream for lemurs, and he will understand how to make it only after he learns something about animal nutrition. / U seriji upoznajemo životinje u zoološkom vrtu. Volonter Marko uči o životinjskom svijetu pomažući u zoološkom vrtu. Svaki dan za njega je novi izazov, jer dobiva poseban zadatak koji ne može obaviti ako ne nauči ponešto o svakodnevnim aktivnostima u zoološkom vrtu _ prehrani, čišćenju i uređenju nastambi, igranju, treniranju ili liječenju životinja. Uz Marka i mi ćemo saznati nešto više o ulozi zooloških vrtova u zaštiti životinjskih vrsta, znanstvenom istraživanju rijetkih i ugroženih vrsta, edukaciji djece, ali i o važnosti timaritelja, zoologa, nutricionista, edukatora u svakodnevnom životu u zoološkom vrtu. U prvoj epizodi Marko je dobio zadatak napraviti sladoled za lemure, a kako da to napravi, shvatit će tek nakon što nešto nauči o prehrani životinja.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Numbers are called to help after a wish at a magical fountain goes wrong. The team must search for coins in the Number Park and collect the exact value needed for a new wish that will restore everything to the way it was. / Brojčići su pozvani u pomoć nakon što želja kod čarobne fontane pođe po zlu. Ekipa mora tražiti kovanice po Brojevnom parku i skupiti točnu vrijednost potrebnu za novu želju koja će sve vratiti na staro.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: When Fiona asks Pablo how he is, Pablo doesn't know the answer. He investigates this question with his friends in the Drawing World, so they all try to find out what it really means. / Kad Fiona upita Pabla kako je, Pablo ne zna odgovor. Istražuje to pitanje s prijateljima u Svijetu crteža pa svi oni pokušaju doznati što to zapravo znači.

programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: "Medo Grizzly and Small Attacks" is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the little lemmings, who live in a forest ranger's log cabin while he is away. / "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti _ leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: Immediately after listening to the story of Gromousno, the dogs set out on a mission to save the elephants who were frightened by the terrible sound. // The mayoress is in charge of the class pet, but the hamster escaped! Dogs on patrol must rescue the pet. / Odmah nakon što su poslušali priču o Gromousnom, psići kreću u misiju spašavanja slonova koji su se prepali strašnog zvuka. // Gradonačelnica je zadužena za razrednog ljubimca, ali hrčak je pobjegao! Psići u ophodnji moraju spasiti ljubimca.

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke

Music and lyrics: Srđan Gulić Gul Singers: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animation, direction, screenplay: Vjekoslav Živković / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju. Glazba i stihovi: Srđan Gulić Gul Pjevaju: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animacija, režija, scenarij: Vjekoslav Živković

programme.title: Odred jelena
programme.desc: Jade's first sleepover gets even more interesting after it starts raining teddy bears around town and the Central Forest! // Sir Steel is beside himself after discovering that he wasn't invited to Lady Fluffpot's party, and the Stag Squad was. / Jadein prvi prespavanac postane još zanimljiviji nakon što po gradu i Centralnoj šumi počnu kišiti medvjedići! // Sir Steel je izvan sebe nakon što otkrije da nije pozvan na zabavu Lady Fluffpot, a Odred jelena je.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skitancije
programme.desc: The second episode of the travel series is dedicated to the wild beauty of the secret corners of Velebit, which are not found on tourist maps or on mountaineer routes. Meteorologist Zoran Vakula guides us through this adventure. He will reveal to us wonderful places of rugged beauty such as the Štirovača rainforest and the abyss of Klepina duliba, descend into the glacier, spend the night in a secret cabin in the forest that only a few people know about. In this adventure, he will be accompanied by Prpa, a lover of Velebit who was born there and decided to die in its forests, a young nature conservationist, Josip Tomaić, who knows and protects every blade of grass in his beloved surroundings, and wildlife photographer Krunoslav Rac, who will take Vakula to photograph wild animals with questionable success. In the end, they all find themselves together on Zavižan, from which there is such a view that even the gentle Vakula _ was speechless. / Druga epizoda putopisne serije posvećena je divljoj ljepoti tajnih kutova Velebita, koji se ne nalaze na turističkim kartama niti u rutama planinara. Kroz tu nas pustolovinu vodi meteorolog Zoran Vakula. On će nam otkrivati čudesna mjesta grube ljepote kao što je prašuma Štirovača i ponor Klepina duliba, spustiti se u ledenicu, noćiti u tajnoj kolibi u šumi za koju znaju samo rijetki. U toj pustolovini društvo će mu biti zaljubljenik u Velebit Prpa koji je tu rođen i koji je odlučio umrijeti u njegovim šumama, mladi čuvar prirode Josip Tomaić koji poznaje i čuva svaku travčicu voljenog okružja, te fotograf divljine Krunoslav Rac koji će Vakulu povesti na fotografiranje divljih životinja s upitnim uspjehom. Na kraju se svi zajedno nalaze na Zavižanu s kojeg se pruža takav pogled da je čak i blagoglagoljivi Vakula _ zanijemio.

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Klasici narodu
programme.desc: It's hard to be alone. And a trivial five minutes and a difficult week and a terrible whole year, and one unfortunate tribe in the small village of Macondo, somewhere in the jungle area of ​​Colombia, was "sentenced" to about 100 years of solitude. Sounds claustrophobic, doesn't it? However, for consolation, Macondo is just a figment of the imagination of the writer Gabriel Garcia Marquez in the fantastic novel "100 Years of Solitude". How 100 years of solitude sounds translated from Spanish to Croatian, hear from the gymnasts and students of the art academy in this episode of "Classic for the People". Whether it's bad weather or a sunny day, you're never alone with a classic. Spend the evening in pleasant company on HRT3. / Teško je biti sam. I tričavih pet minuta i teških tjedan dana i užasnu cijelu godinu, a jedno nesretno pleme u malenom selu Macondo, negdje na džunglovitom području Kolumbije, "osuđeno" je na oko 100 godina samoće. Zvuči klaustrofobično, zar ne? Ipak za utjehu, Macondo je samo plod mašte pisca Gabriela Garcije Marqueza u fantastičnom romanu "100 godina samoće". Kako 100 godina samoće zvuči prevedeno sa španjolskog na hrvatski, poslušajte od gimnastičara i studenata likovne akademije u ovoj epizodi "Klasika narodu". Bilo ružno vrijeme ili sunčan dan, sa klasikom nikad nisi sam. Provedite večer u ugodnom društvu na HRT3.

programme.title: Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Sandra Vitaljić belongs to the younger generation of Croatian photographers. Born in 1972 in Pula, after studying at the FAMU Film Academy in Prague, she came to Zagreb, where she worked as a newspaper, advertising and art photographer. Her portraits, whether they are nudes or fashion photography, are a combination of a character study of the person portrayed and her personal view of the world. In photographs of seemingly deserted landscapes, she connects personal research and topics that occupy her with relevant social events. / Sandra Vitaljić pripada mlađoj generaciji hrvatskih fotografa. Rođena 1972. u Puli, nakon školovanja na Filmskoj akademiji FAMU u Pragu dolazi u Zagreb gdje radi kao novinski, reklamni i umjetnički fotograf. Njezini portreti, bilo da je riječ o aktovima ili modnoj fotografiji, spoj su studije karaktera portretiranog i njezinog osobnog pogleda na svijet. Na fotografijama naizgled pustih krajolika ona povezuje osobna istraživanja i teme koje ju zaokupljaju s relevantnim društvenim zbivanjima.

programme.title: On the occasion of the 100th anniversary of his birth: Who is this Zvonimir Bajsić? / Povodom 100. obljetnice rođenja: Tko je taj Zvonimir Bajsić?
programme.desc: An emotional and poetic journey through the thoughts and works of Zvonimir Bajsić (1925 - 1987), writer, translator, radio, television and theater director, world radio champion and pioneer of domestic television dramatic expression. Who is the man after whom the Croatian Radiotelevision music studio is named? His enormous work of exceptional creative power is almost unknown to the general public. This film is an attempt to correct that mistake. / Emotivno i poetsko putovanje kroz misli i djela Zvonimira Bajsića (1925. _ 1987.), pisca, prevoditelja, radijskog, televizijskog i kazališnog redatelja, prvaka svjetske radiofonije i pionira domaćeg televizijskog dramskog izričaja. Tko je čovjek po kojem nosi ime glazbeni studio Hrvatske radiotelevizije? Njegovo golemo djelo izuzetne kreativne snage gotovo je nepoznato široj javnosti. Ovaj film je pokušaj ispravljanja te pogreške.

programme.title: Ovo je filozofija
programme.desc: We've all heard of platonic love. But do we know what it is? The meaning of this term goes back to the time of one of the greatest thinkers in the world, Plato. His philosophy, which is based on learning about ideas, has remained important until today. When we say that looks are deceiving, we actually sound like platonists. Along with Plato, we will ask about being and we will study some of his key concepts, just as if we were in his famous Academy. But on an accelerated course. We will be accompanied by philosopher Simon Blackburn and mathematician Bartolo Luque. / Svi smo čuli za platonsku ljubav. No znamo li što je to? Značenje tog pojma seže u vrijeme jednog od najvećih mislilaca na svijetu Platona. Njegova filozofija kojoj je polazište učenje o idejama ostala je važna sve do današnjih dana. Kad kažemo da izgled vara, zapravo zvučimo kao platonisti. Uz Platona ćemo se pitati o biću i proučit ćemo neke od njegovih ključnih koncepcija, baš kao da smo u njegovoj slavnoj Akademiji. Ali na ubrzanom tečaju. Društvo će nam praviti filozof Simon Blackburn i matematičar Bartolo Luque.

programme.title: Crvena rijeka
programme.desc: Thomas Dunson (J. Wayne) wants above all to have a big ranch in Texas. He leaves his fiancee Fen (C. Gray) and heads for Texas with his friend, old Nadine Groot (W. Brennan). He learns that his fiancee was killed in an Indian attack on a caravan and finds a boy named Matthew "Matt" Garth, whom he takes and adopts. With only a few head of cattle, Dunson crosses the Red River with Groot and Matt and claims the vast green pastures as his land. When he is confronted by two Mexicans claiming that the land is owned by another man, Dunson kills one of them and says he wants to see who will oppose him and take ownership of the ranch... / Thomas Dunson (J. Wayne) iznad svega želi imati veliki ranč u Teksasu. Ostavi zaručnicu Fen (C. Grey) i odlazi prema Teksasu s prijateljem, starim Nadineom Grootom (W. Brennan). Dozna da je zaručnica ubijena u indijanskom napadu na karavanu i nađe dječaka Matthewa "Matta" Gartha kojega uzme i usvoji. Sa svega nekoliko grla stoke Dunson prelazi s Grootom i Mattom Crvenu rijeku i proglasi prostrane zelene pašnjake svojom zemljom. Kad mu se usprotive dvojica Meksikanaca tvrdeći da je vlasnik zemlje neki drugi čovjek, Dunson ubije jednog od njih i kaže da želi vidjeti tko će mu se suprotstaviti i oduzeti vlasništvo ranča...

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: Chief Xian aTunde Adjuah ​​was born Christian Scott to the illustrious family of Chief Donald Harrison Sr. of New Orleans. The trumpet — a preacher's instrument — seemed like a logical choice for him, with elders saying it had "the kind of sound that calls children home." Young Christian patented an interesting brass instrument that combines trumpet, horn and electric harp, which is a hybrid of the traditional West African instruments ngoni and kora. That's how he defined his sound and called it "stretch music". Since 2002, he has released 16 albums, and the questioning of the socio-political reality of the world _ the consequences of slavery, the paradox of the prison system, growing racism and all kinds of intolerance _ culminated in 2017 in the album trilogy Ruler Rebel, Diaspora and Emancipation Procrastination. With the album Ancestral Recall (2019) and the poet Saul Williams, he went a step further in his search for the decolonization of sound. He has been nominated six times for the Grammy Award, with two nominations for the 2020 album Axiom.
