programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: It brings recordings of Croatian and foreign jazz concerts and festivals, reportage overviews of current events on the Croatian jazz scene. / Donosi snimke hrvatskih i inozemnih jazz-koncerata i festivala, reportažne preglede aktualnih događaja na hrvatskoj jazz-sceni.

programme.title: Skitancije
programme.desc: In the last episode of the travel series "Skitancije" we are guided through the interior of Istria by speleologist, poet and legend writer Tihomir Kovačević-Tihi in the lovely company of Luna, his canine friend. Tihi and Luna travel from Učka to Baradin in search of legends and a dragon baby, in the "Academy of Everything" they listen to stone stories and jazz, taste the drink of the old druids, spin in magic circles, and run headfirst from the shearer Jura Grand. On their mystical journey, they also visited the ghostly Dvigrad, were in the abyss that inspired Dante to describe the road to hell, rested by the milky river and finally descended into a cave full of magical characters. / U posljednjoj epizodi putopisne serije "Skitancije" kroz unutrašnjost Istre vodi nas speleolog, pjesnik i pisac legendi Tihomir Kovačević-Tihi u ljupkom društvu Lune, svoje pseće prijateljice. Tihi i Luna putuju od Učke do Baradina u potrazi za legendama i zmajevom bebom, u "Akademiji svega" slušaju kamene priče i jazz, kušaju piće starih druida, vrte se u čarobnim krugovima, te bježe glavom bez obzira od štriguna Jure Granda. Na svom mističnom putovanju obišli su i sablasni Dvigrad, bili su u ponoru koji je Dantea inspirirao za opis puta u pakao, odmarali se uz mliječnu rijeku i na kraju se spustili u spilju punu čarobnih likova.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The Canadian children's animated series Dogs on Patrol was created by Keith Chapman. The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of a team of search and rescue dogs called Patrol Dogs. The team goes on missions together to protect the coastal community of Adventure Bay. / Kanadska animirana serija za djecu Psići u ophodnji je nastala prema kreaciji Keitha Chapmana. Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just turned three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the flock, he is used to having everything his way. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. Each episode shows one day in kindergarten. The daily routine is disturbed only by the antics of the little ones. Through various accidents and mishaps, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game also await you! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki.

programme.title: Volim životinje
programme.desc: Dokumentarno-animirana serija upoznaje najmlađe sa životinjskim vrstama.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu doesn't realize that Biba is scared of the game they play together. / Lu ne shvaća da Bibu plaši igra koju se igraju zajedno.

programme.title: Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of curious little ones left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy and Muc find a togoban! Tweedy discovers that Muc prefers to climb rather than descend, but finally with a little help and a lot of patience, Muc still finds himself at the top. Will he dare to descend? / Tvidi i Muc pronađu togoban! Tvidi otkrije da se Muc više voli uspinjati nego spuštati, no napokon uz malu pomoć i mnogo strpljenja Muc se ipak nađe na vrhu. Hoće li usuditi spustiti se?

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: The key is gone! Captain Redbeard can't do without him! The numbers come to the rescue and discover that Kljucko has turned into another object, but with one difference. Can I spot which object it is and save Klyuck from the spell? / Kljucko je nestao! Kapetan Riđobradi ne može bez njega! Brojčići dolaze u pomoć i otkrivaju da se Kljucko pretvorio u drugi predmet, ali s jednom razlikom. Mogu li uočiti o kojem se predmetu radi i spasiti Kljucka od čarolije?

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: The Love Monster tries to overcome his fear of loud noises so that he can enjoy the fireworks without interruption. / Ljubavno Čudovište nastoji pobijediti svoj strah od glasnih zvukova kako bi mogao nesmetano uživati u vatrometu.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bitz and Bob will run into Ranger Berk on a distant island, who is trying to help the frogs find water. / Bitz i Bob će na dalekom otoku naletjeti na rendžera Berka, koji pokušava pomoći žabama da pronađu vodu.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: It's a snowy winter's day, and the leader of the parasaurolophine herd, Iskra, has just given birth to a cub that the Dinoranchers name Luna. But Luna hadn't been out for a minute when she disappeared, and she doesn't respond to her mother's calls. Dinoranchers find her and realize that she didn't answer Iskra because she is deaf, so they try to find another way to communicate with her. Miguel invents a special "Luna Light" that flashes different colors and symbols for different messages, thus teaching Luna to talk to them. That evening, a blizzard covers Dinoranch, and a herd of parasaurs panics and flees. With the howling wind and snow too loud to call out, the ranchers figure out that they can use Luna's light to get Luna to help them save the herd. She and Iskra chase after their dinosaurs, and the Dinoranchers use Luna's light to guide them back home to safety. Luna's light not only helped them talk to Luna, but also taught them how important it is to find different ways to communicate with all the other dinosaurs as well! / Snježni je zimski dan, a vođa krda parasaurolofina, Iskra, upravo je dobila mladunče kojem Dinorančeri daju ime Luna. No Luna nije bila vani ni minutu kad je nestala i ne odaziva se na majčine pozive. Dinorančeri je pronađu i shvate da se nije javila Iskri jer je gluha, pa pokušavaju pronaći drugi način sporazumijevanja s njom. Miguel izumi posebno "Lunino svjetlo" koje bljeska različitim bojama i simbolima za različite poruke, čime Luna nauči razgovarati s njima. Te večeri snježna mećava prekrije Dinoranč, a krdo parasaura se uspaniči i pobjegne. Budući da su zavijanje vjetra i snijeg preglasni da bi ih mogli dozvati, rančeri se dosjete da mogu upotrijebiti Lunino svjetlo kako bi im Luna pomogla spasiti krdo. Ona i Iskra pojure za svojim dinosaurima, a Dinorančeri pomoću Lunina svjetla usmjeravaju ih natrag kući na sigurno. Lunino svjetlo ne samo da im je pomoglo razgovarati s Lunom, nego ih je i naučilo koliko je važno pronaći različite načine komunikacije i sa svim drugim dinosaurima!

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song "I'll do it all by myself" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and know how to do by themselves _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy and Muc find a togoban! Tweedy discovers that Muc prefers to climb rather than descend, but finally with a little help and a lot of patience, Muc still finds himself at the top. Will he dare to descend? / Tvidi i Muc pronađu togoban! Tvidi otkrije da se Muc više voli uspinjati nego spuštati, no napokon uz malu pomoć i mnogo strpljenja Muc se ipak nađe na vrhu. Hoće li usuditi spustiti se?

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: The key is gone! Captain Redbeard can't do without him! The numbers come to the rescue and discover that Kljucko has turned into another object, but with one difference. Can I spot which object it is and save Klyuck from the spell? / Kljucko je nestao! Kapetan Riđobradi ne može bez njega! Brojčići dolaze u pomoć i otkrivaju da se Kljucko pretvorio u drugi predmet, ali s jednom razlikom. Mogu li uočiti o kojem se predmetu radi i spasiti Kljucka od čarolije?

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Afraid of the noisy birthday party, Pablo runs back to the car. Friends in the Drawing World join him and help him realize that partying is nothing more than a gathering of friends. / U strahu od bučne rođendanske zabave Pablo otrči natrag u automobil. Prijatelji u Svijetu crteža pridruže mu se i pomognu mu da shvati kako je zabava nije ništa drugo nego okupljanje prijatelja.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bitz and Bob will run into Ranger Berk on a distant island, who is trying to help the frogs find water. / Bitz i Bob će na dalekom otoku naletjeti na rendžera Berka, koji pokušava pomoći žabama da pronađu vodu.

programme.title: Edmond i Luce
programme.desc: Edmund, Luce and Mishka are busy chasing caterpillars out of the vegetable garden when Edo, who finds it all very amusing, tells them not to bother. When night falls, a fantastic creature will come and clean the garden! Intrigued, the children decide to sneak out to see the creature. / Edmund, Luce i Miška zauzeti su tjeranjem gusjenica iz povrtnjaka kad im Edo, kome je sve to vrlo zabavno, veli da se ne trude. Kad padne noć, doći će fantastično stvorenje i očistiti vrt! Zaintrigirana, djeca odluče iskrasti se van kako bi vidjela to stvorenje.

programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: "Medo Grizzly and Small Attacks" is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the little lemmings, who live in a forest ranger's log cabin while he is away. / "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti _ leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan.

Miguel izumi posebno "Lunino svjetlo" koje bljeska različitim bojama i simbolima za različite poruke, čime Luna nauči razgovarati s njima. programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The Canadian children's animated series Dogs on Patrol was created by Keith Chapman. The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of a team of search and rescue dogs called Patrol Dogs. The team goes on missions together to protect the coastal community of Adventure Bay. / Kanadska animirana serija za djecu Psići u ophodnji je nastala prema kreaciji Keitha Chapmana. Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay.

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Najgora vještica
programme.desc: A stunning adaptation of Jill Murphy's favorite Mildred Hubble books. Now Mildred is back at Cackle and is a better witch than before. / Zadivljujuća prerada omiljenih knjiga Jill Murphy o Mildred Hubble. Sad se Mildred vratila u Cackle i bolja je vještica nego prije.

programme.title: Skitancije
programme.desc: In the last episode of the travel series "Skitancije" we are guided through the interior of Istria by speleologist, poet and legend writer Tihomir Kovačević-Tihi in the lovely company of Luna, his canine friend. Tihi and Luna travel from Učka to Baradin in search of legends and a dragon baby, in the "Academy of Everything" they listen to stone stories and jazz, taste the drink of the old druids, spin in magic circles, and run headfirst from the shearer Jura Grand. On their mystical journey, they also visited the ghostly Dvigrad, were in the abyss that inspired Dante to describe the road to hell, rested by the milky river and finally descended into a cave full of magical characters. / U posljednjoj epizodi putopisne serije "Skitancije" kroz unutrašnjost Istre vodi nas speleolog, pjesnik i pisac legendi Tihomir Kovačević-Tihi u ljupkom društvu Lune, svoje pseće prijateljice. Tihi i Luna putuju od Učke do Baradina u potrazi za legendama i zmajevom bebom, u "Akademiji svega" slušaju kamene priče i jazz, kušaju piće starih druida, vrte se u čarobnim krugovima, te bježe glavom bez obzira od štriguna Jure Granda. Na svom mističnom putovanju obišli su i sablasni Dvigrad, bili su u ponoru koji je Dantea inspirirao za opis puta u pakao, odmarali se uz mliječnu rijeku i na kraju se spustili u spilju punu čarobnih likova.

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Bad point / Slaba točka
programme.desc: After months of planning, an unusual duo, safecracker Mike Daniels and failed architect Stephen Booker, prepare to steal a large amount of money and precious stones from the vaults of one of London's largest banks. Their plan is seemingly infallible. But the devil never sleeps. A sudden storm disrupts their plans... / Nakon višemjesečnog planiranja, neobičan dvojac, obijač sefova Mike Daniels i propali arhitekt Stephen Booker, sprema se ukrasti veliku količinu novca i dragog kamenja iz trezora jedne od najvećih londonskih banaka. Njihov je plan naizgled nepogrešiv. No vrag nikada ne spava. Iznenadna oluja poremeti im planove...

programme.title: Istarske freske
programme.desc: Na sačuvanim cjelovitim prikazima ili izvanrednim fragmentima očuvanih fresaka otkriva se višestoljetno kulturno-umjetničko stremljenje stanovnika oslikavanju prostora njihova boravka i kontemplacije. Stilovi, motivi i majstori različiti su od mjesta do mjesta.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Izvan formata
programme.desc: Otti Berger _ the forgotten Bauhaus artist from Baranja "I need to know that you haven't forgotten me!" _ these are the words to Otti Berger from the last letter sent by Isa Gropius on February 22, 1941, from her native Zmajevec in Baranja. Her colleagues from the famous Bauhaus art school did everything to get the talented and successful textile designer to the USA. However, at the very end of the war, in 1944, Otti Berger was taken from her birthplace to Auschwitz, where she was killed. Who was Otti Berger and why do we know so little about her? We try to answer that question in the show, whose thirty minutes are not enough to cover the life and work of the artist who was admired by Alvar Aalto, Marcel Breuer and Walter Gropius. Speaking in the show are Ph.D. Antonija Mlikota, author of the book about Otta Berger, and Darko Šimičić, who has been dedicatedly working to ensure that her name is not forgotten in recent years. We were also with the camera at Otti Berger's birthday in the Zagreb park named after her, where the artist and poet Vlado Martek presented the installation "Doubly present / Tribute to Otti". / Otti Berger _ zaboravljena Bauhaus umjetnica iz Baranje "Moram znati da me niste zaboravili!" _ riječi su to Otti Berger iz posljednjeg pisma koje je 22. veljače 1941. iz rodnog Zmajevca u Baranji poslala Isi Gropius. Njezini kolege iz glasovite umjetničke škole Bauhaus činili su sve kako bi talentirana i uspješna dizajnerica tekstila stigla u SAD. No, Otti Berger je u samom završetku rata, 1944. godine, odvedena iz rodne kuće u Auschwitz, gdje je ubijena. Tko je bila Otti Berger i zašto o njoj znamo tako malo? Na to pitanje pokušavamo odgovoriti u emisiji čijih trideset minuta nije dovoljno da obuhvati život i stvaralaštvo umjetnice kojoj su se divili Alvar Aalto, Marcel Breuer i Walter Gropius. U emisiji govore dr. sc. Antonija Mlikota, autorica knjige o Otti Berger, te Darko Šimičić, koji posljednjih godina predano radi na tome da se njezino ime ne zaboravi. S kamerom smo bili i na rođendanu Otti Berger u zagrebačkom parku koji nosi njezino ime, gdje je umjetnik i pjesnik Vlado Martek predstavio instalaciju "Dvostruko prisutna / Posveta Otti".

programme.title: Groznica
programme.desc: The episode explores the extreme nature of uranium, examining what makes this seemingly special resource so contradictory _ a source of incredible power, but also something out of a nightmare. We explore the unique chemical composition of this commodity and what gives it its fascinating properties. For medicine and energy, but also for warfare. From nuclear weapons in World War II and the subsequent bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki, to studies of the Chernobyl disaster and the Three Mile Island accident, we explore uranium's devastating history and its seemingly ever-changing controversial public image. From the role of nuclear energy in the fight against climate change to the continuous innovations that point to a renaissance of the resource, we will learn how uranium got its nickname "the ill-fated stone". / Epizoda istražuje ekstremnu prirodu uranija, ispitujući što taj naizgled ni po čemu poseban resurs čini toliko kontradiktornim _ izvorom nevjerojatne moći, ali i nečim iz noćne more. Istražujemo jedinstven kemijski sastav ove robe i ono što joj daje fascinantna svojstva. Za medicinu i energiju, ali i za ratovanje. Od nuklearnog oružja u Drugom svjetskom ratu te bombardiranja Hiroshime i Nagasakija koje je uslijedilo, do proučavanja katastrofe u Černobilu i nesreće u elektrani Three Mile Island, istražujemo razornu povijest uranija te njegov kontroverzan ugled u javnosti koji se naizgled neprestano mijenja. Od uloge nuklearne energije u borbi protiv klimatskih promjena do neprekidnih inovacija koje upućuju na renesansu resursa, saznat ćemo kako je uranij dobio svoj nadimak "zlosretni kamen".

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: In the middle of the Atlantic lies a green paradise - the Azores. Nine islands of volcanic origin between Europe and America. Fascinating plant and animal life above and in the sea. A green garden of paradise with an abundance of exotic flowers, a secret destination for travelers, which has so far managed to remain spared from mass tourism. Within that Portuguese archipelago rises the highest mountain in Portugal, the extinct volcano Pico. Some of the 1,700 volcanoes in the Azores are still active. The Azores' national dish, cozido, is cooked by local residents in the heat of the volcano, as in the past. The most beautiful cows on the Atlantic graze on the evergreen slopes of the cooled volcanoes, and there is also the only European tea plantation. The film crew went on an expedition to the Azores. / Usred Atlantika pritajio se zeleni raj _ Azori. Devet otoka vulkanskog podrijetla između Europe i Amerike. Fascinantan biljni i životinjski svijet iznad mora i u njemu. Zeleni rajski vrt s obiljem egzotičnog cvijeća, tajno odredište putnikâ, koje je zasad uspjelo ostati pošteđeno masovnog turizma. U sklopu tog portugalskog arhipelaga uzdiže se najviša planina Portugala, ugasli vulkan Pico. Neki od 1700 vulkana na Azorima još su aktivni. Azorsko nacionalno jelo cozido ovdašnji stanovnici kuhaju u vrelini vulkana, kao u prošlosti. Na zimzelenim obroncima ohlađenih vulkana pasu najljepše krave na Atlantiku, a tu je i jedina europska plantaža čaja. Filmska ekipa krenula je na Azore u ekspediciju.

programme.title: 50. Samobor musical autumn / 50. Samoborska glazbena jesen
programme.desc: The Samobor music autumn is a festival that has been promoting top musical art for five decades and turning Samobor into a musical center where classical music and the historical sights of the city are ideally combined. Over the years, the scope, quality and diversity of the program has developed the festival into an event whose content represents a cultural value of national importance. In front of the altar of the parish church of St. Anastasia, on September 26, 2025, in the festival's 50th jubilee year, the renowned Zagreb Soloists ensemble performed at the opening ceremony, and they were joined by one of the most internationally sought-after double bassists, Božo Paradžik, in top-level chamber music. The repertoire of the Zagreb soloists includes compositions from the baroque, classical and romantic periods, as well as works of the contemporary genre, and on this occasion they performed compositions by J.S. Bach, J. Brahms, F. Schubert, D. Pejačević, G. Puccini, A. Vivaldi and O. Respighi. / Samoborska glazbena jesen festival je koji već pet desetljeća promiče vrhunsku glazbenu umjetnost te pretvara Samobor u glazbeno središte u kojemu se idealno sjedinjuju klasična glazba i povijesne znamenitosti grada. Tijekom godina, festival se opsegom, kvalitetom i raznolikošću programa razvio u manifestaciju koja svojim sadržajem predstavlja kulturnu vrijednost od nacionalnoga značaja. Pred oltarom župne crkve sv. Anastazije, 26. rujna 2025., u jubilarnoj 50. festivalskoj godini, na svečanom otvorenju nastupili su renomirani ansambl Zagrebački solisti, a u vrhunskoj razini komornog muziciranja pridružio im se jedan od međunarodno najtraženijih kontrabasista Božo Paradžik. Repertoar Zagrebačkih solista obuhvaća skladbe baroknog, klasičnog i romantičnog razdoblja, ali i djela suvremenog žanra, a tom prigodom izveli su skladbe J. S. Bacha, J. Brahmsa, F. Schuberta, D. Pejačević, G. Puccinija, A. Vivaldija i O. Respighija.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: The guest of Razgovor with a reason is the director of the Zagreb Youth Theater Snježana Abramović Milković. We talk about the role played by boards that mean life in society. Should provocation and criticism be avoided or encouraged in the theater? Why is it important for the theater to be brave, to be a space of freedom and truth? Why does it have to question social movements and political power? Why should you feel for a person? Can we purify traumas and unresolved relationships through theater? Why is international cooperation important to ZKM? From drama to dance, from provocation to artistic freedom, there are many reasons to talk to Snježana Abramović Milković. / Gošća Razgovora s razlogom je ravnateljica Zagrebačkog kazališta mladih Snježana Abramović Milković. Razgovaramo o ulozi koju u društvu igraju daske koje život znače. Treba li u kazalištu izbjegavati provokaciju i kritiku ili ih poticati? Zašto je važno da kazalište bude hrabro, da bude prostor slobode i istine? Zašto mora preispitivati društvena kretanja i političku moć? Zašto treba imati osjećaj za čovjeka? Možemo li kroz kazalište pročistiti traume i neriješene odnose? Zašto je ZKM-u važna međunarodna suradnja? Od drame do plesa od provokacije do umjetničke slobode, mnogo je razloga za razgovor sa Snježanom Abramović Milković.

programme.title: Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: Every week, passionate readers, critics and theorists discuss one title that is currently being read in Croatia. / Svaki tjedan strastveni čitatelji, kritičari i teoretičari razgovaraju o jednom naslovu koji se trenutačno čita u Hrvatskoj.

programme.title: Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: Readers' club _ Supplementary teaching / Klub čitatelja _ Dopunska nastava

programme.title: Put
programme.desc: Doctor Thomas Avery (M. Sheen) comes from California to France because his son Daniel (E. Estevez) was killed in a storm in the Pyrenees on a pilgrimage. Overwhelmed by grief, Thomas decides to go on a pilgrimage on behalf of his son and reach Santiago de Compostela, where he will spread Daniel's ashes. Like many pilgrims before him, he set off on foot on the Way of Saint James. He met people from all over the world in search of the meaning of his life, and was joined by Dutchman Joost (Y. van Wageningen), Canadian Sarah (D. Kara Unger) and Irishman Jack (J. Nesbitt). Pilgrimage changes them... / Liječnik Thomas Avery (M. Sheen) dolazi iz Kalifornije u Francusku jer mu je u oluji u Pirenejima na hodočašću stradao sin Daniel (E. Estevez). Shrvan tugom, Thomas odluči u ime svojega sina krenuti na hodočašće i stići do Santiaga de Compostele gdje će prosuti Danielov pepeo. Kao i mnogi hodočasnici prije njega, krenuo je pješice na Put svetog Jakova. Susreo je ljude sa svih strana svijeta u potrazi za smislom svog života, a pridružili su mu se Nizozemac Joost (Y. van Wageningen), Kanađanka Sarah (D. Kara Unger) i Irac Jack (J. Nesbitt). Hodačašće ih mijenja...

programme.title: Simpsoni
programme.desc: After Bart befriends a famous young influencer who has his own brand of sportswear, Homer and other disreputable dads rebel. / Nakon što se Bart sprijatelji s poznatim mladim influencerom koji ima vlastitu marku sportske odjeće, u Homeru i drugim neuglednim tatama probudi se bunt.

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Bad point / Slaba točka
programme.desc: After months of planning, an unusual duo, safecracker Mike Daniels and failed architect Stephen Booker, prepare to steal a large amount of money and precious stones from the vaults of one of London's largest banks. Their plan is seemingly infallible. But the devil never sleeps. A sudden storm disrupts their plans... / Nakon višemjesečnog planiranja, neobičan dvojac, obijač sefova Mike Daniels i propali arhitekt Stephen Booker, sprema se ukrasti veliku količinu novca i dragog kamenja iz trezora jedne od najvećih londonskih banaka. Njihov je plan naizgled nepogrešiv. No vrag nikada ne spava. Iznenadna oluja poremeti im planove...

programme.title: 50. Samobor musical autumn / 50. Samoborska glazbena jesen

Bach, J. Brahms, F. Schubert, D. Pejačević, G. Puccini, A. Vivaldi and O. Shrvan tugom, Thomas odluči u ime svojega sina krenuti na hodočašće i stići do Santiaga de Compostele gdje će prosuti Danielov pepeo. Hodačašće ih mijenja...

programme.title: Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: The passenger steamer Baron Gautsch is the true Titanic of the Adriatic. Baron Gautsch, the pride of Austrian Lloyd, which in 1914, due to the incomprehensible carelessness of the ship's command, ran into an Austro-Hungarian minefield, was the first maritime casualty of the First World War in the Adriatic. In the tragedy that took place in calm and beautiful weather, 177 passengers died, mostly family members of Austro-Hungarian officers who were on vacation in Dalmatia. Most of them were women and children. Those responsible for the sinking of the Baron Gautsch were never punished, and all documentation about the investigation was lost in World War II. The wreck of that beautiful steamship still lies on the seabed not far from Rovinj as a memorial to the ancient maritime tragedy and the innocent victims who disappeared forever in the depths of the Adriatic. / Putnički parobrod Baron Gautsch pravi je jadranski Titanic. Baron Gautsch, ponos Austrijskog Lloyda koji je 1914., neshvatljivom neopreznošću zapovjedništva broda naletio na austro-ugarsko minsko polje, prva je pomorska žrtva 1. svjetskog rata na Jadranu. U tragediji koja se odigrala po mirnom i lijepom vremenu poginulo je 177 putnika, mahom članova obitelji austro-ugarskih časnika koje su bile na odmoru u Dalmaciji. Među njima najviše je bilo žena i djece. Krivci za potonuće Barona Gautscha nikada nisu kažnjeni, a sva dokumentacija o istrazi propala je u 2. svjetskom ratu. Olupina toga lijepog parobroda i danas leži na morskome dnu nedaleko od Rovinja kao spomen na davnu pomorsku tragediju i nevine žrtve koje su zauvijek nestale u dubinama Jadrana.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: The show shows how the standard language was created, why the official language in the Republic of Croatia is called the Croatian standard language, whether standard is the same as literary language, and which of our linguists dealt with the theory of standards. / Emisija pokazuje kako je došlo do stvaranja standardnog jezika, zašto se službeni jezik u Republici Hrvatskoj zove hrvatski standardni jezik, je li standardni isto što i književni jezik te koji su se naši jezikoslovci bavili teorijom standarda.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The Canadian children's animated series Dogs on Patrol was created by Keith Chapman. The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of a team of search and rescue dogs called Patrol Dogs. The team goes on missions together to protect the coastal community of Adventure Bay. / Kanadska animirana serija za djecu Psići u ophodnji je nastala prema kreaciji Keitha Chapmana. Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: The class was assigned the task of making useful things from waste, so Timmy decides to turn a cereal box into a tractor. / Razred je za zadatak dobio izradu korisnih stvari od otpada, pa Timmy kutiju žitarica odlučuje pretvoriti u traktor.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game also await you! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. Music, lyrics, performance: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Series authors: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Editor: Sanja Nakić / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić

programme.title: Volim životinje
programme.desc: Dokumentarno-animirana serija upoznaje najmlađe sa životinjskim vrstama.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu declines the snack, which turns out to be tastier than she thought. / Lu odbije zakusku koja ispadne finija nego što je mislila.

programme.title: Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of curious little ones left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: In search of his favorite squeaky button, Muc jumps into the boot, but he can't get out! Help is coming to Tweed! / U potrazi za najdražim fijukavim gumbom Muc uskoči u čizmu, ali više odande ne može izaći! Tvidi stiže upomoć!

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: He is beautifully sad because he injured two of his arms in a drumming accident. Wanting to cheer him up and surprise him, Štefi asks Brojčić to look for instruments that Ljepko can play with the remaining six arms. / Ljepko je tužan jer je ozlijedio dva kraka u bubnjarskoj nezgodi. Želeći ga oraspoložiti i iznenaditi, Štefi zamoli Brojčiće da potraže instrumente koje Ljepko može svirati s preostalih šest krakova.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: Naughty Dog wants the Love Monster to teach him how to play music, but he is a very disobedient student. / Nestašni Psić želi da ga Ljubavno Čudovište nauči puštati glazbu, ali vrlo je neposlušan učenik.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Police chief Berko has his hands full trying to stop the rascals Zip and Pop who are making a lot of noise in Zanatograd. / Šef policije Berko ima pune ruke posla pokušavajući zaustaviti nevaljalce Zipa i Popa koji neobuzdano prave buku u Zanatogradu.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: The Dinoranchers organize the Dinofriends Competition, a series of games where the Dinoranchers and their dinosaurs prove how well they fit together as a team. The prize is a big shiny goblet full of juicy berry beans, watched from nearby bushes by Wicked Sonny, who wants to steal the goblet, while his stealthy raptor Bero wants the fruits. The two rogues decide to join forces and enter the competition, with Sonny cheating every game to advance to the next round. Jon and Blitz suspect that Sonny isn't playing fair, but they can't prove it until the final race between him and Jon. Sonny then tries to cheat by clinging to Bera's saddle, but when he freaks out and runs straight into danger, Sonny loses control! Despite his cheating, Jon and the Dinoranchers bravely come to his and Bera's aid, and this act of kindness prompts Sonny to accept defeat and admit to Jon that he cheated. / Dinorančeri organiziraju natjecanje dinoprijatelja, niz igara u kojima Dinorančeri i njihovi dinosauri dokazuju koliko su usklađeni kao tim. Nagrada je veliki sjajni pehar pun sočnih boba zoba, a iz obližnjih grmova sve to promatra Opaki Sonny, koji želi ukrasti pehar, dok njegov kradljivi raptor Bero želi plodove. Dvojica nevaljalaca odluče udružiti snage i prijaviti se na natjecanje, a Sonny u svakoj igri vara kako bi prošao u sljedeći krug. Jon i Blitz posumnjaju da Sonny ne igra pošteno, ali to ne mogu dokazati sve do posljednje utrke između njega i Jona. Sonny tada pokuša varati tako što se zalijepi za Berino sedlo, no kad se on prepadne i jurne ravno u opasnost, Sonny gubi kontrolu! Unatoč njegovu varanju, Jon i Dinorančeri hrabro priskoče njemu i Beri u pomoć, a taj čin dobrote potakne Sonnyja da prihvati poraz i prizna Jonu da je varao.

programme.title: Consumer code / Potrošački kod
programme.desc: We are talking about the rise of online fraud. In a year's time, a law is due to come into force that requires online sellers to introduce a so-called cancel button — a simple tool that will allow consumers to cancel online purchases with two clicks. The goal is to prevent pressure on customers. Citizens are offered allegedly lucrative investments or prizes, branded goods at special discounts, mobile phones, technical equipment and even excavators via e-mail and social networks. The theft of personal information or money from bank accounts is often hidden behind such offers. Fraudsters have become more and more convincing — so the question arises: how not to fall into their traps? / Govorimo o porastu internetskih prijevara. Za godinu dana na snagu bi trebao stupiti zakon koji internetskim prodavateljima nameće uvođenje takozvanog gumba za otkazivanje — jednostavnog alata kojim će potrošači s dva klika moći odustati od online kupnje. Cilj je spriječiti pritisak na kupce.Građanima se putem e-pošte i društvenih mreža nude navodno unosna ulaganja ili nagrade, brendirana roba po posebnim sniženjima, mobiteli, tehnička oprema pa čak i bageri. Iza takvih ponuda često se kriju krađa osobnih podataka ili novca s bankovnih računa. Prevaranti su postali sve uvjerljiviji — pa se postavlja pitanje: kako ne upasti u njihove zamke?

programme.title: Talenti EU regija
programme.desc: How do European Union member regions respond to demographic challenges? How to stop emigration and how to reward the creativity of talents? Answers to questions about the increasingly pronounced problem of brain drain and growing differences in development are provided by the show "Talents of the EU Region". In 26 short stories of Television Slovenia, examples of good practices from 11 European countries are presented. The project "Talents of the EU region" shows the results of the cohesion policy of the European Union _ one of the key pillars of European development. / Kako regije članica Europske unije odgovaraju na demografske izazove? Kako zaustaviti emigraciju i kako nagraditi kreativnost talenata? Odgovore na pitanja o sve izraženijem problemu odljeva mozgova i rastućim razlikama u razvijenosti donosi emisija "Talenti EU regija". U 26 kratkih priča Televizije Slovenije predstavljaju se primjeri dobrih praksi iz 11 europskih zemalja. Projekt "Talenti EU regija" prikazuje rezultate kohezijske politike Europske unije _ jednog od ključnih stupova europskog razvoja.

programme.title: Romano Bolković - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: Blaine Leslie Reininger (born 1953 in Pueblo, Colorado) is an American post-punk and new-wave musician, multi-instrumentalist, composer and author, best known as the co-founder of the avant-garde band Tuxedomoon. Since 1977, he has been active as a solo artist and collaborator of numerous musicians, including Durutti Column, Snakefinger, Anna Domino and Savage Republic. His work combines American underground and European avant-garde, and he is recognized as one of the key innovators of the post-rock and art-rock scene. After studying music in San Francisco, Reininger formed Tuxedomoon with Steven Brown, with whom he recorded the cult albums Half Mute, Desire and Suite en Sous-Sol. Since 1983, he has developed a rich solo career (Broken Fingers, Night Air, Byzantium), composing music for theater and film. Today he lives in Athens, where he continues to work as a performer and composer. In our conversation with Reininger, we return to San Francisco in the seventies, to Brussels in the eighties and to Europe, which for him became a space of freedom and research. He talks about the emergence of Tuxedomoon's hybrid sound, about collaborations with Maurice Bejart, Wim Wenders and Crammed Disco, and about the constant need to think music outside the market. We also talk about his working methods _ a combination of control and chaos, intuition and structure _ and about the topic of lucid dreaming, silence and space in music. Reininger reflects on contemporary art, technology and artificial intelligence, and the possibility of authentic experimentation in the digital age. / Blaine Leslie Reininger (rođen 1953. u Pueblu, Colorado) američki je post-punk i new-wave glazbenik, multiinstrumentalist, skladatelj i autor, najpoznatiji kao suosnivač avangardnog benda Tuxedomoon. Od 1977. aktivan je i kao solo umjetnik te suradnik brojnih glazbenika, među kojima su Durutti Column, Snakefinger, Anna Domino i Savage Republic. Njegov rad spaja američki underground i europsku avangardu, a prepoznat je kao jedan od ključnih inovatora post-rock i art-rock scene.Nakon studija glazbe u San Franciscu, Reininger s Stevenom Brownom formira Tuxedomoon, s kojim snima kultne albume Half Mute, Desire i Suite en Sous-Sol. Od 1983. razvija i bogatu solo karijeru (Broken Fingers, Night Air, Byzantium), skladajući i glazbu za kazalište i film. Danas živi u Ateni, gdje nastavlja djelovati kao izvođač i skladatelj.U razgovoru s Reiningerom vraćamo se u San Francisco sedamdesetih, u Bruxelles osamdesetih i u Europu koja je za njega postala prostor slobode i istraživanja. Govori o nastanku hibridnog zvuka Tuxedomoona, o suradnjama s Mauriceom Bejartom, Wimom Wendersom i Crammed Discom, te o trajnoj potrebi da glazbu misli izvan granica tržišta.Razgovaramo i o njegovim metodama rada _ spoju kontrole i kaosa, intuicije i strukture _ te o temi lucidnog sanjanja, tišine i prostora u glazbi. Reininger promišlja i suvremenu umjetnost, tehnologiju i umjetnu inteligenciju, te mogućnost autentičnog eksperimenta u digitalnom dobu.

programme.title: Nedjeljom u dva
programme.desc: Why do we kill animals and could we survive as a species without meat? Is a diet without meat healthy and does it contribute to the preservation of the environment _ are just some of the questions that will be discussed in the show "Sunday at 2", whose guest is the president of the Animal Friends Association, Luka Oman. / Zašto ubijamo životinje i bismo li kao vrsta mogli opstati bez mesa? programme.title: Manjinski mozaik
programme.desc: In the city on four rivers, he found his way of life. Born in Karlovac with Czech roots, Dinko Neskusil observes the world through the lens of a camera. He took his first steps with his father, appearing in Karlovac weeklies, but also on the front line, documenting the devastating attacks on the city. His war photographs make up most of the display of the Museum of the Homeland War in Turnje. "It didn't happen again," says Dinko, who still takes photographs with the same passion today. He knows very well that a picture is worth a thousand words. Sound master: Boris Harmić Lighting master: Darko Višek / U gradu na četiri rijeke pronašao je svoj životni tok. Rođeni Karlovčanin čeških korijena, Dinko Neskusil, svijet promatra kroz objektiv fotoaparata. Prve je korake napravio uz oca, stasao u karlovačkim tjednicima, ali i na prvoj liniji fronte, dokumentirajući razorne napade na grad. Njegove ratne fotografije čine većinu postava Muzeja Domovinskog rata na Turnju. "Ne ponovilo se", kaže Dinko, koji i danas fotografira s jednakom strašću. Dobro zna da slika govori više od tisuću riječi. Ton-majstor: Boris Harmić Majstor rasvjete: Darko Višek

programme.title: View across the border - Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina / Pogled preko granice - Hrvati u BiH
programme.desc: After the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina adopted the Reform Agenda, a key document derived from the Growth Plan for the Western Balkans, Ursula von der Leyen visited Bosnia and Herzegovina. From Sunday, the European Union applies a new system for controlling the entry and exit of citizens from outside the EU, the so-called EES, which replaces the traditional use of passports with digital recording of biometric data, such as fingerprints and facial images. The goal is more effective border control, the fight against illegal migration and the monitoring of the stay of foreigners in the Schengen area. The Government of the Republic of Croatia continues to financially support projects for the return of Croats and the creation of sustainable living conditions in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The ceremonial awarding of the financial support contract for this year was held in Orašje. In Odžak, the foundation stone for the construction of the sports hall of the Vladimir Nazor Elementary School, worth one million and 410 thousand convertible marks, was laid, and the funds for the first phase were provided by the counties of Posavina and Osijek-Baranja and the Government of the Republic of Croatia. The beginning of the construction of the expressway Mostar - Polog - Široki Brijeg - the border of the Republic of Croatia was officially marked by the signing of the contract. Good transport connections will help the development of the economy, including agriculture, while Herzegovinian olive growers show how to invest in modernization and new technologies. Collaborating high school from neighboring states, specifically Osijek III. gymnasium and general gymnasium of the Catholic school center "Blaženi Ivan Merz" from Banja Luka, shown in a report by Predrag Solomun. The Osmica Memorial Park recalls the death of eight children in Lašvanska dolina in 1993. They died as a result of a mortar shell explosion on a children's playground in the suburb of Viteška. Thanks to the persistence of the families of the surviving children, the playground became a memorial with a strong anti-war message _ not to be forgotten and never to happen again. The 26th Mediterranean Film Festival ended in Široki Brijeg. In the competition of 19 documentaries, the Grand Prix of the festival was won by the film "Together Forever" by director Anastasya Miroshnichenko, while the award for the best short film was won by "Knives" by Croatian director Ivan Mokrović. / Nakon što je Vijeće ministara BiH donijelo Reformsku agendu, ključni dokument proizašao iz Plana rasta za zapadni Balkan, Ursula von der Leyen posjetila je BiH. Europska unija od nedjelje primjenjuje novi sustav za kontrolu ulaska i izlaska građana izvan EU-a, tzv. EES, koji zamjenjuje tradicionalnu uporabu putovnica digitalnim snimanjem biometrijskih podataka, poput otiska prstiju i slike lica. Cilj je učinkovitija kontrola granica, borba protiv nezakonitih migracija i praćenje boravka stranaca u schengenskom prostoru. Vlada Republike Hrvatske nastavlja financijski poticati projekte povratka Hrvata i stvaranje održivih uvjeta života u BiH. Svečana dodjela ugovora o financijskoj potpori za ovu godinu održana je u Orašju. U Odžaku je položen kamen temeljac za izgradnju sportske dvorane Osnovne škole Vladimira Nazora, vrijedne milijun i 410 tisuća konvertibilnih maraka, a sredstva za prvu fazu osigurale su posavska i osječko-baranjska županija te Vlada Republike Hrvatske. Početak izgradnje brze ceste Mostar _ Polog _ Široki Brijeg _ granica RH službeno je označen potpisivanjem ugovora. Dobra prometna povezanost pomoći će razvoju gospodarstva, uključujući poljoprivredu, dok hercegovački maslinari pokazuju kako se ulagati u modernizaciju i nove tehnologije. Suradnja gimnazija iz susjednih država, konkretno osječke III. gimnazije i Opće gimnazije Katoličkoga školskog centra "Blaženi Ivan Merz" iz Banje Luke, prikazana je u reportaži Predraga Solomuna. Spomen-park Osmica podsjeća na stradanje osmero djece u Lašvanskoj dolini 1993. Poginula su od posljedica eksplozije minobacačke granate na dječjem igralištu u viteškom prigradskom naselju. Zahvaljujući upornosti obitelji preživjele djece, igralište je postalo spomen-obilježje s snažnom antiratnom porukom _ da se ne zaboravi i da se nikada više ne dogodi. U Širokom Brijegu završen je 26. Mediteran film festival. U konkurenciji 19 dokumentaraca, Grand Prix festivala osvojio je film "Zauvijek zajedno" redateljice Anastasye Miroshnichenko, dok je nagradu za najbolji kratkometražni film osvojio "Nožarije" hrvatskog redatelja Ivana Mokrovića.
