programme.title: Romano Bolković - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: We talk with the rector of the University of Zagreb, Stjepan Lakušić, about the key challenges and opportunities that shape the future of the most important higher education institution in Croatia. We will touch on the topic of adapting study programs to the labor market and the needs of the modern economy, as well as the importance of internationalization of education by attracting top foreign students and researchers. We will discuss investments in scientific research, finding new sources of funding, and ways in which the University can strengthen technology transfer and encourage innovations that will bring social and economic benefit. We will pay special attention to the University's role in strengthening Croatia's competitiveness in global challenges, such as climate change, digitization and cyber security. The Rector will talk to us about the importance of an interdisciplinary approach to research and education, as well as strategies for preserving academic freedom, institutional autonomy and transparency in management. We will also discuss the promotion of gender equality, inclusion and support for young scientists to stay and develop in Croatia. Finally, we will touch on the topics of digital transformation of the University, the development of critical and creative thinking among students, as well as the importance of increasing social trust in the academic community. Join us in a conversation about how the University of Zagreb can and wants to be the driver of scientific, technological and social progress in Croatia. Prof. Ph.D. Stjepan Lakušić, former dean of the Faculty of Civil Engineering, took up the position of rector of the University of Zagreb on October 1, 2022. The mandate of the new rector lasts four years, ie until September 30, 2026. Prof. Ph.D. Stjepan Lakušić was born in 1968 in Slavonski Brod. He graduated in 1994 from the Faculty of Civil Engineering at the University of Zagreb, where he was then employed as an assistant _ researcher in the Institute of Roads. In 1998, he completed his master's degree at that faculty, and in 2003, he obtained the academic degree of doctor of science. In November 2017, he was elected to the scientific-teaching position of full-time professor in the field of technical sciences, the scientific field of construction, the scientific branch of transport. Professor Lakušić has been teaching at the Faculty of Civil Engineering at the University of Zagreb since year 1995/1996, and at the postgraduate studies of that Faculty, he has been teaching since year 2004/2005 He was a guest teacher at the Faculty of Civil Engineering at the University of Rijeka and Skopje. Before his term as rector, he held the positions of vice dean and dean of the Faculty of Civil Engineering at the University of Zagreb. Scientific work of prof. Ph.D. Stjepan Lakušić is focused on the field of railways, especially on the research of tram and railway track constructions, the dynamic impact of vehicles on the track, noise and vibrations on the tracks, and the elements of attaching the rail to the base. Professor Lakušić has published as an author or co-author 26 scientific papers in international and domestic journals, 120 papers in proceedings of international and domestic scientific conferences, and 35 book chapters. He participated in numerous international and domestic scientific meetings, was the editor of 13 books and is the editor-in-chief of the magazine Građevinar. In addition, prof. Ph.D. Stjepan Lakušić initiated several international and domestic scientific and scientific-professional conferences and events. His international scientific project Rubberised concrete noise barriers _ RUCONBAR and the innovative product created within that project _ absorbent concrete barriers for noise protection with recycled rubber ‒ RUCONBAR, have been awarded with several international and domestic awards in Belgium, Croatia, the Netherlands, the USA and Switzerland. Professor Lakušić is a member of several professional organizations and a member of the general assembly of the International Association FEHRL (Forum of European National Highway Research Laboratories). He led several domestic and international projects, and was especially involved in the professional affairs of the Department of Railways at the Faculty of Civil Engineering. After the earthquake in the city of Zagreb, he led the preparation of important documents for the Government of the Republic of Croatia, initiated the establishment of the Croatian Center for Earthquake Engineering (HCPI) as a branch of the Faculty of Civil Engineering, and is a member of the Croatian Expert Council for Post-Earthquake Reconstruction. / S rektorom Sveučilišta u Zagrebu Stjepanom Lakušićem razgovaramo o ključnim izazovima i prilikama koje oblikuju budućnost najvažnije visokoobrazovne institucije u Hrvatskoj. Dotaknut ćemo se tema prilagodbe studijskih programa tržištu rada i potrebama modernog gospodarstva, kao i važnosti internacionalizacije obrazovanja privlačenjem vrhunskih stranih studenata i istraživača. Razgovarat ćemo o ulaganjima u znanstvena istraživanja, pronalaženju novih izvora financiranja te o načinima na koje Sveučilište može osnažiti transfer tehnologije i potaknuti inovacije koje će donijeti društvenu i gospodarsku korist. Posebnu pozornost posvetit ćemo ulozi Sveučilišta u jačanju konkurentnosti Hrvatske u globalnim izazovima, kao što su klimatske promjene, digitalizacija i kibernetička sigurnost. Rektor će nam govoriti o važnosti interdisciplinarnog pristupa istraživanjima i obrazovanju, kao i o strategijama za očuvanje akademske slobode, institucionalne autonomije i transparentnosti u upravljanju. Razgovarat ćemo i o poticanju rodne ravnopravnosti, inkluzije te podršci mladim znanstvenicima da ostanu i razvijaju se u Hrvatskoj. Na kraju, dotaknut ćemo se tema digitalne transformacije Sveučilišta, razvoja kritičkog i kreativnog mišljenja kod studenata, kao i važnosti povećanja društvenog povjerenja u akademsku zajednicu. Pridružite nam se u razgovoru o tome kako Sveučilište u Zagrebu može i želi biti pokretač znanstvenog, tehnološkog i društvenog napretka u Hrvatskoj. Prof. dr. sc. Stjepan Lakušić, nekadašnji dekan Građevinskoga fakulteta, stupio je 1. listopada 2022. na dužnost rektora Sveučilišta u Zagrebu. Mandat novoga rektora traje četiri godine, odnosno do 30. rujna 2026. Prof. dr. sc. Stjepan Lakušić rođen je 1968. u Slavonskom Brodu. Diplomirao je 1994. na Građevinskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Zagrebu, gdje je potom zaposlen kao asistent _ znanstveni novak u Zavodu za prometnice. Na tom je fakultetu 1998. završio i magisterij znanosti, a 2003. stekao akademski stupanj doktora znanosti. U studenome 2017. izabran je u znanstveno-nastavno zvanje redovitoga profesora u trajnom zvanju u području tehničkih znanosti, znanstvenom polju građevinarstvo, znanstvenoj grani prometnice. Profesor Lakušić nastavu na Građevinskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Zagrebu izvodi od ak. god. 1995./1996., a na poslijediplomskom studiju toga Fakulteta predaje od ak. god. 2004./2005. Bio je gostujući nastavnik na Građevinskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Rijeci te u Skoplju. Prije rektorskoga mandata obnašao je dužnosti prodekana i dekana Građevinskoga fakulteta Sveučilišta u Zagrebu. Znanstveni rad prof. dr. sc. Stjepana Lakušića usmjeren je na područje željeznica, posebice na istraživanje konstrukcija tramvajskoga i željezničkoga kolosijeka, dinamičkoga utjecaja vozila na kolosijek, buke i vibracija na kolosijecima te elemenata pričvršćenja tračnice na podlogu. Profesor Lakušić objavio je kao autor ili koautor 26 znanstvenih radova u međunarodnim i domaćim časopisima, 120 radova u zbornicima međunarodnih i domaćih znanstvenih skupova te 35 poglavlja u knjigama. Sudjelovao je na brojnim međunarodnim i domaćim znanstvenim skupovima, bio je urednik 13 knjiga te je glavni urednik časopisa Građevinar. Uz to, prof. dr. sc. Stjepan Lakušić pokrenuo je nekoliko međunarodnih i domaćih znanstvenih i znanstveno-stručnih konferencija i događaja. Njegov međunarodni znanstveni projekt Rubberised concrete noise barriers _ RUCONBAR i inovativni proizvod koji je nastao u okviru toga projekta _ apsorbirajuće betonske barijere za zaštitu od buke s recikliranom gumom ‒ RUCONBAR, nagrađeni su s više međunarodnih i domaćih nagrada u Belgiji, Hrvatskoj, Nizozemskoj, SAD-u i Švicarskoj. Profesor Lakušić član je više strukovnih organizacija te član glavne skupštine Međunarodnoga udruženja FEHRL (Forum of European National Highway Research Laboratories). Vodio je više domaćih i međunarodnih projekata, a posebno je uključen i u stručne poslove Katedre za željeznice Građevinskoga fakulteta. Nakon potresa u gradu Zagrebu vodio je izradu važnih dokumenata za Vladu Republike Hrvatske, pokrenuo je osnivanje Hrvatskoga centra za potresno inženjerstvo (HCPI) kao podružnice Građevinskog fakulteta te je član Stručnoga savjeta RH za obnovu nakon potresa.

programme.title: Manjinski mozaik
programme.desc: In the city on four rivers, he found his way of life. Born in Karlovac with Czech roots, Dinko Neskusil observes the world through the lens of a camera. He took his first steps with his father, appearing in Karlovac weeklies, but also on the front line, documenting the devastating attacks on the city. His war photographs make up most of the display of the Museum of the Homeland War in Turnje. "It didn't happen again," says Dinko, who still takes photographs with the same passion today. He knows very well that a picture is worth a thousand words. Sound master: Boris Harmić Lighting master: Darko Višek / U gradu na četiri rijeke pronašao je svoj životni tok. Rođeni Karlovčanin čeških korijena, Dinko Neskusil, svijet promatra kroz objektiv fotoaparata. Prve je korake napravio uz oca, stasao u karlovačkim tjednicima, ali i na prvoj liniji fronte, dokumentirajući razorne napade na grad. Njegove ratne fotografije čine većinu postava Muzeja Domovinskog rata na Turnju. "Ne ponovilo se", kaže Dinko, koji i danas fotografira s jednakom strašću. Dobro zna da slika govori više od tisuću riječi. Ton-majstor: Boris Harmić Majstor rasvjete: Darko Višek

programme.title: Arena sport / Арена спорт
programme.desc: The analytical and informative sports show "Arena Sport" will take viewers beyond pure sports news, expanding and enriching it not only with a picture, but also with the first comments and reactions to what is happening. / Аналитично-информационното спортно предаване "Арена Спорт" ще отведе зрителите отвъд чистите новини в спорта, като ги разшири и обогати не само с картина, но и с първите коментари и реакции на случващото се.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Chavdar Tsvetkov / Зала на славата: Чавдар Цветков
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a column in which we present the most famous faces from the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, who with their successes over the years have delighted sports lovers in our country. In the "Hall of Fame" they talk about themselves - about the successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about the sport that plays a huge role in life and about life after sport. Thanks to the rich archive of the Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the greatest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sports. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Sports news / Спортни новини
programme.desc: Sports news from Bulgaria and the world. / Спортни новини от България и света.

programme.title: Volleyball: Demax League: Maritsa - Levski Sofia / Волейбол: Демакс Лига: Марица - Левски София

programme.title: Slevin's luck / Късметът на Слевин
programme.desc: Slevin is at the bottom of bad luck - he loses his job, his girlfriend cheats and immediately after his arrival in New York he is "attacked". His good friend Nick is missing from his apartment so Slevin feels at home enough to take his place in the scheme he knows nothing about. Nick is indebted to two of the most powerful crime bosses - Shefa and Ravina, who mistakenly discover Slevin. With no explanation available, he must pay off Nick's debts with a 30,000 murder, liquidating one's son in revenge at the behest of the other. Helping the "lucky one" is the amorous neighbor Lindsay - an assistant in the morgue who wants to be a detective, on his trail is inspector Brikovski, who wants to reach the "top", while the mysterious killer Goodcat moves the strings "down" in the underworld... / Слевин е на дъното на лошия късмет - губи работата си, приятелката му изневерява и веднага след пристигането му в Ню Йорк е "нападнат". Добрият му приятел Ник липсва в апартамента си така, че Слевин да се почувства у дома си толкова, че да заеме мястото му в схемата, за която нищо не знае. Ник е длъжник на двама от най-могъщите криминални босове - Шефа и Равина, които погрешно откриват Слевин. Без възможност за обяснения, той трябва да изплати дълговете на Ник с убийство за 30 000, ликвидирайки за отмъщение сина на единия по поръчка на другия. В помощ на "късметлията" е влюбената съседка Линдзи - асистентка в моргата, която иска да бъде детектив, по следите му е инспектор Бриковски, който иска да стигне "върха", докато тайнственият килър Гудкет размества конците "долу" в подземния свят...

programme.title: Football: First League Telemach: Bravo - Primorje / Nogomet: Prva liga Telemach: Bravo - Primorje
programme.desc: While Bravaši scored a point against Mura before the national team break, Ajdovci were looking forward to all three in the coastal derby with Koper. The sons of Burje also openly come to Stožice for positive... / Medtem ko so Bravaši pred reprezentančnim premorom vpisali točko proti Muri, so se Ajdovci veselili vseh treh na primorskem derbiju s Koprom. Sinovi burje tudi v Stožice odkrito prihajajo po pozitiven...

programme.title: Handball - Slovenian league: Škofja Loka - Slovenj Gradec / Rokomet - Slovenska liga: Škofja Loka - Slovenj Gradec
programme.desc: The Slovenian Handball Association has been in existence since 1949. In 1991, the First Slovenian Handball League was founded, in which the most successful handball players from Celje are with more than twenty championship titles. / Slovenska rokometna zveza obstaja še od leta 1949. 1991. leta je osnovana Prva slovenska rokometna liga, v kateri so najuspešnejši rokometaši Celja z več kot dvajsetimi naslovi prvaka.

programme.title: Football - Turkish League: Fenerbahce - Fatih Karagumruk / Nogomet - Turška liga: Fenerbahce - Fatih Karagumruk
programme.desc: The Turkish Football League, better known as the Super Lig, is the highest rank of Turkish football and at the same time the most popular sports competition in the entire country. 18 teams are competing for the title, most of... / Turška nogometna liga bolj poznana pod imenom Super Lig je najvišji rang turškega nogometa in hkrati najpopularnejše športno tekmovanje v celotni državi. programme.title: Tennis - WTA 500 Tokio / Tenis - WTA 500 Tokio
programme.desc: This time, the women's tennis caravan is traveling to Tokyo, where tennis players will compete on the hard court in the WTA 500 tournament, whose beginnings date back to 1976. / Ženska teniška karavana tokrat potuje v Tokio, kjer se bodo tenisačice pomerile na trdi podlagi na turnirju WTA 500, čigar začetki segajo v leto 1976.

programme.title: CASH OR TRESH / KEŠ ILI TREŠ
Osinje gnijezdo
programme.desc: Rene González (Édgar Ramírez) is a Cuban pilot who leaves his wife (Penelope Cruz) and their young daughter to defect to America in the early 1990s. In Miami, he starts a new life and uses his piloting skills to help the large number of Cubans who have fled the island by ship due to the effects of the Cuban economic collapse. / Rene González (Édgar Ramírez) kubanski je pilot koji ostavlja svoju suprugu (Penelope Cruz) i njihovu mladu kćerku kako bi prebjegao u Ameriku početkom 90-ih godina prošlog stoljeća. U Miamiju, on započinje novi život i koristi svoje pilotske vještine kako bi pomogao velikom broju Kubanaca koji su brodovima pobjegli s otoka zbog posljedica kubanskog ekonomskog kolapsa.

programme.title: Asher
programme.desc: Asher is a contract killer who has spent the better part of his life taking the lives of others, taking orders from Avi. He lives a solitary life, enjoying wine and good food, angering his apprentice Uzi, who takes over his jobs because he is younger. When Ava gives Asher 3 more revenge kills, he makes casual contact with Sophie, the ballet teacher, but can't reveal anything about his life to her. Asher is forced to team up with Uzi, but when the job goes wrong, Asher soon becomes the hunted, and death becomes a threat to all who come in contact with him. / Asher je plaćeni ubojica koji je najbolji dio svog života proveo oduzimajući živote drugima, primajući naređenja od Avija. Živi usamljeničkim životom, uživajući u vinu i dobroj hrani, ljuteći svog šegrta Uzija, koji preuzima njegove poslove jer je mlađi. Kad Avi da Asheru nova 3 ubojstva iz osvete, on uspostavi slučajni kontakt sa Sophie, učiteljicom baleta, ali joj ne može ništa otkriti o svom životu. Asher bude primoran udružiti se sa Uzijem, no kad posao krene po zlu, Asher ubrzo postane lovina, a smrt postane prijetnja svima koji su u dodiru s njim.

programme.desc: Italian Serie A: Highlights - (sport. program, Italy) Serie A is a professional football competition with 20 teams in a two-round league championship. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a number of great players and coaches. Due to the decline in the financial power of the Italian first league teams and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly dropped in quality, but it is returning to its rightful place with sure steps. ... / Italian Serie A: Highlights - (sport. program, Italija) Serie A profesionalno je nogometno natjecanje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Dugi niz godina talijanski se nogomet svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Europi. Padom financijske moći talijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada. ...

programme.title: Football - Europa League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program, 2025) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. From that season, the competition was officially called the UEFA Cup and was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. a competition by groups was introduced, followed by eliminations. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program, 2025) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europa League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program, 2025) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. From that season, the competition was officially called the UEFA Cup and was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. a competition by groups was introduced, followed by eliminations. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program, 2025) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europa League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program, 2025) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. From that season, the competition was officially called the UEFA Cup and was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. a competition by groups was introduced, followed by eliminations. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program, 2025) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Cibona - Dijon, FIBA ​​Eurocup 2025/2026, 2nd round / Cibona - Dijon, FIBA Eurokup 2025./2026., 2.kolo
programme.desc: Basketball: EuroCup - (sport. program, 2025) The Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second Euroleague Basketball competition. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and mostly clubs from the top 15 strongest European leagues participate in it. Placement in the Eurocup is secured through national championships and cups, and through invitations to the so-called "wildcards". The second strongest competition in European basketball was created by merging the Radivoje Korać FIBA ​​Cup and the Saporta Cup. The significance of this competition is that the winner secures the right to compete next season in the strongest club basketball competition in Europe, the Euroleague... / Basketball: EuroCup - (sport. program, 2025) Eurokup je nastao 2002. godine kao drugo natjecanje Euroleague Basketball, U ovom natjecanju se natječu najjači košarkaški klubovi koji ne uspiju izboriti plasman u Euroligu, te u njemu sudjeluju uglavnom klubovi iz top 15 najjačih europskih liga. Plasman u Eurokup se osigurava kroz nacionalna prvenstva i kupove, te kroz pozivnice tzv. "wildcards". Drugo po jačini natjecanje u europskoj košarci nastalo je spajanjem FIba Kupa Radivoja Koraća i Saporta Kupa. Značaj za ovo natjecanje je da pobjednik osigurava pravo natjecati se naredne sezone u najjačem klupskom košarkaškom natjecanju u Europi, Euroligi...

programme.title: Caren Miosga
programme.sub-title: Middle East and Ukraine: How effective is the Trump method? / Nahost und Ukraine: Wie wirksam ist die Methode Trump?
programme.desc: "Caren Miosga" diskutiert mit Entscheidern in Politik, Wirtschaft, Kultur und Gesellschaft das aktuell relevanteste Thema der Woche. Dabei sollen unterschiedliche Standpunkte und Sichtweisen auf ein Problem sowie die dahinterstehenden politischen Prozesse deutlich werden. programme.title: Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Hubert and Girwidz find the body of art patron Irmgard Kuhne next to their car. At first they suspected that the elderly woman had a circulatory collapse. But the autopsy leads to traces of the autumn crocus poison colchicine. As Dr. When Fuchs discovers the same poison in the goat's milk that is in Irmgard Kuhne's refrigerator, the case takes a delicate turn: Did Kuhne's daughter, a self-proclaimed herb witch, poison her mother in order to save the inheritance shortly before the old lady moved into a luxury retirement home? Dairy farmer Auzinger, on whose farm Kuhne's goat is kept, also comes under suspicion... / Hubert und Girwidz finden die Leiche von Kunstmazenin Irmgard Kuhne neben ihrem Auto. Zunachst vermuten sie einen Kreislaufkollaps der betagten Frau. Doch die Obduktion fuhrt zu Spuren des Herbstzeitlosengifts Colchicin. Als Dr. Fuchs dasselbe Gift in der Ziegenmilch, die in Irmgard Kuhnes Kuhlschrank steht, feststellt, nimmt der Fall eine heikle Wendung: Hat Kuhnes Tochter, eine selbsternannte Krauterhexe, ihre Mutter vergiftet, um kurz vor dem Umzug der alten Dame in ein Luxus-Seniorenwohnheim das Erbe zu retten? Auch Milchbauer Auzinger, auf dessen Hof Kuhnes Ziege untergestellt ist, gerat unter Verdacht ...

programme.title: WaPo Elbe
programme.sub-title: Out of control / Aus dem Ruder
programme.desc: On the Elbe, young Anna Nowak (16) is rammed by a motorboat and seriously injured. It soon becomes clear to the WaPo that it is not just a hit-and-run accident. Do the dubious dealings of Anna's father, a well-known scrap dealer, have anything to do with the incident? Or even the attractive Bender from the water sports club where Anna trains with her friends? Because he still has a score to settle with Anna's father. And why do references to the local football club appear everywhere? But the deeper the WaPo officials investigate the water sports club, the more clearly they realize that Anna is not entirely innocent. One girl in particular suffered from Anna's humiliation: the quiet Marlene, daughter of a single-parent driver. But does that make her the perpetrator? / Auf der Elbe wird die junge Anna Nowak (16) von einem Motorboot gerammt und schwer verletzt. Der WaPo ist bald klar, dass es sich nicht nur um einen Unfall mit Fahrerflucht handelt. Haben die dubiosen Geschafte von Annas Vater, einem bekannten Schrotthandler, mit dem Vorfall zu tun? Oder gar der attraktive Bender aus dem Wassersportverein, in dem Anna mit ihren Freundinnen trainiert? Denn der hat mit Annas Vater noch eine Rechnung offen. Und wieso tauchen uberall Hinweise auf den lokalen FuSSballverein auf? Doch je tiefer die WaPo-Beamten im Wassersportverein ermitteln, desto klarer erkennen sie, dass Anna nicht ganz unschuldig ist. Besonders ein Madchen hat unter Annas Demutigungen gelitten: die stille Marlene, Tochter einer alleinerziehenden Fahrfrau. Aber macht sie das zur Taterin?

programme.title: Meister des Alltags
programme.desc: Is it true that radishes grow well next to cucumbers in the garden? Can a can of hairspray be carried in checked luggage? And can you use arganol as a cooking oil in the kitchen? This quiz has both feet firmly on the ground: with the answers to "Master of Everyday Life" you learn for everyday life! Moderator Florian Weber puts his prominent candidates' suitability for everyday use to the test in the SWR knowledge quiz. Cabaret artist Christoph Sonntag and actress Alice Hoffmann compete against comedian Bodo Bach and presenter Enie van de Meiklokjes. Creativity and inventiveness are required when guessing the tricky questions from everyday life. Both teams play for projects run by the Herzenssache children's charity - and the winning team's winnings are doubled! / Stimmt es, dass Radieschen im Garten gut neben Gurken gedeihen? Darf eine Dose Haarspray im aufgegebenen Fluggepack transportiert werden? Und kann man Arganol in der Kuche als Speiseol verwenden? Dieses Quiz steht mit beiden Beinen fest auf der Erde: Denn mit den Antworten bei "Meister des Alltags" lernt man furs tagliche Leben! Moderator Florian Weber stellt im SWR-Wissensquiz die Alltagstauglichkeit seiner prominenten Kandidaten auf die Probe. Kabarettist Christoph Sonntag und Schauspielerin Alice Hoffmann treten gegen Comedian Bodo Bach und Moderatorin Enie van de Meiklokjes an. Kreativitat und Ideenreichtum sind gefragt beim Erraten der kniffligen Fragen aus dem taglichen Leben. Beide Teams spielen jeweils fur Projekte der Kinderhilfsaktion Herzenssache - und die erspielte Summe des Siegerteams wird verdoppelt!

programme.title: Rote Rosen
programme.desc: Daniel wants to hire Franka as a landscape architect. But Richard, Daniel's business partner, won't reach a deal with Franka. Daniel insists on Franka and puts everything on one card: If he wins at poker, Richard will have to make a new offer to Franka. Richard loses and Franka demands a high price. During a ride, Carla ends up on an abandoned horse farm that has been for sale for years. Gunter knows why: Dornenhof is haunted! An old woman promptly appears to Carla in a dream who wants to know what Carla is doing on the farm. Valerie is still unhappily in love with Noah and cuts Toni. But Toni wants a better relationship with her half-sister. Noah wants to mediate and invites Valerie to dinner in the shared apartment. But Toni, of all people, is waiting for him in a sexy outfit. After Britta finds out that Matteo is hiding from the police with her, she throws him out. But Gisela offers her kitchen as shelter. / Daniel will Franka als Landschaftsarchitektin einstellen. Aber Richard, Geschaftspartner von Daniel, wird mit Franka nicht handelseinig. Daniel besteht auf Franka und setzt alles auf eine Karte: Wenn er beim Poker gewinnt, muss Richard Franka ein neues Angebot machen. Richard verliert und Franka fordert einen hohen Preis.Bei einem Ausritt landet Carla auf einem verlassenen Pferdehof, der seit Jahren zum Verkauf steht. Gunter weiSS, warum: Auf dem Dornenhof spukt es! Prompt erscheint Carla im Traum eine alte Frau, die wissen will, was Carla auf dem Hof zu suchen hat.Valerie ist nach wie vor unglucklich in Noah verliebt und schneidet Toni. Aber Toni wunscht sich ein besseres Verhaltnis zu ihrer Halbschwester. Noah will vermitteln und ladt Valerie in die WG zum Essen ein. Doch da wartet ausgerechnet Toni in einem sexy Outfit auf ihn.Nachdem Britta erfahren hat, dass Matteo sich bei ihr vor der Polizei versteckt, wirft sie ihn raus. Doch Gisela bietet ihre Kuche als Unterschlupf an.

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: After realizing that she and Fritz have something in common, Fanny is overwhelmed and withdraws. When she digs up a bed to distract herself and tears something up, Hildegard, concerned, sends her to the hospital. The injury turns out to be harmless, but Yannik senses that something is wrong. Fanny lets him in and admits what's bothering her: Does Fritz even know what Fanny knows now? Greta and Miro are at a loss as to how they should deal with Greta's desire to have their own restaurant. When Miro recognizes Kilian's interest in the restaurant, he becomes thoughtful and makes a suggestion to Greta: Maybe the whole thing can work - but only as a family business. Anja, in love, decides to stay with Michael in Bichlheim and gets her job back from Yannik. Michael initially appears relieved in front of Erik, but then he gets the chance for his research, while Anja receives bad news from her family. They both pull together and speak the truth. / Nach der Erkenntnis, dass Fritz und sie eine Gemeinsamkeit haben, ist Fanny uberfordert und entzieht sich. Als sie zur Ablenkung ein Beet umgrabt und sich dabei etwas verreiSSt, schickt Hildegard sie besorgt ins Krankenhaus. Die Verletzung entpuppt sich als harmlos, aber Yannik spurt, dass etwas nicht stimmt. Fanny weiht ihn ein und gesteht, was sie umtreibt: WeiSS Fritz uberhaupt, was Fanny nun weiSS?Greta und Miro sind ratlos, wie sie mit Gretas Wunsch nach einem eigenen Restaurant umgehen sollen. Als Miro Kilians Interesse an dem Restaurant erkennt, wird er nachdenklich und macht Greta einen Vorschlag: Das Ganze kann vielleicht doch funktionieren - aber nur als Familienbetrieb.Anja entscheidet sich verliebt dazu, bei Michael in Bichlheim zu bleiben, und holt sich bei Yannik ihren Job zuruck. Michael zeigt sich vor Erik zunachst erleichtert, doch dann bekommt er die Chance fur seine Forschung, wahrend Anja schlechte Nachrichten von ihrer Familie erhalt. Da geben beide sich einen Ruck und sprechen die Wahrheit aus.

programme.title: Who knows something like that? / Wer weiSS denn sowas?
Morden im Norden
programme.desc: The aspiring algae researcher Dr. Kyra Ruckert, 31, is found hanging from the mast of her sailboat. Initial investigations at the crime scene reveal that Kyra was the victim of a murder disguised as suicide. Her partner and research assistant Emily comes under suspicion. The quick-tempered young woman felt disrespected and exploited by her partner. Kyra's half-sister Zarah, who had a bitter dispute with the dead woman over her parents' inheritance, also had a motive for the crime. Or is the murder related to Kyra's research project? The victim was working on a promising process for extracting nutrients from algae. When brought to market, the patents could make the inventor a fortune. Behind the façade of scientific research, a world of resentment and jealousy opens up to the commissioners. / Die aufstrebende Algenforscherin Dr. Kyra Ruckert, 31, wird erhangt am Mast ihres Segelbootes aufgefunden. Erste Untersuchungen am Tatort ergeben, dass Kyra einem als Selbstmord getarnten Mord zum Opfer gefallen ist. Unter Verdacht gerat ihre Lebensgefahrtin und Forschungsassistentin Emily. Die schnell aufbrausende junge Frau fuhlte sich von ihrer Partnerin geringgeschatzt und ausgebeutet. Ein Motiv fur die Tat hatte aber auch Kyras Halbschwester Zarah gehabt, die mit der Toten einen erbitterten Streit um das elterliche Erbe fuhrte. Oder hangt der Mord mit Kyras Forschungsprojekt zusammen? Das Opfer arbeitete an einem vielversprechenden Verfahren zur Nahrstoffgewinnung aus Algen. Zur Marktreife gebracht, konnten die Patente der Erfinderin ein Vermogen einbringen. Hinter der Fassade wissenschaftlicher Forschung eroffnet sich den Kommissaren eine Welt aus Missgunst und Eifersucht.

programme.title: Knowledge before eight - future / Wissen vor acht - Zukunft
programme.desc: We are paper recycling world champions, but not all paper can be recycled. Composite materials such as aluminum milk cartons, wax paper and receipts do not belong in the blue bin. But these non-recyclable papers could serve a new purpose: as a cement replacement in concrete. Anja Reschke explains what this “ash concrete” can do and how it helps save CO2 in “Knowledge before Eight - Future”. / Wir sind Papier-Recycling-Weltmeister, aber nicht alles Papier kann recycelt werden. Verbundmaterialien wie Milchtuten mit Aluminium, Wachspapier und Kassenzettel gehoren nicht in die blaue Tonne. Doch diese nicht recycelbaren Papiere konnten einen neuen Zweck erfullen: Als Zement-Ersatz in Beton. Was dieser "Aschebeton" kann und wie er dabei hilft, CO2 zu sparen, erklart Anja Reschke in "Wissen vor acht - Zukunft".

Diese Frage wird bei "Wetter vor acht" anhand von anschaulichen Grafiken und fundierten Prognosen geklart.

programme.title: Die Wahrheit uber Eigenmarken
programme.desc: Own brands such as “Ja” from Rewe or “Gut und cheap” from Edeka are booming. Due to inflation in recent years, many people are paying even more attention to their wallets. But can you actually save money with your own brands? And do consumers have to compromise on quality to achieve this? The film follows, among other things, a family of five in the experiment of eating exclusively own-brand products for a month. How big will the savings be at the end of the month - and are the products convincing? 100 passers-by were allowed to taste branded and private label chocolate at the Deutsches Eck in Koblenz after a chocolatier melted Alpine milk chocolate into neutral shapes so that the brand can no longer be recognized from its external appearance. Private labels are particularly popular in sausage products - the film takes a look behind the scenes of production and examines the question of whether Savings are made on animal husbandry for cheap products. All-in-1 winder tabs were also examined in the laboratory with regard to cleaning performance and material protection. The surprising result: certain inexpensive own-brand tabs perform significantly better than the high-priced premium brands - this is where consumers can save money. The so-called “brand detectives” Manon and Patrick Sieber research which manufacturers are behind the cheap own brands. Do some private label packaging actually hide branded products - just packaged differently? In 2024, private labels accounted for around 45 percent of food sales. A billion dollar market - and the trend is rising. The retail chains also use their own brands as a means of pressure in price negotiations. As an anonymous insider, a private label producer talks about the dark side of the private label world. Who pays the price for the cheap own brands? The documentary “The Truth About Private Labels” provides answers. / Eigenmarken wie "Ja" von Rewe oder "Gut und gunstig" von Edeka boomen. Aufgrund der Inflation der vergangenen Jahre schauen viele noch starker auf den Geldbeutel. Doch lasst sich tatsachlich mit Eigenmarken sparen? Und mussen Verbraucherinnen und Verbraucher dafur Abstriche bei der Qualitat machen?Der Film begleitet unter anderem eine funfkopfige Familie bei dem Experiment, sich einen Monat lang ausschlieSSlich von Eigenmarken-Produkten zu ernahren. Wie groSS wird die Ersparnis am Ende des Monats sein - und uberzeugen die Produkte? 100 Passantinnen und Passanten durfen am Deutschen Eck in Koblenz Schokolade von Marken und Eigenmarken verkosten, nachdem ein Chocolatier Alpenmilch-Schokolade in neutrale Formen umgeschmolzen hat, so dass die Marke nicht mehr anhand von ÄuSSerlichkeiten erkennbar ist.Besonders beliebt sind Eigenmarken auch bei Wurstwaren - der Film wirft einen Blick hinter die Kulissen der Herstellung und geht der Frage nach, ob fur die gunstigen Produkte bei der Tierhaltung gespart wird. AuSSerdem wurden All-In-1-Spulmaschinen-Tabs im Hinblick auf Reinigungsleistung und Materialschonung im Labor untersucht. Das uberraschende Ergebnis: Bestimmte gunstige Eigenmarken-Tabs schneiden deutlich besser ab als die hochpreisigen Premium-Marken - hier konnen Verbraucherinnen und Verbraucher bares Geld sparen. Die sogenannten "Markendetektive" Manon und Patrick Sieber recherchieren, welche Hersteller hinter den gunstigen Eigenmarken stecken. Verbergen sich hinter manchen Eigenmarken-Verpackungen in Wahrheit Marken-Produkte - nur anders abgefullt?2024 machten Handelsmarken rund 45 Prozent des Umsatzes bei Lebensmitteln aus. Ein Milliardenmarkt - Tendenz steigend. Die Handelsketten setzen ihre Eigenmarken dabei auch als Druckmittel bei Preisverhandlungen ein. Ein Eigenmarken-Produzent erzahlt als anonymer Insider von den Schattenseiten der Handelsmarken-Welt. Wer zahlt den Preis fur die gunstigen Eigenmarken? Antworten gibt die Doku "Die Wahrheit uber Eigenmarken".

programme.title: Hart aber fair
programme.sub-title: Everything is getting more expensive: What to do about the rising prices? / Alles wird teurer: Was tun gegen die steigenden Preise?
programme.desc: Directly after the supermarket documentary: Meat, fruit and chocolate are becoming more and more expensive. Food prices have skyrocketed by around 30 percent in the past four years. But not only food prices have risen, but also services prices. Who can still afford this? What responsibility does retail have for this inflation? And what should politicians do about inflation? / Direkt nach der Supermarkt-Doku: Fleisch, Obst und Schokolade werden immer teurer. Die Lebensmittelpreise sind in den vergangenen vier Jahren um rund 30 Prozent in die Hohe geschossen. Aber nicht nur die Preise fur Nahrungsmittel sind gestiegen, auch die fur Dienstleistungen. Wer kann sich das noch leisten? Welche Verantwortung tragt der Einzelhandel fur diese Teuerung? Und was muss die Politik gegen die Inflation unternehmen?

programme.title: The Netanyahus - A family at war / Die Netanjahus - Eine Familie im Krieg
programme.desc: How do you become Israel's longest-serving prime minister - and why hardly any politician divides the country as much as Benjamin Netanyahu? The documentary "The Netanyahus - A Family at War" highlights the history and influence of the Netanyahu family on Israeli politics. The focus is on Benjamin Netanyahu, who shaped the country as Israel's prime minister for many years. The documentary traces his political career, addresses the challenges of his time in office and addresses current developments surrounding the Gaza war and the international investigations against him. Particular attention is paid to the family environment: wife Sara Netanyahu and son Yair are not only close confidants, but also actively influence political decisions. How does the Netanyahu family influence political events? What role does Sara Netanyahu play, who is publicly involved in both social and diplomatic issues? And how do the ongoing investigations and allegations against members of the family affect the public image and the political future? "The Netanyahus - A Family at War" offers a current and comprehensive insight into the interplay between personal history, power and crisis - and asks the question of how much Israel's politics is shaped by a single family. How much of Israel is still in Netanyahu - and how much of Netanyahu in Israel? / Wie wird man der am langsten amtierende Ministerprasident Israels - und warum spaltet kaum ein Politiker das Land so sehr wie Benjamin Netanjahu? Die Dokumentation "Die Netanjahus - Eine Familie im Krieg" beleuchtet die Geschichte und den Einfluss der Familie Netanjahu auf die israelische Politik. Im Mittelpunkt steht Benjamin Netanjahu, der als langjahriger Ministerprasident Israels das Land gepragt hat. Die Doku zeichnet seine politische Laufbahn nach, thematisiert die Herausforderungen seiner Amtszeiten und geht auf die aktuellen Entwicklungen rund um den Gaza-Krieg und die internationalen Ermittlungen gegen ihn ein.Ein besonderes Augenmerk gilt dem familiaren Umfeld: Ehefrau Sara Netanjahu und Sohn Yair sind nicht nur enge Vertraute, sondern nehmen aktiv Einfluss auf politische Entscheidungen. Wie pragt die Familie Netanjahu das politische Geschehen? Welche Rolle spielt Sara Netanjahu, die sich sowohl in sozialen als auch diplomatischen Fragen offentlich engagiert? Und wie wirken sich die laufenden Ermittlungen und Vorwurfe gegen Mitglieder der Familie auf das offentliche Bild und die politische Zukunft aus?"Die Netanjahus - Eine Familie im Krieg" bietet einen aktuellen und umfassenden Einblick in das Zusammenspiel von personlicher Geschichte, Macht und Krise - und stellt die Frage, wie sehr Israels Politik von einer einzigen Familie gepragt wird.Wie viel Israel steckt noch in Netanjahu - und wie viel Netanjahu in Israel?

programme.title: Calmeyer's dilemma. Jews save in the shadow of the Nazis / Calmeyers Dilemma. Juden retten im Schatten der Nazis
programme.desc: Hans Georg Calmeyer (1903-1972) war ein deutscher Jurist aus Osnabruck, der wahrend des Zweiten Weltkrieges als "Rassereferent" der nationalsozialistischen Verwaltung in Den Haag uber Leben und Tod von Tausenden Menschen entschied. Die Dokumentation beleuchtet die Frage: Hat Calmeyer niederlandische Juden aktiv gerettet? Oder hat er lediglich einige vor der Verfolgung verschont?Widerstand im NS-System: zwischen Verwaltung und GewissenCalmeyers Geschichte steht fur einen der komplexesten moralischen Konflikte des 20. Jahrhunderts. Als Beamter einer nationalsozialistischen Verwaltung, die Menschen nach rassistischen Kategorien der NS-Ideologie klassifizierte, akzeptierte er bewusst gefalschte Antrage zu Abstammungsnachweisen. Durch diese Form des stillen Widerstands rettete er nachweislich Tausende niederlandischer Juden vor der Deportation in Konzentrationslager. Gleichzeitig uberlieSS er andere Menschen der NS-Judenverfolgung. Diese Ambivalenz wahrend der deutschen Besatzung der Niederlande wirft fundamentale Fragen uber Widerstand und Kollaboration auf: Kann man Teil eines verbrecherischen NS-Systems sein und trotzdem moralisch handeln? Was unterscheidet aktives Retten von passivem Verschonen in der Zeit des Nationalsozialismus?Kontroverse in der Geschichtsforschung um Calmeyers Vermachtnis1972 verlieh die Internationale Holocaust-Gedenkstatte Yad Vashem in Jerusalem Hans Georg Calmeyer den Titel "Gerechter unter den Volkern". Doch sein Wirken bleibt umstritten. Wahrend manche Historiker in ihm einen "Schindler von Osnabruck" sehen, betrachten Kritiker ihn primar als Funktionar der nationalsozialistischen Rassenpolitik. Als in Osnabruck ein Ausstellungsgebaude nach ihm benannt werden sollte, protestierten niederlandische Historiker mit einem Brief an die ehemalige Bundeskanzlerin Angela Merkel (CDU) gegen diese Ehrung.Dokumentarfilm basiert auf Archivquellen zum Zweiten WeltkriegDer Film erzahlt biografisch und exemplarisch die Geschichte Hans Georg Calmeyers wahrend der deutschen Besetzung der Niederlande. Er basiert unter anderem auch auf neu erschlossenem Archivmaterial aus den Niederlanden der 1930er- und 1940er-Jahre sowie dem personlichen Nachlass Calmeyers. Interviews mit letzten Zeitzeugen des Zweiten Weltkriegs und der Judenverfolgung erganzen die historischen Quellen.Aktuelle Relevanz: Lehren aus der NS-Zeit fur heuteIn Zeiten erstarkender autoritarer Systeme gewinnt Calmeyers Geschichte neue Aktualitat. Der Dokumentarfilm stellt die unbequeme Frage nach individuellen Handlungsspielraumen wahrend des Nationalsozialismus: Was waren die Moglichkeiten des Einzelnen in der nationalsozialistischen Gesellschaft? Und welche Lehren lassen sich daraus fur den Umgang mit heutigen autoritaren Tendenzen ziehen?"Calmeyers Dilemma" bietet keine einfachen Antworten auf komplexe moralische Fragen der NS-Geschichte, sondern ladt zur Selbstreflexion ein: Wie hatte ich wahrend der Judenverfolgung gehandelt? Und wie handele ich heute angesichts von Ungerechtigkeit und Unterdruckung?

programme.title: Police call 110 / Polizeiruf 110
programme.desc: The two detectives Katrin Konig and Melly Bowe are dealing with a dramatic crime in Rostock. Two people die on the street. A young man stabs a woman and then kills himself. At the crime scene, Konig and Bowe are faced with a puzzle, because there is no apparent connection between Leon Schilling and the manager Mona Farber. The only trace is a message on Schilling's cell phone: "Do it!" The message came from Felix Lange, a 28-year-old teacher, the night before the crime. But he denies any involvement in the crime and claims to have known nothing about Schilling's intentions. But it is not the first time that he has testified in a similar context: Felix had contact with Lara Trensbach, a 19-year-old woman who also recently committed suicide in Rostock. / Die beiden Kommissarinnen Katrin Konig und Melly Bowe haben es in Rostock mit einem dramatischen Verbrechen zu tun. Auf offener StraSSe sterben zwei Menschen. Ein junger Mann ersticht eine Frau und richtet sich dann selbst. Am Tatort stehen Konig und Bowe vor einem Ratsel, denn zwischen Leon Schilling und der Managerin Mona Farber gibt es keinerlei erkennbare Verbindung. Die einzige Spur ist eine Nachricht auf Schillings Handy: "Tu es!". Die Nachricht stammt von Felix Lange, einem 28-jahrigen Lehrer, in der Nacht vor der Tat. Doch der streitet jede Beteiligung an der Tat ab und behauptet, von Schillings Absichten nichts gewusst zu haben. Aber es ist nicht das erste Mal, dass er in ahnlichem Kontext aussagt: Felix hatte Kontakt zu Lara Trensbach, einer 19-jahrigen Frau, die sich ebenfalls vor kurzer Zeit in Rostock das Leben nahm.

programme.title: The Netanyahus - A family at war / Die Netanjahus - Eine Familie im Krieg
programme.desc: How do you become Israel's longest-serving prime minister - and why hardly any politician divides the country as much as Benjamin Netanyahu? The documentary "The Netanyahus - A Family at War" highlights the history and influence of the Netanyahu family on Israeli politics. The focus is on Benjamin Netanyahu, who shaped the country as Israel's prime minister for many years. The documentary traces his political career, addresses the challenges of his time in office and addresses current developments surrounding the Gaza war and the international investigations against him. Particular attention is paid to the family environment: wife Sara Netanyahu and son Yair are not only close confidants, but also actively influence political decisions. How does the Netanyahu family influence political events? What role does Sara Netanyahu play, who is publicly involved in both social and diplomatic issues? And how do the ongoing investigations and allegations against members of the family affect the public image and the political future? "The Netanyahus - A Family at War" offers a current and comprehensive insight into the interplay between personal history, power and crisis - and asks the question of how much Israel's politics is shaped by a single family. How much of Israel is still in Netanyahu - and how much of Netanyahu in Israel? / Wie wird man der am langsten amtierende Ministerprasident Israels - und warum spaltet kaum ein Politiker das Land so sehr wie Benjamin Netanjahu? Die Dokumentation "Die Netanjahus - Eine Familie im Krieg" beleuchtet die Geschichte und den Einfluss der Familie Netanjahu auf die israelische Politik. Im Mittelpunkt steht Benjamin Netanjahu, der als langjahriger Ministerprasident Israels das Land gepragt hat. Die Doku zeichnet seine politische Laufbahn nach, thematisiert die Herausforderungen seiner Amtszeiten und geht auf die aktuellen Entwicklungen rund um den Gaza-Krieg und die internationalen Ermittlungen gegen ihn ein.Ein besonderes Augenmerk gilt dem familiaren Umfeld: Ehefrau Sara Netanjahu und Sohn Yair sind nicht nur enge Vertraute, sondern nehmen aktiv Einfluss auf politische Entscheidungen. Wie pragt die Familie Netanjahu das politische Geschehen? Welche Rolle spielt Sara Netanjahu, die sich sowohl in sozialen als auch diplomatischen Fragen offentlich engagiert? Und wie wirken sich die laufenden Ermittlungen und Vorwurfe gegen Mitglieder der Familie auf das offentliche Bild und die politische Zukunft aus?"Die Netanjahus - Eine Familie im Krieg" bietet einen aktuellen und umfassenden Einblick in das Zusammenspiel von personlicher Geschichte, Macht und Krise - und stellt die Frage, wie sehr Israels Politik von einer einzigen Familie gepragt wird.Wie viel Israel steckt noch in Netanjahu - und wie viel Netanjahu in Israel?

programme.title: Hubert ohne Staller
programme.sub-title: The children of the five lakes / Die Kinder der funf Seen
programme.desc: A dead man on the edge of the forest presents Hubert and Girwidz with a puzzle: Who is the bearded man who has no papers with him and is wearing strangely simple clothes? Thanks to a public search, it quickly emerges that it is the former lawyer Fabian Fritz, who gave up his old life some time ago to live with his wife Eva on the farm of the children of the five lakes. Apparently the sect, led by Guru Noah, is preparing for the end of the world in complete seclusion. But that is not the only discovery that presents the Wolfratshausen police with completely new challenges. / Ein Toter am Waldrand stellt Hubert und Girwidz vor ein Ratsel: Wer ist der bartige Mann, der keine Papiere bei sich hat und seltsam schlichte Kleidung tragt? Dank offentlicher Fahndung kommt schnell heraus, dass es sich um den ehemaligen Anwalt Fabian Fritz handelt, der vor einiger Zeit sein altes Leben aufgegeben hat, um gemeinsam mit seiner Frau Eva auf dem Hof der Kinder der funf Seen zu wohnen. Offenbar bereitet sich die Sekte unter Leitung von Guru Noah in aller Abgeschiedenheit auf den Weltuntergang vor. Aber das ist nicht die einzige Entdeckung, die die Wolfratshauser Polizei vor vollig neue Herausforderungen stellt.

programme.title: WaPo Elbe
programme.sub-title: The enemy on my boat / Der Feind auf meinem Boot
programme.desc: A Czech water police boat pursues suspects into German territory - a clear violation of the rules, especially because the Czech officials keep the reason for the persecution a secret. When the WaPo officers finally find the escaped boat, one of the occupants is seriously injured. Worse still: she is a former colleague who attended the police school with Jana and Moritz. Maike and her people ask themselves numerous questions: Did the injured person join drug smugglers after being thrown out of the German police? In this case, perhaps the Czech colleagues know more than you or are they in cahoots with the smugglers? An exchange of officials between Germany and the Czech Republic is the ideal opportunity to find out what risky game is actually taking place here - and who is on which side... / Ein Boot der tschechischen Wasserschutzpolizei verfolgt Verdachtige bis in deutsches Hoheitsgebiet - ein klarer RegelverstoSS, vor allem, weil die tschechischen Beamten aus dem Grund der Verfolgung ein Geheimnis machen. Als die WaPo-Beamten das fluchtige Boot schlieSSlich finden, ist eine der Insassinnen schwer verletzt. Schlimmer noch: Sie ist eine ehemalige Kollegin, die mit Jana und Moritz die Polizeischule besucht hat. Maike und ihre Leute stellen sich zahlreiche Fragen: Hat die Verletzte sich nach ihrem Rauswurf bei der deutschen Polizei Drogenschmugglern angeschlossen? Wissen die tschechischen Kollegen in diesem Fall vielleicht mehr als sie oder stecken sie mit den Schmugglern unter einer Decke? Ein Beamtenaustausch zwischen Deutschland und Tschechien ist die ideale Gelegenheit herauszufinden, welch riskantes Spiel hier tatsachlich stattfindet - und wer auf welcher Seite steht ...

programme.title: Meister des Alltags
programme.desc: Will copper pans shine again in the washing machine? For example, in addition to the wine queen, is there also an apricot princess? And do you buy fermented tuna when you need anchovies for a salad dressing? These and many other exciting and curious questions about everyday life can be found in the SWR knowledge quiz! In "Master of Everyday Life", presenter Florian Weber puts his prominent candidates' suitability for everyday use to the test. Cabaret artist Christoph Sonntag and actress Alice Hoffmann compete against comedian Bodo Bach and presenter Enie van de Meiklokjes. Creativity and inventiveness are required when guessing the tricky questions from everyday life. Both teams play for projects of the Herzenssache children's aid campaign - and the winning team's earned amount is doubled! Today, the children's music world of the Siegmund Kiener Foundation in Baden-Baden and the "Singing Bowl Therapy" project in the Am Ordensgut elementary school in Saarbrücken are supported. / Werden Kupferpfannen in der Spulmaschine wieder strahlend schon? Gibt es neben der Wein-Konigin zum Beispiel auch eine Marillen-Prinzessin? Und kauft man fermentierten Thunfisch, wenn man fur ein Salatdressing Anchovis braucht? Diese und viele weitere spannende und kuriose Fragen rund um den ganz normalen Alltag gibt es im SWR-Wissensquiz!Moderator Florian Weber stellt in "Meister des Alltags" die Alltagstauglichkeit seiner prominenten Kandidaten auf die Probe. Kreativitat und Ideenreichtum sind gefragt beim Erraten der kniffligen Fragen aus dem taglichen Leben.Beide Teams spielen jeweils fur Projekte der Kinderhilfsaktion Herzenssache - und die erspielte Summe des Siegerteams wird verdoppelt!Unterstutzt wird heute die Kinder-Musik-Welt der Siegmund Kiener-Stiftung in Baden-Baden sowie das Projekt "Klangschalen-Therapie" in der Grundschule Am Ordensgut in Saarbrucken.

programme.title: Rote Rosen
programme.desc: When Richard hears that Victoria is grooming her granddaughter Bella to be her successor in the EmKA, he doesn't like it at all. Toni doesn't want to back down again and when Britta doesn't come to her, Toni spontaneously quits her job at the hospital. Matteo and Heiner are both lovesick. They give themselves courage and want to fight for their love, but have no idea that they are in love with the same woman: Britta! Carla has fallen in love with the old Dornenhof and is determined to take it over. Neither Britta nor Gunter understand Carla. She doesn't care. But Michael is also against their plan. Will er verhindern, dass Bella die EmKA bekommt?Toni und Noah planen glucklich ihre Reise zum Nordkap, bis Toni erfahrt, dass ihr Urlaub wegen Personalmangels nicht bewilligt wird. Toni will nicht wieder zuruckstecken und als auch Britta ihr nicht entgegenkommt, kundigt Toni spontan ihren Job im Krankenhaus.Matteo und Heiner haben beide Liebeskummer. Sie machen sich Mut und wollen um ihre Liebe kampfen, ahnen aber nicht, dass sie in die gleiche Frau verliebt sind: Britta!Carla hat sich in den alten Dornenhof verliebt und ist entschlossen, ihn zu ubernehmen. Weder Britta noch Gunter verstehen Carla. Das ist ihr egal. Doch auch Michael ist gegen ihr Vorhaben. Kann Carla ihn uberzeugen, den alten Pferdehof zu kaufen?

programme.title: Who knows something like that? / Wer weiSS denn sowas?
WaPo Bodensee
programme.desc: The body of dentist Linda Stern was caught in a Lake Constance fisherman's net. When Julia (Wendy Guntensperger) and Jakob (Max Konig) meet her husband Dr. When Thomas Stern (Patrick Khatami) informs him, he is shocked to say that his wife wanted to separate from him. The culprit was her depression, which she recently treated with the psychologist and shaman Dr. Johannes Ringwald (Ingo Abel) had treatment. Because he also works with banned hallucinogens from the Amazon jungle, Julia and Jakob encounter a wall of silence among his patients. Only the young Timo (Thimo Meitner) is a little more open. Nele (Floriane Daniel), who has not yet appeared during the investigation, is now investigating undercover. Under a false name, she takes part in a group meeting at Dr. Ringwald's magic forest by the lake and gains the trust of Thomas Stern's ex Frauke (Anjorka Stechel), who was also friends with his wife Linda. Suddenly 200,000 euros unexpectedly appear in Stern's safe and Nele finds herself in great danger. She lies tied up and stunned in a boat that races her across the lake. Mechthild (Diana Korner) has no idea about this and brews her own shamanic magic potion... / Im Netz eines Bodenseefischers hat sich die Leiche der Zahnarztin Linda Stern verfangen. Als Julia (Wendy Guntensperger) und Jakob (Max Konig) ihren Ehemann Dr. Thomas Stern (Patrick Khatami) informieren, gibt er betroffen zu Protokoll, dass sich seine Frau von ihm trennen wollte. Schuld waren ihre Depressionen, die sie zuletzt bei dem Psychologen und Schamanen Dr. Johannes Ringwald (Ingo Abel) behandeln lieSS. Weil der auch mit verbotenen Halluzinogenen aus dem Amazonas-Urwald arbeitet, stoSSen Julia und Jakob auf eine Mauer des Schweigens bei seinen Patienten. Nur der junge Timo (Thimo Meitner) zeigt sich etwas offener. Nele (Floriane Daniel), die bei den Nachforschungen bislang nicht in Erscheinung getreten ist, ermittelt nun undercover. Unter falschem Namen nimmt sie an einer Gruppensitzung in Dr. Ringwalds Zauberwald am See teil und erringt das Vertrauen von Thomas Sterns Ex Frauke (Anjorka Stechel), die auch mit dessen Frau Linda befreundet war. Plotzlich tauchen in Sterns Tresor unvermutet 200.000 Euro auf und Nele gerat in groSSe Gefahr. Gefesselt und betaubt liegt sie in einem Boot, das mit ihr uber den See rast. Mechthild (Diana Korner) ahnt davon nichts und braut einen eigenen schamanischen Zaubertrank ...

programme.title: Knowledge before eight - nature / Wissen vor acht - Natur
programme.desc: A school of fish is not only beautiful to look at, it also has many advantages. A school can react incredibly quickly - many times faster than a single fish. A swarm therefore offers better protection against predators. Prerequisite: Everyone sticks to the swarm rules, explains Thomas D in “Knowledge before Eight - Nature”. / Ein Fischschwarm ist nicht nur schon anzusehen, er hat auch viele Vorteile. Ein Schwarm kann unglaublich schnell reagieren - um ein Vielfaches schneller als ein einzelner Fisch. Ein Schwarm bietet also besseren Schutz vor Fressfeinden. Voraussetzung: Alle halten sich an die Schwarmregeln, erklart Thomas D bei "Wissen vor acht - Natur".

programme.title: Die Heiland - We are lawyers / Die Heiland - Wir sind Anwalt
programme.desc: Six-year-old Kyla Lange (Pamuk Pilavci) disappears from an allotment during the handover between her parents, who are separated. The mother, Pia Lange (Isabel Thierauch), alerts the police and hires a lawyer: Rudi Illic (Aleksandar Jovanovic). She accuses her father Theo Vidal (Christoph Bach) of not handing over her daughter. Kyla was supposed to walk the last few meters alone through the facility to her grandfather, but she never reached him. The father receives a public defender, Romy Heiland. Coincidence? Romy suspects that Odette Santos (Anne Diemer) brought about this constellation. But there is no time for personal feelings, there are only a few hours left to find the child. Romy, Rudi and Odette have to work closely together to bring the parents, who accuse each other of kidnapping the child, together and to better understand the background. A large-scale manhunt is underway, the search radius of which is expanding every hour. There is still the possibility that Kyla simply ran away or that an unknown person kidnapped her. In this context, Romy wonders what role Grandfather Martin Lange (Thomas Bading) plays, who, as it turns out, has a criminal record. Romy has to gather all her courage to tell her mother Karin about her half-sister because she doesn't know what this will do to Karin. She is surprised that Karin reacts surprisingly calmly. Ringo (Tim Kalkhof) realizes that he has never had a relationship like the one with Odette. He wanted Tilly to get to know Odette privately. Tilly reacts reluctantly. But she has to realize that in her professional life, Odette Santos is the public prosecutor who makes life difficult for her boss. In private, however, she is Odette, her cousin Ringo's friend. / Die sechsjahrige Kyla Lange (Pamuk Pilavci) verschwindet aus einer Kleingartenanlage bei der Übergabe zwischen den Eltern, die getrennt sind. Die Mutter Pia Lange (Isabel Thierauch) alarmiert die Polizei und nimmt sich einen Anwalt: Rudi Illic (Aleksandar Jovanovic). Sie wirft dem Vater Theo Vidal (Christoph Bach) vor, ihre Tochter nicht ubergeben zu haben. Kyla sollte die letzten Meter allein durch die Anlage zu ihrem GroSSvater gehen, bei dem sie aber nie ankam. Der Vater erhalt eine Pflichtverteidigerin, diese ist Romy Heiland. Zufall? Romy ahnt, dass Odette Santos (Anne Diemer) diese Konstellation herbeigefuhrt hat. Aber fur personliche Befindlichkeiten ist keine Zeit, es bleiben nur wenige Stunden, um das Kind zu finden. Romy, Rudi und Odette mussen eng zusammenarbeiten, um die Eltern, die sich gegenseitig die Entfuhrung des Kindes vorwerfen, an einen Tisch zu bringen und die Hintergrunde besser zu verstehen. Eine GroSSfahndung lauft, deren Suchradius stundlich erweitert wird. Es besteht immer noch die Moglichkeit, dass Kyla einfach weggelaufen ist oder dass ein Unbekannter sie entfuhrt hat. In diesem Zusammenhang fragt sich Romy, welche Rolle der GroSSvater Martin Lange (Thomas Bading) spielt, der, wie sich herausstellt, vorbestraft ist.Romy muss all ihren Mut zusammennehmen, um ihrer Mutter Karin von ihrer Halbschwester zu erzahlen, da sie nicht weiSS, was dies bei Karin auslosen wird. Sie ist uberrascht, dass Karin erstaunlich gefasst reagiert.Ringo (Tim Kalkhof) realisiert, dass er eine Beziehung wie die mit Odette noch nie hatte. Er mochte, dass Tilly Odette privat kennenlernt. Tilly reagiert widerwillig. Aber sie muss einsehen: Im beruflichen Leben ist Odette Santos die Staatsanwaltin, die ihrer Chefin das Leben schwermacht. Im Privaten aber ist sie Odette, die Freundin ihres Cousins Ringo.

programme.title: In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: Cornelius Hefer collapses in the Saxony Clinic with stomach pain. He is an employee of the security service that Sarah Marquardt hired after the attack on Dr. Lucia Bohm and Kris Haas. Dr. Ilay Demir discovers a pathological change in the liver during an ultrasound. The security guard is transferred to the ward to clarify the findings. On the way there he observes Miriam Schneider, who has a visit from her friend Nele Garbow. He seems to have a common past with the policewoman and warns Miriam about her. David Schrader goes to see Dr. Kathrin Globisch in pain therapy treatment. When asked, he assures her that he has stopped taking the high-dose painkillers, but he can only get through the physiotherapy with the help of secretly taken tablets. While Dr. Roland Heilmann gives relaxed, Dr. Martin Stein has enormous doubts as to whether David is really just a “normal patient” for Kathrin. She even lets David invite her to dinner. / Cornelius Hefer bricht in der Sachsenklinik mit Bauchschmerzen zusammen. Er ist ein Mitarbeiter des Wachdienstes, den Sarah Marquardt nach dem Übergriff auf Dr. Lucia Bohm und Kris Haas engagiert hat. Dr. Ilay Demir entdeckt im Ultraschall eine krankhafte Veranderung der Leber. Zur Abklarung des Befundes wird der Wachmann auf Station verlegt. Auf dem Weg dorthin beobachtet er Miriam Schneider, die Besuch von ihrer Freundin Nele Garbow hat. Er scheint mit der Polizistin eine gemeinsame Vergangenheit zu haben und warnt Miriam vor ihr.David Schrader begibt sich bei Dr. Kathrin Globisch in schmerztherapeutische Behandlung. Auf Nachfrage versichert er ihr, die hochdosierten Schmerzmittel abgesetzt zu haben, doch die Physiotherapie steht er nur mit Hilfe heimlich eingenommener Tabletten durch. Wahrend sich Dr. Roland Heilmann entspannt gibt, bekommt Dr. Martin Stein enorme Zweifel, ob David fur Kathrin wirklich nur ein "ganz normaler Patient" ist. Sie lasst sich von David sogar zum Essen einladen.

programme.title: Deutsches Geld fur den Terror
programme.desc: Attacks like those by the so-called Islamic State or Hamas show brutally: Terror is possible at any time and anywhere. But how are these attacks financed? The shocking answer: also from Germany. Money from Germany regularly flows into the coffers of Islamist terrorist groups via normal bank transfers, donation groups, online payment services or cryptocurrencies. Many small donations add up to large amounts. The flow of money often goes unnoticed because German laws make investigations more difficult than in other countries. The documentation follows the trail of money - from Germany to Syria. She tells the story of a young German IS returnee who gives insights into how money is collected, passed on and what it is used for. The film reconstructs how money is collected through middlemen in Germany and Austria - sometimes also for Hamas. At the same time, the team of authors investigates the question of why German authorities notice so little about it and why investigators in other countries are apparently more successful in drying up the extremists' financial flows. An investigative search for clues with exclusive file finds and impressive interviews. A film that makes it clear how close the issue of terrorist financing is to our everyday lives - and that even small donations from Germany can ultimately have fatal consequences. / Anschlage wie die des sogenannten Islamischen Staates oder der Hamas zeigen mit brutaler Harte: Terror ist jederzeit und uberall moglich. Doch wie werden diese Anschlage finanziert? Die erschutternde Antwort: auch aus Deutschland.Über ganz normale Bankuberweisungen, Spendenvereine, Online-Bezahldienste oder Kryptowahrungen flieSSt regelmaSSig Geld aus Deutschland in die Kassen islamistischer Terrorgruppen. Viele kleine Spenden summieren sich zu groSSen Betragen. Oft bleiben die Geldflusse unbemerkt, weil die deutschen Gesetze Ermittlungen schwerer machen als in anderen Landern.Die Dokumentation verfolgt die Spur des Geldes - von Deutschland bis nach Syrien. Sie erzahlt die Geschichte einer jungen deutschen IS-Ruckkehrerin, die Einblicke gibt: wie Geld gesammelt, weitergeleitet und wofur es genutzt wird. programme.title: Echtes Leben
programme.desc: Mona is in her mid-40s, mother of a five-year-old daughter - and is in the middle of a midlife crisis. Self-doubt and deep-seated inner convictions such as “You can’t do that anyway” characterize their everyday lives. She asks herself the question more and more often: What's next in life? In order to give her daughter a strong, more self-confident image of women, she makes a decision: She wants to show the five-year-old - and herself - that you can fulfill your dreams if you believe in them strongly enough. Since she was a child, Mona has dreamed of being on the musical stage with the actors from “Starlight Express”. But how will the makers of “Starlight Express” react when they find out about Mona’s wish? Mona is also untrained and hasn't sung in front of other people for decades. The path to her big dream quickly leads her to physical limits, old fears and deep-seated self-doubt. Will she still manage to be on stage at the end? The film follows Mona as she tries to roller skate her way out of a midlife crisis. / Mona ist Mitte 40, Mutter einer funfjahrigen Tochter - und steckt mitten in der Midlifecrisis. Selbstzweifel und tiefsitzende innere Überzeugungen wie "Das kannst du eh nicht" pragen ihren Alltag. Immer haufiger stellt sie sich die Frage: Was kommt jetzt noch im Leben? Um ihrer Tochter ein starkes, selbstbewussteres Frauenbild mit auf den Weg zu geben, fasst sie einen Entschluss: Sie will der Funfjahrigen - und sich selbst - zeigen, dass man sich seine Traume erfullen kann, wenn man stark genug an sie glaubt. Denn Mona traumt seit ihrer Kindheit davon, einmal mit den Darstellerinnen und Darstellern von "Starlight Express" auf der Musical-Buhne zu stehen. Doch wie werden die Macherinnen und Macher von "Starlight Express" reagieren, wenn sie von Monas Wunsch erfahren? AuSSerdem ist Mona untrainiert und hat seit Jahrzehnten nicht mehr vor anderen Menschen gesungen. Der Weg zum groSSen Traum fuhrt sie schnell an korperliche Grenzen, alte Ängste und tiefsitzende Selbstzweifel. Wird sie es trotzdem schaffen, am Ende auf der Buhne zu stehen? Der Film begleitet Mona bei dem Versuch, sich auf Rollschuhen aus der Midlifecrisis zu fahren.

programme.title: Die Heiland - We are lawyers / Die Heiland - Wir sind Anwalt
programme.desc: Six-year-old Kyla Lange (Pamuk Pilavci) disappears from an allotment during the handover between her parents, who are separated. The mother, Pia Lange (Isabel Thierauch), alerts the police and hires a lawyer: Rudi Illic (Aleksandar Jovanovic). She accuses her father Theo Vidal (Christoph Bach) of not handing over her daughter. Kyla was supposed to walk the last few meters alone through the facility to her grandfather, but she never reached him. The father receives a public defender, Romy Heiland. Coincidence? Romy suspects that Odette Santos (Anne Diemer) brought about this constellation. But there is no time for personal feelings, there are only a few hours left to find the child. Romy, Rudi and Odette have to work closely together to bring the parents, who accuse each other of kidnapping the child, together and to better understand the background. A large-scale manhunt is underway, the search radius of which is expanding every hour. There is still the possibility that Kyla simply ran away or that an unknown person kidnapped her. In this context, Romy wonders what role Grandfather Martin Lange (Thomas Bading) plays, who, as it turns out, has a criminal record. Romy has to gather all her courage to tell her mother Karin about her half-sister because she doesn't know what this will do to Karin. She is surprised that Karin reacts surprisingly calmly. Ringo (Tim Kalkhof) realizes that he has never had a relationship like the one with Odette. He wanted Tilly to get to know Odette privately. Tilly reacts reluctantly. But she has to realize that in her professional life, Odette Santos is the public prosecutor who makes life difficult for her boss. In private, however, she is Odette, her cousin Ringo's friend. / Die sechsjahrige Kyla Lange (Pamuk Pilavci) verschwindet aus einer Kleingartenanlage bei der Übergabe zwischen den Eltern, die getrennt sind. Die Mutter Pia Lange (Isabel Thierauch) alarmiert die Polizei und nimmt sich einen Anwalt: Rudi Illic (Aleksandar Jovanovic). Sie wirft dem Vater Theo Vidal (Christoph Bach) vor, ihre Tochter nicht ubergeben zu haben. Kyla sollte die letzten Meter allein durch die Anlage zu ihrem GroSSvater gehen, bei dem sie aber nie ankam. Der Vater erhalt eine Pflichtverteidigerin, diese ist Romy Heiland. Zufall? Romy ahnt, dass Odette Santos (Anne Diemer) diese Konstellation herbeigefuhrt hat. Aber fur personliche Befindlichkeiten ist keine Zeit, es bleiben nur wenige Stunden, um das Kind zu finden. Romy, Rudi und Odette mussen eng zusammenarbeiten, um die Eltern, die sich gegenseitig die Entfuhrung des Kindes vorwerfen, an einen Tisch zu bringen und die Hintergrunde besser zu verstehen. Eine GroSSfahndung lauft, deren Suchradius stundlich erweitert wird. Es besteht immer noch die Moglichkeit, dass Kyla einfach weggelaufen ist oder dass ein Unbekannter sie entfuhrt hat. In diesem Zusammenhang fragt sich Romy, welche Rolle der GroSSvater Martin Lange (Thomas Bading) spielt, der, wie sich herausstellt, vorbestraft ist.Romy muss all ihren Mut zusammennehmen, um ihrer Mutter Karin von ihrer Halbschwester zu erzahlen, da sie nicht weiSS, was dies bei Karin auslosen wird. Sie ist uberrascht, dass Karin erstaunlich gefasst reagiert.Ringo (Tim Kalkhof) realisiert, dass er eine Beziehung wie die mit Odette noch nie hatte. Er mochte, dass Tilly Odette privat kennenlernt. Tilly reagiert widerwillig. Aber sie muss einsehen: Im beruflichen Leben ist Odette Santos die Staatsanwaltin, die ihrer Chefin das Leben schwermacht. Im Privaten aber ist sie Odette, die Freundin ihres Cousins Ringo.

programme.title: In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: Cornelius Hefer collapses in the Saxony Clinic with stomach pain. He is an employee of the security service that Sarah Marquardt hired after the attack on Dr. Lucia Bohm and Kris Haas. Dr. Ilay Demir discovers a pathological change in the liver during an ultrasound. The security guard is transferred to the ward to clarify the findings. On the way there he observes Miriam Schneider, who has a visit from her friend Nele Garbow. He seems to have a common past with the policewoman and warns Miriam about her. David Schrader goes to see Dr. Kathrin Globisch in pain therapy treatment. When asked, he assures her that he has stopped taking the high-dose painkillers, but he can only get through the physiotherapy with the help of secretly taken tablets. While Dr. Roland Heilmann gives relaxed, Dr. Martin Stein has enormous doubts as to whether David is really just a “normal patient” for Kathrin. She even lets David invite her to dinner. / Cornelius Hefer bricht in der Sachsenklinik mit Bauchschmerzen zusammen. Er ist ein Mitarbeiter des Wachdienstes, den Sarah Marquardt nach dem Übergriff auf Dr. Lucia Bohm und Kris Haas engagiert hat. Dr. Ilay Demir entdeckt im Ultraschall eine krankhafte Veranderung der Leber. Zur Abklarung des Befundes wird der Wachmann auf Station verlegt. Auf dem Weg dorthin beobachtet er Miriam Schneider, die Besuch von ihrer Freundin Nele Garbow hat. Er scheint mit der Polizistin eine gemeinsame Vergangenheit zu haben und warnt Miriam vor ihr.David Schrader begibt sich bei Dr. Kathrin Globisch in schmerztherapeutische Behandlung. Auf Nachfrage versichert er ihr, die hochdosierten Schmerzmittel abgesetzt zu haben, doch die Physiotherapie steht er nur mit Hilfe heimlich eingenommener Tabletten durch. Wahrend sich Dr. Roland Heilmann entspannt gibt, bekommt Dr. Martin Stein enorme Zweifel, ob David fur Kathrin wirklich nur ein "ganz normaler Patient" ist. Sie lasst sich von David sogar zum Essen einladen.
