programme.title: Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is designed to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes aimed at children who play sports, no matter what level of success, will show the essential benefits of sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that there are many talented children in Montenegro who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation to at least one level higher. We want to draw attention to the potential that belongs only to us, that is undeniable, a potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Epizode namijenjene djeci koje se bave sportom, nebitno na kom nivou uspjeha, prikazaće suštinske prednosti koje pružaju sport i pravilna ishrana. Mišljenja smo da u Crnoj Gori ima mnogo talentovane djece koja nemaju adekvatne uslove za razvoj njihovog talenta. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. Želimo da skrenemo pažnju na potencijal koji pripada samo nama, koji je neosporan, potencijal koji zaslužuje mnogo više.

programme.title: Dnevna soba
programme.desc: It is an entertainment show, which will try to advise and entertain the viewers. The aim is for the viewers to relax and have fun in the hour and a half, in order to escape from the daily problems. It is intended for all generations and families. In numerous sections, we deal with interesting and current topics, and with the help of our interlocutors, we share tips for a simpler life. Along with simple and concrete advice for the viewers, in the show we will host numerous individuals or groups engaged in humanitarian work, as well as celebrities who we will present in a slightly different light, giving them the opportunity to share with the viewers their life experiences and small secrets in the functioning of the household. / Riječ je o emisiji Zabavnog programa, koja će pokušati da savjetuje i razonodi gledaoce. Želja je da se u sat i po gledaoci relaksiraju i zabave, kako bi pobjegli od dnevnih problema. Namijenjena je svim generacijama i porodici. U brojnim rubrikama bavimo se zanimljivim i aktuelnim temama, a uz pomoć sagovornika dijelimo savjete za jednostavniji život. Uz jednostavne i konkretne savjete za gledaoce, u emisiji ćemo ugostiti brojne individualce ili grupe koje se bave humanitarnim radom, kao i poznate ličnosti koje ćemo predstavljati u nešto drugačijem svjetlu, pružiti im mogućnost da sa gledaocima dijele svoja životna iskustva i male tajne u funkcionisanju domaćinstva.

programme.title: Dnevna soba
programme.desc: It is an entertainment show, which will try to advise and entertain the viewers. The aim is for the viewers to relax and have fun in the hour and a half, in order to escape from the daily problems. It is intended for all generations and families. In numerous sections, we deal with interesting and current topics, and with the help of our interlocutors, we share tips for a simpler life. Along with simple and concrete advice for the viewers, in the show we will host numerous individuals or groups engaged in humanitarian work, as well as celebrities who we will present in a slightly different light, giving them the opportunity to share with the viewers their life experiences and small secrets in the functioning of the household. / Riječ je o emisiji Zabavnog programa, koja će pokušati da savjetuje i razonodi gledaoce. Želja je da se u sat i po gledaoci relaksiraju i zabave, kako bi pobjegli od dnevnih problema. Namijenjena je svim generacijama i porodici. U brojnim rubrikama bavimo se zanimljivim i aktuelnim temama, a uz pomoć sagovornika dijelimo savjete za jednostavniji život. Uz jednostavne i konkretne savjete za gledaoce, u emisiji ćemo ugostiti brojne individualce ili grupe koje se bave humanitarnim radom, kao i poznate ličnosti koje ćemo predstavljati u nešto drugačijem svjetlu, pružiti im mogućnost da sa gledaocima dijele svoja životna iskustva i male tajne u funkcionisanju domaćinstva.

programme.title: Alo Alo
programme.desc: France, World War II. René Artois is the owner of a small cafe, with unusual hardships. In his small cafe, a collection of various characters meet, from fighters of the French resistance movement, through Gestapo officers and German soldiers to British paratroopers. All of them try not to be discovered in their intentions, while Rene tries not to be discovered by his father-in-law and his wife in affairs with waitresses. / Francuska, II Svjetski rat. Rene Artoa je vlasnik malog kafea, sa nesvakidašnjim mukama. U njegovom malom kafeu se sastaje bulumenta raznih likova, od boraca francuskog pokreta otpora, preko oficira Gestapoa i njemačkih vojnika do britanskih padobranaca. Svi oni pokušavaju da ne budu otkriveni u svojim namjerama, dok se Rene trudi da ga tašta i žena ne otkriju u aferama sa konobaricama.

programme.desc: The Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second "Euroleague Basketball" competition. programme.title: Lobito's Tales / Os Contos do Lobito
programme.desc: Lobito dreams of being like the heroes of the storybooks he loves to read, traveling from story to story to live their adventures. programme.title: Rev and Roll

programme.title: A Escola dos Roaridos / A Escola dos Rugidos

programme.title: Numberblocks

Privado da sua família e amigos, Dimitri aprende a superar os seus medos para explorar o mundo extraordinário da savana.

programme.desc: Tragic events occur unexpectedly and dramatically. We will bring together politics and culture, economics and sport, science and children's literature, national and international current affairs in a simple and objective language. / Radar XS e um telejornal para crianças dos 8 aos 12 anos onde se pretende incentivar o pensamento crítico e a cidadania consciente. Vamos juntar a política e a cultura, a economia e desporto, a ciencia e a literatura infantil, a atualidade nacional e internacional numa linguagem simples e objetiva.

programme.title: Academia de Super-Herois
programme.desc: A group of teenagers attend a special school for future superheroes where they try to master deadly obstacle courses and create their own super costumes! / Um grupo de adolescentes frequenta uma escola especial para futuros super-herois onde tentam dominar pistas de obstáculos mortais e criar as suas proprias super-roupas!

programme.title: Sempre Atrasados
programme.desc: Every morning, Nuno and Malika leave home 30 minutes early to go to school and they still arrive late every morning! This is because every morning, something incredible happens along the way. But even though their stories are always true, the school principal never believes them... / Todas as manhas, Nuno e Malika saem de casa 30 minutos mais cedo para ir à escola e ainda assim todas as manhas chegam atrasados! Isto porque todas as manhas, algo incrível acontece no caminho. Mas mesmo que as suas historias sejam sempre verdadeiras, a diretora da escola nunca acredita nelas...

programme.title: Escola de Herois
programme.desc: Hero School is a school for budding superheroes, where children learn to master their innate powers to help people, solve problems and try to make the world a better place. / A Escola de Herois e uma escola para super-herois principiantes, onde as crianças aprendem a dominar os seus poderes inatos para ajudar as pessoas, resolver problemas e tentar tornar o mundo num lugar melhor.

programme.title: Lobito's Tales / Os Contos do Lobito
programme.desc: Lobito dreams of being like the heroes of the storybooks he loves to read, traveling from story to story to live their adventures. But as the intrepid little wolf quickly discovers, reaching a happy ending is no easy task and he will have to learn from his mistakes. / Lobito sonha ser como os herois dos livros de historias que mais gosta de ler, viajando de conto em conto para viver as suas aventuras. Mas como o intrepido lobinho depressa descobre, chegar ao final feliz nao e tarefa fácil e terá de aprender com os seus erros.

programme.title: Rev and Roll
programme.desc: Join Rev, an 8-year-old boy, and his best friend, Rumble, a boisterous and powerful truck who thinks he's a dog, and live big, fun adventures with them in their hometown of Fender Bend! / Junta-te Rev, um menino de 8 anos, e ao seu melhor amigo, Rumble, um camiao turbulento e poderoso que pensa que e um cachorro, e vive com eles grandes e divertidas aventuras na sua cidade natal, Fender Bend!

programme.title: A Escola dos Roaridos / A Escola dos Rugidos
programme.desc: Going to school for the first time is one of the biggest challenges we have to face. Roaring School helps children prepare for school life by exploring a child's first year through the relationships and experiences of our mini monsters. / Ir para a escola pela primeira vez e um dos maiores desafios que temos de enfrentar. A Escola dos Rugidos ajuda as crianças a prepararem-se para a vida escolar explorando o primeiro ano da criança atraves dos relacionamentos e experiencias dos nossos mini monstros.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Numberblocks are a really fun group of numbers that work together to solve big and small problems and will teach you to count in a really fun way! / Os Numberblocks sao um grupo de números muito divertido que trabalham juntos para resolver grandes e pequenos problemas e vao ensinar-te a contar de uma forma muito divertida!

programme.title: Kiwi
programme.desc: Let's learn English with Twiki and Twini! Each episode will be an adventure to discover new words and new sounds. / Vamos aprender Ingles com Twiki e Twini! Cada episodio será uma aventura para descobrir novas palavras e novos sons.

programme.title: A Grande Descoberta
programme.desc: Hugo, like all children, has a curious personality, and constantly questions himself on a journey in search of knowledge, logic and understanding the meaning of things. / Hugo, tal como todas as crianças, tem uma personalidade curiosa, e questiona-se constantemente numa jornada em busca de conhecimento, da logica e de compreender o significado das coisas.

programme.title: Ziggy and the Zootram
programme.desc: Ziggy is a friendly freshwater crocodile from Australia. He and his friends live in their eccentric houses located in a crater on an island. Ziggy and his friends have a very special secret - besides walking like people, talking like people - they all work in a zoo! / Ziggy e um simpático crocodilo-de-água-doce da Austrália. Ele e os seus amigos vivem nas suas excentricas casas situadas numa cratera de uma ilha. Ziggy e os seus amigos tem um segredo muito especial - alem de andarem como gente, falarem como gente - todos trabalham num jardim zoologico!

programme.title: Dimitri
programme.desc: Dimitri, a small bird, was lost from his family during migration and now roams the African continent, very different from his home continent, Europe. Deprived of his family and friends, Dimitri learns to overcome his fears to explore the extraordinary world of the savannah. / Dimitri, um pequeno pássaro, perdeu-se da sua família durante a migraçao e agora vagueia pelo continente africano, muito diferente do seu continente natal, a Europa. Privado da sua família e amigos, Dimitri aprende a superar os seus medos para explorar o mundo extraordinário da savana.

programme.title: Mia Go
programme.desc: Mia is a girl whose enthusiasm infects everyone around her. With her fearless sense of adventure, she tries things for the first time with a fearless attitude. Mia lives in the busy city Everyday with her closest friends and together they go on great adventures. / Mia e uma menina cujo entusiasmo contagia todos ao seu redor. Mia mora na movimentada cidade Todososdias com os seus amigos mais proximos e juntos vao viver grandes aventuras.

programme.title: Tottenham Hotspur vs Aston Villa - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8
programme.desc: None of the last 20 Premier League matches between Tottenham Hotspur and Aston Villa have been drawn since a 1-1 stalemate in May 2012. Only two fixtures in the competition’s history have ever had more successive games without a draw: Newcastle v Spurs and Chelsea v Crystal Palace. Aston Villa have won four of their last six Premier League games against Tottenham Hotspur, as many as their previous 29 beforehand.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Manchester United - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8
programme.desc: Liverpool have lost just one of their last 14 Premier League meetings with Manchester United, a 1-2 defeat at Old Trafford in August 2022. Indeed, since the start of 2018-19, this is the fewest defeats any side to face the Red Devils 3+ times in the competition has had against them. Manchester United are winless in their last nine Premier League games at Anfield since a 1-0 win in January 2016 under Louis van Gaal. Liverpool could become just the second side to avoid defeat in 10+ successive Premier League home games against the Red Devils, after Chelsea.

programme.title: Getafe vs Real Madrid - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 9
programme.desc: Getafe have lost their last seven LaLiga matches against Real Madrid, failing to score in six of them, after having scored in their previous two against the Whites in the competition without conceding a goal. Getafe have suffered 30 defeats in LaLiga against Real Madrid, their highest tally against a single opponent in their history in the top flight and against whom they have suffered the most home defeats in the competition.

programme.title: Nottingham Forest vs Chelsea - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini match
programme.desc: Nottingham Forest have won just one of their last eight Premier League meetings with Chelsea, a 1-0 victory at Stamford Bridge in September 2023. Chelsea have won three of their last four Premier League away games against Nottingham Forest, including both of their last two in a row. The Blues have never before won three successive away league games against the Tricky Trees.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Everton - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini match
programme.desc: Manchester City are unbeaten in their last 16 Premier League meetings with Everton since a 0-4 defeat at Goodison Park in January 2017. Only against Fulham, West Brom, and West Ham are the Citizens currently on a longer unbeaten run in the competition. Everton are winless in their last 14 away Premier League games against Manchester City since a 2-1 victory in December 2010 during David Moyes’ first spell in charge. Only at Man Utd, Liverpool, Arsenal, and Chelsea have they ever had longer winless away runs in the competition.

programme.title: Fulham vs Arsenal - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini match
programme.desc: Fulham have only won one of their last 14 Premier League games against Arsenal, a 2-1 victory in December 2023. Indeed, the Cottagers have conceded at least once in each of their last 20 against the Gunners in the competition. After winning five successive league visits to Fulham from 2012-13 to 2022-23, Arsenal have since failed to win at Craven Cottage in both of the last two campaigns. The Gunners last failed to win more consecutive league visits to Fulham in April 1962.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Manchester United - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini match
programme.desc: Liverpool have lost just one of their last 14 Premier League meetings with Manchester United, a 1-2 defeat at Old Trafford in August 2022. Indeed, since the start of 2018-19, this is the fewest defeats any side to face the Red Devils 3+ times in the competition has had against them. Manchester United are winless in their last nine Premier League games at Anfield since a 1-0 win in January 2016 under Louis van Gaal. Liverpool could become just the second side to avoid defeat in 10+ successive Premier League home games against the Red Devils, after Chelsea.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Everton - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini match
programme.desc: Manchester City are unbeaten in their last 16 Premier League meetings with Everton since a 0-4 defeat at Goodison Park in January 2017. Only against Fulham, West Brom, and West Ham are the Citizens currently on a longer unbeaten run in the competition. Everton are winless in their last 14 away Premier League games against Manchester City since a 2-1 victory in December 2010 during David Moyes’ first spell in charge. Only at Man Utd, Liverpool, Arsenal, and Chelsea have they ever had longer winless away runs in the competition.

programme.title: Fulham vs Arsenal - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini match
programme.desc: Fulham have only won one of their last 14 Premier League games against Arsenal, a 2-1 victory in December 2023. Indeed, the Cottagers have conceded at least once in each of their last 20 against the Gunners in the competition. After winning five successive league visits to Fulham from 2012-13 to 2022-23, Arsenal have since failed to win at Craven Cottage in both of the last two campaigns. The Gunners last failed to win more consecutive league visits to Fulham in April 1962.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Manchester United - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini match
programme.desc: Liverpool have lost just one of their last 14 Premier League meetings with Manchester United, a 1-2 defeat at Old Trafford in August 2022. Indeed, since the start of 2018-19, this is the fewest defeats any side to face the Red Devils 3+ times in the competition has had against them. Manchester United are winless in their last nine Premier League games at Anfield since a 1-0 win in January 2016 under Louis van Gaal. Liverpool could become just the second side to avoid defeat in 10+ successive Premier League home games against the Red Devils, after Chelsea.

programme.title: Brighton and Hove Albion vs Newcastle United - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8
programme.desc: Brighton have never lost in eight Premier League home games against Newcastle United. Indeed, the Magpies are the only side to visit Brighton 5+ times in the competition without ever winning. Newcastle United have won just two of their 16 Premier League games against Brighton, a win rate of 13% - their lowest ratio against any side they have faced 3+ times in the competition.

programme.title: Toulouse vs Metz - French Ligue 1 2025/2026 Week 8
programme.desc: Toulouse have won 64% of their home matches against Metz in Ligue 1, their highest winning ratio against any opponent they have hosted at least 20 times in the top-flight. Toulouses matches have produced 23 goals in Ligue 1 2025/26, the highest tally for TFC after seven matches in a Ligue 1 season since 1985/86.

programme.desc: The Turkish Super Lig is the top-flight competition of the Turkish football league system and is live and exclusive on beIN SPORTS. programme.title: Chelsea vs Benfica - UEFA Champions League 2025/26 - MD2
programme.desc: Chelsea have won all four of their competitive meetings with Benfica, with the most recent of those coming earlier this year at the FIFA Club World Cup. This will be the first meeting between Chelsea and Benfica in the group/league phase of a competition, with the previous four all having come in the knockout stages: UEFA Champions League quarter-finals in 2011-12, UEFA Europa League final in 2012-13 and the FIFA Club World Cup last 16 earlier this year.

programme.title: Napoli vs Sporting Clube de Portugal - UEFA Champions League 2025/26 - MD2
programme.desc: The two previous meetings between Napoli and Sporting CP have both finished 0-0, with both coming in the first round of the 1989-90 UEFA Cup first round. Napoli have won all four of their UEFA Champions League matches against Portuguese sides, beating Benfica twice in 2016-17 and Braga twice in 2023-24.

programme.title: Race - Qiddiya Round - Extreme H World Cup 2025
programme.desc: Extreme H World Cup hits Qiddiya for a desert race. Hydrogen-powered Pioneer 25 SUVs face Time Trials, head-to-head heats, and a multi-car Grand Final, with energy management, tyre wear and route choice deciding positions. Expect dunes, dust and daring passes under the Tuwaiq cliffs, driver switches, and strategy on boost usage as teams chase points, manufacturer bragging rights and momentum in the sport’s new zero-emissions era. Broadcast highlights and on-board shots bring the action home.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Manchester United - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini match
programme.desc: Liverpool have lost just one of their last 14 Premier League meetings with Manchester United, a 1-2 defeat at Old Trafford in August 2022. Liverpool could become just the second side to avoid defeat in 10+ successive Premier League home games against the Red Devils, after Chelsea.

programme.title: Chartres vs PSG - LNH Division 1 - French Handball Starligue
programme.desc: Dive into the excitement of French handball with Liqui Moly Starligue, formerly LNH Division 1. Established in 1952, this premier league event features 16 top teams battling for glory. With Montpellier’s 14 Handball titles and Paris Saint-Germains 11 wins, the competition is fierce. Champions earn spots in the EHF Champions League, while cup winners qualify for the European League.

programme.title: al arabi VS al duhail - Qatar Stars League 2025/26 - w5 / Al Arabi vs Al Duhail - Qatar Stars League 2025/26 - W5
programme.desc: The Qatari League is the official football league in Qatar. The league includes 12 teams. The most famous participating clubs are Al-Sadd, the champions of the last season; Al-Rayyan and Al-Arabi, the popular teams, Al-Duhail and Al-Gharafa, serious contenders for the title every season. Football: WWIN Liga BIH: Sloga - Zrinjski / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Sloga - Zrinjski
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league got a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 teams compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and the Survival League. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Železničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league: Cedevita Olimpija - Zadar / Košarka - ABA liga: Cedevita Olimpija - Zadar
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: They live for football / Oni žive za fudbal
programme.desc: A show for all fans of this sport, who are fed up with industrial, high-budget football, for those who are fed up with tactics and games without goals. Emisija će pratiti utakmice koje se igraju u trećem rangu fudbalskog takmičenja u Srbiji. Svake nedelje predstavićemo po jednu utakmicu iz sve četiri grupe srpske lige, čućemo zanimljive intervjue i videti interesantne priloge.

programme.title: We live for basketball / Mi živimo za košarku

programme.title: Football: WWIN Liga BIH: Široki Brijeg - Rudar / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Široki Brijeg - Rudar
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league got a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 teams compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and the Survival League. programme.title: Football - Croatian League: Dinamo - Osijek / Fudbal - Hrvatska liga: Dinamo - Osijek
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Zagreb's Dinamo won it the most times. The absolute record holder for the number of goals scored is Varteksa legend Davor Vugrinec with 144 goals. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se menjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prelazni kup namenjen prvaku delo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo. Apsolutni rekorder po broju postignutih pogodaka legenda je Varteksa Davor Vugrinec sa 144 gola.

programme.desc: An entertainment show whose goal is to cheer up families across the country, offer them a helping hand, and make dreams come true for individuals. / Zabavna oddaja, katere cilj je razveseljevati družine po državi, jim ponuditi roko pomoči, posameznikom uresničiti sanje.

programme.title: Ulice San Francisca
programme.desc: An experienced San Francisco cop teams up with a daring young detective. Although their methods are radically different, this duo is very successful in solving cases. / Izkušeni policist iz San Francisca se združi z drznim mladim detektivom. Čeprav se njune metode radikalno razlikujejo, je ta dvojec zelo uspešen pri reševanju primerov.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Bonanza series takes place around 1860 in Nevada. Ben Cartwright lives with his three sons on the Ponderosa Ranch near Virginia City on the shores of Lake Tahoe. / Serija Bonanza se dogaja okoli leta 1860 v Nevadi.Ben Cartwright skupaj s tremi sinovi živi na ranču Ponderosa v bližini mesta Virginia City ob obali jezera Tahoe.

programme.title: Samra
programme.desc: A telenovela about love and suffering, about injustices and differences in society, about the intertwining of tradition and modernity, about poverty and wealth. / Telenovela o ljubezni in trpljenju, o nepravičnostih in razlikah v družbi, o prepletu tradicije in sodobnosti, o revščini in bogastvu.

programme.title: Kapsula
programme.desc: The Kapsula show presents the latest fashion trends for the young and the young at heart. Every day a new offer and a large selection of different clothes, fashion accessories, shoes and jewelry. / V oddaji Kapsula so predstavljeni najnovejši modni trendi za mlade in mlade po srcu.Vsak dan nova ponudba in velika izbira različnih oblačil, modnih dodatkov, čevljev in nakita.

programme.desc: Live TV sales of clothes. / TV prodaja oblačil v živo.

programme.title: Klepet ob kavi
programme.desc: Open the treasury of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer teaches together with interesting guests in the show Klepet ob kava. In each show, they discuss several current topics related to health, personal growth and spirituality. The creators of the show are also researchers who devote themselves to both old wisdom and modern approaches. They believe in good stories and exceptional people, so in every show we will be able to listen to interesting personalities and their experiences and life stories. / Odprite zakladnico zanimivih zamisli, idej in informacij, ki jih Jasmina Kandorfer predaja skupaj z zanimivimi gosti v oddaji Klepet ob kavi. V vsaki oddaji obravnavajo več aktualnih tematik, ki se navezujejo na zdravje, osebnostno rast in duhovnost. Ustvarjalci oddaje so hkrati raziskovalci, ki se posvečajo tako starim modrostim kot sodobnim pristopom. Verjamejo v dobre zgodbe in izjemne ljudi, zato bomo v vsaki oddaji lahko prisluhnili zanimivim osebnostim ter njihovim izkušnjam in življenjskim zgodbam.

programme.title: Laughter is not a sin / Smeh ni greh
programme.desc: The hidden camera will put passers-by in uncomfortable positions and the audience will laugh to the point of tears at their reactions. Can you imagine being scared by a spider, snake, rat or gorilla? How would you react if you saw a grandpa stealing? Have you ever experienced an unexpected splash of water? / Mimoidoče bo skrita kamera spravila v nelagodne položaje in gledalci se bodo do solz nasmejali njihovim odzivom.Si lahko predstavljate, da vas prestraši pajek, kača, podgana ali gorila? Kako bi odreagirali, če bi zagledali dedka, ki krade? Ste že kdaj doživeli, da vas nepričakovano zalije curek vode?

programme.title: Football (M): Koper - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Koper - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.desc: In the preparatory period between seasons and before major competitions, clubs and national teams maintain their form by playing friendly matches. programme.title: Football (M): Koper - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Koper - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Koper - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Koper - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Futsal: Friendly match: Croatia - Slovenia / Futsal: Prijateljska tekma: Hrvaška - Slovenija
programme.desc: In the preparatory period between seasons and before major competitions, clubs and national teams maintain their form by playing friendly matches. Watch a friendly match of futsal, also known as futsal, played on a smaller pitch, usually indoors. Two teams with five players each compete against each other, and the coaches will have the opportunity to test their form and play different tactical variants of defense and attack. / V pripravljalnem obdobju med sezonama in pred velikimi tekmovanji klubi in reprezentance vzdržujejo formo z igranjem prijateljskih tekem. Oglejte si prijateljsko tekmo v futsalu, znanem tudi pod imenom mali nogomet, ki se igra na manjšem igrišču, ponavadi v dvorani. Med seboj se pomerita ekipi s po petimi igralci, trenerji pa bodo dobili priložnost preizkusiti njihovo formo in uigravati različne taktične variante obrambe in napada.

programme.title: Football (M): Koper - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Koper - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. programme.desc: The architect decided to buy an apartment in Trieste because life in the seaside city is close to her, and in addition, real estate prices there are more bearable than in Slovenia. From an old apartment with furniture from the 70s of the last century, she has created a bright, colorful home with a unique atmosphere through renovation. On a sunny slope, he will reveal to us the importance of water motifs, present a rich collection of cacti and highlight the plant peculiarities that give the park its unique charm. / Za nakup stanovanja v Trstu se je arhitektka odločila, ker ji je življenje v obmorskem mestu blizu, poleg tega pa so tamkajšnje cene nepremičnin znosnejše kot v Sloveniji. Iz postaranega stanovanja z opremo iz 70. let prejšnjega stoletja je s prenovo ustvarila svetel, barvit dom z edinstvenim vzdušjem.Znova se odpravljamo v Zeleni raj nad Litijo, kjer nas bo lastnik Miha Kos popeljal skozi slikovit rastlinski park na 600 metrih nadmorske višine. Na sončnem pobočju nam bo razkril pomen vodnih motivov, predstavil bogato zbirko kaktusov in izpostavil rastlinske posebnosti, ki parku dajejo edinstven čar.

From Klanc to Klanc, cycling challenge with Tadej Pogačar, reportage / S Klanca v klanc, kolesarski izziv s Tadejem Pogačarjem, reportaža
programme.desc: At the end of a new exceptional season, in which he won the race in France for the fourth time and added the titles of world and European champion, the world's number one cyclist set a special challenge to the fans: to compete with him on the climb from his hometown Klanc pri Komenda to Plaža na Krvavac. The "home" slope on Krvavec is an important part of his preparations for the season. The response was extraordinary: cyclists from as many as 36 countries participated in the first edition of Pogačar's challenge. Cycling with the best in the world is simply a priceless experience. / Prvi kolesar sveta je za konec nove izjemne sezone, v kateri je že četrtič osvojil dirko po Franciji ter temu dodal še naslova svetovnega in evropskega prvaka, navijačem postavil poseben izziv: da se z njim pomerijo na vzponu od njegovega domačega Klanca pri Komendi do Plaže na Krvavcu. »Hišni« klanec na Krvavec je pomemben del njegovih priprav na sezono. Odziv je bil izjemen: na prvi izvedbi Pogačarjevega izziva so bili kolesarji iz kar 36 držav. Kolesariti z najboljšim na svetu je enostavno neprecenljivo doživetje.

programme.title: Schonbrunn Summer Concert 2025, Vienna Philharmonic, Piotr Beczała and Tugan Sokiev, Mon. / Poletni koncert iz Schonbrunna 2025, Dunajski filharmoniki, Piotr Beczała in Tugan Sokijev, pon.
programme.desc: The summer concert in the picturesque castle gardens of Schonbrunn Palace in Vienna is one of the world's most popular outdoor music events. Schonbrunn Park is otherwise a protected area and is usually closed in the evening; it is opened to the public only once a year, for the summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic, which has been playing there since 2004. This time the conductor is in the hands of Tugan Sokijev, and the Vienna Boys' Choir, founded by Slovenian bishop, choirmaster and composer Jurij Slatkonja, also performs for the first time at the concert. The famous Polish tenor Piotr Bezcała will perform as a soloist, and the concert program once again offers popular classical music from different eras. / Poletni koncert v slikovitih grajskih vrtovih dvorca Schonbrunn na Dunaju je eden izmed najbolj priljubljenih svetovnih glasbenih dogodkov na prostem. Park Schonbrunn je sicer zaščiteno območje in je zvečer navadno zaprt; za javnost ga odprejo le enkrat letno, za poletni koncert Dunajskih filharmonikov, ki tam igrajo že vse od leta 2004. Taktirka je tokrat v rokah Tugana Sokijeva, na koncertu pa prvič nastopa tudi Zbor dunajskih dečkov, ki ga je ustanovil slovenski škof, zborovodja in skladatelj Jurij Slatkonja. Kot solist bo nastopil sloviti poljski tenorist Piotr Bezcała, program koncerta pa vnovič ponuja priljubljeno klasično glasbo različnih obdobij.

programme.title: Asia: The Frozen North, British documentary series, 3/7 / Azija: Zamrznjeni sever, britanska dokumentarna serija, 3/7
programme.sub-title: Asia; The documentary series Asia explores the extraordinary nature and natural wonders of the largest continent on Earth. It takes us through the most stunning Asian landscapes - from the world's highest peaks in the Himalayas to the jungles of Borneo, from the polar wilderness of Siberia to coral reefs. / Asia; Dokumentarna serija Azija raziskuje izjemno naravo in naravna čudesa največje celine na Zemlji. Popelje nas skozi najosupljivejše azijske pokrajine – od najvišjih vrhov sveta v Himalaji do džungel Bornea, od polarne divjine Sibirije do koralnih mo
programme.desc: Part 3: The Frozen North In North Asia, life defies extreme conditions. In Lake Baikal, seal pups must learn to swim under the ice at an early age. Hokkaido's hot springs shelter dancing cranes. In Tibet, for a lone Himalayan wolf, every hunt is a test of endurance, and in Japan, bats hibernate right under the snow. In Arctic Russia, starving polar bears wait longer and longer on desolate shores for the sea to freeze again. ASIA / Great Britain / 2024 / Director: Henry M Mix. / 3. del: Zamrznjeni severV severni Aziji življenje kljubuje skrajnim razmeram. V Bajkalskem jezeru se morajo tjulnji mladiči že zgodaj naučiti plavati pod ledom. Topli vrelci na Hokaidu dajejo zavetje plešočim žerjavom. V Tibetu je za osamljenega himalajskega volka vsak lov preizkušnja vzdržljivosti, na Japonskem pa netopirji prezimujejo kar pod snegom. V arktični Rusiji sestradani severni medvedi na pustih obalah čedalje dlje čakajo, da bo morje spet zaledenelo. ASIA / Velika Britanija / 2024 / Režija: Henry M Mix.

programme.title: Heads Up - The Glorious History of the Blue Pill: Fat Earnings UK Documentary Series 2/2 Mon. / Glavo pokonci – veličastna zgodovina modre tabletke: Mastni zaslužki, britanska dokumentarna serija, 2/2, pon.
programme.sub-title: Keeping It Up; The documentary series chronicles the discovery and development of Viagra, the first pill to treat erectile dysfunction, which, a quarter of a century ago, is considered by many to have caused a second sexual revolution comparable to the invention of the birth control pill. Pharmacist / Keeping It Up; Dokumentarna serija prikazuje odkritje in razvoj viagre, prve tablete za zdravljenje motnje erekcije, ki je pred četrt stoletja po mnenju mnogih povzročila drugo spolno revolucijo, primerljivo z iznajdbo kontracepcijskih tablet. Farmacevt
programme.desc: Part 2: Big Money When Viagra hit the market in 1998, it became the best-selling and most counterfeited drug of all time. According to some estimates, the counterfeiters even earned more from it than the manufacturer, the pharmaceutical giant Pfizer. After a few years, as competing drugs emerged, Pfizer's market share declined. TV commercials featuring celebrities, politicians and athletes promoting Viagra didn't help either. Pfizer resorted to bribing doctors and therefore paid a billion fine in the United States. However, this was low compared to the profit Viagra brought to the manufacturer. In the last decade, viagra has become a tool that many people use for fun and no longer for the treatment of erectile dysfunction, for which it was originally intended. KEEPING IT UP / Great Britain / 2023 / Director: Stephen Bennett. / 2. del: Mastni zaslužkiKo je viagra leta 1998 prišla na trg, je postala najbolj prodajano in najpogosteje ponarejano zdravilo vseh časov. Ponarejevalci so po nekaterih ocenah z njo zaslužili celo več kot proizvajalec, farmacevtski velikan Pfizer. Po nekaj letih, ko so se pojavila konkurenčna zdravila, se je Pfizerjev tržni delež zmanjšal. Pomagali niso niti televizijski oglasi, v katerih so viagro oglaševale znane osebnosti, politiki in športniki. Pfizer se je zatekel k podkupovanju zdravnikov in zato v Združenih državah Amerike plačal milijardno kazen. Vendar je bila ta nizka glede na dobiček, ki ga je viagra prinesla proizvajalcu. V zadnjem desetletju je viagra postala pripomoček, ki ga mnogi uporabljajo za zabavo in ne več za zdravljenje motnje erekcije, čemur je bila sprva namenjena.KEEPING IT UP / Velika Britanija / 2023 / Režija: Stephen Bennett.

programme.desc: While autumn celebrates abundance with color, we notice the brilliant purple fruits of the American dyehouse. Vanes Husić will explain which fruit species can be used to replace a dug-up tree, as we do not plant the same species in the same place. FIG CHEŽANA Even though we have already picked most of the fruit, for example, persimmons are still ripening in October, with a lot of luck we will find another perfect fig. For the winter, figs can be frozen, dried or made into jam, marmalade, even čežana and cheese. SABINA - DECORATION Decorating homes for Halloween is an opportunity to get creative by carving scary figures out of pumpkins. Pumpkin can be made in other ways, Dr. By the way, Sabina Šegula also makes a cute spider. / Medtem ko jesen z barvami praznuje obilje, opazimo sijoče vijoličaste plodove ameriške barvilnice. Zelnata trajnica, nekoč okras v parkih, zdaj invazivno zarašča robove gozdov. Več o njej z Meto Pivec iz Botaničnega vrta Univerze v Mariboru. PRAVILNO SAJENJE SADNIH DREVESZ Metrobovim strokovnjakom smo tokrat iz sadnega vrta odstranili obolelo jablano. Vanes Husić bo razložil, s katero sadno vrsto lahko nadomestimo izkopano drevo, saj iste vrste ne sadimo na isto mesto. Sabina Šegula pa mimogrede naredi še prikupnega pajka.

programme.title: S-prehodi: Martina Piko-Rustia, direktorica Slovenskega narodopisnega inštituta Urban Jarnik iz Celovca
programme.desc: Today's guest is Martina Piko-Rustia, director of the Slovenian Ethnological Institute Urban Jarnik in Klagenfurt. The scientific institution is named after a popular priest and fighting figure of the literary and national revival from Ziljska dolina. In addition to poems and studying the history of Carinthia, he also wrote about the autochthonousness of Slovenes in Carinthia. He provided the first historical and social analysis of the causes of the decline of Slovenian life in Carinthia. He also signed the first dialectological treatise on the Carinthian Slovenian dialects entitled "The face of the Slovenian dialect in Carinthia". / Današnja gostja je Martina Piko-Rustia, direktorica Slovenskega narodopisnega inštituta Urban Jarnik v Celovcu. Znanstvena ustanova je poimenovana po priljubljenem duhovniku in borbeni osebnosti literarnega in narodnega preporoda iz Ziljske doline. Poleg pesmi in proučevanja koroške zgodovine je pisal tudi o avtohtonosti Slovencev na Koroškem. Podal je prvo zgodovinsko in družbeno analizo vzrokov za nazadovanje slovenskega življa na Koroškem. Podpisuje pa tudi prvo dialektološko razpravo o koroških slovenskih narečjih z naslovom »Obraz slovenskega narečja u Koruškoj«.

programme.title: Ah, these years!: Life in the countryside, Mon. / Ah, ta leta!: Življenje na podeželju, pon.
programme.sub-title: Some of us swear by life in the middle of the city bustle, while others prefer the peace of the countryside and nature. Today we will move from the city to the village and discover old traditions, the dynamics of relations between people and the good sides of the rural way of life. / Nekateri prisegamo na življenje sredi mestnega vrveža, spet drugi imamo raje mir podeželja in narave. Mi se bomo danes preselili iz mesta na vas in tam odkrivali stare tradicije, dinamiko odnosov med ljudmi in dobre plati podeželskega načina življenja.
programme.desc: In the section Ah, this web! we will present the concept of smart villages, and the show will be rounded off with a quiz on the knowledge of generations. / V rubriki Ah, ta splet! bomo predstavili koncept pametnih vasi, oddajo pa zaokrožili s kvizom (Spo)znanje generacij.

programme.title: Concert of the Ljubljana Mandolin Orchestra, conductor Andrej Zupan, Mon. / Koncert Orkestra Mandolina Ljubljana, dirigent Andrej Zupan, pon.
programme.desc: R: Levstik Nejc... Orkester Mandolina Ljubljana is one of the few, but certainly the most recognizable mandolin ensembles, which has been working very successfully in our area for four decades. The mandolin is a delicate stringed instrument that is very rarely included in a wide variety of musical genres and ensembles, and the Ljubljana Mandolin Orchestra tries to do just that with its creation. He presents to the audience compositions of various musical genres, from classical and world music to popular, rock and film music in arrangements for mandolin. At a concert in the full Gallus hall of Cankarjev dom, he presented a selection of compositions under the baton of the established conductor and clarinetist Andrej Zupan. He was joined on stage by a guest, the singer of the popular rock band Big Foot Mama. / R: Levstik Nejc... Orkester Mandolina Ljubljana je ena redkih, vsekakor pa najbolj prepoznavnih mandolinskih zasedb, ki v našem prostoru zelo uspešno deluje že štiri desetletja. Mandolina je nežno strunsko glasbilo, ki je zelo redko vključeno v najrazličnejše glasbene zvrsti in zasedbe, Orkester Mandolina Ljubljana pa s svojim ustvarjanjem preizkuša prav to. Občinstvu predstavlja skladbe različnih glasbenih žanrov, od klasične in svetovne glasbe do popularne, rockovske in filmske glasbe v priredbah za mandoline. Na koncertu v polni Gallusovi dvorani Cankarjevega doma je predstavil izbor skladb pod taktirko uveljavljenega dirigenta in klarinetista Andreja Zupana. Na odru se mu je pridružil gost, pevec popularne rockovske zasedbe Big Foot Mama.

The same day in the afternoon, a meeting of the Slovenes of Porabi took place, as part of which two deserving persons received the award of the State Slovenian Self-Government "For Slovenes in Hungary". At the end of the show, we present the 8th Days of Slovenian Film in Sombotel, where the screening of of the feature film It's a Robbery! followed by a conversation with the director and the main actress. / V nadaljevanju sledi prispevek o Škofijskem narodnostnem srečanju, ki so ga letos priredili Slovenci, in sicer v Monoštru. Po štirijezičnem bogoslužju sombotelskega škofa so se pri Slovenskem domu narodnostne skupnosti predstavile s kulturnim programom.Še isti dan v popoldanskih urah se je odvijalo Srečanje porabskih Slovencev, v sklopu katerega sta priznanje Državne slovenske samouprave »Za Slovence na Madžarskem« prejeli dve zaslužni osebi.Ob koncu oddaje predstavljamo še 8. Dneve slovenskega filma v Sombotelu, kjer je projekciji slovenskega celovečernega filma To je rop! sledil pogovor z režiserjem in glavno igralko.

programme.title: Down the Danube with Joanna Lumley, British documentary series, 3/4, Mon. / Po Donavi z Joanno Lumley, britanska dokumentarna serija, 3/4, pon.
programme.sub-title: Joanna Lumley's Danube: Europe's Mightiest River; In this four-part series, Joanna Lumley takes us on an epic journey through the heart of Europe along the world's most international river, the Danube. From its source in the Black Forest in Germany all the way to its mouth on the coast of the Black Sea / Joanna Lumleys Danube: Europes Mightiest River; Joanna Lumley nas v tej štiridelni seriji popelje na epsko potovanje po osrčju Evrope vzdolž najbolj mednarodne reke na svetu, Donave. Od izvira v Črnem gozdu v Nemčiji pa vse do ustja na obali Črnega morj
programme.desc: Part 3: Joanna Lumley continues her adventure along the largest European river in Hungary and Romania. In Budapest, the pearl of the Danube, he explores the river by boat and rides a unique children's railway, while discovering the city's Jewish heritage. In the Great Hungarian Plain, she meets pirates who clean the rivers of plastic waste, and the last csikos, traditional cowboys, who show her their incredible riding skills. In the beautiful Romanian landscape of Transylvania, he meets Dracula, follows a brown bear and spends the night in a charming guest house owned by the English King Charles III. JOANNA LUMLEYS DANUBE: EUROPE'S MIGHTIEST RIVER / Great Britain / 2025 / Director: Eric McFarland. / 3. del:Joanna Lumley na Madžarskem in v Romuniji nadaljuje svojo pustolovščino ob največji evropski reki. V Budimpešti, biseru Donave, reko raziskuje z ladjo in se pelje z edinstveno otroško železnico, obenem pa odkriva judovsko dediščino mesta. V Veliki madžarski nižini spozna gusarje, ki reke čistijo plastičnih odpadkov, in zadnje csikose, tradicionalne kavboje, ki ji pokažejo svoje neverjetne jahalne veščine. V čudoviti romunski pokrajini Transilvaniji pa se sreča z Drakulo, sledi rjavim medvedom in prenoči v očarljivem gostišču, ki je v lasti angleškega kralja Karla III.JOANNA LUMLEYS DANUBE: EUROPES MIGHTIEST RIVER / Velika Britanija / 2025 / Režija: Eric McFarland.

programme.title: Ivan and Karla, feature-documentary film, Mon. / Ivan in Karla, igrano-dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Alma Lapajne... The feature-documentary film Ivan in Karla opens a view of the relationship between the writer Ivan Mrak and his wife, the sculptor Karla Bulovec. / R: Alma Lapajne... Igrano-dokumentarni film Ivan in Karla odpira pogled na razmerje med pisateljem Ivanom Mrakom in njegovo ženo kiparko Karlo Bulovec.
programme.desc: It is impossible to present Mrak without presenting his commitment to Bulovčeva, who upset her narrow-minded contemporaries both with her perfect artistic talent and with the fact that she spent more than half of her life with Mrak. Of course, the reverse is also true. Even Karla's life is revealed to us as a whole only if we take the right to look through Mrak's glasses. Their coexistence was also a mutual artistic exchange through the most lyrical medium: love. Where are the intersections where they touch each other? Where are the alienations and the cold days of solitude? Why do they run away and keep coming back? The filmmakers were looking for answers to these questions and found ourselves on the edge of a torrent that is steadily flowing away: laughter and crying, strength and weakness, nakedness and veiling. Karla Bulovec: "It's the devil in me. God help me! Torn and raging, I can't find peace anywhere and in anything, not even for a moment, but I want it so badly. I have to have changes every moment." Ivan Mrak: "The masculine principle is dominant in Karla just as it is in me, so we don't find ourselves in everyday life in any way. We were not looking for two halves, the surprising whole was horrified to recognize itself in the inscrutable whole. That's how we became brother and sister - but just like in ancient times, when incest was not yet blasphemy." At the end of the story, we didn't ask how Ivan the Dark endured loneliness after Karla's death. If two people mean as much to each other as they did to each other, the departure of one of them is an unfilled pit for the rest. They were different and above all their own. The film narrative was directed by Alma Lapajne. / Predstaviti Mraka ni mogoče, ne da bi predstavili njegove zavezanosti Bulovčevi, ki je svoje ozkosrčne sodobnike razburjala tako s popolnim umetniškim talentom kot tudi s tem, da je več kot polovico svojega življenja prehodila z Mrakom.Seveda velja tudi obratno. Tudi Karlino življenje se nam odkrije kot celota samo, če si vzamemo pravico pogledati skozi Mrakova očala. Njuno sobivanje je bilo hkrati tudi medsebojno umetniško oplajanje skozi najbolj liričen medij: ljubezen.Kje so presečišča, kjer se dotikata drug drugega? Kje so odtujenosti in hladni dnevi samote? Zakaj bežita in se vedno znova vrneta? Ustvarjalci filma smo iskali odgovore na ta vprašanja in se znašli na produ hudournika, ki vztrajno odplavlja: smeh in jok, moč in šibkost, goloto in zakritost.Karla Bulovec: »Je to hudič v meni. Bog mi pomagaj! Razrvana in divja, da prav nikjer in v ničemer ne najdem miru, niti za trenutek, pa si ga tako želim. Vsak moment moram imeti spremembe.«Ivan Mrak: »Moški princip je prevladujoč pri Karli tako kot pri meni, zato se nikakor ne znajdeva v vsakdanjosti. V naju se nista iskali dve polovici, presenetljiva celost se je zgroženo prepoznala v nedoumljivi celosti. Tako sva postala brat in sestra – a tako, kot v pradobi, ko incest še ni bil bogoskrunstvo.« Na koncu zgodbe se nismo vprašali, kako je Ivan Mrak prenesel samoto po Karlini smrti. Če si dva človeka pomenita toliko kot sta si pomenila ona, je odhod enega izmed njiju preostalemu nezasuta jama.Bila sta drugačna in predvsem svoja. Filmsko pripoved je režirala Alma Lapajne.

programme.title: S-passes: Martina Piko-Rustia, director of the Slovenian Ethnographic Institute Urban Jarnik from Klagenfurt, Mon. / S-prehodi: Martina Piko-Rustia, direktorica Slovenskega narodopisnega inštituta Urban Jarnik iz Celovca, pon.
programme.desc: Today's guest is Martina Piko-Rustia, director of the Slovenian Ethnological Institute Urban Jarnik in Klagenfurt. The scientific institution is named after a popular priest and fighting figure of the literary and national revival from Ziljska dolina. In addition to poems and studying the history of Carinthia, he also wrote about the autochthonousness of Slovenes in Carinthia. He provided the first historical and social analysis of the causes of the decline of Slovenian life in Carinthia. He also signed the first dialectological treatise on the Carinthian Slovenian dialects entitled "The face of the Slovenian dialect in Carinthia". / Današnja gostja je Martina Piko-Rustia, direktorica Slovenskega narodopisnega inštituta Urban Jarnik v Celovcu. Znanstvena ustanova je poimenovana po priljubljenem duhovniku in borbeni osebnosti literarnega in narodnega preporoda iz Ziljske doline. Poleg pesmi in proučevanja koroške zgodovine je pisal tudi o avtohtonosti Slovencev na Koroškem. Podal je prvo zgodovinsko in družbeno analizo vzrokov za nazadovanje slovenskega življa na Koroškem. Podpisuje pa tudi prvo dialektološko razpravo o koroških slovenskih narečjih z naslovom »Obraz slovenskega narečja u Koruškoj«.

programme.title: Osmi and, pound. / Osmi dan, pon.
programme.desc: We saw the exhibition on the 80th anniversary of the Archive of the Republic of Slovenia, which has become the central guardian of the Slovenian archival heritage and thus collective memory. With the exhibition in the Archive, among other things, they highlight the crucial, but often ignored, role of this institution in modern society. In the studio, we will host film editor Janez Briclj, who will receive the Milka and Metod Badjure Lifetime Achievement Award at the upcoming Slovenian Film Festival in Portorož. We also watched the first puppet animated feature film for children, which has a Slovenian director and producer. Tales from the Magic Garden is a film that presents the theme of loss and mourning through magical narratives. It was created in collaboration with Czech, Slovak and French authors, and we talked to Slovenian creators about the interesting process of creation, which is also shown at the exhibition in the Slovenian Cinematheque. We also spoke with one of the most important European authors who create in the field of comics and animation, Benjamin Renner. Lightness, sincere humor and the ability to appeal to adults with childish playfulness, among other things, are also distinguished by his best-known animated feature film Ernest and Celestina, which won the César Award and was nominated for an Oscar. / Ogledali smo si razstavo ob osemdesetletnici delovanja Arhiva Republike Slovenije, ki je postal osrednji varuh slovenske arhivske dediščine in s tem tudi kolektivnega spomina. Z razstavo v Arhivu med drugim poudarjajo ključno, a velikokrat prezrto vlogo te ustanove v sodobni družbi. V studiu bomo gostili filmskega montažerja Janeza Briclja, ki bo na prihajajočem Festivalu slovenskega filma v Portorožu prejel nagrado Milke in Metoda Badjure za življenjsko delo. Ogledali smo si tudi prvi lutkovni animirani celovečerni film za otroke, ki ima slovenskega režiserja in producenta. Zgodbe iz čarobnega vrta je film, ki skozi magične pripovedi predstavi tematiko izgube in žalovanja. Nastal je v sodelovanju čeških, slovaških in francoskih avtorjev, mi pa smo se o zanimivem procesu ustvarjanja, ki je prikazan tudi na razstavi v Slovenski kinoteki, pogovarjali s slovenskimi ustvarjalci. Pogovarjali smo se še z enim od najpomembnejših evropskih avtorjev, ki ustvarjajo na področju stripa in animacije, Benjaminom Rennerjem. Lahkotnost, iskren humor in sposobnost, da z otroško igrivostjo med drugim nagovori odrasle, odlikujejo tudi njegov najbolj znani animirani celovečerni film Ernest in Celestina, ki je prejel nagrado cezar in nominacijo za oskarja.

To opazi Otto John, vodja druge nemške tajne službe, Zveznega urada za varstvo ustave, ki že dolgo sumi, da Gehlen s svojega položaja pomaga nekdanjim nacističnim zločincem. programme.title: Blues a lestudi
programme.desc: Space that deals a dull blow to the panorama of blues and its variants in Catalonia. One of the key elements of this musical program is that it allows you to see key artists of this genre in their natural areas: the recording studios. / Espai que fa un cop dull al panorama del blues i les seves variants a Catalunya. Un dels elements clau daquest programa musical es que permet veure artistes clau daquest gènere en el seus àmbits naturals: els estudis de gravacio.

programme.title: Jazz a lestudi
programme.desc: Space that deals a dull blow to the panorama of jazz and its variants in Catalonia. One of the key elements of this musical program is that it allows you to see artists such as Dani Nel·lo, Raimundo Amador and Horacio Fumero in their natural areas: the recording studios. / Espai que fa un cop dull al panorama del jazz i les seves variants a Catalunya. programme.title: News 3CatInfo / Notícies 3CatInfo
programme.desc: Information space with news, general information, sports and weather forecast. / Espai informatiu amb notícies dinformacio general, esportiva i previsio meteorològica.

programme.title: Matins
programme.desc: Morning program that gives the keys to the day that begins, explains the news that has happened by providing the context to understand them and analyzes with accredited voices the current affairs nearest and beyond the world. / Programa matinal que dona les claus del dia que comença, explica les notícies que han passat aportant-ne el context per entendre-les i analitza amb veus acreditades lactualitat mes propera i la darreu del mon.

programme.title: Everything is soft / Tot es mou
programme.desc: Helena Garcia Melero runs this daily magazine that follows current affairs, gives voice to the protagonists of the moment and deals with those issues that most closely affect the citizens with a friendly and distracted tone. / Helena Garcia Melero condueix aquest magazín diari que segueix lactualitat, dona veu als protagonistes del moment i tracta aquelles questions que toquen mes de prop els ciutadans amb un to amable i distret.

programme.title: Telenotícies comarques
programme.desc: Daily news, directed and presented by Núria Sole, with local and regional information that highlights the voice of the street, the witnesses and the protagonists of the news. TN Comarques explains and reflects the reality of towns and cities in Catalonia. / Informatiu diari, dirigit i presentat per Núria Sole, amb informacio local i comarcal que posa en valor la veu del carrer, els testimonis i els protagonistes de la notícia. TN Comarques explica i reflecteix la realitat dels pobles i ciutats de Catalunya.

programme.title: Telenotícies migdia
programme.desc: Daily news that includes the most outstanding current events, collected by TVC's news services, with the support of chronicles and connections with correspondents and special envoys around the world. / Informatiu diari que inclou els esdeveniments mes destacats de lactualitat, recollits pels serveis informatius de TVC, amb el suport de les cròniques i les connexions amb els corresponsals i enviats especials arreu del mon.

programme.title: Cuines
programme.desc: Space where chef Marc Ribas offers recipes that anyone can make and with easy-to-find ingredients. In addition, the program has the advice section in which Ribas explains curiosities about the products and tricks to know how to buy better. / Espai en el qual el cuiner Marc Ribas ofereix receptes que tothom pot fer i amb ingredients fàcils de trobar. A mes, el programa compta amb la seccio el consell en la que Ribas explica curiositats dels productes i trucs per saber comprar millor.

programme.title: Cuines
programme.desc: Space where chef Marc Ribas offers recipes that anyone can make and with easy-to-find ingredients. In addition, the program has the advice section in which Ribas explains curiosities about the products and tricks to know how to buy better. / Espai en el qual el cuiner Marc Ribas ofereix receptes que tothom pot fer i amb ingredients fàcils de trobar. A mes, el programa compta amb la seccio el consell en la que Ribas explica curiositats dels productes i trucs per saber comprar millor.

programme.title: Like it was yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of former high school classmates meet again, after twenty-five years, at the funeral of one of them. The time at the high school turned them into a heterogeneous group, hooligans and full of life, but life dealt them very different cards. TV3's new bet on the table, after the end of La Riera, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday takes place in Barcelona and the protagonists live spread over the entire geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d'ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present an everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even funny. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: Ladies' paradise / El paraíso de las señoras
programme.desc: Betrayed by her boyfriend, Teresa leaves the village and flees to the big city. There he discovers that his uncle's store is going through difficulties due to the opening of a large warehouse El Paradís de les Senyores. / Traïda pel seu xicot, Teresa sen va de poble i fuig a la gran ciutat. Allà descobreix que la botiga del seu oncle passa per dificultats a causa de lobertura duns grans magatzems El Paradís de les Senyores.

programme.title: The jungle: Episode 30 / La selva: Episodi 30
programme.desc: Xavier Grasset presents this afternoon magazine in which the current affairs of the day are reviewed in a relaxed way. A meeting full of knowledge and follow-up of the events of the day, but also with a lot of entertainment and with various collaborators. / Xavier Grasset presenta aquest magazín de tardes en el que es fa un repàs a lactualitat del dia de forma distesa. Una trobada plena de coneixement i seguiment dels fets del dia, però tambe amb molt dentreteniment i amb diversos col·laboradors.

programme.title: Atrapam si pots: Episode 184 / Atrapam si pots: Episodi 184
programme.desc: Llucià Ferrer presents this question and answer contest in which six contestants compete to win the pot. The questions cover the whole field of knowledge, focus on trivia and make use of word games and riddles. / Llucià Ferrer presenta aquest concurs de preguntes i respostes en què sis concursants competeixen per guanyar el pot. Les preguntes abasten tot el camp del coneixement, se centren en curiositats i fan ús de jocs de paraules i endevinalles.

programme.title: It's Happening: Episode 30 / Està passant: Episodi 30
programme.desc: Satirical news presented by Òscar Andreu, Jair Dominguez, Natza Farre and Queco Novell, which analyzes the keys to the current affairs of the day. Lespai also gives voice to experts to give their opinion on current events and interview its main protagonists. / Informatiu satíric presentat per Òscar Andreu, Jair Dominguez, Natza Farre i Queco Novell, que analitza les claus de lactualitat del dia. Lespai tambe dona veu a experts perquè donin la seva opinio sobre lactualitat i entrevista els seus principals protagonistes.

programme.title: Telenotícies vespre
programme.desc: Daily information that collects the most outstanding events in the Catalan, national and international sphere. From Monday to Friday, Toni Cruanyes is in charge of presenting the news of the day. / Informatiu diari que recull els esdeveniments mes destacats en làmbit català, estatal i internacional. De dilluns a divendres, Toni Cruanyes es lencarregat de presentar les notícies de la jornada.

programme.title: Aixafa lestafa: Superoferta
programme.desc: A house for 20 euros? A car for 4? If you see an amazing Super Deal. / Una casa per 20 euros? Un cotxe per 4? Si veus una Superoferta increïble.

programme.title: Vintage
programme.desc: While recording the first episode of the podcast, Genís is very uncomfortable, his crotch is very itchy. The doctor tells him that he has a sexually transmitted disease and he endures disgust because he can only have entrusted Pie to him. / Mentre grava el primer episodi del pòdcast, el Genís està molt incòmode, li pica molt lentrecuix. El metge li diu que te una malaltia de transmissio sexual i semporta un disgust perquè nomes li pot haver encomanat la Pie.

programme.title: Vintage
programme.desc: Paco crashes his car after drinking too much at a party, thinking he can still hook up with a young girl. Also, his friend Genís, a Tinder scammer, has his wife steal all the savings from the marriage. / Paco sestimba amb el cotxe despres de beure en exces en una festa, pensant-se que encara pot lligar amb una noia jove. A mes, al seu amic Genís, un estafador del Tinder, li roba la dona tots els estalvis del matrimoni.

programme.title: In the car: Episode 4 / Al cotxe: Episodi 4
programme.desc: Eloi Vila accompanies by car several well-known characters who have participated during the week in TV3 programs. During the journey, converse with them in an intimate way so that the guests can talk about themselves in an informal and spontaneous way. / Eloi Vila acompanya en cotxe a varis personatges coneguts que han participat durant la setmana als programes de TV3. Durant el trajecte, conversa amb ells de forma íntima perquè els convidats puguin parlar d’ells mateixos de manera informal i espontània.

programme.title: Mesnit
programme.desc: Informative space with Marina Romero at the head, which has the will to be a center for debating ideas and analyzing political activity. / Espai informatiu amb Marina Romero al capdavant que te la voluntat de ser un centre de debat didees i danàlisi de lactivitat política.

programme.desc: In Skovde, three masked men rob a watch shop with slag and crowbars, they hit the display stands and then escape on a bicycle. programme.title: Caught on police camera / Fångat på polisens kamera
programme.desc: Police are chasing a van in Haninge that was neglected despite slippery conditions and poor visibility. The driver is under the influence of cannabis and more drugs are found. programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: Detective Inspector William Sommerset takes on his last case before retirement with the help of the recently transferred David Mills. They record a series of elaborate and gruesome murders, which they soon realize were committed by the same perpetrator. / Kriminalinspektor William Sommerset tar sig an sitt sista fall fore pensionen med hjalp av den nyligen forflyttade David Mills. De upptacker en rad utstuderade och ohyggliga mord, som de snart inser ar begångna av samma garningsman.

programme.title: Sommaren med slakten
programme.desc: Carro has believed that Bobo does not have a job and decides to try to trick Bobo into getting a job from a business acquaintance. Jens traffar en så kallad Sverigevan och det blir snart bråk.

programme.title: Sommaren med slakten
programme.desc: Jens and father-in-law Gunnar have to renovate the outhouse, which immediately puts pressure on their already strained relationship. programme.title: House Hunters International
programme.desc: A couple is preparing to move to Malmo to work there. One wants to buy a home while the other prefers to rent first. / Ett par forbereder sig for att flytta till Malmo for att jobba dar. Den ene vill kopa ett hem medan den andra foredrar att hyra forst.

programme.title: House Hunters International
programme.desc: From Denmark to the Dominican Republic. programme.title: Stugdrommar
programme.desc: Jonas and Linda have bought the old painting studio in Boda in northern Öland. programme.desc: A lorry hit the slippery E4 outside Jonkoping. programme.title: Forsta dejten
programme.desc: In addition to a charming teenage couple on a speed date, we meet 62-year-old Stefan, who is a good dancer, but even though he meets ladies on the dance floor, he doesn't want to "hunt at his workplace". After several years of being single, he now longs for twoness. Lena, 62, has stayed in the safe corner of the home for far too long, which has made her feel a little rusty when it comes to dating. When the cautious couple sit down at the bar, it turns out that not only do they have like-minded values, they're pretty much neighbors too, but is it enough for them both to dare to say yes to a second date? Elias, 17, from Gothenburg longs for manhood and already knows what his future child will be called. 17-year-old Molly hasn't planned quite as far ahead, she's more focused on the ogon color of her date. If it turns out that the color is wrong, it can be very problematic with the ogon contact. / Forutom ett charmigt tonårspar på speeddejt moter vi 62-åriga Stefan som ar en duktig dansor, men trots att han traffar damer på dansgolvet vill han inte ”jaga på sin arbetsplats”. Efter flera år som singel langtar han nu efter tvåsamhet. Lena, 62, har stannat i hemmets trygga vrå alldeles for lange vilket gjort att hon kanner sig lite rostig nar det kommer till dejting. Nar det forsiktiga paret satter sig i baren visar det sig inte bara att de har likasinnade varderingar, de ar i stort sett grannar också, men racker det for att de båda ska våga saga ja till en andra dejt? Elias, 17, från Goteborg langtar efter karlek och vet redan vad hans framtida barn ska heta. 17-åriga Molly har inte planerat riktigt lika långt fram i tiden, hon ar mer fokuserad på sin dejts ogonfarg. Visar det sig att fargen ar fel kan det bli mycket problematiskt med ogonkontakten.

Frank smakar sig igenom några av de olika sorterna. Darefter vantar en resa till Svalbard, dar han ska besoka en sakerhetsgenbank dar man forvarar froer från hela varlden. Ett sjalvforsorjande lantbruk som drivs på ett hållbart vis och med gamla metoder ar drommen for Frank och hans familj på Kastanjegården.

programme.title: Married at first sight - The new life / Gift vid forsta ogonkastet – Det nya livet
programme.desc: Jannika and Dennis were welcomed into the experiment when they had almost given up hope of male sex. The path there has been lined with impotence problems, deep wounds from previous relationships, panic attacks and damaged self-images - but their masculinity has only grown stronger! nNow a new everyday life together in Malmo and soon their first child is needed. The hopes are high, but the worries are there: Jannika is in a new city, far from her network, and her previous miscarriage worries her. Dennis has battled panic attacks - but now the big question is whether he is ready to become a father. It will be a sensational continuation of one of GVFÖ's most tested - and strongest - male play stories. / Jannika och Dennis mottes i experimentet nar de nastan hade gett upp hoppet om karlek. Vagen dit har varit kantad av impotensproblem, djupa sår från tidigare relationer, panikångest och stukade sjalvbilder - men deras karlek har bara vuxit sig starkare! nNu vantar en ny vardag tillsammans i Malmo och snart aven deras forsta barn. Forhoppningarna ar stora, men oron finns dar: Jannika ar i en ny stad, långt från sitt natverk, och hennes tidigare missfall gor henne orolig. Dennis har kampat mot panikångesten - men nu ar den stora frågan om han ar redo att bli pappa. Det blir en kanslosam fortsattning på en av GVFÖ:s mest provade - och starkaste - karlekshistorier.

programme.title: Under bar himmel
programme.desc: It is early summer when Markus Torgeby meets the actor Ewa Froling in Roslagen's skargård, for a conversation about the spirituality of life. Ewa is often associated with being belligerent, very funny, and has said that she hates the forest. But does she really do that? / Det ar forsommar nar Markus Torgeby traffar skådespelaren Ewa Froling i Roslagens skargård, for ett samtal om livets andlighet. Ewa forknippas ofta med att vara stridbar, sylvasst rolig, och har sagt att hon hatar skogen. Men gor hon verkligen det?

programme.title: That's how Sweden does drugs / Så knarkar Sverige
programme.desc: What does drug use look like in Sweden? For the first time, data on illegal drugs from all over the country is being compiled in a comprehensive sewer feed. The feeding takes place in 37 Swedish municipalities during a summer weekend in 2025. The focus is on amphetamines and its more expensive butchery cocaine. Addiction researcher Markus Heilig finds out which drugs are the most addictive and what causes some to become addicted and others not. / Hur ser narkotikabruket i Sverige ut? For forsta gången sammanstalls data om olagliga droger från hela landet i en omfattande avloppsmatning. Matningen sker i 37 svenska kommuner under en sommarhelg 2025. Fokus ar amfetamin och dess dyrare slakting kokain. Beroendeforskaren Markus Heilig reder ut vilka droger som ar mest beroendeframkallande och vad som gor att vissa blir beroende och andra inte.

programme.title: The Others
programme.desc: The Second World War has just come to an end and on the desolate island of Jersey, young Grace sits and waits for her husband to come home from the war. She has raised her two children alone in the beautiful and dark Victorian mansion she thought was the only safe place for the children. However, they are no longer safe. The day three new servants appear at the household's staircase, startling things begin to happen. Grace's daughter reports that she has seen, and spoken to, apparitions that come and go in the house. At first, the deeply religious Grace refuses to believe in the child, but after a while she also begins to suspect that an intruder is within the walls of the house. Who is there? And what do they want Grace's family?
