Hon har ensam fostrat sina två barn i den vackra och morka viktorianska herrgård hon trott ar den enda sakra platsen for barnen. De ar dock inte sakra langre. Den dag tre nya tjanare dyker upp vid hushållets trappa borjar hapnadsvackande saker att ske. Graces dotter berattar att hon har sett, och pratat med, uppenbarelser som kommer och går i huset. programme.title: Innocence: opera av Kaija Saariaho
programme.desc: Finnish composer Kaija Saariaho's (1952-2023) opera Innocence took both audiences and critics by storm at its world premiere in Aix-en-Provence in 2021. The libretto, written by renowned author Sofi Oksanen, takes place in two timelines and depicts the shocking account of a school shooting. We hear the London Symphony Orchestra and soloists such as Magdalena Kožena and Sandrine Piau under the direction of conductor Susanna Malkki. The 2025 edition of the world's biggest prize for classical music - the Birgit Nilsson Prize - is awarded to the opera festival in Aix-en-Provence. The award justification emphasizes the festival's outstanding artistic achievements, with special recognition for the 2021 staging of the opera Innocence. The prize will be awarded on 21 October. / Den finlandska kompositoren Kaija Saariahos (1952-2023) opera Innocence tog både publik och kritiker med storm vid sin varldspremiar i Aix-en-Provence 2021. Librettot, skrivet av den beromda forfattaren Sofi Oksanen, utspelas i två tidsplan och skildrar den skakande berattelsen om en skolskjutning. Vi hor London Symphony Orchestra och solister som Magdalena Kožena och Sandrine Piau under ledning av dirigenten Susanna Malkki. 2025 års upplaga av varldens storsta pris for klassisk musik - Birgit Nilsson Prize - tilldelas operafestivalen i Aix-en-Provence. I prismotiveringen betonas festivalens enastående konstnarliga prestationer, med ett sarskilt erkannande for 2021 års uppsattning av just operan Innocence. Priset delas ut den 21 oktober.

programme.title: The Neverending Story - The craziest border in the world / La Storia infinita - Il confine più pazzo del mondo
programme.sub-title: The craziest border in the world / Il confine più pazzo del mondo
programme.desc: A journey along an invisible but very powerful line: the one that divides (and unites) Ticino to Italy. Traced in 1521 and remaining almost unchanged to this day, this frontier is the scene of fascinating and often contradictory stories. From smuggling to cross-border workers, from refugees to spending across the border, up to the paradox of the Campione Casino. For almost five hundred years the border between Ticino and Italy has remained immobile, a line that has resisted time and events. But he was never silent. It is the oldest in Europe, born from a war: the Swiss conquest of Ticino, when by force of arms a frontier was drawn that was destined to last for centuries. Along this line, daily, contradictory and often absurd events have been layered, which together tell the great history of Europe. Here there was a fight for a pasture or a cow. Here the smugglers faced the night with panniers full of coffee and cigarettes, risking their lives to get through the ramina. Armies, refugees, cross-border workers and spies have passed through here, leaving scars and memories. There have been dark pages, such as the rejections during the Second World War, but also light stories, made of cunning and laughter born of fatigue. The border has been a wall and a bridge, a wound and a resource, tragedy and comedy at the same time. A stage spanning five centuries that still shapes our identity today. And to tell the story of its popular soul there is also Davide Van De Sfroos, who with his music and his words returns the ironic and melancholic voice of this frontier. A surprising and anecdotal journey that shows how our identity is not born only from great events, but from all those concrete and paradoxical events that have crossed - and continue to cross - the oldest border in Europe. An episode that intertwines history and legend, memory and irony, to discover while having fun how our border continues to tell who we are. A program by and with Jonas Marti. / Un viaggio lungo una linea invisibile ma potentissima: quella che divide (e unisce) il Ticino allItalia. Tracciata nel 1521 e rimasta quasi immutata fino a oggi, questa frontiera è teatro di storie affascinanti e spesso contraddittorie. Dal contrabbando ai frontalieri, dai profughi alla spesa oltreconfine, fino al paradosso del Casinò di Campione. Per quasi cinquecento anni il confine tra Ticino e Italia è rimasto immobile, una linea che ha resistito al tempo e agli eventi. Ma non è mai stato silenzioso. È il più antico dEuropa, nato da una guerra: la conquista svizzera del Ticino, quando con la forza delle armi fu tracciata una frontiera destinata a durare nei secoli. Su questa linea si sono stratificate vicende quotidiane, contraddittorie e spesso assurde, che insieme raccontano la grande storia dEuropa. Qui si è combattuto per un pascolo o per una mucca. Qui i contrabbandieri hanno affrontato la notte con le gerle piene di caffè e sigarette, rischiando la vita pur di superare la ramina. Qui sono passati eserciti, profughi, frontalieri e spie, lasciando cicatrici e memorie. Ci sono state pagine oscure, come i respingimenti durante la Seconda guerra mondiale, ma anche storie leggere, fatte di astuzie e risate nate dalla fatica. Il confine è stato muro e ponte, ferita e risorsa, tragedia e commedia insieme. Un palcoscenico lungo cinque secoli che ancora oggi plasma la nostra identità. E a raccontarne lanima popolare cè anche Davide Van De Sfroos, che con la sua musica e le sue parole restituisce la voce ironica e malinconica di questa frontiera. Un viaggio sorprendente e aneddotico che mostra come la nostra identità non nasca solo dai grandi eventi, ma da tutte quelle vicende concrete e paradossali che hanno attraversato - e continuano ad attraversare - il confine più antico dEuropa. Una puntata che intreccia storia e leggenda, memoria e ironia, per scoprire divertendosi come il nostro confine continui a raccontare chi siamo. Un programma di e con Jonas Marti.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as executive producer of the show in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious crime writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni.Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: The gold of Rancate by Gaetano Agueci and Maria Roselli Gold has always been considered a safe investment; It's hard to imagine losing ourselves, and yet it happened, of course. Around 800 people spread across Switzerland, Germany and Austria are victims of a large-scale scam, which could cause losses of 84 million francs. At the center of the scam were some characters who had the Canton of Ticino as their base. And right south of the Alps, in Rancate to be precise, the refinery that transformed the raw metal coming from Africa was supposed to operate. Gold that probably never arrived in Ticino. All crazy about gold by Claudio Moschin They sift through the waterways of Lombardy and Piedmont, they know that those streams are rich in specks of gold. On the slopes of Monte Rosa this practice was already in vogue in Roman times, but today, with the prices of the yellow metal at historic highs, enthusiasts are on the increase. For some, the "gold rush" has become almost a fixed activity, while sales of shovels, sieves and washing boards are growing. And obviously there is a championship, with participants coming from all over Europe, to crown the best gold digger of the year. The hotels on Everest by Frank Senn and Jacqueline Schwerzmann Climbing to the top of the highest mountain in the world is no longer something that only interests mountaineers. The number of tourists is growing and with it the related offers; at the base camp, instead of after several days on foot, you can arrive comfortably by helicopter and once you disembark you will find rooms with services worthy of a hotel. A somewhat surreal environment, also told by an Italian-Swiss helicopter pilot who spends part of the year in the Himalayas. / L’oro di Rancate di Gaetano Agueci e Maria Roselli L’oro è da sempre considerato un investimento sicuro; difficile immaginare di perderci, eppure è successo, eccome. Circa 800 persone sparse tra Svizzera, Germania e Austria sono vittime di una truffa in grande stile, che potrebbe causare perdite per 84 milioni di franchi. Al centro del raggiro alcuni personaggi, che avevano come base dei loro traffici il Canton Ticino. E proprio a Sud delle Alpi, a Rancate per la precisione, avrebbe dovuto operare la raffineria che trasformava il metallo grezzo in provenienza dall’Africa. Oro che in Ticino, verosimilmente, non è mai arrivato. Tutti pazzi per l’oro di Claudio Moschin Setacciano i corsi d’acqua della Lombardia e del Piemonte, sanno che quei torrenti sono ricchi di pagliuzze d’oro. Alle falde del Monte Rosa questa pratica era in voga già ai tempi dei romani, ma oggi, con le quotazioni del metallo giallo ai massimi storici, gli appassionati sono in aumento. Per alcuni la “corsa all’oro” è diventata quasi un’attività fissa, mentre le vendite di palette, setacci, assi di lavaggio, sono in crescita. E non manca ovviamente un campionato, con partecipanti che arrivano da tutt’Europa, per incoronare il miglior cercatore d’oro dell’anno. Gli alberghi sull’Everest di Frank Senn e Jacqueline Schwerzmann Salire in cima alla montagna più alta del mondo ormai non è più una cosa che interessa solo gli alpinisti. La schiera dei turisti cresce e con essa le relative offerte; al campo base, invece che dopo diversi giorni a piedi si arriva comodamente in elicottero e una volta sbarcati si trovano stanze con servizi degni di un albergo. Un ambiente per certi versi surreale, raccontato anche da un pilota di elicottero italo-svizzero che trascorre parte dell’anno in Himalaya.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.desc: Gwaii Haanas National Park Reserve and Haida Heritage Site is a national park located on the Queen Charlotte Islands, British Columbia, Canada. programme.title: Storie
programme.desc: A sensorial and poetic journey in Cappadocia, guided by those who cannot see but know how to look deeper. Igor and Barbara, visually impaired, lead us on a unique experience between underground cities, ancient traditions and a spectacular hot air balloon trip. Through their daily gestures and the emotions experienced, we rediscover the beauty of the small things that are often forgotten. A documentary where the gaze becomes listening, speech, touch, scent and memory and the protagonists become narrators of their own world. A documentary by Mirko Aretini / Un viaggio sensoriale e poetico in Cappadocia, guidato da chi non può vedere ma sa guardare più a fondo. Igor e Barbara, ipovedenti, ci conducono in un’esperienza unica tra città sotterranee, antiche tradizioni ed uno spettacolare viaggio in mongolfiera. Attraverso i loro gesti quotidiani e le emozioni vissute, riscopriamo la bellezza delle piccole cose spesso dimenticate. Un documentario dove lo sguardo diventa ascolto, parola, tocco, profumo e memoria e i protagonisti diventano narratori del proprio mondo.Un documentario di Mirko Aretini

programme.title: Niente di nuovo sul Fronte occidentale
programme.desc: Victor Tognola's documentary retraces the events of Ypres, the scene of five decisive battles of the First World War, through period footage, archive materials and interviews with historians and experts. The words of Erich Maria Remarque, survivor of the conflict and author of All Quiet on the Western Front, accompany a journey that connects the memory of the past to the questions of the present. A work that combines historical reconstruction and reflection on the universal meaning of war. / Il documentario di Victor Tognola ripercorre le vicende di Ypres, teatro di cinque battaglie decisive della Prima guerra mondiale, attraverso filmati depoca, materiali darchivio e interviste a storici ed esperti. Le parole di Erich Maria Remarque, sopravvissuto al conflitto e autore di Niente di nuovo sul fronte occidentale, accompagnano un viaggio che collega la memoria del passato alle domande del presente. Unopera che unisce ricostruzione storica e riflessione sul significato universale della guerra.

programme.title: Segni dei tempi
programme.desc: A gunshot, a financial scam. Crimes for which a door closes behind you. It is that of the cantonal prison facilities of Lugano. In the meeting with a prisoner and with those who have now returned to freedom, the search for personal interiority and rebirth. Spiritual assistant Daniele Campoli accompanies us on this journey into human suffering. / Un colpo di pistola, una truffa finanziaria. Reati per i quali dietro a se si chiude una porta. È quella delle strutture carcerarie cantonali di Lugano. Nell’incontro con un detenuto e con chi ora è tornato in libertà la ricerca di un’interiorità personale e di una rinascita. In questo viaggio nella sofferenza umana ci accompagna l’assistente spirituale Daniele Campoli.

programme.title: Paganini
programme.desc: An instrument that crosses genres and is extraordinarily versatile, capable of shining both as a solo voice and as a discreet companion, the piano will be the protagonist of the Paganini episode broadcast on Sunday 19 October at 10.30am on RSI LA1. With two different contributions, the program will explore the jazz declination of the instrument, between regional roots and international horizons. The starting point is a significant anniversary: ​​twenty years ago Riccardo Garzoni, one of the greatest Ticino jazz pianists and one of the few to have gained prominence on the international scene, left us prematurely. To remember him, one of his performances recorded for the RSI Nautilus broadcast in 1988 will be shown again, in a trio with drummer Alan Nelson and double bass player Peter Bockius. Of a completely different generation and with a different musical language, Erroll Garner was one of the most famous jazz pianists ever, capable of achieving a notoriety comparable to that of pop and rock stars during his lifetime. His story was recently told by the Swiss director Georges Gachot in the documentary Misty - The story of Erroll Garner: a work which, in addition to enhancing his inventiveness and musical energy, restores the deep and intimate emotions of his private and family experience. - Riccardo Garzoni Trio - Misty - The story of Erroll Garner / Strumento trasversale ai generi e straordinariamente versatile, capace di brillare sia come voce solista sia come compagno discreto, il pianoforte sarà protagonista della puntata di Paganini in onda domenica 19 ottobre alle 10.30 su RSI LA1. Con due diversi contributi, la trasmissione esplorerà la declinazione jazzistica dello strumento, tra radici regionali e orizzonti internazionali. Il punto di partenza è una ricorrenza significativa: ventanni fa ci lasciava prematuramente Riccardo Garzoni, tra i maggiori pianisti jazz ticinesi e tra i pochi ad aver conquistato rilievo anche sulla scena internazionale. Per ricordarlo, verrà riproposta una sua esibizione registrata per la trasmissione RSI Nautilus nel 1988, in trio con il batterista Alan Nelson e il contrabbassista Peter Bockius. Di tuttaltra generazione e con un linguaggio musicale differente, Erroll Garner è stato invece uno dei pianisti jazz più celebri di sempre, capace di raggiungere in vita una notorietà paragonabile a quella delle star del pop e del rock. La sua storia è stata recentemente raccontata dal regista svizzero Georges Gachot nel documentario Misty - La storia di Erroll Garner: un lavoro che, oltre a esaltarne linventiva e lenergia musicale, restituisce le emozioni profonde e intime del suo vissuto privato e famigliare. - Riccardo Garzoni Trio - Misty - La storia di Erroll Garner

programme.title: Abandoned places - Türkiye, Germany and Poland / Luoghi abbandonati - Turchia, Germania e Polonia
programme.desc: This episode begins in a place rich in history: the Turkish village of Savasan on the banks of the Euphrates. Later, we find ourselves in cold Europe, in the abandoned house of a German doctor, and again in Berlin, in the enigmatic Spreepark, an amusement park now conquered by nature. Still enchanted by the first stage, we return to Türkiye, to Kayakoy, a village nestled in the mountains overlooking the Aegean; and again projected into Germany, witnesses of ancient conflicts in an abandoned military garrison. We conclude by painfully remembering the suffering of the Second World War at the Skierniewice railway station in Poland. / Questo episodio inizia in un luogo ricco di storia: il villaggio turco di Savasan sulle rive dellEufrate. In seguito, ci ritroviamo nella fredda Europa, nella casa abbandonata di un medico tedesco, e di nuovo a Berlino, nellenigmatico Spreepark, un parco dei divertimenti ormai conquistato dalla natura. Ancora stregati dalla prima tappa, ritorniamo in Turchia, a Kayakoy, un villaggio immerso tra le montagne che guardano lEgeo; e di nuovo proiettati in Germania, testimoni di antichi conflitti in una guarnigione militare abbandonata. Concludiamo ricordando con dolore le sofferenze della Seconda guerra mondiale alla stazione ferroviaria di Skierniewice, in Polonia.

programme.desc: Jan Vokes (Toni Collette) works as a cleaner and barmaid in a small town in Wales. With very little money and no experience, Jan convinces his neighbors to reduce their meager earnings to breed and raise Dream Alliance, a competition horse, in hopes of competing with horse racing's elite. Despite moments of great difficulty, in which Jan fights with love to support the horse to which she is deeply attached, the passion and commitment of the group are rewarded when Dream begins to climb the rankings with grit and determination, going so far as to race in the most important competitions in which he shows the makings and heart of a true champion. A film full of hope that invites you to pursue your dreams even when they seem unattainable. / Jan Vokes (Toni Collette) lavora come addetta alle pulizie e barista in una piccola città del Galles. Con pochissimi soldi e nessuna esperienza, Jan convince i suoi vicini a ridurre i loro magri guadagni per allevare e far crescere Dream Alliance, un cavallo da competizione, nella speranza di gareggiare con l’elite delle corse ippiche. Nonostante dei momenti di grande difficoltà, in cui Jan si batte con amore per supportare il cavallo a cui è profondamente legata, la passione e l’impegno del gruppo vengono ricompensati quando Dream inizia a scalare le classifiche con grinta e determinazione, arrivando a correre nelle più importanti competizioni in cui mostra la stoffa e il cuore di un vero campione. Un film pieno di speranza che invita a perseguire i propri sogni anche quando sembrano irraggiungibili.

programme.desc: Gebel Barkal, or Pure Mountain, is a relief about 400 kilometers north of Khartoum, in Sudan, on a large bend of the Nile, close to the fourth cataract. Historically it represents the maximum limit of Egyptian penetration towards the south, into the territory of Nubia, around 1450 BC, with the Egyptian pharaoh Thutmose III. In this place the ruler founded the city of Napata which, about 300 years later, became the capital of the independent kingdom of Kush. / Gebel Barkal, o Montagna Pura, è un rilievo a circa 400 chilometri a nord di Khartoum, in Sudan, su una larga ansa del Nilo, a ridosso della quarta cateratta. Rappresenta storicamente il limite massimo della penetrazione egizia verso il sud, nel territorio della Nubia, verso il 1450 a.C., con il faraone egiziano Thutmose III. In questo luogo il sovrano fondò la città di Napata che, circa 300 anni dopo, divenne capitale del regno indipendente di Kush.

programme.title: Les Chapardeurs
programme.sub-title: Ludo's Crazy Day / La Folle journee de Ludo
programme.desc: With Marie and Tom gone, Ludo sleeping all morning, the Thieves decide to go pilfering in broad daylight, thinking they will be safe. But Ludo gets up earlier than expected and starts working out. Arrietty, on a mission in the bathroom, drops the soap which runs onto the landing. Bad luck, Ludo steps on it, falls down the stairs and finds himself on the ground, his back blocked. While the council of Thieves meets to find out whether or not they can help the Zumain, Arrietty, feeling responsible, does not wait and takes Yuna with her to help Ludo, without being seen by him. / Marie et Tom partis, Ludo dormant toute la matinee, les Chapardeurs decident d’aller chaparder en plein jour pensant etre tranquilles. Mais Ludo se lève plus tôt que prevu et se met au sport. Arrietty, en mission dans la salle de bain, fait tomber le savon qui file sur le palier. Pas de chance, Ludo marche dessus, tombe en bas des escaliers et se retrouve au sol, le dos bloque. Alors que le conseil des Chapardeurs se reunit pour savoir s’ils peuvent ou non aider le Zumain, Arrietty, se sentant responsable, n’attend pas et entraine Yuna avec elle pour aider à Ludo, sans etre vues de lui.

programme.title: Les Chapardeurs
programme.sub-title: I saw it all! / Jai tout vu !
programme.desc: Pod gives a repair lesson in the Zumains' kitchen, with Gurnard and Arrietty. While they are about to be spotted by Marie and Tom, Arrietty manages to discreetly signal Tom to turn back with his grandmother. The thieves return home relieved, but aside, Gurnard claims to have seen EVERYTHING and asks Arrietty for services in exchange for her silence. Convinced that Gurnard has discovered the secret of her friendship with Tom, Arrietty panics. But what exactly did Gurnard see? It’s the start of a game of cat and mouse between Arrietty and Gurnard, where true and false secrets will mix… / Pod donne une leçon de reparation dans la cuisine des Zumains, avec Gurnard et Arrietty. Alors qu’ils sont sur le point de se faire reperer par Marie et Tom, Arrietty parvient à faire discrètement signe à Tom pour qu’il rebrousse chemin avec sa grand-mère. Les chapardeurs retournent chez eux soulages, mais à l’ecart, Gurnard pretend avoir TOUT vu et demande à Arrietty des services en echange de son silence. Persuadee que Gurnard a decouvert le secret de son amitie avec Tom, Arrietty s’affole. Mais qu’a vu exactement Gurnard ? C’est le debut d’un jeu de chat et de souris entre Arrietty et Gurnard, où se meleront vrais et faux secrets…

programme.title: Les Chapardeurs
programme.sub-title: Sewn with white thread / Cousu de fil blanc
programme.desc: While going to pilfer an object, Gurnard damages a sofa cushion. Marie punishes Tom and Ludo, thinking they are responsible. Arrietty, for her part, confronts Gurnard, accusing him of being a saboteur. The Davenports, upset by Arrietty's accusations, decide to go and repair Gurnard's stupidity. But Tom and Arrietty had the same idea... And no luck, it's exactly the evening when Marie and Ludo are overcome by insomnia! The repair mission turns out to be more complicated than expected! / En allant chaparder un objet, Gurnard abîme un coussin du canape. Marie punit Tom et Ludo, les pensant responsables. Arrietty, de son côte, confronte Gurnard lui reprochant d’etre un saboteur. Les Davenport, vexes par les accusations d’Arrietty, decident d’aller reparer la betise de Gurnard. Mais Tom et Arrietty ont eu la meme idee... Et pas de bol, c’est pile le soir où Marie et Ludo sont pris d’insomnie ! La mission reparation s’avère plus compliquee que prevue !

Et c’est comme ça qu’elle se retrouve seule à bord du Calypso pendant une de leur mission. Mais comme les choses ne se deroulent pas comme prevu, c’est elle qui va devoir sauver tout le monde.

programme.title: Big Blue
programme.desc: Wanting to strengthen team spirit within the Cyclone Unit, Plink and Krill are swallowed by a Kraken. Lettie fait tout ce qu’elle peut pour les sauver, mais Leo n’arrete pas de la deconcentrer avec sa guitare. programme.title: Big Blue
programme.desc: The Calypso crew has always relied on teamwork to get by, but when Mira Cristalline steals missions from them and succeeds before Lettie and her crew can intervene, the captain decides to take matters into her own hands. / L’equipage du Calypso a toujours compte sur le travail d’equipe pour s’en sortir, mais quand Mira Cristalline leur vole des missions et les reussit avant meme que Lettie et son equipage ne puissent intervenir, la capitaine decide de prendre les choses en main.

programme.title: Abominable et la cite invisible

programme.title: Abominable et la cite invisible

programme.title: The doc and the veto / La doc et le veto
programme.desc: In Valerande, breeders are worried about the actions of vultures (a species reintroduced since the 1960s for rendering dead animals), which according to them have become too numerous and are attacking their healthy animals. programme.title: A word to the wise - Sign / A bon entendeur - Signe
programme.sub-title: Change your decor like your shirt? - Sign / Changer de deco comme de chemise ? - Signe
programme.desc: “Fast deco” brands like HandM Home, Zara Home or Søstrene Grene have been flourishing in our city centers for several years. Their objective: to encourage us to constantly renew our interiors, to the rhythm of trends or the seasons. But behind these fashionable and inexpensive vases, candlesticks and baskets, what is the real cost of this decorative frenzy? “À bon entendeur” takes you behind the scenes of this booming market in Switzerland, where the decor is inspired by the codes of fast fashion to seduce us. Between temptation, pleasure and ecological impact, should we really succumb to fast decor? Decoding of this phenomenon in this broadcast. / Les enseignes de «fast deco» comme HandM Home, Zara Home ou Søstrene Grene fleurissent depuis quelques annees dans nos centres-villes. Leur objectif: nous inciter à renouveler sans cesse nos interieurs, au rythme des tendances ou des saisons. Mais derrière ces vases, bougeoirs et paniers à la mode et à petits prix, quel est le vrai coût de cette frenesie decorative? «À bon entendeur» vous emmène dans les coulisses de ce marche en plein boom en Suisse, où la deco s’inspire des codes de la fast fashion pour nous seduire. Entre tentation, plaisir et impact ecologique, faut-il vraiment succomber à la fast deco? Decodage de ce phenomène dans cette emission.

programme.title: Mama For Ever
programme.sub-title: My mother is white and I have black skin / Ma mère est blanche et moi j’ai la peau noire
programme.desc: Withney Toyloy has the distinction of being a mixed race child. His mother is white, of Swiss origin, and his father is black, Afro-American. When she was little, she looked with envy at her mother's straight hair and dreamed of being able to do her hair as quickly as her. The texture of her hair and the color of her skin caused her to be the victim of racism at school but also afterwards, when in 2008 she was elected Miss Switzerland. Today Withney is a woman who takes responsibility, she fights against ordinary racism. It even happens that she has to explain to her white mother that racist remarks can arise at any time, even sometimes without the person expressing them being aware of it. Cecile is the mother of 3 mixed race girls. Their dad is Senegalese. The 3 children were born with black skin, which differentiates them from their mother who has white skin. This physical difference is a topic of conversation at home. The little ones would like to be more like their mother. But it is in the street that this difference between mother and daughters is most intriguing. It is not uncommon for Cecile to face inquisitive questions from intriguing passers-by. That a white woman can have dark-skinned biological children remains a matter of misplaced curiosity. Whitney and Cecile don't know each other. Mama Forever will provoke the meeting. / Withney Toyloy a la particularite d’etre une enfant metisse. Sa mère est blanche, suissesse d’origine, et son père est noir afro-americain. Petite, elle a regarde avec envie les cheveux lisses de sa maman et revait de pouvoir se coiffer aussi rapidement qu’elle. La texture de ses cheveux et la couleur de sa peau lui ont d’ailleurs valu d’etre la victime de racisme à l’ecole mais, après aussi, lorsque en 2008 elle est elue Miss Suisse. Aujourd’hui Withney est une femme qui s’assume, elle lutte contre le racisme ordinaire. Il arrive meme qu’elle doive expliquer à sa maman blanche que des propos racistes peuvent surgir à tout moment, meme parfois sans que la personne qui les expriment en aie conscience. Cecile est la maman de 3 filles metis. Leur papa est Senegalais. Les 3 enfants sont nees avec la peau noir, ce qui les differencie de leur maman qui, elle, a la peau blanche. Cette difference physique est un sujet de conversation à la maison. Les petites auraient souhaiter ressembler d’avantage à leur mère. Mais, c’est dans la rue que cette difference entre la mère et les filles intriguent le plus. Il n’est pas rare que Cecile doivent faire face à des questions inquisitrices de passants intrigues. Qu’une femme blanche puisse avoir des enfants biologiques à la peau foncee reste un sujet de curiosite mal placee. Withney et Cecile ne se connaissent pas. Mama Forever va provoquer la rencontre.

programme.title: Temps present
programme.desc: Travelers, the fight for places: Dozens of Traveler caravans blocked on the highway in Saint-Maurice by the Valais police: the image caused a stir and illustrates the tensions between nomadic populations and the Swiss municipal and cantonal authorities. Even the Yeniche community, although recognized as a national minority, struggles to find parking spaces as the prejudices against them are still tenacious. How to live as a nomad in a country of sedentary people? Temps Present went to meet traveling people. / Gens du voyage, la lutte des places: Des dizaines de caravanes de gens du voyage bloquees sur l’autoroute à Saint-Maurice par la police valaisanne : l’image a fait grand bruit et illustre les crispations entre les populations nomades et les autorites communales et cantonales suisses. Meme la communaute yeniche, pourtant reconnue comme minorite nationale, peine à trouver des places de stationnement tant les prejuges à leur encontre sont encore tenaces. Comment vivre en nomade dans un pays de sedentaires ? Temps Present est alle à la rencontre des gens du voyages.

programme.title: Fast and Furious
programme.desc: Dominic Toretto, an ex-prisoner, reigns, every night, on the streets of Los Angeles at the head of a band of faithful, Letty, Vince, Jesse, Leon and his sister Mia Toretto, who share his taste for risk, his passion for speed and his worship of sports cars launched at more than 250 km/h in violent urban rodeos. His days are devoted to tinkering with and revamping high-end models, making them ever more efficient and more eye-catching, and organizing illicit contests where numerous candidates compete mercilessly under the loving gaze of their groupies. Following several truck attacks by thieves operating in sports cars, the Los Angeles police decided to investigate the street racer scene. Brian OConner, a young police officer, is then responsible for infiltrating Toretto's gang, which is, with that of his rival Johnny Tran, at the forefront of suspects. But to be able to be part of Toretto's gang, the policeman must undergo initiation tests. Once these are successful, he discovers that the world of cars and the night attracts him dangerously... / Dominic Toretto, un ex-prisonnier, règne, chaque nuit, sur les rues de Los Angeles à la tete dune bande de fidèles, Letty, Vince, Jesse, Leon et sa sœur Mia Toretto, qui partagent son goût du risque, sa passion de la vitesse et son culte des voitures de sport lancees à plus de 250 km/h dans de violents rodeos urbains. Ses journees sont consacrees à bricoler et à relooker des modèles haut de gamme, à les rendre toujours plus performants et plus voyants, à organiser des joutes illicites où de nombreux candidats saffrontent sans merci sous le regard enamoure de leurs groupies. Suite à plusieurs attaques de camions par des voleurs operant en voitures de sport, la police de Los Angeles decide denqueter sur le milieu des street racers. Brian OConner, un jeune policier, est alors charge dinfiltrer la bande de Toretto, qui figure, avec celle de son rival Johnny Tran, au premier rang des suspects. Mais pour pouvoir faire partie de la bande de Toretto, le policier doit subir des epreuves dinitiation. Une fois celles-ci reussies, il decouvre que le monde des voitures et de la nuit lattire dangereusement...

programme.title: Dirty jobs - work that no one wants to do / Dirty Jobs - Arbeit, die keiner machen will
programme.desc: Work where others vacation! Despite the best omens, Mike Rowe had a bad suspicion shortly before his departure for Hawaii: Maybe there is a catch to the supposed dream job in the holiday paradise, barely five minutes from the white sandy beach? And extreme jobber Mike is unfortunately right. The new challenge is really tough. Even during the briefing, the tough guy from Baltimore starts sweating in fear, and his cameraman resigns - for the first time in the history of "Dirty Jobs". But who could blame him, because crawling around on the facade of a skyscraper at a height of 120 meters is really not for everyone. / Arbeiten, wo andere Urlaub machen! Trotz allerbester Vorzeichen beschleicht Mike Rowe kurz vor seiner Abreise nach Hawaii eine bose Ahnung: Vielleicht ist an dem vermeintlichen Traumjob im Urlaubsparadies, kaum funf Minuten vom weissen Sandstrand entfernt, ja doch ein Haken? Und Extrem-Jobber Mike soll leider Recht behalten. Die neue Herausforderung hat es wirklich in sich. Schon bei der Einweisung treibt es dem hart gesottenen Burschen aus Baltimore den Angstschweiss auf die Stirn, und sein Kameramann quittiert - zum ersten Mal in der Geschichte von „Schmutzige Jobs“ - den Dienst. Doch wer konnte es ihm verdenken, denn in 120 Metern Hohe an der Fassade eines Wolkenkratzers herumzukrabbeln, ist wirklich nicht jedermanns Sache.

programme.title: Dirty jobs - work that no one wants to do / Dirty Jobs - Arbeit, die keiner machen will
programme.desc: Regardless of whether it is an LCD television, a curling iron, a games console, a navigation device, a computer or a mobile phone, for most people everyday life is unthinkable without the technical achievements of modern times. And because it should always be the coolest, newest gadgets with which we communicate, dress up or pass the time, the mountains of electronic waste around the world are getting bigger and bigger. Since this “e-waste” is far too valuable to put into the scrap press and also contains tons of dangerous pollutants, someone has to be very careful about its disposal. Mike Rowe shows how to do it right in this episode of “Dirty Jobs” in Roseville, California. / Egal ob LCD-Fernseher, Lockenstab, Spielkonsole, Navigationsgerat, Computer oder Mobiltelefon, fur die meisten Menschen ist ein Alltag ohne die technischen Errungenschaften der Neuzeit undenkbar. Und weil es auch immer die tollsten, neuesten Gadgets sein sollten, mit denen wir kommunizieren, uns aufstylen oder die Zeit vertreiben, werden die Berge an elektronischem Abfall weltweit immer riesiger. Da dieser „E-Mull“ viel zu wertvoll ist, um ihn in die Schrottpresse zu stecken, und ausserdem haufenweise gefahrliche Schadstoffe enthalt, muss sich jemand sehr gewissenhaft um die Entsorgung kummern. Wie’s richtig geht, zeigt Mike Rowe in dieser Episode von „Schmutzige Jobs“ in Roseville, Kalifornien.

programme.desc: We explore Switzerland from above. programme.title: The Beckenbauer - pools of superlatives / Die Beckenbauer - Pools der Superlative
programme.desc: Florida limestone and sand on the bottom: Lucas Congdon and his team are designing a bathing landscape with ocean flair for their customers in the historic fishing village of Cortez on the Gulf of Mexico. Craig and Cat Scherer bought a dream home there. Their new pool has space for up to 20 people - without it being crowded. The couple can celebrate ultra-cool parties there in the future. The absolute eye-catcher of the construction is a rock-water wall. There are also seating areas with massage jets. / Florida-Kalkstein und Sand auf dem Grund: Lucas Congdon und sein Team entwerfen fur ihre Kundschaft im historischen Fischerdorf Cortez am Golf von Mexiko eine Badelandschaft mit Ozean-Flair. Dort haben sich Craig und Cat Scherer ein Traumhaus gekauft. In ihrem neuen Pool haben bis zu 20 Leute Platz - ohne, dass es eng wird. Dort kann das Paar zukunftig ultracoole Partys feiern. Absoluter Blickfang der Konstruktion ist eine Fels-Wasserwand. AuSSerdem gibt es Sitzgelegenheiten mit Massagedusen.

programme.title: Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: Big, bigger, biggest! Commercially available indoor aquariums are also nice, but Wayde King and his partner Brett Raymer have little to do with 10 liter tanks. Her specialty is breathtaking underwater worlds! From the octagonal eco-system with morays and stingrays to the telephone booth aquarium to the shark tank for the doctor's office: there is almost no idea that the boys don't dare to try. Accordingly, the motto of the two New Yorkers is: What others dream of, we put into practice! And their super aquariums are not only extremely popular with the underwater inhabitants, but also with the public. Wherever Brett and Wayde present their impressive custom-made designs to the public, people can't help but be amazed / Gross, grosser, am grossten! Handelsubliche Zimmer-Aquarien sind auch nett, doch mit 10 Liter-Becken haben Wayde King und sein Partner Brett Raymer wenig am Hut. Ihr Spezialgebiet sind atemberaubende Unterwasserwelten! Vom achteckigen Öko-System mit Muranen und Stachelrochen uber das Telefonzellen-Aquarium bis zum Haifisch-Tank fur die Arzt-Praxis: Es gibt fast keine Idee, an die sich die Jungs nicht herantrauen.Dementsprechend lautet das Motto der beiden New Yorker: Wovon andere traumen, setzen wir in die Tat um! Und ihre Super-Aquarien gefallen nicht nur den Unterwasser-Bewohnern ausgesprochen gut, sondern auch dem Publikum.Wo immer Brett und Wayde ihrer beeindruckenden Spezialanfertigungen der Öffentlichkeit prasentieren, kommen die Leute aus dem Staunen nicht heraus

programme.title: Die Drei vom Pfandhaus
programme.desc: Someone offers the Harrisons Led Zeppelin vinyl albums for sale. Then Rick looks at an ornate 19th century desk. Together with Corey, he inspects a baseball base that was used in the 2016 World Series. Rick also takes a little trip to see the "object", an obelisk-shaped object depicted on the Led Zeppelin album "Presence". But the current owner doesn't want to part with this rarity. / Jemand bietet den Harrisons Led-Zeppelin-Vinylalben zum Kauf an. Dann sieht sich Rick einen kunstvoll gearbeiteten Schreibtisch aus dem 19. Jahrhundert an. Gemeinsam mit Corey begutachtet er eine Baseball-Base, die in der World Series 2016 benutzt wurde. Ausserdem unternimmt Rick einen kleinen Ausflug, um das „Objekt“ zu sehen, einen obeliskformigen Gegenstand, der auf dem Led-Zeppelin-Album „Presence“ abgebildet ist. Doch der momentane Besitzer will sich nicht von dieser Raritat trennen.

programme.title: Die Drei vom Pfandhaus
programme.desc: Rick and Corey are offered an anti-war speech by Dr. Martin Luther King signed it. Then Rick and Chum look at a remote control boat that is a small version of the boat from a Disney World attraction. Also, someone brings a German medal from World War I to the pawn shop, and Chum looks at a Nikon camera from the 1950s. / Rick and Corey bekommen eine Anti-Kriegs-Rede angeboten, die von Dr. Martin Luther King unterschrieben wurde. Dann sehen sich Rick und Chum ein ferngesteuertes Boot an, das die kleine Ausgabe des Bootes einer Disney-World-Attraktion ist. Ausserdem bringt jemand einen deutschen Orden aus dem Ersten Weltkrieg ins Pfandhaus, und Chum sieht sich eine Nikon-Kamera aus den 1950er-Jahren an.

programme.title: Die Drei vom Pfandhaus
programme.desc: Rick and Chum look at a toy Batman utility belt. Then someone brings a stunning Mosrite guitar to the pawn shop, and Rick continues his hunt for the "item" featured on the cover of the Led Zeppelin album "Presence." When one finally comes to the pawn shop, Rick really wants it. Meanwhile, Corey examines an autograph book signed by 41 comic artists. / Rick und Chum sehen sich einen Spielzeug-Batman-Allzweckgurtel an. Dann bringt jemand eine umwerfende Mosrite-Gitarre ins Pfandhaus, und Rick setzt seine Jagd nach dem „Objekt“ fort, das auf dem Cover des Led-Zeppelin-Albums „Presence“ abgebildet ist. Als endlich eins ins Pfandhaus kommt, will Rick es unbedingt haben. Unterdessen begutachtet Corey ein Autogrammbuch, in dem 41 Comic-Kunstler unterschrieben haben.

programme.title: Die Drei vom Pfandhaus
programme.desc: In Washington D.C. Rick looks at one of the first Jeeps built for use in World War II. While he's in town, he also visits a used bookstore to find out about an ancient alchemy book. Meanwhile, in Las Vegas, Chum looks at a magic lantern, a projection device from the early 20th century. Later, someone brings a pair of pants to the pawn shop that belonged to golfer Payne Stewart. / In Washington D.C. sieht sich Rick einen der ersten Jeeps an, die fur den Einsatz im Zweiten Weltkrieg gebaut wurden. Wahrend er in der Stadt ist, besucht er auch ein Antiquariat, um sich uber ein uraltes Alchemiebuch zu informieren. Chum sieht sich unterdessen in Las Vegas eine Laterna magica an, ein Projektionsgerat aus dem fruhen 20. Jahrhundert. Spater bringt jemand eine Hose ins Pfandhaus, die dem Golfer Payne Stewart gehorte.

programme.title: Die Drei vom Pfandhaus
programme.desc: Rick tries to buy a signed card from President Abraham Lincoln. Corey and Chum consider purchasing a golf club shaft designed specifically for Bill Clinton, until they learn that he may never have used it. Rick examines a personal check signed by President James Madison and a pattern for an antique flag press. / Rick versucht, eine signierte Karte von Prasident Abraham Lincoln zu kaufen. Corey und Chum denken daruber nach, einen Golfschlagerschaft anzukaufen, der speziell fur Bill Clinton entworfen wurde, bis sie erfahren, dass er ihn vielleicht nie benutzt hat. Rick begutachtet einen personlichen Scheck, der von Prasident James Madison unterzeichnet wurde, sowie ein Muster fur eine antike Flaggenpresse.

programme.title: Die Drei vom Pfandhaus
programme.desc: Rick is interested in a sword with an attached pistol from the 18th century. Then a portrait of legendary actor John Barrymore is brought to the pawn shop. Meanwhile, Corey examines a 1969 Harley. / Rick interessiert sich fur ein Schwert mit einer angebauten Pistole aus dem 18. Jahrhundert. programme.title: Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: Big, bigger, biggest! Commercially available indoor aquariums are also nice, but Wayde King and his partner Brett Raymer have little to do with 10 liter tanks. Her specialty is breathtaking underwater worlds! From the octagonal eco-system with morays and stingrays to the telephone booth aquarium to the shark tank for the doctor's office: there is almost no idea that the boys don't dare to try. Accordingly, the motto of the two New Yorkers is: What others dream of, we put into practice! And their super aquariums are not only extremely popular with the underwater inhabitants, but also with the public. Wherever Brett and Wayde present their impressive custom-made designs to the public, people can't help but be amazed / Gross, grosser, am grossten! Handelsubliche Zimmer-Aquarien sind auch nett, doch mit 10 Liter-Becken haben Wayde King und sein Partner Brett Raymer wenig am Hut. Ihr Spezialgebiet sind atemberaubende Unterwasserwelten! Vom achteckigen Öko-System mit Muranen und Stachelrochen uber das Telefonzellen-Aquarium bis zum Haifisch-Tank fur die Arzt-Praxis: Es gibt fast keine Idee, an die sich die Jungs nicht herantrauen.Dementsprechend lautet das Motto der beiden New Yorker: Wovon andere traumen, setzen wir in die Tat um! Und ihre Super-Aquarien gefallen nicht nur den Unterwasser-Bewohnern ausgesprochen gut, sondern auch dem Publikum.Wo immer Brett und Wayde ihrer beeindruckenden Spezialanfertigungen der Öffentlichkeit prasentieren, kommen die Leute aus dem Staunen nicht heraus

programme.title: Mountain Life - dream home wanted / Mountain Life - Traumhaus gesucht
programme.desc: From the forested peaks of the Blue Ridge Mountains in the eastern Appalachians to Bald Mountain with its magnificent alpine sports, the high mountain village of Midway in Utah and the picturesque peaks of the Rockies to Hawaii's tropical Mauna Loa: There are numerous remote mountain towns in the United States that hardly anyone knows about. They are the perfect retreat for stressed city dwellers and exhausted families fleeing traffic chaos, hustle and bustle and pollution. And just as the mountain destinations are different, the properties are also different, because, depending on budgets and availability, there is almost everything - from a rustic log cabin with a wood stove to a bamboo bungalow with a view of the volcano to a fully glazed design property with a private spa. The documentary series follows mountain fans on their search for their dream home. / Von den bewaldeten Bergkuppen der Blue Ridge Mountains im Osten der Appalachen uber Bald Mountain mit seinen grandiosen Alpinsportmoglichkeiten, das Hochgebirgsdorf Midway in Utah und die malerischen Gipfel der Rockies bis zu Hawaiis tropischem Mauna Loa: In den Vereinigten Staaten gibt es zahlreiche abgelegene Gebirgsorte, die kaum jemand kennt. Sie sind der perfekte Ruckzugsort fur gestresste Stadter und erschopfte Familien, die vor Verkehrschaos, Hektik und Umweltverschmutzung fluchten. Und so unterschiedlich die Mountain-Destinationen sind, so verschieden sind auch die Immobilien, denn, abhangig von Budgets und Verfugbarkeit gibt es fast alles - von der rustikalen Blockhutte mit Holzofen uber den Bambus-Bungalow mit Vulkanblick bis hin zum vollverglasten Designobjekt mit privatem Spa. Die Doku-Serie begleitet Berg-Fans bei ihrer Suche nach dem Traumhaus.

programme.title: Mountain Men - Wilderness Survival / Mountain Men - Überleben in der Wildnis
programme.desc: Three men have decided to dedicate their lives to simple survival. And it's not as simple as it sounds at first. Without any connection to modern life, they spend their time in the harsh mountain world of America, fighting hungry animals, mudslides, storms and falling trees to get what they need to survive. / Drei Manner haben sich entschieden, ihr Leben dem simplen Überleben zu widmen. Und das nicht so simpel wie es im ersten Moment klingt. Ohne jedwede Verbindung zum modernen Leben verbringen sie ihre Zeit in der rauen Bergwelt Amerikas, kampfen mit hungrigen Tieren, Schlammlawinen, Unwetter und fallenden Baumen um sich selber zu beschaffen, was sie zum Leben brauchen.

programme.title: The Song of Others - Looking for Europe / Das Lied der Anderen - Auf der Suche nach Europa
programme.desc: An essayistic film about Europe's wounds and hopes. In personal encounters, a multi-voiced picture emerges of a continent that stands between memory and the future - and asks how we can learn from history instead of repeating it. / Ein essayistischer Film uber Europas Wunden und Hoffnungen. In personlichen Begegnungen entsteht ein vielstimmiges Bild eines Kontinents, der zwischen Erinnerung und Zukunft steht – und fragt, wie wir aus der Geschichte lernen konnen, statt sie zu wiederholen.

programme.title: Die letzte Metro
programme.desc: A theater troupe rehearses in occupied Paris in 1942. The Jewish director has officially fled, but is living in the theater basement. His wife plays a leading role and officially leads the troupe when she falls in love with the lead actor. SRF 1 is showing the drama on Gerard Depardieu's 75th birthday. / Im besetzten Paris probt 1942 eine Theatertruppe. Der judische Direktor ist offiziell geflohen, haust aber im Theaterkeller. Seine Frau spielt eine Hauptrolle und leitet offiziell die Truppe, als sie sich in den Hauptdarsteller verliebt. SRF 1 zeigt das Drama zum 75. Geburtstag von Gerard Depardieu.

programme.title: Sternstunde Philosophie
programme.sub-title: Violence against women – ignored, tolerated, kept secret? / Gewalt gegen Frauen – ignoriert, geduldet, verschwiegen?
programme.desc: Sad femicide record in Switzerland, monstrous rapes in France: What does this violence say about our society - and what can be done to counter it? / Trauriger Femizid-Rekord in der Schweiz, monstrose Vergewaltigungen in Frankreich: Was sagt diese Gewalt uber unsere Gesellschaft – und was ist ihr entgegenzusetzen?

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut – Huttengeschichten
programme.desc: After a power outage in Zermatt VS and the gondolas coming to a standstill, the hut attendant Felix is ​​even more happy to finally be able to hug his partner. Preparations for the big festival are underway - the Gandegghütte is celebrating its 140th anniversary. Felix also faces an emotional task: handing over the keys to the new caretaker Alessandro. Will Felix come to the Gandegghutte again? The hut warden of the Voralphutte spends most of her time in the kitchen. Petra is a trained chef and thrives on the creative process of cooking. In addition to the usual Hut menus like Rosti, she also serves a Thai curry. Her brother Stefan helps her gain new clients and organizes a trail run through the alpine terrain to the Voralphute. And even more changes, Petra has to say goodbye to her five chickens. Playing theater at the Glecksteinhutte is a tradition. Every year on August 1st, the Sager family organizes this event. Daughter Mena writes the script and assigns the roles. The guests enjoy the entertainment in the hut. The head of the hut, Christoph, is less amused by the unwanted guests who bring their own picnic. Sarah tries to please everyone and has the family organization firmly under control. / Nach einem Stromausfall in Zermatt VS und Stillstand der Gondeln, freut sich der Huttenwart Felix umso mehr, seine Partnerin endlich in die Arme schliessen zu konnen. Die Vorbereitungen fur das grosse Fest laufen – die Gandegghutte feiert ihr 140-Jahre-Jubilaum. Zudem steht Felix vor einer emotionalen Aufgabe: die Schlusselubergabe an den neuen Huttenwart Alessandro. Wird Felix nochmals auf die Gandegghutte kommen?Die meiste Zeit verbringt die Huttenwartin der Voralphutte in der Kuche. Petra ist gelernte Kochin und bluht beim kreativen Prozess des Kochens auf. Nebst den gangigen Huttenmenus wie Rosti gibt es bei ihr auch mal ein Thai-Curry. Ihr Bruder Stefan hilft ihr neue Klientel zu gewinnen und organisiert einen Trail-Run durch das alpine Gelande zur Voralphute. Und noch mehr Veranderungen, Petra muss sich von ihren funf Huhnern verabschieden. Theater spielen auf der Glecksteinhutte hat Tradition. Jedes Jahr am 1. August organisiert die Familie Sager diesen Anlass. Tochter Mena schreibt das Drehbuch und verteilt die Rollen. Die Gaste geniessen die Unterhaltung auf der Hutte. Weniger amusiert ist der Huttenchef Christoph uber die unerwunschten Gaste, die ihr eigenes Picknick mitnehmen. Sarah versucht allen gerecht zu werden und hat die Familienorganisation fest im Griff.

programme.title: Zu Tisch
programme.desc: In central Portugal, two former religious sisters have created a meeting place. The centerpiece is their permaculture garden. Margarida and Eduarda treat the earth gently. Beans, cabbage and pumpkin come to the table in September. The sisters' cuisine is simple but nutritious. They bake bread once a week. / In Zentralportugal haben zwei ehemalige Ordensschwestern einen Ort der Begegnung geschaffen. Das Herzstuck ist ihr Garten fur Permakultur. Margarida und Eduarda gehen schonend mit der Erde um. Im September kommen Bohnen, Kohl und Kurbis auf den Tisch. Die Kuche der Schwestern ist einfach, aber nahrhaft. Einmal in der Woche backen sie Brot.

programme.title: Inga Lindstrom – The House of 1000 Stars / Inga Lindstrom – Das Haus der 1000 Sterne
programme.sub-title: The House of 1000 Stars / Das Haus der 1000 Sterne
programme.desc: Stine Olson, who recently completed her architecture degree, keeps herself afloat with small commissions. Then she happens to meet her childhood friend Jan and his brother Paul. Both want to sell a house on the land that they inherited from their father, and Stine offers her services as an architect. The new buyer wants to have the house torn down. But the house holds a secret that will change everyone. / Stine Olson, die vor Kurzem ihr Architekturstudium abgeschlossen hat, halt sich mit Kleinstauftragen uber Wasser. Da trifft sie zufallig auf ihren Jugendfreund Jan und dessen Bruder Paul. Beide wollen ein Haus auf dem Land verkaufen, das sie von ihrem Vater geerbt haben, und Stine bietet ihre Dienste als Architektin an. Der neue Kaufer will das Haus abreiSSen lassen. Doch das Haus birgt ein Geheimnis, das alle verandern wird.

programme.title: SRF DOK
programme.sub-title: Mutter unter Vertrag – Leihmutterschaft in Georgien
programme.desc: Zhana is carrying a child for a foreign family for the third time - as a surrogate mother in Georgia. She hopes to give her daughter Elene a better life. / Zhana tragt zum dritten Mal ein Kind fur eine fremde Familie aus – als Leihmutter in Georgien. Sie hofft, damit ihrer Tochter Elene ein besseres Leben zu ermoglichen.

programme.title: Mini Tits, Mini Tits / Mini Chuchi, dini Chuchi
programme.desc: On the final day of “Mini Chuchi, dini Chuchi” with the motto “Ricotta”, Carina is at the stove. Will she win the week with her ricotta tomatoes and fried potatoes? / Am Finaltag bei «Mini Chuchi, dini Chuchi» mit dem Motto «Ricotta» steht Carina am Herd. Die 20-jahrige BWL-Studentin liebt Hindernislaufe, weil sie sich selbst gerne fordert. Auch in der Kuche gibt sie Gas. Holt sie sich mit ihren Ricotta-Tomaten und Bratkartoffeln den Wochensieg?

programme.title: In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: Dr. Kaminski visits Vera Bader at the dementia farm and meets Thea Klausen, Vera's niece. She intends to report him because of Vera's money. When Kaminski sees how well Vera and Thea are doing, he agrees to pay Thea the money to convert her apartment to make it suitable for care. Shortly afterwards, Thea and Vera are admitted to the emergency room and Kaminski begins to have doubts. / Dr. Kaminski besucht Vera Bader auf dem Demenzbauernhof und trifft dort auf Thea Klausen, Veras Nichte. Diese beabsichtigt, ihn wegen Veras Geld anzuzeigen. Als Kaminski sieht, wie gut es Vera mit Thea geht, stimmt er zu, Thea das Geld fur den pflegegerechten Umbau ihrer Wohnung auszuzahlen. Kurz darauf werden Thea und Vera in die Notaufnahme eingeliefert und Kaminski bekommt Zweifel.

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: Lorenz Graf caught the cooking bug in high school cooking school and was constantly taking on new cooking challenges. When he cooks today, it's elaborate and sophisticated, but only when he has time and friends are at the table. The single hardly cooks for himself; during the week, his job as a computer scientist and his hobby - art - leave him too little scope for cooking. Luckily, there are many fine restaurants in the city, fast take-away shops and the gas station shop opposite his apartment. One of the big challenges for Lorenz Graf in the cooking competition is the space in his small kitchen: Once again, the amateur chef realizes how little counter space he has and how urgently he needs a dishwasher. / In der Kochschule der Oberstufe ist Lorenz Graf mit dem Kochvirus angesteckt worden und hat sich standig neuen Kochherausforderungen gestellt. Wenn er heute kocht, dann aufwendig und raffiniert, allerdings nur wenn er Zeit hat und Freunde mit am Tisch sitzen. Fur sich alleine kocht der Single kaum, unter der Woche lassen ihm sein Job als Informatiker und sein Hobby - die Kunst - zu wenig Spielraum fur das Kochen. Zum Gluck gibt es in der Stadt viele feine Restaurants, schnelle Take-away-Buden und den Tankstellenshop gegenuber seiner Wohnung.Eine grosse Herausforderung beim Kochwettbewerb sind fur Lorenz Graf unter anderem die Platzverhaltnisse in seiner kleinen Kuche: Einmal mehr wird dem Hobbykoch bewusst, wie wenig Ablageflache er hat, und wie dringend er einen Geschirrspuler brauchte.

programme.title: Wilde Eltern
programme.desc: Reproduction is the key to species preservation. Therefore, the goal of all animal parents is to give their offspring a good start in life. But before the birth, the first step is to find a partner, mating and building a nest. Mammals, insects and birds accomplish these tasks in very different ways. / Fortpflanzung ist der Schlussel zur Arterhaltung. Daher ist das Ziel aller Tiereltern, dem Nachwuchs einen guten Start ins Leben zu ermoglichen. Doch bis zur Geburt stehen erst einmal Partnersuche, Paarung und Nestbau an. Diese Aufgaben bewaltigen Saugetiere, Insekten oder Vogel auf ganz unterschiedliche Weise.

programme.title: Spring – When time stands still / Fruhling – Wenn die Zeit stehen bleibt
programme.desc: Friederike Neumeister cannot come to terms with the disappearance of her daughter eight years earlier. Like every year, she celebrates the missing Marie's birthday together with her son Theo. / Friederike Neumeister kann mit dem Verschwinden ihrer Tochter acht Jahre zuvor nicht abschlieSSen. Wie jedes Jahr feiert sie gemeinsam mit Sohn Theo den Geburtstag der vermissten Marie.

programme.title: Notrufzentrale
programme.desc: The emergency call center is busy: a baby is foaming at the mouth and a senior citizen is attacked. Rega has a lot to do: a delta glider crashes and an alpinist falls into a crevasse. In Sicilian cuisine, the oil is used for typical dishes such as caponata, arancini and cassata al forno. / Die Bruder Andrea und Salvatore Manno produzieren in Westsizilien aromatisches Olivenol. Jedes Jahr degustieren sie den neuen Jahrgang und versuchen, den Geschmack in Worte zu fassen. In der sizilianischen Kuche verwendet man das Öl fur typische Gerichte wie Caponata, Arancini und Cassata al Forno.

programme.title: Spring – When time stands still / Fruhling – Wenn die Zeit stehen bleibt
programme.desc: Friederike Neumeister cannot come to terms with the disappearance of her daughter eight years earlier. Like every year, she celebrates the missing Marie's birthday together with her son Theo. / Friederike Neumeister kann mit dem Verschwinden ihrer Tochter acht Jahre zuvor nicht abschlieSSen. Wie jedes Jahr feiert sie gemeinsam mit Sohn Theo den Geburtstag der vermissten Marie.

programme.title: Eco Talk
programme.sub-title: Welchen Stempel wollen Sie Postfinance aufdrucken, Herr Rothlisberger?
programme.desc: «Eco Talk» reflektiert und vertieft die wirtschaftliche und berufliche Wirklichkeit eines wirtschaftsinteressierten Publikums mit uberraschenden Gesprachsgasten.Der Talk bildet das gesamte Spektrum der Wirtschaftswelt mit spannenden Personlichkeiten ab. Kurze Zuspielelemente animieren das Gesprach. Das Publikum wird uber Social Media eingebunden.

programme.title: Puls
programme.sub-title: Mental health on the plate – How food influences the psyche / Mental Health auf dem Teller – Wie Essen die Psyche beeinflusst
programme.desc: Which foods make our memory strong and the brain fit? Science continues to discover amazing connections between what we eat and our psyche. Can our diet relieve stress, anxiety and even depression? / Welche Lebensmittel machen unser Gedachtnis stark und das Gehirn fit? Die Wissenschaft entdeckt immer wieder erstaunliche Zusammenhange zwischen dem, was wir essen und unserer Psyche. Kann unsere Ernahrung Stress, Angst und sogar Depressionen lindern?

programme.title: Mini Tits, Mini Tits / Mini Chuchi, dini Chuchi
programme.desc: Gina from Sigigen in the canton of Lucerne starts the week. The 23-year-old actually never wanted a dog until the Bernese Mountain Dog Kira came into her life. The two have been inseparable for five years. Gina will serve her guests a chicken ragout with peanut sauce in a paprika chorbli with rice. / Den Wochenstart macht Gina aus Sigigen im Kanton Luzern. Eigentlich wollte die 23-Jahrige nie einen Hund, bis die Berner Sennenhundin Kira in ihr Leben kam. Seit funf Jahren sind die beiden unzertrennlich. Ihren Gasten wird Gina ein Pouletragout an Erdnuss-Sauce im Paprikachorbli mit Reis servieren.

programme.title: Tagesschau kompakt
programme.desc: “Tagesschau compact” reports briefly and succinctly on the most important topics of the day from politics, business, culture and sport. / «Tagesschau kompakt» berichtet kurz und pragnant uber die wichtigsten Themen des Tages aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Kultur und Sport.

programme.desc: “SRF Meteo” reports on the weather in Switzerland and its regions several times a day. programme.title: In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: Roofer Esther Molsberg falls into Kathrin Globisch's garden during the final inspection of the roof. Despite severe injuries, Philipp Brentano initially decided against amputating his lower leg. Esther's husband Arno supports his wife, who is very afraid of losing her leg. But the conflict between the two, because Esther has recently become the boss of the company where Arno also works, quickly boils up again. / Dachdeckerin Esther Molsberg sturzt bei der Endabnahme des Dachs in Kathrin Globischs Garten. Philipp Brentano entscheidet sich trotz starker Verletzungen zunachst gegen die Amputation des Unterschenkels. Esthers Mann Arno fangt seine Frau, die groSSe Angst hat, ihr Bein zu verlieren, auf. Doch der Konflikt zwischen beiden, weil Esther seit kurzem Chefin der Firma ist, in der auch Arno arbeitet, kocht schnell wieder hoch.

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: The third competition dinner will take place in Gunten on Lake Thun. Host Stephan JJ. Maeder is a hotelier and a passionate cook in his free time. He experimented with soups as a child and over time his cooking skills have refined. He serves primarily regional and seasonal ingredients. His menu consists of traditional dishes from the Bernese Oberland, which he interprets in a modern way. He tries to make sausages and impress his competitors with a sausage machine that is over a hundred years old. His kitchen is a dream for creative cooking experiments. There is enough space for the busy amateur chef. “JJ” as he is called by his good friends, cooks some of his dishes for the starter, the main course and the dessert at the same time. “Preparation is everything” is his motto. However, since each course consists of at least three dishes, there is a high risk that guests will be overwhelmed by this variety. / Das dritte Wettbewerbsessen findet in Gunten am Thunersee statt. Gastgeber Stephan JJ. Maeder ist Hotelier und in seiner Freizeit ein leidenschaftlicher Koch. Schon als Kind hat er mit Suppen experimentiert, und im Laufe der Zeit haben sich seine Kochkunste verfeinert. Bei ihm auf den Tisch kommen vorwiegend regionale und saisonale Zutaten. Sein Menu setzt sich aus traditionellen Gerichten aus dem Berner Oberland zusammen, die er aber modern interpretiert. Mit einer uber hundert Jahre alten Wurstmaschine versucht er zu wursten und damit seine Konkurrenten zu beeindrucken. Seine Kuche ist ein Traum fur kreative Kochexperimente. Platz fur den wirbligen Hobbykoch ist genugend vorhanden. «JJ» wie er von seinen guten Freunden genannt wird, kocht einige seiner Gerichte fur die Vorspeise, den Hauptgang und das Dessert gleichzeitig. «Vorbereitung ist alles», ist sein Motto. Da aber jeder Gang aus mindestens drei Gerichten besteht, ist die Gefahr gross, dass seine Gaste von dieser Vielfalt uberfordert sind.

programme.title: GESUNDHEITHEUTE – Die Gesundheitssendung mit Dr. Jeanne Furst
programme.desc: The thought of group therapy makes many people uneasy. You have inhibitions about opening up to others. But it is precisely the exchange with other affected people that is very helpful. The show also presents a promising therapeutic approach against severe migraines. / Der Gedanke an eine Gruppentherapie lost bei vielen Menschen Unbehagen aus. Sie haben Hemmungen, sich vor anderen zu offnen. Doch gerade der Austausch mit anderen Betroffenen ist sehr hilfreich. Zudem stellt die Sendung einen vielversprechenden Therapieansatz gegen schwere Migrane vor.

programme.title: Rosamunde Pilcher
programme.desc: Over the course of a year, the Combe family finds itself in a threatening crisis. Stephen Combe tries to drive his ex-wife Julia away from Endellion. But Julia can count on the support of her former brother-in-law Charles and wins the affection of her granddaughter Abby. Pilcher romance. / Im Verlauf eines Jahres gerat die Familie Combe in eine bedrohliche Krise. Stephen Combe versucht, seine Ex-Frau Julia von Endellion zu vertreiben. Aber Julia kann auf die Unterstutzung ihres fruheren Schwagers Charles zahlen und gewinnt die Zuneigung ihrer Enkelin Abby. Pilcher-Romanze.

programme.title: Guetnachtgschichtli
programme.desc: Gigglibug wants to find a mountain high enough for the cool Hasli to fit his great longboard, but the Hasli almost can't admit that he's scared. / Gigglibug mochte fur das coole Hasli einen Berg finden, der hoch genug ist fur sein tolles Longboard nur kann das Hasli fast nicht zugeben, dass es Angst hat.

programme.title: Jenseits der Spree
programme.sub-title: In the land of dead dreams / Im Land der toten Traume
programme.desc: Bosnian citizen Adnan Tomić is found dead in his car in Copenick. Carbon monoxide poisoning. Suicide? Murder? Robert and Mavi investigate a tricky case. / In Kopenick wird der bosnische Staatsburger Adnan Tomić tot in seinem Auto gefunden. Kohlenmonoxidvergiftung. Suizid? Mord? Robert und Mavi ermitteln in einem verzwickten Fall.

programme.title: Kassensturz
programme.sub-title: The show about consumption, money and work / Die Sendung uber Konsum, Geld und Arbeit
programme.desc: Swiss dating platforms – millions with lonelinessFunf dating platforms promise love and eroticism to lonely hearts all over Europe. SRF Investigative reveals that the opaque companies are based in the canton of Zug and turn over millions. A self-experiment shows that instead of real contacts and sensual dates, the reporters find fake profiles and sex workers. If you really long for a new relationship, look into the pipes. The State Secretariat for Economic Affairs SECO is of the opinion that what the dating companies do is forbidden. “Dry Bags” test – the laundry usually stays dry. Swiss rivers are so clean that you can confidently jump into the cooling waters. But where should you take your clothes, wallet or beach towel while swimming in the river or on a boat tour? Dry bags are the robust companions for this: they keep all utensils dry, even when swimmers use them as a swimming bag. At least that's what the promises say. “Kassenrutsch” tested nine dry bags both in practice and in the laboratory. Not all products were completely convincing. New broadcast concept from August On June 24, 2025, “Kassenrutsch” will be broadcast live from Studio 8 for the last time. From August 19, 2025, the show will no longer be recorded in the studio, but on site. In the future, the “cash collapse” will be even closer to consumers and strengthen the digital offering. In the last broadcast before the summer break, “Kassenrutsch” looks back on highlights of the studio’s 50-year history. / Schweizer Dating-Plattformen – Millionen mit der EinsamkeitFunf Dating-Plattformen versprechen einsamen Herzen in ganz Europa Liebe und Erotik. SRF Investigativ deckt auf, dass die undurchsichtigen Firmen im Kanton Zug sitzen und Millionen umsetzen. Ein Selbstversuch zeigt: Statt echte Kontakte und sinnliche Dates finden die Reporter Fake-Profile und Sexarbeiterinnen. Wer sich wirklich nach einer neuen Beziehung sehnt, guckt in die Rohre. Das Staatssekretariat fur Wirtschaft SECO ist der Meinung, dass es verboten sei, was die Dating-Firmen machen.Test «Dry Bags» – Die Wasche bleibt meist trockenSchweizer Flusse sind so sauber, dass man getrost den Sprung in die kuhlenden Fluten wagen kann. Doch wohin wahrend dem Fluss-Schwumm oder einer Bootli-Tour mit Kleidern, Portemonnaie oder Badetuch? Dry Bags sind dafur die robusten Begleiter: Sie halten alle Utensilien trocken, sogar wenn Schwimmerinnen und Schwimmer sie als Schwimmsack benutzen. So zumindest die Versprechen. «Kassensturz» hat neun Dry Bags sowohl in der Praxis wie auch im Labor getestet. Nicht alle Produkte konnten vollumfanglich uberzeugen.Neues Sendekonzept ab AugustAm 24. Juni 2025 wird der «Kassensturz» zum letzten Mal live aus dem Studio 8 gesendet. Ab dem 19. August 2025 wird die Sendung nicht mehr im Studio, sondern vor Ort aufgezeichnet. So ist der «Kassensturz» kunftig noch naher bei den Konsumentinnen und Konsumenten und starkt das digitale Angebot. In der letzten Sendung vor der Sommerpause blickt «Kassensturz» zuruck auf Highlights der 50-jahrigen Studio-Geschichte.

programme.title: Club: America, let’s talk
programme.sub-title: Trump's economic deals - who pays the price? / Trumps Wirtschaftsdeals – wer zahlt den Preis?
programme.desc: Barbara Luthi und Peter Duggeli zeigen, wie Trumps Entscheidungen das wirtschaftliche und soziale Gefuge der USA umkrempeln. Zudem werden die Auswirkungen auf die Unternehmen und die US-Konsumentinnen und -konsumenten beleuchtet. Barbara Luthi und Peter Duggeli reden auch mit Unterstutzern von Trumps Zollpolitik und zeigen auf, wo seine Politik der Re-Industrialisierung Fruchte tragen kann. Ebenfalls Thema sind die kontroversen Kurzungen bei Sozialprogrammen sowie der Krankenversicherung.Ein «Club» uber Burgerinnen und Burger, Unternehmer und Wirtschaftsexpertinnen, die Trumps Versprechen, Jobs zuruckzuholen und Amerika umzugestalten, kritisch unter die Lupe nehmen oder mitttragen.

programme.title: Newsflash SRF 1

programme.title: Christine
programme.desc: The fact-based story of Christine, a 1970s TV reporter who struggled with severe depression. Rebecca Hall is at her best in this little-known film gem and portrays the reporter in a disturbing and sensitive way at the same time. / Die auf Tatsachen beruhende Geschichte von Christine, einer TV-Reporterin aus den 1970er-Jahren, die mit einer schweren Depression zu kampfen hatte. Rebecca Hall lauft in dieser wenig bekannten Filmperle zur Hochstform auf und portratiert die Reporterin verstorend und einfuhlsam zugleich.

programme.desc: Over the course of a year, the Combe family finds itself in a threatening crisis. Stephen Combe tries to drive his ex-wife Julia away from Endellion. But Julia can count on the support of her former brother-in-law Charles and wins the affection of her granddaughter Abby. Pilcher romance. / Im Verlauf eines Jahres gerat die Familie Combe in eine bedrohliche Krise. Stephen Combe versucht, seine Ex-Frau Julia von Endellion zu vertreiben. Aber Julia kann auf die Unterstutzung ihres fruheren Schwagers Charles zahlen und gewinnt die Zuneigung ihrer Enkelin Abby. Pilcher-Romanze.

programme.title: Kassensturz
programme.sub-title: The show about consumption, money and work / Die Sendung uber Konsum, Geld und Arbeit
programme.desc: Swiss dating platforms – millions with lonelinessFunf dating platforms promise love and eroticism to lonely hearts all over Europe. SRF Investigative reveals that the opaque companies are based in the canton of Zug and turn over millions. A self-experiment shows that instead of real contacts and sensual dates, the reporters find fake profiles and sex workers. If you really long for a new relationship, look into the pipes. The State Secretariat for Economic Affairs SECO is of the opinion that what the dating companies do is forbidden. “Dry Bags” test – the laundry usually stays dry. Swiss rivers are so clean that you can confidently jump into the cooling waters. But where should you take your clothes, wallet or beach towel while swimming in the river or on a boat tour? Dry bags are the robust companions for this: they keep all utensils dry, even when swimmers use them as a swimming bag. At least that's what the promises say. “Kassenrutsch” tested nine dry bags both in practice and in the laboratory. Not all products were completely convincing. New broadcast concept from August On June 24, 2025, “Kassenrutsch” will be broadcast live from Studio 8 for the last time. From August 19, 2025, the show will no longer be recorded in the studio, but on site. In the future, the “cash collapse” will be even closer to consumers and strengthen the digital offering. In the last broadcast before the summer break, “Kassenrutsch” looks back on highlights of the studio’s 50-year history. / Schweizer Dating-Plattformen – Millionen mit der EinsamkeitFunf Dating-Plattformen versprechen einsamen Herzen in ganz Europa Liebe und Erotik. SRF Investigativ deckt auf, dass die undurchsichtigen Firmen im Kanton Zug sitzen und Millionen umsetzen. Ein Selbstversuch zeigt: Statt echte Kontakte und sinnliche Dates finden die Reporter Fake-Profile und Sexarbeiterinnen. Wer sich wirklich nach einer neuen Beziehung sehnt, guckt in die Rohre. Das Staatssekretariat fur Wirtschaft SECO ist der Meinung, dass es verboten sei, was die Dating-Firmen machen.Test «Dry Bags» – Die Wasche bleibt meist trockenSchweizer Flusse sind so sauber, dass man getrost den Sprung in die kuhlenden Fluten wagen kann. Doch wohin wahrend dem Fluss-Schwumm oder einer Bootli-Tour mit Kleidern, Portemonnaie oder Badetuch? Dry Bags sind dafur die robusten Begleiter: Sie halten alle Utensilien trocken, sogar wenn Schwimmerinnen und Schwimmer sie als Schwimmsack benutzen. So zumindest die Versprechen. «Kassensturz» hat neun Dry Bags sowohl in der Praxis wie auch im Labor getestet. Nicht alle Produkte konnten vollumfanglich uberzeugen.Neues Sendekonzept ab AugustAm 24. Juni 2025 wird der «Kassensturz» zum letzten Mal live aus dem Studio 8 gesendet. Ab dem 19. August 2025 wird die Sendung nicht mehr im Studio, sondern vor Ort aufgezeichnet. So ist der «Kassensturz» kunftig noch naher bei den Konsumentinnen und Konsumenten und starkt das digitale Angebot. In der letzten Sendung vor der Sommerpause blickt «Kassensturz» zuruck auf Highlights der 50-jahrigen Studio-Geschichte.

programme.title: Mini Tits, Mini Tits / Mini Chuchi, dini Chuchi
programme.desc: Gina from Sigigen in the canton of Lucerne starts the week. The 23-year-old actually never wanted a dog until the Bernese Mountain Dog Kira came into her life. The two have been inseparable for five years. Gina will serve her guests a chicken ragout with peanut sauce in a paprika chorbli with rice. / Den Wochenstart macht Gina aus Sigigen im Kanton Luzern. Eigentlich wollte die 23-Jahrige nie einen Hund, bis die Berner Sennenhundin Kira in ihr Leben kam. Seit funf Jahren sind die beiden unzertrennlich. Ihren Gasten wird Gina ein Pouletragout an Erdnuss-Sauce im Paprikachorbli mit Reis servieren.

programme.title: Mini Tits, Mini Tits / Mini Chuchi, dini Chuchi
programme.desc: Things get wild on day 2: Adrian from Schupfheim LU cooks a deer ragout with homemade spaetzli and vegetables for his guests. The 61-year-old has a green thumb, which he lives out in his garden and on the balcony. Many herbs grow there that he can use for his ragout. / An Tag 2 wird es wild: Adrian aus Schupfheim LU kocht fur seine Gaste ein Hirschragout mit hausgemachten Spatzli und Gemuse. Der 61-Jahrige hat einen grunen Daumen, den er in seinem Garten und auf dem Balkon auslebt. Dort wachsen viele Krauter, die er fur sein Ragout brauchen kann.
